96.text: Enes (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Allah (ﷻ) buyurur ki: 'Kulum bana bir karış yaklaşırsa, ben ona bir arşın yaklaşırım. Bana bir arşın yaklaşırsa, ben ona bir kulaç yaklaşırım. Bana yürüyerek gelirse, ben ona koşarak gelirim.'" (Buhârî)
96.commentary: Allah'ın rahmeti ve yakınlığı sonsuzdur. Kulumuz O'na ne kadar yaklaşırsa, O da kuluna daha fazla yaklaşır. Bu, Allah'ın lütuf ve kereminin bir ifadesidir.

97.text: Abdullah bin Abbâs (رضي الله عنهما) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "İki nimet vardır ki insanların çoğu onların kıymetini bilmez: Sağlık ve boş zaman." (Buhârî)
97.commentary: Sağlık ve boş vakit, değeri bilinmeyen iki büyük nimettir. Kişi bu iki nimeti Allah yolunda kullanmalı, gafletle geçirmemelidir.

98.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to engage in namaz at night to such an extent that his feet would swell. I dedi to him:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Why do you do this when Allāh has forgiven all your past and future günahlar?"He cevap verdi:"Should I not be a grateful kul?"(Bukhārī and Müslüman. This is the wording of Bukhārī. A similar narration appears in Bukhārī and Müslüman from Mughīrah ibn Shu'bah.)
98.commentary: An outstanding feature of the blessed life of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was that he would remain awake in the ibadet of bütünāh her night. The Ṣaḥābah and our pious predecessors also consistently engaged in this uygulama. Awakening for optional ibadet during the latter portion of the night has çok sayıda faydalar. Du'ā's are readily accepted during this time and those who do so are more alert and energetic during the day. It is our inanç that bütün the Messengers were sinless. They were pure from bütün major and minor günahlar. In appreciation of this great favour of bütünāh, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) exerted himself in His ibadet. bazı âlimlere göre it is impossible - even for a Messenger - to fulfil the haklar of ibadet and gratitude to bütünāh, bundan dolayı the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and the Messengers regarded this as a deficiency that warranted tövbe.

99.text: When the last ten days of Ramaḍān would begin, Resûlullah (ﷺ) would remain awake at night, awaken his family, strive to the utmost and fasten his loin cloth."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
99.commentary: "He would fasten his loin cloth" demektir ki he remained aloof from conjugal relations with his wives. It could also mean that he would devote himself to ibadetler. Bu hadis bize hatırlatır ki a Muslim should recognise the value of his free time by doing iyilikler, özellikle during Ramaḍān. Tirmidhī reports from Zaynab bint Umm Salamah, "When ten (nights) were left of Ramaḍān, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) would not leave anyone of his household asleep who had the ability to stand in ibadet." He would exert himself more than normal during the last ten nights in order to search for the night of Qadr, which is more virtuous than a thousand months.

100.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A strong mümin is better and more beloved in the sight of Allāh than a weak mümin, although there is good in both of them. Desire whatever could be of benefit to you, seek help from Allāh and do not give up. If anything afflicts you, do not say: 'If I had done that, such and such would have been the outcome.' You should rather say: 'It was destined by Allāh and He does whatever He wills.' 'If' opens the door to Satanic whispers."(Müslüman)
100.commentary: Imām Qurṭubī said that a "güçlü believer" is one who is güçlü in body and soul and who has developed the sağlamlık of purpose to strive in ibadetler gibi ḥaj, ṣawm and encouraging good and forbidding evil. A "güçlü believer", according to Imām Nawawī, is one who has gerçek desire for the ahiret and advances in matters of ibadet. "There is good in her iki of them" demektir ki a güçlü and a zayıf believer her iki have goodness because they have the quality of īmān. The hadis encourages us to be desirous of performing her beneficial iyilik and reinforces the Islāmic concept of striving against the carnal self. Importantly, it highlights the core concept of predestination. A Muslim believes that everything in life is predestined; bu nedenle, barriers and difficulties should not cause one to lose focus. One should accept the decree of bütünāh and persevere by capitalising on the present, as excessive ruminating about the past only leads to regret.

101.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Hell-fire is veiled by desires and Cennet is veiled by hardships."(Bukhārī, Müslüman) Another narration of Müslüman has the word"surrounded"instead of"veiled."Both have the same meaning, namely they are barriers between Hell-fire and Cennet. If a person commits them, he will enter either of them.
101.commentary: "cehennem-fire is veiled by desires" demektir ki one will enter cehennem by engaging in haram ameller gibi consuming liquor, indulging in adultery, fornication, backbiting and fraud. "cennet is veiled by hardships" demektir ki one will not enter cennet except through sacrifice and effort in the form of consistency in ibadet, sabır upon adversity, controlling of anger, exercising merhamet and forbearance, giving in charity, exhibiting iyilik to adversaries and restraining the base desires. In this hadis, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) eloquently explained the nature of cennet and cehennem. He likened hardships to a barrier that cannot be traversed except by adopting the appropriate means and methods. bundan dolayı, one cannot acquire cennet except through difficulty, sacrifice and sabır upon adversity and one cannot gain salvation from cehennem except by restraining one's desires and disciplining the carnal self.

102.text: I offered namaz with Resûlullah (ﷺ) one night and he began by reciting Sûre al-Baqarah. I thought to myself that he would go into rukū' after reciting 100 verses, but he continued reciting. I then thought to myself that he would complete the Sûre in the namaz (two rak'āts), but he continued. I then thought that he would go into rukū' at the end of the Sûre, but he began reciting Sûre al-Nisā' and completed the entire Sûre. He then began reciting Sûre Āl 'Imrān and completed the entire Sûre. His recitation was slow and measured. When he recited a verse containing glorification, he glorified Allāh. When he recited a verse of request, he sordu from Allāh. When he recited a verse seeking refuge, he sought refuge (in Allāh). He then went into rukū' and dedi: 'Subḥāna Rabbiyal 'Aẓīm' (Glory be to my Sustainer, the Mighty). His rukū' was similar to his standing. He then dedi: 'Sami' Allāhu liman ḥamidah' (Allāh hears the one who praises Him). 'Rabbanā lakal ḥamd' (O our Sustainer! All praise is due to You). He then remained standing for a long time, almost as long as his rukū'. He then prostrated and dedi: 'Subḥāna Rabbiyal A'lā' (Glory be to my Sustainer, the Most High). His prostration was almost as long as his standing."(Müslüman)
102.commentary: Bu hadis describes the intensity and zeal of the Messenger of bütünāh's (ﷺ) ibadet. His example should motivate us to strive in the itaat of bütünāh. Through this, we can attain closeness to bütünāh, bağışlanma of our günahlar, entry into cennet, salvation from cehennem, blessings in dünya and other countless rewards. It should also be remembered that the more one engages in ibadet, the greater the pleasure and enjoyment one experiences. The hadis states that the recitation of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was slow and measured; bundan dolayı, it is a Sunnah to recite the Qur'ān slowly, clearly and with the doğru pronunciation.

103.text: I offered namaz with Resûlullah (ﷺ) one night and he remained standing in namaz for so long that I thought of doing something evil."He was sordu:"What did you think of doing?"He cevap verdi:"I thought of sitting down and leaving him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
103.commentary: Bu hadis highlights the sacrifice and effort of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) in ibadet. The Ṣaḥābah tried their utmost to adopt the very same spirit but realized that their efforts were in vain. The ṣalāh referred to here is Tahajjud; bundan dolayı, it was acceptable to prolong it. In normal circumstances, it is not acceptable for an Imām to prolong the Farḍ ṣalāh to such an extent that it inconveniences those in the congregation who are elderly or ill. Ibn Mas'ūd's reluctance to oppose the amel of the Imām emphasises the need to be respectful towards seniors and teachers.

104.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Three things accompany the deceased (to his grave): his family, his mal and his deeds. Two of these return and one remains with him. His family and mal return, while his deeds remain."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
104.commentary: "His wealth accompanying him" işaret eder the ancient Arab sünnet wherein the deceased's slaves, animals and possessions would be taken with him to his grave and then brought back to his home. tıpkı... gibi a traveller carries luggage which will fayda him on his journey, Bu hadis urges us to accumulate iyilikler so that these could be to our advantage on our journey of the ahiret.

105.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Cennet is closer to you than your sandal straps and cehennem ateşi is just the same."(Bukhārī)
105.commentary: cennet and cehennem have been compared to sandal straps for three reasons. Firstly, tıpkı... gibi sandal straps are regarded as trivial, good or bad ameller which are considered trivial may be decisive in leading a person to cennet or cehennem. bundan dolayı, we are well advised to strive for her iyilik and abstain from her günah because we frequently do not know which ameller draw bütünāh's rahmet or anger. Secondly, attaining cennet and cehennem is as easy as tying sandal straps. According to Ibn al-Jawzī, the hadis demektir ki attaining cennet is easy provided one corrects his niyetler and does acts of itaat, and entering cehennem is easy if one follows one's desires and does sinful ameller. Thirdly, it could mean that cennet and cehennem are close to a person tıpkı... gibi sandal straps are close to his body; bundan dolayı the performance of ameller which draw him closer to either of these abodes are also easily accessible to him.

106.text: Rabī'ah ibn Ka'b al-Aslamī (رضي الله عنه) (the attendant of the Messenger of Allāh ﷺ and one from among the people of Ṣuffah) anlatır:"I used to spend nights with Resûlullah (ﷺ) and bring him his water for wuḍū' (ablution) and other necessities."(One day), he dedi to me:"Ask me (whatever you like)."I cevap verdi:"I ask you for your companionship in Cennet."He sordu:"Is that all?"I cevap verdi:"That is all."He dedi:"Help me in achieving your desire by means of abundant prostrations."(Müslüman)
106.commentary: The Ṣuffah işaret eder a roofed area at the rear of Masjid al-Nabawī where the poor and those who had no family would reside. They would learn Islām from the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and wheasla charity would come to the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), he would give bazı of it to them. The mention of "prostrations" is a reference to ṣalāh because sajdah (prostration) en önemlilerindendir postures of ṣalāh. Bu hadis proves that cennet and the company of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) can only be attained by striving against the carnal self in the form of acts of itaat and ibadet. The Ṣaḥābī's request for the companionship of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) in cennet displayed his foresight and hikmet. He desired the blessing of being able to see the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) bütün the time and as the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) has been uniquely blessed to intercede for his Ummah, this request was not unreasonable.

107.text: Abū 'Abdullāh (he is also known as Abū 'Abd al-Raḥmān) Thaubān (رضي الله عنه), the freed slave of Resûlullah (ﷺ), anlatır: I heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"You should perform abundant prostrations (by offering abundant namaz) for surely every time you prostrate to Allāh, Allāh will elevate you by one degree and expiate one of your günahlar."(Müslüman)
107.commentary: Bu hadis can be better understood by the narration of Ma'dān ibn Ṭalḥa who said, "I came to Thaubān (رضي الله عنه) and said, 'Tell me of an amel, on account of which bütünāh will enter me into cennet,' (or he said, 'The çoğu beloved amel to bütünāh'). Thaubān remained silent. He asked again and Thaubān remained silent. He asked a third time and then Thaubān replied, 'I asked the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) regarding this...' and he then narrated this hadis." The hadis bize öğretir ki optional ibadetler and itaat elevate one's status and eradicate günahlar. Scholars have expressed çeşitli opinions regarding whether abundant prostrations or extended periods of standing in ṣalāh are more virtuous. The preferred view is that standing is more virtuous. Either yol, the önem of striving in the itaat of bütünāh by means of ṣalāh is highlighted here.

108.narrator: Abdullāh ibn Busr al-Aslamī (رضي الله عنه)
108.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The best of people is one who lives a long life and whose deeds are good."(Tirmidhī)
108.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki the goodness of a person is determined by the multitude of his iyilikler. Life and time are assets that need to be utilised wisely. While birçok people can boast of their age, health, wealth and offspring, it is important to ask how birçok can say that their lives are filled with iyilikler. Bu hadis has very appropriately been narrated by a Ṣaḥābī who lived for one hundred years. He was böylece a living example of the message it contains. May bütünāh be pleased with bütün the Ṣaḥābah, bless us with gerçek and sincere sevgi for them and unite us with them in cennet.

109.text: My uncle, Anas ibn al-Naḍr (رضي الله عنه) was not present for the battle of Badr and he dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I was absent from the first battle in which you fought against the polytheists. If Allāh gives me the opportunity to fight the polytheists, Allāh will show what I will do.' When the battle of Uḥud took place, the Müslümans were exposed (when a group of them left their posts), so he dedi: 'Allah'ım! I ask You to excuse what these people (i.e. Müslümans) have done and I absolve myself from what these people (i.e. polytheists) have done.' He then advanced and Sa'd ibn Mu'ādh met him, so he dedi: 'O Sa'd ibn Mu'ādh! By the Lord of the Ka'bah, I desire Cennet. I can smell its fragrance from a place closer than Mount Uḥud.' Sa'd (رضي الله عنه) dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I was unable to do what he did.' Anas (رضي الله عنه) says: 'We found him with more than 80 sword strikes, spear stabs and arrow shots. We found that he had been killed and that the polytheists had mutilated his body. None could recognize him except his sister who looked at his fingertips.' Anas (رضي الله عنه) says: 'We believed that this verse was revealed with regard to him and others like him: 'Among the müminler there are men who are true to the pledge which they made to Allāh...'"(Sûre al-Aḥzāb, 23) (Bukhārī, Müslüman)
109.commentary: Anas ibn al-Naḍr (رضي الله عنه) regretted missing the battle of Badr. He did not participate because the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) had left Madīnah Munawwarah with the niyet of raiding the trade caravan of the Quraish and had taken along only a small group of Ṣaḥābah. Despite the Quraishite caravan altering their route and escaping danger, they called for reinforcements from Makkah Mukarramah. Abū Jahal was adamant upon fighting and the Muslims were forced to face the Quraish at Badr. With the help of bütünāh, the Quraish were defeated and routed and birçok of their leaders were killed. Despite this, they remained firm in their küfür and came to Uḥud the following year intending revenge. Anas ibn al-Naḍr (رضي الله عنه) made a firm niyet to strive in jihād to the best of his ability. Due to his doğruluk and ihlâs, bütünāh referred to it as a pledge. He subsequently fought bravely, giving his life in the cause of bütünāh.

110.narrator: Uqbah ibn 'Amr al-Anṣārī al-Badrī (رضي الله عنه)
110.text: When the verse giving sadaka was revealed, we used to earn a living by carrying goods on our backs. A man would come and give a lot of mal in sadaka and some people would say: 'He is showing off.' Then another man would come and give one ṣā' (a small weight) in sadaka and some people would say: 'Allāh does not need the ṣā' of this person.' The following verse was then revealed: 'Those who mock the müminler because of their sadaka which they give of their own free will and those who do not find anything to give except their labour.' (Sûre al-Tövbe, 79) (Bukhārī, Müslüman)
110.commentary: The person who gave a lot of wealth in charity was 'Abd al-Raḥmān ibn 'Auf (رضي الله عنه). He gave 8000 dirhams or, according to others, 4000 dirhams. bazı say he gave 40 uqiyah of gold. The person who gave one ṣā' was Abū 'Aqīl (رضي الله عنه). A ṣā' is approximately 3.216 kilograms. Bu hadis stresses the need for her believer to strive and fulfil the yükümlülükler of bütünāh according to his ability and potential. Like the Ṣaḥābah, one who seeks to please bütünāh and live according to the Sunnah will also have to bear criticism. Such criticism should not cause one to waver, but to persevere with the same passion, enböyleceiasm and vigour.

111.text: From Rabī'ah ibn Yazīd, who anlatır from Abū Idrīs al-Khawlānī, who anlatır from Abū Dharr Jundub ibn Junādah (رضي الله عنه), who anlatır from Resûlullah (ﷺ) who anlatır from Allah (ﷻ) that He dedi:"O My kullar! I have yasakladı oppression for Myself and made it yasakladı among you, so you should not wrong one another. O My kullar! All of you are astray except those whom I guide, so seek My guidance and I will guide you. O My kullar! All of you are hungry except those whom I feed, so ask Me to feed you and I will feed you. O My kullar! All of you are naked except those whom I clothe, so ask Me to clothe you and I will clothe you. O My kullar! You commit günahlar by day and night and I bağışla all günahlar, so seek bağışlanma from Me and I will bağışla you. O My kullar! If you wish to harm Me, you will never be able to do so and if you wish to benefit Me, you will never be able to do so. O My kullar! If the first and last of you and all the humans and jinn among you were to reach the level of the most salih among you, then that will not increase My sovereignty in any way. O My kullar! If the first and last of you and all the humans and jinn among you were to reach the level of the most wicked among you, then that will not decrease My sovereignty in any way. O My kullar! If the first and last of you and all the humans and jinn among you were to stand on a single field and ask Me (whatever they desire) and I give to every person whatever he asks for, that will not decrease My treasures any more than when a needle is dipped into the ocean. O My kullar! It is your deeds which I keep in store for you and I will then repay you in full, so whoever does good should thank Allāh and whoever does evil, should blame none but himself."(Müslüman) Sa'īd (one of the narrators) dedi:"When Abū Idrīs used to narrate this hadis, he would sit up on his knees."Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal (رحمه الله) dedi:"The people of Syria regarded this hadis as the most noble."
111.commentary: Bu hadis al-Qudsī brings to the fore a number of key concepts of iman. It bize hatırlatır ki the kingdom and sovereignty of bütünāh is at the ultimate level of perfection. bütünāh is in total control of her facet of existence. He is independent, supreme and flawless in her saygı. The iyilikler and günahlar of people do not fayda nor harm bütünāh in any yol. "bütün of you are astray" does not contradict the hadis that states "her new-born is born on natural disposition" because the latter infers that her person has the potential and ability to be rightly guided. If bütünāh then chooses, He prepares such demektir ki cause him to be rightly guided in practise; and if bütünāh does not choose one to be rightly guided, He allows his natural disposition to be changed towards other faiths gibi Christianity, Judaism and Zoroastrianism. The example of a needle being placed into the ocean is merely to explain the concept of bütünāh's greatness by means of an example which people may understand, otherwise there is absolutely no decrease in the treasures of bütünāh. bütünāh has prohibited bütün forms of oppression; bu nedenle, the lives, wealth, honour and haysiyet of bütün people must be respected and protected.

112.text: Ebû Hüreyre (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Allah, ömrünü uzatıp da hayır yapmayana özür bırakmamıştır." (Buhârî, Müslim)
112.commentary: Uzun ömür, kişiye daha fazla ibadet ve hayır yapma fırsatı verir. Bu fırsatı değerlendirmeyenler için özür yoktur.

113.text: 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) used to permit me to join the discussions with the senior Sahâbe who had taken part in the battle of Badr. It seemed that some of them were annoyed at this and dedi: 'Why should this one be permitted to join us when we also have children of his age?' 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) cevap verdi: 'You know well where he comes from.' One day 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) summoned me to join them and I think he did so in order to demonstrate it to them. 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) sordu them: 'What do you have to say about this verse: 'When the help of Allāh and victory comes'?' Some of them dedi: 'We are emretti to praise Allāh and seek His bağışlanma when He helps us and grants us victory.' Others remained silent and did not say anything. He then sordu me: 'Is this your opinion too, O Ibn Abbās?' I cevap verdi: 'No.' He sordu: 'What do you say?' I cevap verdi: 'It refers to the demise of Resûlullah (ﷺ). Allāh haber verdi him by diyerek: 'When the help of Allāh and victory comes,' that is a sign of your demise, so 'glorify the praises of your Sustainer and seek His bağışlanma. Surely He accepts repentance.' (On hearing this), 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) dedi: 'I know of no other explanation except yours.'"(Bukhārī)
113.commentary: 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) used to consult the senior Ṣaḥābah of Badr in matters of önem. In view of the profound and outstanding knowledge of 'Abdullāh ibn 'Abbās (رضي الله عنه), 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) included him in the council as well. When this Sūrah was revealed the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) delivered a sermon in which he said, "bütünāh gave a servant the choice between dünya and what is with Him. He chose that which is with bütünāh." Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) cried when he heard this and remarked, "May our parents be your ransom, O Messenger of bütünāh!" The other Ṣaḥābah were surprised at Abū Bakr's ifade as they did not understand at the time that the slave who was given the choice was the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ).

114.text: After the revelation of the verse, 'When the help of Allāh and victory comes', Resûlullah (ﷺ) did not perform any namaz without diyerek, 'Glory be to You, O our Sustainer and praise be to You. Allah'ım! Forgive me.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman) A narration of Bukhārī and Müslüman from 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) has:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) would abundantly say in his rukū' and sajdah: 'Glory be to You, O Allāh, our Sustainer and praise be to You. Allah'ım! Forgive me,' thereby practising upon the order of the Kur'an."A narration of Müslüman has:"Before Resûlullah (ﷺ) passed away, he used to abundantly say: 'Glory be to You, O Allāh and praise be to You. I seek bağışlanma from Allāh and I turn in repentance to Him.'"'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) anlatır:"I sordu: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I notice you diyerek these words which you have now started diyerek?' He cevap verdi: 'My Sustainer haber verdi me that I will see a particular sign in my Ummah and when I see it, I should abundantly say: 'Glory and praise be to Allāh. I seek bağışlanma from Allāh and I turn repentance to Him.' I have seen that sign: 'When the help of Allāh and victory comes,' and that victory refers to the conquest of Makkah, 'and you see the people entering the religion of Allāh in groups, then glorify the praises of your Sustainer and seek bağışlanma from Him. Surely He accepts repentance.'"
114.commentary: After the revelation of Sūrah al-Naṣr, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) realised that his demise was near. He bu nedenle began to praise bütünāh, glorify Him and recite abundant istighfār in itaat to the emir of bütünāh. It is our inanç that bütün the Messengers of bütünāh are sinless. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) bu nedenle sought bağışlanma due to his tevazu and not because he committed günahlar. He regarded his ibadet and davranış, as a slave of bütünāh, to be deficient in fulfilling the haklar of bütünāh. ayrıca, he engaged in abundant taubah in order to teach the Ummah to do the same.

115.text: Allāh gönderdi revelation more frequently to Resûlullah (ﷺ) as he neared his demise, so that when he passed away revelation was at its highest frequency."(Bukhārī)
115.commentary: The abundance of revelation close to the demise of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), was due to the birçok delegations that came to Madīnah Munawwarah after the conquest of Makkah. These delegations posed birçok questions pertaining to the rules and regulations of Islām, necessitating revelation. Further, there was a need to reveal the remaining aspects of the sharī'ah so yanilām was perfected before the demise of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). It is also possible that, due to the Messenger of bütünāh's closeness to bütünāh during the end stages of his dünya hayatı, bütünāh communicated with him more frequently.

116.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Every person will be resurrected in the state in which he passed away."(Müslüman)
116.commentary: Based on this hadis, scholars explain that a person who passes away in ḥaj will be resurrected reciting the talbiyah. ayrıca, one who dies with a musical instrument in his hand, in a state of intoxication or while committing adultery will be resurrected in the very same şart. The hadis, bu nedenle, encourages us to engage in praiseworthy ameller and söz at bütün times so that we are resurrected accordingly. The author appropriately concluded the chapter with Bu hadis because it encourages one towards perfection, özellikle towards the end of one's life when death is imminent. As the end result is decisive and conclusive, it is hoped that one who engaged in iyilikler towards the end of his life will have glad tidings of goodness for the ahiret.

117.narrator: Ebû Zer Jundub ibn Junādah (رضي الله عنه)
117.text: Ebû Zer (رضي الله عنه) şöyle anlatır: Dedim ki: "Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Hangi amel daha faziletlidir?" Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Allah'a iman ve O'nun yolunda cihad" buyurdu. Dedim ki: "Hangi köle azat etmek daha faziletlidir?" Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Sahibinin yanında en değerli ve fiyatı en yüksek olanı" buyurdu. Dedim ki: "Ya hiçbir şey yapamazsam?" Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Bir iş yapana yardım edersin veya bir iş yapamayana yardımcı olursun" buyurdu. Dedim ki: "Ya bunu da yapamazsam?" Resûlullah (ﷺ): "İnsanlara zarar vermezsin; çünkü bu da senin için bir sadakadır" buyurdu. (Buhârî, Müslim)
117.commentary: Amellerin fazileti konusunda önemli bir hadistir. Herkes gücüne göre hayır işlemeli, yapamadığında başkalarına yardım etmeli veya en azından kimseye zarar vermemelidir.

118.text: Ebû Zer (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Her birinizin her gün her eklemi için bir sadaka gerekir. Her sübhanallah bir sadakadır, her elhamdülillah bir sadakadır, her la ilahe illallah bir sadakadır, her Allahu ekber bir sadakadır. İyiliği emretmek ve kötülükten sakındırmak bir sadakadır. Kuşluk vaktinde kılınan iki rekat namaz da bunların hepsine yeter." (Müslim)
118.commentary: Sadaka sadece mal ile olmaz; zikir, iyiliği emretmek, kötülükten sakındırmak ve hatta güzel söz söylemek bile sadakadır. Kuşluk namazı (duhâ) bütün bu sadakaların yerine geçer.

119.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The good and evil deeds of my Ummah were presented before me. I noticed that removing a harmful object from the path was from among their good deeds and I noticed that phlegm which is left unburied in the mescid was from among their evil deeds."(Müslüman)
119.commentary: Bu hadis highlights the fazilet of benefitting people and safeguarding them from harm. Ibn Ruslān (رحمه الله) said that he heard from scholars that it is appropriate to recite the testimony of iman (lā ilāha illallāh) when removing a harmful object from the yol. This is in order to unite the lowest branch of īmān (removing a harmful object from the yol) with the highest (the testimony of iman). Further, when the niyet of the heart is joined to the söz of the tongue, ameller reach perfection. The hadis also urges us to refrain from harmful forms of söz. One should bu nedenle be wary of speaking lies, insulting, passing disparaging remarks, backbiting or sowing disunity between people.

120.text: Some people dedi:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! The wealthy have taken all the rewards: they offer namaz as we do, they fast as we do, but they can give their extra mal in sadaka."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"Has Allāh not given you something which you could give in sadaka? Every glorification of Allāh is sadaka; every expression of the greatness of Allāh is sadaka; every praise of Allāh is sadaka; every proclamation of the oneness of Allāh is sadaka; commanding good is sadaka; forbidding evil is sadaka; and engaging in conjugal relations with your wife is sadaka."The Sahâbe sordu:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! If any of us fulfils his passions, is he rewarded for it?"He cevap verdi:"If he were to have illicit relations, will it not be a günah against him? Similarly, if he were to have lawful conjugal relations he will be rewarded for it."(Müslüman)
120.commentary: bütün of the above-mentioned ameller have been referred to as charity because their sevap is equivalent to giving charity. This is because they are done for the pleasure of bütünāh, even though they may differ in status, nature, characteristics and effect. The hadis highlights the aspect of ahlâk and faithfulness in marriage and is bilhassa important in our era of immorality and shamelessness. Islām teaches that fulfilling one's desires with one's wife draws ilâhî rewards when it is accompanied with the doğru niyet. Such an niyet could be to safeguard one's chastity or the chastity of one's spouse from evil thoughts and gazes, to fulfil the spouse's marital haklar, to produce offspring that will believe in one bütünāh, or to increase the Ummah of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). Intending to rear pious offspring is a noble niyet as they will serve as a perpetual sevap after their parent's demise by performing iyilikler on the latter's behalf.

121.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: to me: 'Do not regard any good deed to be insignificant even if it is meeting your brother with a cheerful face.'"(Müslüman)
121.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki no iyilik should be regarded as insignificant as it may be a means of earning bütünāh's pleasure. It also teaches us to smile because people are attracted to a person who has a cheerful countenance. A smile removes ill feelings, makes others feel comfortable, and creates sevgi between people.

122.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Every day in which the sun rises, sadaka is due on behalf of every joint of the body. Establishing justice between two people is sadaka; helping a man to mount his animal or to load his goods onto it is sadaka; a good word is sadaka; every step that you take towards namaz is sadaka; removing a harmful object from the path is sadaka."(Bukhārī, Müslüman) This is also rivayet etti by Müslüman from 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) who dedi: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"Every human being is created with 360 joints. The person who expresses the greatness of Allāh, praises Allāh, proclaims the oneness of Allāh, glorifies Allāh, seeks bağışlanma from Allāh, removes a rock, thorn or bone from the path of people, enjoins good or prohibits evil, has justly accounted for the 360 joints and he will then have spent that evening having distanced himself from cehennem ateşi."
122.commentary: In this hadis, we are told to be grateful on a daily basis for the health of our joints and bodies. Gratitude may be expressed by engaging in any of the çok sayıda forms of iyilikler mentioned. bununla birlikte it should be remembered that ihlâs is a precondition for the acceptance of her iyilik. One who arbitrates or reconciles justly between people in order to bring about peace, receives the sevap of charity. aslında, reconciling between disputing groups is such a noble amel that speaking a lie becomes helal for this purpose. bazı scholars are of the view that speaking a lie in such situations işaret eder tawriyah - when the speaker intends something farklı to what the listener understands.

123.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Whoever goes to the mescid at the times of dawn and dusk, Allāh prepares for him a special feast in Cennet for every occasion he went to the mescid at the times of dawn and dusk."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
123.commentary: bütünāh will prepare a feast in cennet for one who frequents the masjid to perform ṣalāh or i'tikāf, recite the Qur'ān or seek knowledge for the pleasure of bütünāh.

124.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"O Müslüman women! No neighbour should regard anything as insignificant for another neighbour even if it be a sheep'in trotter."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
124.commentary: A person should not refrain from sending a gift to a neighbour considering it to be insignificant or little because a gift may be insignificant to the person receiving it but its sevap with bütünāh is immense. ayrıca, charity and gifts should be given according to one's financial status; bundan dolayı, the poor are also teşvik edilen to give something yani affordable to them. It is better to give something small rather than nothing at bütün. bütünāh says, "One who does an atom's-weight of good, will see its sevap." (Sūrah al-Zilzāl, 7) The hadis may also mean that a person who has received a gift should not regard it as insignificant. Sheep's trotters are rarely sent as a gift because they are of little value; bundan dolayı, the hadis uses them as an example to emphasize the önem of giving in charity.

125.text: Ebû Hüreyre (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Güneşin doğduğu her yeni günde, kişinin her eklemi için bir sadaka gerekir. İki kişi arasında adaletle hükmetmek bir sadakadır. Binmek isteyene yardım etmek veya yükünü yüklemek bir sadakadır. Güzel söz bir sadakadır. Namaz kılmak için atılan her adım bir sadakadır. Yoldan eziyet veren bir şeyi kaldırmak bir sadakadır." (Buhârî, Müslim)
125.commentary: Her gün için şükür gereklidir. Hizmet, yardım, güzel söz ve çevre temizliği gibi basit işler bile sadaka sayılır. Bir Müslüman, günlük hayatının her anında sevap kazanabilir.

126.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A man was once walking on a path and he became very thirsty. He found a well into which he climbed and drank. When he emerged, he saw a dog panting and eating mud because of thirst. The man thought to himself: 'This dog is experiencing a similar degree of thirst to what I had experienced.' So he again climbed down the well, filled his leather socks with water and holding it in his mouth, climbed back out of the well and gave it to the dog to drink. Allāh appreciated this act of his and forgave him."The Sahâbe sordu:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Are we rewarded even because of animals?"He cevap verdi:"There is sevap for (showing iyilik to) every living creature."(Bukhārī, Müslüman) A narration of Bukhārī has:"Allāh appreciated this act of his, forgave him and admitted him into Cennet."A narration of Bukhārī and Müslüman has:"A dog on the verge of dying due to thirst was walking around a well. An immoral woman from the Banī Isrā'īl saw the dog, so she removed her leather socks, filled them with water and gave it to the dog. Due to this she was forgiven."
126.commentary: When bütünāh grants such a splendid sevap for an act of iyilik towards an animal, one wonders the gerçek extent of bütünāh's sevap and iyilik towards His close and beloved servants. The narration, which states that a woman (instead of a man) had given water to a dog is not contradictory because it may refer to another incident. ihlâs draws ilâhî sevap. The man's amel of giving water to the dog was sincere and devoid of ulterior motives, bundan dolayı it attracted bütünāh's bağışlanma. Providing water to people is an exceedingly noble amel in the sight of bütünāh. This includes providing a water source for people in drought-stricken areas or giving a fasting person water to drink. bütünāh is merciful to bütün His creation, even animals. The fact that bütünāh forgives major günahlar due to minor acts of goodness displays His grace and magnanimity.

127.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"I saw a man enjoying the pleasures of Cennet because of a tree which he chopped off from the path because it was obstructing the Müslümans."(Müslüman) Another narration has:"A man passed by a branch of a tree which was obstructing the path and thought to himself: 'By Allāh, I will remove this from the path of the Müslümans so that it does not obstruct them.' For this he was admitted into Cennet."A narration of Bukhārī and Müslüman has:"While a man was walking, he saw a thorn tree on the path and moved it aside. Allāh appreciated this act of his and forgave him."
127.commentary: Bu hadis explains the tremendous fazilet of any amel that faydalar the Muslims or removes harm from them. Islām advocates cleanliness and orderliness in her aspect of life and this is of particular önem with regard to public amenities gibi roads, gardens and other communal facilities. A Muslim should bu nedenle be considerate and contribute to the overall comfort and genel well-being of others.

128.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Whoever performs a perfect wuḍū', then attends the Cuma namaz, listens attentively to the sermon and remains silent, will have his günahlar forgiven until the next Friday and another three days more. But, a person who plays with pebbles has involved himself in a futile act."(Müslüman)
128.commentary: A "mükemmel ablution" entails observing bütün the relevant Sunan and ādāb (etiquettes) associated with it. The hadis önemine işaret eder focusing the body and soul to the Jumu'ah sermon. Playing with pebbles is a useless activity, bundan dolayı any form of disinterest towards the sermon is haram. From other aḥādīth, we learn that even advising another person to remain silent while the Jumu'ah sermon is in progress is haram. Scholars have stated that the sevap for a single day of Jumu'ah is multiplied tenfold, bundan dolayı a total of ten days' minor günahlar are forgiven, because of her iyilik is multiplied by ten times according to a law mentioned in the Qur'ān.

129.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a Müslüman kul or mümin performs wuḍū' and washes his face, every günah which he committed with his eyes leaves his face with the water or with the last drop of water. When he washes his hands, every günah which his hands committed leaves his hands with the water or with the last drop of water. When he washes his feet, every günah which his feet walked towards leaves his feet with the water or with the last drop of water. This continues until he leaves completely purified of günah."(Müslüman)
129.commentary: When a person commits a günah, it leaves a stain or blemish on his limbs. People of takvâ can bazen see these stains because of their manevî insight. Performing a mükemmel wuḍū' with the doğru niyet will cause such günahlar to be physically washed away by the grace of bütünāh. This is the literal anlam of the hadis. According to the figurative yorum, the hadis would mean that bütünāh forgives günahlar. ayrıca to believing that wuḍū' washes away günahlar, a person should be remorseful over having committed a günah and make a firm resolution not to commit the günah again. Wuḍū' washes away only minor günahlar because bağışlanma for major günahlar requires taubah.

130.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The five daily namazs, one Friday to the next Friday and one Ramaḍān to the next Ramaḍān are expiation for whatever günahlar are committed between them provided the major günahlar are avoided."(Müslüman)
130.commentary: Bu hadis is an açıklama of a verse of the Qur'ān, "iyilikler obliterate evil ameller." (Sūrah Hūd, 114) Ḥāfiẓ Walī ud-Dīn 'Irāqī stated that Bu hadis is proof that only minor günahlar are forgiven through iyilikler. bununla birlikte, Imām Qurṭubī stated that bütünāh forgives even the major günahlar of a person through iyilikler if his niyet is sincere. bütünāh grants this favour to whomever He chooses. A question may be posed here: when so birçok iyilikler can obliterate günah, what transpires when bütün the günahlar of a person have been obliterated? Scholars explain that when one engages in iyilikler while having no minor günahlar, his status will be raised; or if a person has only major günahlar, it is hoped that these will also be forgiven. bununla birlikte, it should be remembered that the genel rule is that major günahlar require taubah.

131.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Shall I not inform you of that by which Allāh expiates günahlar and by which He raises ranks?"The Sahâbe cevap verdi:"Indeed, Ey Allah'ın Resûlü!"He dedi:"Performing a complete wuḍū' despite difficulties, taking many steps to the mescid and waiting for the next namaz after having performed the present one. That is ribāṭ."(Müslüman)
131.commentary: Ribât, İslâm devletinin sınırlarını korumak, Müslüman topraklarının güvenliğini sağlamak ve düşman saldırılarını önlemek demektir.

132.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Whoever offers the two 'cold' namazs shall enter Cennet."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
132.commentary: The 'cold' Ṣalāhs refer to the Fajr and 'Aṣr Ṣalāhs. They are referred to as such because it is relatively cooler during these times of the day compared to other times. At the time of Fajr ṣalāh people are enjoying their sleep while at the time of 'Aṣr ṣalāh they are concluding their business activities for the day, bundan dolayı to perform these Ṣalāhs punctually bir işaretidir ihlâs and displays sevgi for ibadet. The hadis does not mean that cennet is guaranteed for one who performs only these two Ṣalāhs, rather it işaret eder the fact that one who performs these two Ṣalāhs will observe the remaining three ṣalāhs more regularly and punctually.

133.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a person falls ill or is on a journey, the same good deeds that he used to do while he was healthy or resident are recorded in his favour."(Bukhārī)
133.commentary: Bu hadis demonstrates the immense rahmet of bütünāh in that the iyilikler we habitually engage in are recorded in our favour when we cannot do them. According to Abū Dāwūd, the best ameller done by a person when he is healthy are recorded for him when he is ill. ayrıca, iyilikler refer to optional ones, not the farz and compulsory ones, as the latter need to be performed without fail.

134.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Every good deed is sadaka."(Bukhārī)
134.commentary: Bir Müslüman gerçekten şanslıdır çünkü onun her iyiliği sadaka sevabı kazandırır ve ahirette ödüllendirilir. Niyete göre niyet de amel sayılır.

135.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"No Müslüman plants a tree without him receiving the sevap of sadaka for whatever is eaten from it, whatever is stolen from it and whatever someone takes from it."(Müslüman) A narration of Müslüman has:"No Müslüman plants a tree without him receiving the sevap of sadaka until the day of Kıyamet for whatever a human, animal or bird eats from it."Another narration of Müslüman has:"No Müslüman plants a tree or sows a field without him receiving the sevap of sadaka for whatever a human, an animal or anything else eats from it."
135.commentary: The hadis indicates that planting a tree or vegetation, from which the creation of bütünāh may derive fayda, is a virtuous amel and one who does so will be rewarded even after his demise. This is termed Ṣadaqah al-Jāriyah (perpetual charity). There are six such ameller that earn perpetual sevap. They are continuous charity, knowledge that faydalar others, a pious child that supplicates for his parents, farming, planting of vegetation and ribāṭ (guarding the borders of the Islāmic state). A Muslim should daima strive to fayda the creation of bütünāh to the best of his ability.

136.text: The Banū Salimah intended relocating closer to the mescid. This information reached Resûlullah (ﷺ) and he dedi: 'I have heard that you want to relocate closer to the mescid.' They cevap verdi: 'Yes, Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! That is what we have decided to do.' He dedi: 'O Banū Salimah! Remain in your homes and your footsteps will be recorded in your favour. Remain in your homes and your footsteps will be recorded in your favour.'"(Müslüman) Another narration has:"Every step that you take will elevate you by one degree."Bukhārī also rivayet etti a similar hadis from Anas (رضي الله عنه).
136.commentary: The tribe of Banū Salimah were a branch of the Anṣār and they lived at a distance from Masjid al-Nabawī. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) teşvik edilen them to stay where they were because of the great rewards for her step taken while walking to and from the masjid. While walking to and from the masjid, one should engage in dhikr, remove obstacles from the yol, greet people and do iyilikler to supplement one's rewards.

137.text: There was a particular man, and I do not know of anyone else who lived further away from the mescid than him, but he never missed a namaz. He was sordu (or I sordu him) 'Why don't you purchase a donkey which you could ride in the dark of the night and the heat of the sun?' He cevap verdi: 'It would not please me to have my house right next to the mescid. Instead, I want my footsteps to the mescid and my footsteps while returning to my family to be recorded in my favour.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Allāh has combined all those rewards for you.'"(Müslüman) Another narration has:"You shall receive whatever you hoped for."
137.commentary: The Ṣaḥābah gave due önem to performing ṣalāh in congregation and endured bütün forms of difficulty in this regard. One is teşvik edilen to perform ṣalāh in congregation even if one resides far from the masjid.

138.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
138.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There are 40 excellent deeds, the highest of which is loaning one'in goat so that others could consume its milk. When one does any of these good deeds in anticipation of their sevap and believing in whatever has been promised for this, Allāh admits him into Cennet."(Bukhārī)
138.commentary: bütünāh, through His rahmet and grace, has given us birçok avenues of doing iyilikler. He accepts even the smallest of good ameller, when these are based on sincere niyetler. From other narrations, we learn that bazı of the forty excellent ameller alluded to here are concealing the faults of Muslims, planting a tree, being compassionate to others, sharing in the joys and happiness of people, creating space for others to join in a gathering, replying to salām (Islāmic greeting), and answering to the praise of one who sneezes.

139.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Safeguard yourselves from cehennem ateşi even if it is by giving half a date (in sadaka)."(Bukhārī, Müslüman) A narration of Bukhārī and Müslüman has: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"Allāh will most certainly speak with every single one of you without any interpreter. He will look to his right and see nothing except the deeds that he sent ahead. He will look to his left and see nothing except the deeds that he sent ahead. He will look in front of him and see only cehennem ateşi straight before him. So safeguard yourselves from cehennem ateşi even if it is by giving half a date (in sadaka). And if you do not have even that, then by a good word."
139.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki her biri person will be directly accountable to bütünāh for his ameller on the day of Qiyāmah. Only iyilikler will fayda a person at that time. We are also teşvik edilen to give in charity, according to our capacity and to deal kindly and gently with people. A Qur'ānic verse states, "Kind sözler and forgiving of faults are better than ṣadaqah (charity) followed by injury." (Sūrah al-Baqarah, 263)

140.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh is pleased with a person who eats and praises Allāh for it, or drinks and praises Allāh for it."(Müslüman)
140.commentary: In this hadis, we are teşvik edilen to be grateful to bütünāh for His birçok bounties. It is bütünāh alone Who is worthy of praise. The Sunnah of praising bütünāh after a meal can be fulfilled by saying 'alḥamdulillāh'. Other du'ā's that may be recited will be mentioned in the chapter on etiquettes, if bütünāh wills. Ibn Mālik (رحمه الله) said that it is also Sunnah not to raise ones voice when praising bütünāh, so as not to disturb others who may still be eating. bütünāh greatly rewards one who is grateful to Him. In another hadis it is stated, "One who is grateful while eating is like one who fasts patiently." We are indeed fortunate that bütünāh has made eating an act of itaat. When done with the doğru niyet and adab, we can enjoy a meal in dünya and still acquire sevap in the ahiret.

141.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Charity is compulsory upon every Müslüman."He was sordu:"What if one does not have anything to give?"He cevap verdi:"He should work by himself and thereby benefit himself and then give in sadaka."He was sordu:"What if he is unable to do so?"He cevap verdi:"He should assist a needy and distressed person."He was sordu:"What if he is unable to do so?"He cevap verdi:"He should command good or goodness."He was sordu:"What if he cannot do so?"He cevap verdi:"He should restrain himself from committing evil, for that is also sadaka."' (Bukhārī, Müslüman)
141.commentary: Charity is incumbent upon her person in gratitude for the countless bounties of bütünāh he enjoys at her moment. Bu hadis lists çeşitli avenues of charity. The best of these is to give charity from the wealth one earns by one's own efforts and the very least is to abstain from harming others. There is immense sevap for assisting others, özellikle those who are oppressed and afflicted. This sentiment is expressed in other aḥādīth gibi, "bütünāh remains in the assistance of a servant who continues to assist his brother." (Muslim) We are teşvik edilen to work in order to earn a living so that we are able to fulfil our needs without asking or begging from others.

142.text: Âişe (رضي الله عنها) şöyle anlatır: Resûlullah (ﷺ) yanında bir kadın olduğu halde Âişe'ye geldi ve: "Bu kim?" diye sordu. Âişe: "Falan kadındır, uykusunu (namazını) anlatıyor" dedi. Resûlullah (ﷺ) bu söz üzerine şöyle buyurdu: "Amellerinizden gücünüzün yettiğini yapın. Allah usanmaz, ama siz usanırsınız." (Buhârî, Müslim)
142.commentary: İbadette aşırılıktan kaçınmak esastır. Kişi gücünün yettiği kadar ibadet etmeli, kendini zorlamamalıdır. Amelde süreklilik, az da olsa önemlidir.

143.text: Enes (رضي الله عنه) şöyle anlatır: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in hanımlarının odalarına üç kişi gelerek Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in ibadetini sordular. Kendilerine haber verilince, ibadeti azımsayarak: "Biz Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e nereden yetişeceğiz? O'nun geçmiş ve gelecek günahları bağışlanmıştır" dediler. İçlerinden biri: "Ben gece boyunca namaz kılarım" dedi. Diğeri: "Ben hiç iftar etmeden (aralıksız) oruç tutarım" dedi. Üçüncüsü: "Ben kadınlardan uzak durur ve hiç evlenmem" dedi. Bunun üzerine Resûlullah (ﷺ) gelip şöyle buyurdu: "Siz şöyle şöyle diyenlersiniz. Allah'a yemin ederim ki, ben sizin Allah'tan en çok korkanınız ve O'ndan en çok sakınanınızım. Fakat bazı günler oruç tutar, bazı günler iftar ederim. Namaz kılar ve uyurum. Kadınlarla da evlenirim. Kim benim sünnetimden yüz çevirirse, benden değildir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
143.commentary: Bu hadis, sünnete uymanın önemini vurgular. Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in sünneti, aşırılıklardan uzak, dengeli bir hayat tarzıdır. Sürekli ibadet için oruç tutmamak, gece namazı kılıp uyumak ve evlenmek sünnettir. Dinde aşırılık yasaklanmıştır.

144.text: İbn Mes'ud (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kendilerine aşırı yüklenenler helâk oldu" - bunu üç kere tekrarladı. (Müslim)
144.commentary: Dinde aşırı gitmek ve kendine gereksiz yere zorluk çıkarmak yasaklanmıştır. Müslüman, orta yolu izlemeli ve aşırılıklardan kaçınmalıdır.

145.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The religion (of İslâm) is easy. One who imposes upon himself undue hardships in religious matters, they will overwhelm him. So follow the middle path, do as much as you can, rejoice (over the sevap for your good deeds) and seek to utilise a portion of the morning and evening and latter part of the night (in ibadet)."(Bukhārī) Another narration of Bukhārī has:"Remain moderate and do as much as you possibly can. (Worship) in the morning, evening and in the latter part of the night. Be moderate, be moderate and you will reach your goal."
145.commentary: We are advised to be moderate and balanced in our ibadet as extremism leads to more harm than fayda. It is daima wise to gradually increase and progress to the point of üstünlük rather than attempt to reach the top bütün at once. One who improperly exerts himself sık sık "overwhelms" himself, as the hadis explains and is then deprived of engaging in any good. It should be remembered that this only applies to optional forms of ibadet. farz forms of ibadet need to be compulsorily performed at their required times, irrespective whether one is tired or not. "The din (of Islām) is easy" compared to religions of the past because bütünāh removed çeşitli complications from the Muslims that were placed on previous nations.

146.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) entered the mescid and noticed a rope tied between two pillars. He sordu:"What is this rope for?"The Sahâbe cevap verdi:"Zaynab tied this rope. When she is tired (by ibadet), she holds onto it."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"Untie it. You should offer namaz when you are energetic and when you are tired you should lie down."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
146.commentary: Bu hadis işaret eder Zaynab bint Jaḥsh, the wife of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and mother of the believers. Her home was adjacent to the masjid, bundan dolayı she would engage in optional ṣalāh in the masjid. The foundational principle of moderation in ibadet also runs through this hadis. One should not overburden oneself in optional ibadet, but pace oneself so that one may gradually increase in intensity.

147.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any of you feels drowsy while offering namaz, he should lie down so that his drowsiness disappears. If a person offers namaz when he is drowsy, he may unknowingly curse himself instead of seeking bağışlanma."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
147.commentary: Bu hadis explains that overindulgence in ibadet and itaat may lead to adverse results; a person may become sinful rather than attain sevap. The scholars of hadis explain that the point of drowsiness referred to in Bu hadis is when a person can hear the söz of others but cannot understand it. He should then rest, rather than engage in ṣalāh because he may very easily utter an inappropriate ifade. This applies to her iki Farḍ and Nafl ṣalāh, bununla birlikte in the case of the former one should ensure that the time of that particular ṣalāh does not elapse while one is asleep. Ibn Abī Jamrah said that bunun sebebi yasak is that a person may unfortunately make an inappropriate du'ā' at a time when du'ā's are readily accepted by bütünāh. Imām Nawawī stated that Bu hadis proves the önem of performing ṣalāh with a clear mind and total concentration.

148.text: I used to offer namazs with Resûlullah (ﷺ). His namazs and sermons were moderate in length."(Müslüman)
148.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki leaders should be moderate in leading communal activities in cognisance of those who are of zayıf temperament. This ifade of Jābir ibn Samurah was based on extensive experience, because he stated, "By bütünāh, I have performed more than 2000 ṣalāh with the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ)." (Muslim) "Moderate" in Bu rivayet demektir ki his ṣalāh and sermons were perfectly performed with bütün the necessary Sunan, without excessive lengthening or shortening. bununla birlikte, narrations state that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) would bazen shorten the ṣalāh and sermon out of rahmet and merhamet for the ill and zayıf. As he could impart a comprehensive message with a az sayıda sözler, his sermons were perfectly paced for the audience to derive maximum fayda therefrom.

149.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) joined Salmān and Abū al-Dārdā' in brotherhood. One day, Salmān went to visit Abū al-Dārdā' and saw Umm al-Dārdā' poorly dressed. He sordu her: 'What is the matter with you?' She cevap verdi: 'Your brother, Abū al-Dārdā', has no inclination to this world.' Abū al-Dārdā' then came, prepared food for Salmān and dedi to him: 'You may eat, for I am oruç.' Salmān dedi: 'I will not eat unless you join me.' So he ate with him. When night came, Abū al-Dārdā' stood up (to offer namaz) and Salmān dedi to him: 'Go to sleep.' So he went back to sleep. He then awoke again (to offer namaz), and Salmān dedi to him: 'Go to sleep.' In the last portion of the night Salmān dedi: 'You may awake now.' They then offered namaz together and Salmān then dedi to him: 'Your Sustainer has a right over you, your soul has a right over you and your family has a right over you. So you should give everyone their due right.' Abū al-Dārdā' then went to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and related to him all that had transpired. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Salmān spoke the truth.'"(Bukhārī)
149.commentary: Umm al-Dārdā' did not wear beautiful clothing nor did she adorn herself because her husband would fast during the day and stand in ṣalāh at night as mentioned in the narration of Tirmidhī. After hearing this, Salmān tried to convince Abū al-Dārdā' to try to maintain a balance between ibadet and sosyal sorumluluklar. He advised him to adopt moderation and avoid extremism. Muslims should strengthen their unity and mutual brotherhood for the sake of bütünāh by visiting one another. It is helal to talk to a strange woman at times of necessity. One should advise others regarding matters in which one senses negligence. It is helal to stop a person from optional ibadet when such ibadet causes him to abandon the compulsory haklar of bütünāh and His creation. One is permitted to break an optional fast when invited for a meal; bununla birlikte, it should be kept on another day. One should live respectfully with one's spouse and fulfil his or her natural desires. Spouses should also beautify themselves for her biri other in order to keep the flame of sevgi burning between them. Optional ṣalāh during the last portion of the night is extremely virtuous.

150.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
150.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) was haber verdi that I had dedi: 'By Allāh, I will keep fast all day and remain in namaz all night for as long as I live.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sordu: 'Did you say that?' I cevap verdi: 'May my parents be sacrificed for you, Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I did say that.' He dedi: 'You will not be able to do so. You should fast some days and not others. You should sleep and awake (for namaz). Surely, your body has a right over you. Your eyes have a right over you. Your wife has a right over you. Your guests have a right over you. It is sufficient for you to fast three days every month and because the sevap for a single deed is multiplied ten times, it will be as though you kept fast forever.' However, I was harsh upon myself and things became difficult for me. I dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I have strength.' He dedi: 'Fast as the Messenger of Allāh, Dāwūd, used to fast and do not do more than that.' I sordu: 'What was his oruç like?' He cevap verdi: 'Half of the time.' After 'Abdullāh became old, he used to say: 'If only I had accepted the concession of Resûlullah (ﷺ).'"
150.commentary: Göre another narration, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) asked him: "Have I not been informed that you fast bütün day and offer ṣalāh bütün night?" I replied: "Indeed, O Messenger of bütünāh!" He said: "Do not do so. You should fast bazı days and not others. You should sleep and awake (for ṣalāh). Surely, your body has a doğru over you. Your eyes have a doğru over you. Your wife has a doğru over you. Your guests have a doğru over you. It is sufficient for you to fast three days her month and because the sevap for a single amel is multiplied ten times, it will be as though you kept fast forever." ('Abdullāh says): bununla birlikte, I was harsh upon myself and things became difficult for me. I said: "O Messenger of bütünāh! I have strength." He said: "If yani the case, then fast for one day and do not fast for the next two days." I said: "I have the strength to do more than that." He said: "Then fast her 20 days." I said: "O Messenger of bütünāh, I have the strength to do more than that." He said: "Then fast her 10 days." I said: "O Messenger of bütünāh, I have the strength to do more than that." He said: "Then tam a recitation her seven days and do not do more than that." Another narration has: "The fast bütünāh loves çoğu is that of Dāwūd and the ṣalāh bütünāh loves çoğu is that of Dāwūd. He used to sleep half the night, remain in ṣalāh for one third of the night, and then sleep one sixth of the night. He used to keep fast one day and not fast the next day and he did not flee when he faced the enemy (in battle)."

151.text: Ḥanzalah ibn al-Rabī' al-Usaydī al-Kātib (رضي الله عنه), one of the scribes of Resûlullah (ﷺ), anlatır:"Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) met me (one day) and sordu: 'How are you, O Ḥanzalah?' I cevap verdi: 'Ḥanzalah has become a münafık.' He dedi: 'Glory be to Allāh! What are you diyerek?' I dedi: 'When we are in the company of Resûlullah (ﷺ) and he talks to us about Cennet and cehennem ateşi, then it is as though we can see them right before our eyes. Then when we leave the company of Resûlullah (ﷺ) and we become occupied with our wives, children and livelihood we forget much.' Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) dedi: 'By Allāh, I have also experienced the same thing.' Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) and I then went to Resûlullah (ﷺ). I dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Ḥanzalah has become a münafık.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sordu: 'Why is that?' I dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! When we are with you and you talk to us about Cennet and cehennem ateşi, it is as though we can see them right before our eyes. But when we leave you and we become occupied with our wives, children and livelihoods we forget much.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Nefsim elinde olan Allah'a yemin ederim ki, if you remain in the condition in which you are when you are in my company and you remain in the remembrance of Allāh, the angels will shake hands with you on your beds and on your pathways, but, O Ḥanzalah, there is a time (for ibadet) and there is a time (for worldly engagements).' He dedi this three times."(Müslüman)
151.commentary: Ḥanzalah (رضي الله عنه) feared that he had become a hypocrite because his state of focus and awareness while in the gathering of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) would fade away when he would engage in his daily affairs. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), bununla birlikte, reassured him that he was not compelled to remain perpetually in that elevated state of spirituality. Only the angels remember bütünāh continuously. The life of man oluşur body and soul; the body is nourished by his endeavours to earn and sustain himself, while his soul is nourished by his manevî relationship with his Creator. Company, environment and circumstances influence him and the change in his state of mind does not entail nifak. Neither is the enjoyment of life's bounties contrary to the requirements of ibadet and spirituality.

152.text: While Resûlullah (ﷺ) was delivering a sermon, he noticed a man standing and sordu regarding him. The Sahâbe şöyle dedi: 'He is Abū Isrā'īl. He aldı a vow to stand in the sun and not sit down, take shade or speak and to fast perpetually.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) şöyle dedi: 'Go and tell him to speak, take shade, sit down, but to complete his fast.'"(Bukhārī)
152.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) informed the Ṣaḥābī that his ameller were not regarded as ibadet. Ibn Rajab (رحمه الله) has explained in Jāmi' al-'Ulūm wal-Ḥikam that bütün such ameller are baseless and rejected, which bütünāh and His Messenger (ﷺ) have not classified as ibadet or a means of achieving closeness to bütünāh, despite ones niyet to achieve closeness to bütünāh by engaging in them. Bu hadis highlights the important point that closeness to bütünāh and His Messenger (ﷺ) can only be attained through those channels, which Islām has stipulated. Man might conceive çeşitli ideas and methods of ibadet but these will not be acceptable because their origin is not from ilâhî sources. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) instructed Abū Isrā'īl to keep his fast, as this aspect of his vow was possible to accomplish, as opposed to the others.

153.text: Ömer bin Hattâb (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kim gece ibadetinden bir bölümü uyuyarak kaçırırsa, onu sabah ile öğle arasında kılsın; böylece onu yapmış gibi sevap alır." (Müslim)
153.commentary: Gece namazı (teheccüd) kaçırıldığında, gündüz kaza edilebilir ve aynı sevap alınır. Bu, Allah'ın kolaylık dileyen dininin bir göstergesidir.

154.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
154.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: to me: 'O 'Abdullāh! Do not be like so-and-so person who used to ibadet at night and then stopped doing so.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
154.commentary: Bu hadis gives us a glimpse of the ahlâkî integrity of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) because Ibn Ḥajar al-'Asqalānī mentioned that from the çeşitli narrations of this hadis, not even one specifies the name of the person who was worthy of admonishment. başka bir deyişle, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) concealed his identity. Based on this hadis, it is preferable to adopt continuity upon a good alışkanlık, according to Ibn al-'Arabī, bununla birlikte one should adopt moderation.

155.text: Âişe (رضي الله عنها) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ), hastalık veya başka bir sebeple gece namazını kaçırdığında, gündüz on iki rekât kılardı. (Müslim)
155.commentary: Peygamber (ﷺ) kaçırdığı gece namazını gündüz kaza ederdi. Zamanında kılınamayan nâfile namazların kazası müstehaptır.

156.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Size bıraktığımı alın (fazlasını istemeyin). Çünkü sizden öncekiler ancak çok soru sormaları ve peygamberleri hakkında ihtilafa düşmeleri yüzünden helâk oldu." (Buhârî, Müslim)
156.commentary: Peygamber (ﷺ)'in "size bıraktığımı alın" ifadesi, farz ve sünnetlerle yetinip gereksiz sorular sormamayı emreder. Aşırı soru sormak, önceki ümmetlerin helâk sebebidir.

157.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) bize öyle derin ve beliğ bir hutbe irad etti ki, kalplerimiz titredi, gözlerimiz yaşardı. Biz: "Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Bu vedalaşan birinin konuşması gibi. Bize ne tavsiye edersin?" dedik. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Size, Allah'a karşı takvayı, emretse bile bir Habeşli köleyi dinleyip itaat etmeyi tavsiye ederim. Benden sonra sağ olanlarınız çok ihtilaflar görecek. O zaman sünnetime ve hidâyete erdirilmiş halifelerin sünnetine sımsıkı sarılın. Isırırcasına ona tutunun. Sonradan çıkarılan şeylerden (bid'atlerden) sakının. Çünkü her bid'at sapıklıktır." (Ebû Dâvûd, Tirmizî)
157.commentary: Bu hadis, sünnete sımsıkı sarılmanın ve bid'atlerden sakınmanın önemini vurgular. Her bid'at sapıklıktır ve dinde sonradan çıkarılan her şey reddedilmelidir.

158.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Ümmetimin hepsi cennete girecek, ancak kabul etmeyenler hariç." "Peygamber'den kabul etmeyen kim olur?" diye soruldu. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Bana itaat eden cennete girer, bana isyan eden ise kabul etmemiştir" buyurdu. (Buhârî)
158.commentary: İmanın esası, Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e itaattir. O'na itaat eden cennete girer, isyan eden giremez. "Kabul etmeyen", itaat etmeyen kimsedir.

159.narrator: Salamah ibn 'Amr ibn al-Akwa (رضي الله عنه)
159.text: Bir adam, Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in huzurunda sol eliyle yemek yedi. Resûlullah (ﷺ) ona: "Sağ elinle ye!" buyurdu. Adam: "Yapamıyorum" dedi. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Yapamaz olasın!" buyurdu. Ondan sonra adamın eli ağzına gitmez oldu. (Müslim)
159.commentary: Sağ elle yemek yemek sünnettir. Sol elle yemek yemek mekruhtur. Büyüklenerek sünnete karşı gelen kişi bundan mahrum bırakılabilir.

160.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim: "Ya saflarınızı düzgün tutarsınız ya da Allah yüzlerinizi birbirine çevirir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
160.commentary: Namazda safların düzgün olması, cemaat namazının önemli bir parçasıdır. Safları düzgün tutmayanlar, kalplerinin birbirinden ayrılması tehlikesiyle karşı karşıyadır.

161.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Bu ateş sizin düşmanınızdır. Uyuduğunuzda onu söndürün." (Buhârî, Müslim)
161.commentary: Yangın güvenliği konusunda dikkatli olunmalıdır. Bu hadis, İslâm'ın can ve mal güvenliğine verdiği önemi gösterir.

162.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Allah'ın benimle gönderdiği hidayet ve ilmin misali, bol yağmura benzer. Yağmurun isabet ettiği toprağın bir kısmı suyu emer, bol ot ve bitki yetiştirir. Bir kısmı kuraktır, suyu tutar, Allah da onunla insanları faydalandırır; onlar içer, hayvanlarını sular ve ekin eker. Bir kısmı da kaygan ve düzdür, ne suyu tutar ne de ot bitirir. İşte bu, Allah'ın dinini anlayıp faydalanan kimse ile, duyduğu halde başını kaldırmayan ve hidayeti kabul etmeyen kimsenin misalidir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
162.commentary: Bu hadis, ilmin farklı şekillerde kabul edildiğini ve insanların ilimden faydalanma derecelerinin farklı olduğunu anlatır. Önemli olan, ilmi alıp ondan faydalanmaktır.

163.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Benim ve sizin misaliniz, ateş yakan bir adam gibidir. Ateşin etrafına pervaneler ve böcekler düşmeye başlayınca, adam onları kurtarmak için uğraşır. Ben de sizi ateşten kurtarmak için eteklerinizden tutuyorum. Siz ise elimden kaçıp gidiyorsunuz." (Buhârî, Müslim)
163.commentary: Peygamber (ﷺ)'in ümmetine olan şefkatini gösterir. O, ümmetini cehennem ateşinden kurtarmak için büyük çaba sarf etmiştir.

164.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) parmakları ve tabağı yalamayı emretti ve şöyle buyurdu: "Bereketin hangi yemekte olduğunu bilemezsiniz." (Müslim)
164.commentary: Yemekten sonra parmakları ve tabağı yalamak müstehaptır, çünkü bereketin nerede olduğu bilinemez. İsraftan kaçınılmalıdır.

165.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) bize hitaben ayağa kalktı ve şöyle buyurdu: "Ey insanlar! Siz Allah'ın huzuruna yalınayak, çıplak ve sünnetsiz olarak çıkarılacaksınız." Sonra şu âyeti okudu: "Yaratmaya nasıl başladıysak, onu tekrarlayacağız. Üzerimize düşen bir vaaddir. Şüphesiz biz bunu yapanız." (Buhârî, Müslim)
165.commentary: Ahiret hayatının gerçekliğini ve dünyanın geçiciliğini vurgular. İnsan, mahşer günü için hazırlıklı olmalıdır.

166.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) başparmak ve şehadet parmağıyla çakıl taşı atmayı yasakladı ve şöyle buyurdu: "Bu ne avı öldürür ne de düşmana zarar verir. Fakat gözü çıkarabilir ve dişi kırabilir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
166.commentary: Boş yere ve faydasız işlerle uğraşmak yasaklanmıştır. Çakıl taşı atmak gibi hem faydasız hem de zararlı olabilecek davranışlardan kaçınılmalıdır.

167.text: Ömer bin Hattâb (رضي الله عنه)'ın Hacerü'l-Esved'i öptüğünü ve şöyle dediğini gördüm: "Biliyorum ki sen, ne zarar ne de fayda vermeyen bir taşsın. Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i seni öperken görmeseydim, seni öpmezdim." (Buhârî, Müslim)
167.commentary: Sahâbenin sünnete bağlılığını ve taklidî değil, tahkikî imanı gösterir. Ömer (رضي الله عنه) sünnete uymayı, akla ve duyguya tercih eder.

168.text: Enes (رضي الله عنه) şöyle anlatır: "Göklerde ve yerde ne varsa Allah'ındır. İçinizdekini açığa vursanız da gizleseniz de Allah sizi onunla hesaba çeker" âyeti inince, bu Müslümanlara ağır geldi. Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e gelip oturdular ve: "Gücümüz yetmeyen şeylerle mükellef tutulduk" dediler. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Teslim olun (semi'nâ ve ata'nâ) demek ister misiniz?" buyurdu. Bunun üzerine Allah: "Peygamber, Rabbinden kendisine indirilene iman etti, müminler de..." âyetini indirdi. (Müslim)
168.commentary: Müslümanlar, Allah'ın emirlerini işitince tereddütsüz kabul etmelidir. Bu âyetin nüzulü, sahâbenin Allah'a olan teslimiyetini ve itaatini göstermektedir.

169.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kim bizim dinimize, ondan olmayan bir şey sokarsa, o şey kabul edilmez (reddedilir)." (Buhârî, Müslim)
169.commentary: Dinde sonradan ortaya çıkarılan her şey (bid'at) reddedilmiştir. Din, Peygamber (ﷺ) tarafından tebliğ edildiği şekliyle kabul edilmelidir.

170.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) hutbe irad ettiğinde gözleri kızarır, sesi yükselir ve öfkesi şiddetlenirdi. Sanki bir orduya: "Düşman sabah bastıracak" diye uyarı yapıyor gibi olurdu. Şöyle derdi: "Ben ve kıyamet şu iki parmak gibi yakınız." (Şehadet ve orta parmağını birleştirerek). (Müslim)
170.commentary: Peygamber (ﷺ)'in hutbeleri çok tesirli ve etkileyiciydi. Kıyametin yakınlığı konusunda ümmetini sürekli uyarırdı.

171.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kim İslâm'da güzel bir çığır açarsa, onun sevabını ve kendisinden sonra o çığırda yürüyenlerin sevabını, onların sevabından hiç eksiltmeksizin alır. Kim de İslâm'da kötü bir çığır açarsa, onun günahını ve kendisinden sonra o çığırda yürüyenlerin günahını, onların günahından hiç eksiltmeksizin yüklenir." (Müslim)
171.commentary: İyilik veya kötülük başlatan kişi, kendisinden sonra gelenlerin amelinden de sorumludur. Bu, insanı hayra vesile olmaya teşvik eder.

172.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Hiç kimse haksız yere öldürülmez ki, onun kanından bir pay, Âdem'in ilk oğluna da verilmiş olmasın. Çünkü cinayeti ilk işleyen odur." (Buhârî, Müslim)
172.commentary: Haksız yere adam öldürmenin vebali büyüktür. İlk cinayeti işleyen Kâbil olduğu için, her maktulün günahından bir pay ona da gider.

173.narrator: Abū Mas'ūd 'Uqbah ibn 'Amr al-Anṣārī al-Badrī (رضي الله عنه)
173.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kim bir hayra yönlendirirse, o hayrı işleyenin sevabı kadar sevap alır." (Müslim)
173.commentary: Hayra vesile olan, hayrı işleyen gibi sevap alır. Bu, Müslümanları hayır işlerinde birbirlerine yardım etmeye teşvik eder.

174.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kim hidayete çağırırsa, kendisine uyanların sevabı kadar sevap alır, bu onların sevabından hiçbir şey eksiltmez. Kim de dalalete çağırırsa, kendisine uyanların günahı kadar günah alır, bu onların günahından hiçbir şey eksiltmez." (Müslim)
174.commentary: Hayra ve şerre vesile olmanın sorumluluğu büyüktür. Herkes, başkalarını etkileme gücünün farkında olmalıdır.

175.narrator: Sahl ibn Sa'd al-Sā'idī (رضي الله عنه)
175.text: Hayber Savaşı sırasında Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Yarın sancağı öyle birine vereceğim ki, Allah onun eliyle fetih nasip edecek. O, Allah'ı ve Resûl'ünü sever, Allah ve Resûlü de onu sever." (Buhârî, Müslim)
175.commentary: Ali (رضي الله عنه)'nin faziletini ve Peygamber (ﷺ) katındaki değerini gösterir. Allah'ı ve Resûl'ünü seven, onlar tarafından da sevilir.

176.text: Benî Eslem'den bir genç: "Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Cihada çıkmak istiyorum ama binecek bir hayvanım yok" dedi. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Falan kişiye git, o cihada hazırlanıyordu ama hastalandı" buyurdu. Genç ona gitti ve: "Allah seni mübarek kılsın" dedi. (Buhârî, Müslim)
176.commentary: Cihada katılamayan, ona vesile olan kişi de sevap alır. Müslümanlar hayırda yardımlaşmalıdır.

177.narrator: Zeyd bin Hâlid el-Cühenî (رضي الله عنه)
177.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kim bir mücahidi donatırsa, kendisi de cihada çıkmış gibi sevap alır. Kim bir mücahidin ailesine hayırla bakarsa, o da cihada çıkmış gibi sevap alır." (Buhârî, Müslim)
177.commentary: Cihadı desteklemek, bizzat cihada katılmak gibi sevap kazandırır. Mücahidlerin ailelerine bakmak da aynı ecri getirir.

178.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) Huzeyl kabilesinden Benî Lihyân'a bir askeri birlik gönderdi ve şöyle buyurdu: "Her iki kişiden biri savaşa katılsın, sevapta ortaktırlar." (Müslim)
178.commentary: Cihad için ordu hazırlamak ve asker göndermek, toplumsal bir sorumluluktur. Bu konuda işbirliği yapılmalıdır.

179.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) Ravhâ'da bir kervanla karşılaştı ve onlara: "Siz kimsiniz?" diye sordu. Onlar: "Müslümanlarız" dediler. "Ya siz?" diye sordular. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Ben Allah'ın Resûlüyüm" buyurdu. (Müslim)
179.commentary: Tebliğin her fırsatta yapılması gerektiğini gösterir. Yolda karşılaşılan bir kervanla dahi konuşup İslâm'ı anlatmak önemlidir.

180.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kendisine emredileni gönül hoşluğuyla yerine getiren ve aldığına da rıza gösteren güvenilir Müslüman bir hazinedar, sadaka verenlerden biridir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
180.commentary: İşinde güvenilir ve dürüst olan kişi, sadaka veren gibi sevap kazanır. Güvenilirlik büyük bir fazilettir.

181.narrator: Tamīm ibn Aus al-Dārī (رضي الله عنه)
181.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Din nasihattir." "Kimin için?" diye sorduk. "Allah için, Kitabı için, Resûlü için, Müslüman yöneticiler ve bütün Müslümanlar için" buyurdu. (Müslim)
181.commentary: Nasihat (samimiyet), İslâm'ın temelidir. Müslüman, Allah, Kitap, Peygamber ve tüm Müslümanlar hakkında samimi olmalıdır.

182.text: Cerîr bin Abdullah (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e namaz kılmak, zekât vermek ve her Müslümana nasihat etmek üzere biat ettim. (Buhârî, Müslim)
182.commentary: Biat, İslâm'da önemli bir kavramdır. Müslümanlar, namaz, zekât ve nasihat üzere birbirlerine bağlıdır.

183.text: Enes (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Sizden biriniz, kendisi için istediğini (hayrı) din kardeşi için de istemedikçe (gerçek anlamda) iman etmiş olmaz." (Buhârî, Müslim)
183.commentary: İmanın kemali, başkaları için de kendin için istediğini istemekle olur. Bu, İslâm kardeşliğinin en güzel ifadesidir.

184.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim: "Sizden kim bir kötülük (münker) görürse, onu eliyle değiştirsin. Buna gücü yetmezse diliyle düzeltsin. Buna da gücü yetmezse kalbiyle buğzetsin. Bu ise imanın en zayıf derecesidir." (Müslim)
184.commentary: Kötülükle mücadele, kişinin gücüne göre derecelendirilmiştir: el, dil, kalp. Kalpten buğz etmek imanın en zayıf derecesidir ve bunun altı iman sayılmaz.

185.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Benden önce Allah'ın bir ümmete gönderdiği hiçbir peygamber yoktur ki, onun havarileri ve ashabı olmasın. Onlar peygamberin sünnetine sarılır ve emrine uyarlardı. Sonra onların yerine, yapmadıklarını söyleyen ve emredilmediklerini yapan nesiller geldi. Kim onlara karşı eliyle cihad ederse mümindir, diliyle cihad ederse mümindir, kalbiyle cihad ederse mümindir. Bunun ötesinde ise hardal tanesi kadar iman yoktur." (Müslim)
185.commentary: Emr-i bi'l-maruf ve nehy-i ani'l-münker (iyiliği emretmek, kötülükten sakındırmak) farz-ı kifayedir. Bunu terk edenler topluca azaba uğrayabilir.

186.text: Ubâde bin Sâmit (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e zorlukta ve kolaylıkta, hoşumuza giden ve gitmeyen hallerde işitip itaat etmek üzere, bizi yönetenlerin emrinden çıkmamak ve nerede olursak olalım hakkı söylemek, Allah yolunda hiçbir kınayanın kınamasından korkmamak üzere biat ettik. (Buhârî, Müslim)
186.commentary: Müslüman yöneticilere itaat, meşru olmayan emirler dışında farzdır. Kınanmaktan korkmadan hakkı söylemek de bir biat şartıdır.

187.text: Nu'mân bin Beşîr (رضي الله عنهما) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Allah'ın sınırlarını koruyan (haddleri uygulayan) ve onları çiğneyenlerin misali, bir gemide oturan bir topluluğa benzer.
