One who repels evil with evil only succeeds in creating further disunity and driving people away from bütünāh.

319.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kim rızkının genişlemesini ve ömrünün uzamasını istiyorsa, akrabasını ziyaret etsin." (Buhârî, Müslim)
319.commentary: "Expansion in his sustenance" can mean that there will be an asıl increase in sustenance or that there will be barakah therein. Bu hadis may seem to contradict verses of the Qur'ān that state that a person's sustenance and age are fixed and preordained. Scholars have explained this apparent contradiction in çeşitli ways. Firstly, an increase in age means barakah in time, the ability to perform additional iyilikler, having the good fortune of protecting one's time from futile activities and possessing good health which will result in inner peace and contentment. Similarly, one will be remembered and praised after one's demise, causing one to remain alive on the tongues of people. One will also be blessed with pious children who will continue praying for him, thereby keeping his legacy alive. A second açıklama is that the Qur'ānic verses relate to bütünāh's ultimate knowledge that does not change, while the hadis relates to that which is perceived by man. başka bir deyişle, bütünāh knows whether a person will maintain family ties, bundan dolayı in the knowledge of bütünāh his age is preordained. bununla birlikte, in the anlayış of man his life will appear to be lengthened by maintaining family ties.

320.text: Enes (رضي الله عنه) şöyle anlatır: Ebû Talha (رضي الله عنه), Medine'de ensarın en çok hurmalığına sahipti. En sevdiği malı ise Beyruhâ adlı bahçesiydi. "Sevdiğiniz şeylerden infak etmedikçe iyiliğe eremezsiniz" âyeti inince Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e gelip: "Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! En sevdiğim malım Beyruhâ'dır. Onu Allah yolunda sadaka olarak veriyorum. Allah katında onu biriktirmeni ve yakınlarım arasında paylaştırmanı dilerim" dedi. (Buhârî, Müslim)
320.commentary: Bu hadis has been discussed in a previous chapter. See hadis 297. It bize öğretir ki it is preferable and more rewarding to spend on our family and relatives as compared to others. One of the faydalar of such spending is that it creates unity and cements the bonds of sevgi and iyilik amongst family.

321.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
321.text: Bir adam Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e gelip: "Sevabını Allah'tan umarak hicret ve cihat için size biat ediyorum" dedi. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Ana babandan sağ olan var mı?" buyurdu. Adam: "Evet, ikisi de sağ" dedi. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Peki sen sevabı Allah'tan mı umuyorsun?" buyurdu. Adam: "Evet" dedi. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Öyleyse ana babana dön ve onlara iyi bak" buyurdu. (Buhârî, Müslim)
321.commentary: Bu hadis önemine işaret eder being kind to one's parents, serving them and earning their pleasure. Migration at that time held the status of wujūb (compulsion), bununla birlikte caring for parents enjoys a greater status of wujūb, bundan dolayı the latter was preferred. This hüküm applies to a person whose din is safe in the area where he resides. bununla birlikte, if he fears for his din by remaining where he is, it will be compulsory upon him to migrate even if he has to leave his parents and children behind, as the Muhājirīn did. In Islām, serving one's parents enjoys a greater status than jihād because the former is Farḍ 'Ain (an individual farz), while the latter is Farḍ al-Kifāyah (a collective farz, which is fulfilled if even one person performs it). bununla birlikte, this hüküm will change in the case when jihād becomes Farḍ 'Ain.

322.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
322.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Sıla-i rahim (akraba ziyareti), iyiliğe iyilikle karşılık vermek değildir. Asıl sıla-i rahim, akrabasının ilişkiyi kestiği zaman onunla ilişkiyi sürdürendir." (Buhârî)
322.commentary: Scholars have classified three categories of people with regard to family relations. The first is a person who breaks ties. The second is one who reciprocates by dealing in the same şekil in which others deal with him, by not doing any more or any less. The third is one who maintains ties by being good to those who sever ties with him. Bu hadis işaret eder this third category. In essence, it encourages us to be kind to those who are unkind to us.

323.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Rahim (akrabalık bağı) Arş'a asılıdır ve şöyle der: 'Benimle bağını sürdürenle Allah bağını sürdürsün, beni kesenle Allah bağını kessin.'" (Buhârî, Müslim)
323.commentary: The hadis does not literally mean that ties of kinship have a physical form; rather, a metaphor has been used to highlight the önem of family ties. Such methods of expression are very yaygın amongst Arabs.

324.narrator: The Mother of the Believers, Maymūnah bint al-Ḥārith (رضي الله عنها)
324.text: Âişe (رضي الله عنها) şöyle anlatır: Bir cariyeyi Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in iznini almadan azat etti. Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in yanına gelme sırası geldiğinde ona durumu anlattı. (Buhârî, Müslim)
324.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki giving away one's slave to serve other family members that are in need is more virtuous than freeing the slave, because it constitutes charity as well as joining ties of kinship. The amel of Maymūnah bint al-Ḥārith (رضي الله عنها) proves that a wife may utilise or dispose of her wealth without her husband's izin, according to the majority of the scholars. According to Imām Mālik (رحمه الله), she may only do so with a third or less of her wealth; for more than a third, she requires her husband's izin. It is daima wise to seek the counsel of the pious and elderly when intending to perform good ameller gibi charity. Their foresight and experience will prove invaluable in guiding one in the doğru direction.

325.narrator: Asmā' bint Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq (رضي الله عنهما)
325.text: Esma bint Ebû Bekr (رضي الله عنها) şöyle anlatır: Müşrik olan annem Resûlullah (ﷺ) zamanında bana geldi. Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e: "Annem bana geldi. Ona iyilik yapabilir miyim?" diye sordum. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Evet, annene iyilik yap" buyurdu. (Buhârî, Müslim)
325.commentary: The mother of Asmā' (رضي الله عنها) had come from Makkah Mukarramah to see her daughter in Madīnah Munawwarah during the period of the treaty of Ḥudaibiyyah. Asmā' (رضي الله عنها) was unsure how to deal with her mother because she was a non-Muslim and bu nedenle enquired from the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) ordered that she be treated kindly, in accordance with the verse of the Qur'ān: "But if they (her iki) strive with you to make you join in ibadet as partner that of which you have no knowledge, then obey them not, but behave with them in the world kindly." (Sūrah Luqmān, 15) This bize öğretir ki it is necessary to maintain ties with and provide financial support for parents who are non-Muslims.

326.text: Abdullah bin Mes'ûd (رضي الله عنه)'un hanımı Zeyneb es-Sekafiyye (رضي الله عنها) şöyle anlatır: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Ey kadınlar! Malınızın bir kısmını sadaka olarak verin." (Buhârî, Müslim)
326.commentary: The hadis teaches us to spend on relatives and family. Another hadis states, "Indeed the çoğu worthy recipients of optional charity, zakāh, vows and penalties (kaffārah), endowments (waqf), bequests (waṣiyyah) and bütün avenues of goodness are one's close relatives." According to the Ḥanafī school, it is not helal to give zakāh to one's ascendants gibi parents, grandparents, etc.; and it is not helal to give zakāh to one's descendants gibi one's children, grandchildren etc. ayrıca, the husband and wife cannot give zakāh to her biri other. One is permitted to give zakāh to other relatives gibi brothers, sisters, uncles, aunts, nephews, nieces, etc. Bu hadis according to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله) bu nedenle relates to optional ṣadaqah and not zakāh.

327.narrator: Ebû Süfyân Sakr bin Harb (رضي الله عنه)
327.text: Ebû Süfyân (رضي الله عنه) şöyle anlatır: Herakleios'un uzun konuşmasında bana: "Resûlullah (ﷺ) size neyi emrediyor?" diye sordu. Ben: "Namaz kılmayı, doğru söylemeyi, iffetli olmayı ve akrabalık bağlarını korumayı emrediyor" dedim. (Buhârî, Müslim)
327.commentary: The emir to reject ascribing partners with bütünāh includes major shirk (polytheism) which is küfür, as well as minor shirk, which is riyā' (pride). Bu hadis also appears in the Chapter on doğruluk. See hadis 56. The önem Islām gives to family ties can be understood from the fact that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) emphasised it from the very beginning of his nebevî mission.

328.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Yakında öyle bir beldeyi fethedeceksiniz ki, orada kırat (para birimi) kullanılır." (Buhârî)
328.commentary: Imām Nawawī (رحمه الله) says that the scholars explain that a qīrāṭ is a portion of a dīnār or dirham and it was used as a currency in Egypt. Egypt is a land with a rich history which goes back 5000 years before 'Isā (عليه السلام). It was conquered by the Muslim genel 'Amr ibn al-'Āṣ (رضي الله عنه) during the khilāfah of 'Umar (رضي الله عنه). birçok Messengers (عليهم السلام) walked on its soil, hundreds of Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) resided there and thousands of great scholars were born there. The ties of kinship which linked Arabs and Egyptians was because the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was from the progeny of Ismā'īl (عليه السلام). The oppressive king that ruled Egypt during the time of Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام) gave Hājirah as a gift to Sārah, who was the wife of Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام), then gifted Hājirah to her husband, who then married her. Ismā'īl (عليه السلام) was born from this union. The ties of marriage that linked them was because of the Egyptian slave-girl, Māriyah. When the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) wrote to Muqauqis, the king of Egypt, inviting him to accept Islām, the latter did not embrace the iman, but sent two slave-girls Māriyah and Sīrīn as gifts to the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) kept Māriyah for himself and gave Sīrīn to Ḥassān ibn Thābit (رضي الله عنه). Ibrāhīm (رضي الله عنه), the son of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was born to Māriyah, but he passed away in infancy. The ties of kinship of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) through Hājirah and Ismā'īl (عليه السلام) spanned birçok generations back, bununla birlikte the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) advised the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) to honour them. This bize öğretir ki distant relatives should also be treated like family.

329.text: "Yakın akrabanı uyar" (Şuarâ 214) âyeti inince, Resûlullah (ﷺ) Kureyş'i topladı ve genel ve özel olarak uyardı. (Buhârî, Müslim)
329.commentary: Bu hadis emphasises the önem of family ties and maintaining them even if one's family are disbelievers. bazı people believe that they will receive salvation from azap because of their family, lineage or association with the pious and bundan dolayı continue with their lives of günah. Bu hadis refutes such a inanç because only one's īmān and iyilikler can save a person on the day of Qiyāmah. A Qur'ānic verse states, "Then, when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no kinship among them that Day, nor will they ask of one another." (Sūrah al-Mu'minūn, 101) The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) wisely addressed his çoğu beloved daughter in public, in order to teach others that even his fatherly sevgi and link could not save her from ilâhî azap, if she was deserving of it.

330.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i yüksek sesle şöyle derken işittim: "Falan ailesi benim dostlarım değildir. Benim dostlarım Allah ve salih müminlerdir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
330.commentary: The hadis points out that a Muslim should maintain family ties with relatives even if they are disbelievers, bununla birlikte gerçek friendship should only be established between Muslims. This teaching corresponds with the Qur'ānic verse, "And if you back her biri other against him (the Messenger (ﷺ)), then bütünāh is his supporter and Jibra'īl and the righteous believers." (Sūrah al-Taḥrīm, 4) Kawāshī (رحمه الله) stated in the commentary of Bu âyet that "the righteous believers" refer to Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه), 'Umar (رضي الله عنه), her believer yani free of nifak, and the Messengers (عليهم السلام).

331.narrator: Abū Ayyūb Khālid ibn Zayd al-Anṣārī (رضي الله عنه)
331.text: Bir adam: "Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Bana beni cennete sokacak ve cehennemden uzaklaştıracak bir amel söyle" dedi. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Allah'a ibadet et, O'na hiçbir şeyi ortak koşma, namazı kıl, zekâtı ver ve akrabanı ziyaret et" buyurdu. (Buhârî, Müslim)
331.commentary: One of the unique qualities of the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) was their tremendous zeal to improve their spirituality. For this, they enquired from the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) about ameller that would earn the pleasure of bütünāh, enabling later generations to also practise upon them. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) perhaps singled out family ties for this particular Ṣaḥābī because he knew that the Ṣaḥābī was not one who upheld family ties, bundan dolayı he was commanded to concentrate on this more than other matters.

332.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Biriniz orucunu açacağı zaman hurma ile açsın. Çünkü hurma bereketlidir. Hurma bulamazsa su ile açsın. Çünkü su temizdir." (Tirmizî, Ebû Dâvûd)
332.commentary: Scholars mention that the blessings associated with dates include the strengthening of the eyesight, replenishing lost energy, cleansing the stomach and providing nourishment to the body. It is preferable to break the fast with dates and/or water. As a genel rule one should choose those avenues of good that draw the çoğu sevap.

333.text: Abdullah bin Ömer (رضي الله عنهما) şöyle anlatır: Sevdiğim bir kadınla evliydim. Babam Ömer (رضي الله عنه) onu sevmezdi. Bana: "Onu boşa" dedi. Ben boşamadım. Babam Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e gidip durumu anlattı. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Boşa onu" buyurdu. (Tirmizî, Ebû Dâvûd)
333.commentary: Ibn 'Umar's (رضي الله عنهما) sevgi for his wife was based on passion and emotion, while 'Umar's (رضي الله عنه) dislike for her was based on dinî reasons. bütünāh blessed 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) with great foresight. History records birçok occasions when he expressed an opinion that was later doğrulanan by ilâhî revelation. bundan dolayı, in this particular case, he disapproved of his son's wife based on dinî grounds or he perhaps feared that she was detrimental to his manevî life. If his assessment of the situation had been incorrect, it would asla have been approved of by the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). Bu hadis has relevance in modern times. birçok young people nowadays openly disobey their parent's wishes in their choice of marriage partners. The hadis bize öğretir ki parents that have a geçerli Islāmic reason for disliking a particular marriage partner for their offspring should be obeyed. Marriages which are initiated without the blessing and du'ās of parents frequently run into problems. Scholars state that Bu hadis does not prove that it is compulsory to obey parent's wishes in bütün circumstances. bunun sebebi is that not bütün parents are righteous and bütünāh-fearing and at times parents may dislike their daughter-in-law based on bazı dünyevî motive yani not a geçerli reason for a divorce. In such a case, the son should respectfully explain to them their mistake and maintain his marriage.

334.text: Bir adam Sa'd (رضي الله عنه)'a gelip: "Bir eşim var, annem onu boşamamı istiyor" dedi. Sa'd: "Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim: 'Ana babaya itaat etmeyen kimse cennetin kokusunu bile alamaz'" dedi. (Buhârî, Müslim)
334.commentary: The man approached Abū al-Dardā' (رضي الله عنه) because he was uncertain about divorcing his wife, due to his sevgi for her. Abū al-Dardā' (رضي الله عنه) advised that he should obey his parents. As explained in the previous hadis, it is necessary to obey one's parents in matters that conform to sharī'ah. The parent is described as the middle gate of cennet, which is the best gate. This demektir ki being obedient to parents en hayırlılarındandır means of entering cennet.

335.commentary: As the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) departed after the Qaḍā' 'Umrah in 7 Hijrī, the daughter of Ḥamzah called out, 'My uncle!' 'Alī (رضي الله عنه) took her to Fāṭimah (رضي الله عنها) and said, "Take care of the daughter of your uncle." Subsequently, a dispute ensued between 'Alī (رضي الله عنه), Zayd (رضي الله عنه) and Ja'far (رضي الله عنه), who bütün wanted to take care of the girl. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) settled the matter by stating that the maternal aunt enjoys the same status as the mother, bundan dolayı she should take care of the child. This bize öğretir ki we should strive to be kind to our maternal aunts. It is gerçek that nephews and nieces generally receive greater affection from their maternal aunts than from others.

336.narrator: Abū Bakrah Nufay' ibn al-Ḥārith (رضي الله عنه)
336.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Size büyük günahların en büyüğünü haber vereyim mi?" Bunu üç kere tekrarladı. "Allah'a ortak koşmak, ana babaya isyan etmek" buyurdu. Sonra yaslanmışken doğrulup: "Dikkat edin! Yalan söylemek ve yalancı şahitlik de!" Bunu o kadar tekrarladı ki, keşke sussaydı dedik. (Buhârî, Müslim)
336.commentary: "Major günahlar" refer to günahlar for which there are severe warnings mentioned in the Qur'ān and hadis. The çoğu serious of major günahlar have been classified as such because of the evil and vice they constitute. Bu hadis describes three of them. Ascribing partners to bütünāh is a major crime that entails slander and falsehood against bütünāh, amongst other evils. isyan to parents is an expression of ingratitude, denial of one's origin and negligence of farz haklar. Giving yanlış testimony entails oppression, deception, usurping the haklar of others and spreading of corruption amongst people. It sık sık springs from nefret and enmity. To stress its şiddet and warn people against it, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) changed his posture when mentioning it.

337.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
337.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Büyük günahlar: Allah'a ortak koşmak, ana babaya isyan etmek, bir cana kıymak ve yalan yemin etmektir." (Buhârî)
337.commentary: Killing an innocent soul is a major günah. The Qur'ān states that taking the life of a single person is tantamount to killing humanity in its entirety. Despite man's progress in technology, man has remained very primitive in the domain of protecting insanî life. It is for this reason that when innocent people are killed in birçok parts of the world, nations who pride themselves with ostentatious attributes turn a blind eye. Taking a yanlış oath in the name of bütünāh is such a major günah that even charity cannot atone for it. One who engages in this günah mocks at bütünāh's greatness; bundan dolayı, it is mentioned in the same breath as associating partners with bütünāh.

338.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
338.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Büyük günahlardan biri de kişinin ana babasına sövmesidir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
338.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) here displayed his in-depth anlayış of insanî nature by explaining that the genel reaction of people is to retaliate against those who harm them. By being vulgar towards other's parents, bu nedenle, unnecessarily exposes one's own parents to abuse. The Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) asked in surprise if a person could actually abuse his parents because one who recognises their haklar and status will be kind and grateful to them, not vulgar and ill mannered.

339.narrator: Abū Muḥammad Jubayr ibn Muṭ'im (رضي الله عنه)
339.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Akrabalık bağını kesen cennete giremez." (Buhârî, Müslim)
339.commentary: The hadis warns against severing ties of kinship, özellikle with one's parents. It can be interpreted in one of two ways. A person who severs ties of kinship will not enter cennet with those who are successful; he will first be punished for his günah and thereafter enter cennet. Alternatively it could mean that one who regards severing of ties to be helal, knowing that it is haram, will asla enter cennet because of his denial of a fundamental law of Islām.

340.narrator: Abū 'Īsā al-Mughīrah ibn Shu'bah (رضي الله عنه)
340.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Allah size annelere isyanı, mal biriktirip vermemeyi, kız çocuklarını diri diri gömmeyi yasakladı. Size dedikodu yapmayı, çok soru sormayı ve malı israf etmeyi de hoş görmedi." (Buhârî, Müslim)
340.commentary: Göre 'bütünāmah Ṭībī (رحمه الله), Bu hadis is the basis of comprehending güzel ahlâk. It comprises six types of evils: 1. isyan to mothers - bütünāh has haram isyan to mothers. Fathers are also included in the hüküm; bununla birlikte, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) sufficed by mentioning only mothers because the latter are more sık sık disobeyed due to their weakness. 2. Hoarding işaret eder holding back from spending that which is compulsory to spend and, at the same time, desiring what others possess. 3. Burying daughters alive - Although daughters have been specifically mentioned in this hadis, the yasak includes male offspring as well. 4. Futile talk includes relating what one hears without verifying the authenticity and truth thereof. 5. Asking questions in abundance - This may refer to questioning about problematic issues without any pressing need or unnecessary probing into the affairs of others. 6. Wasting wealth - This işaret eder spending wealth in those avenues that are not permitted by the sharī'ah and in which there is no manevî or dünyevî fayda.

341.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "İyiliğin en güzeli, kişinin babasının dostlarıyla iyi ilişkisini sürdürmesidir." (Müslim)
341.commentary: bütünāh and the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) have emphatically commanded us in the Qur'ān and hadis to obey, honour and serve our parents. It follows from this that we should also honour and saygı those who are associated with them. Bu bölüm also encourages us to honour our in-laws, teachers, students, just rulers, etc. When society is filled with mutual saygı it will lead to harmony and unity.

342.text: Abdullah bin Dinar, Abdullah bin Ömer (رضي الله عنهما)'den şöyle rivayet eder: Mekke yolunda bir bedevî ona rastladı. Abdullah ona iyilik yaptı ve bir merkep verdi. (Buhârî)
342.commentary: Hadis 341 ve 342 aslında birdir. Hadis 342, hadis 341'deki hükmün verilmesine yol açan olayın şartlarını açıklar.

343.narrator: Abū Usayd Mālik ibn Rabī'ah al-Sā'idī (رضي الله عنه)
343.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in yanında oturuyorduk. Benî Seleme kabilesinden bir adam gelip: "Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Annemden sonra ona iyilik yapabileceğim bir şey kaldı mı?" dedi. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Evet, ona dua et, onun için bağışlanma dile, vasiyetini yerine getir, dostlarına ikramda bulun ve akrabalarına sıla-i rahim yap" buyurdu. (Ebû Dâvûd)
343.commentary: Bu hadis teaches us to continuously make du'ā' for our parents after their demise because a child's du'ā' for the parent is accepted and the sevap thereof reaches the parent. Another hadis states that one of the avenues through which a person will continuously be rewarded in the ahiret is the du'ā' of his pious offspring. The Qur'ān teaches us excellent du'ās in this regard: "O my Sustainer, have rahmet upon them tıpkı... gibi they brought me up when I was little." (Sūrah al-Isrā', 24) and, "O my Sustainer, forgive me and my parents." (Sūrah Nūḥ, 28). 'Āqūlī (رحمه الله) provided a useful açıklama for "maintaining ties of kinship that cannot be maintained except through them." He said that if we assume that we were born directly from soil and not through the agency of a mother, then we would not have had the opportunity of entering cennet through the iyilik of maintaining ties of kinship, because such ties would have been non-existent. bu nedenle, because one's parents are the means of this act of goodness, it will be compulsory to honour them by honouring their respective families.

344.text: Âişe (رضي الله عنها) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in hanımlarından hiçbirini, Hatice (رضي الله عنها)'yi kıskandığım kadar kıskanmadım. Onu hiç görmedim ama Resûlullah (ﷺ) onu çok anardı. (Buhârî, Müslim)
344.commentary: "I asla saw her" demektir ki 'Ā'ishah did not meet Khadījah (رضي الله عنها) because the latter passed away before 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) could reach the age of perception. It could also mean that 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) and Khadījah (رضي الله عنها) were not co-wives at one time. Hālah bint Khuwaylid (رضي الله عنها) was Khadījah's (رضي الله عنها) only sister. She was the mother of 'Āṣ ibn al-Rabī' (رضي الله عنه), the husband of Zaynab (رضي الله عنها), who was the daughter of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) had tremendous sevgi and affection for Khadījah (رضي الله عنها). She was the only wife that bore him children that lived to marriageable age. Although she was 15 years older than he was, they were happily married for approximately 24 years. She had great insight, knowledge and possessed sterling qualities. She was the first to believe in his message, she desteklenen him when birçok rejected him, she spent from her wealth for the sake of Islām, she patiently teşvik edilen her husband through the torments and hardships he faced and she shared in his pain. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was so deeply affected by her demise that the year became known as 'the year of grief' for him. 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) once asked him, "Has bütünāh not granted you that which is better in exchange?" He replied, "No, by bütünāh, she believed in me when my nation disbelieved in me, she helped me when my nation abandoned me and she gave me from her wealth when my nation deprived me." The Messenger of bütünāh's (ﷺ) tremendous sevgi for everything associated with his first wife has been aptly explained by the fact that one who loves an entity will sevgi everything associated with it or that resembles it. bu nedenle, the Messenger of bütünāh's (ﷺ) davranış towards the friends of his deceased spouse was proof of his unflinching sadakat and sevgi for her even after her demise.

345.text: Cerîr bin Abdullah el-Becelî (رضي الله عنه) ile bir yolculuğa çıktım. Bana hizmet etti. Ben: "Bunu yapma" dedim. O: "Müslümanların birbirine hizmet etmesi güzel bir şeydir" dedi. (Müslim)
345.commentary: Anas (رضي الله عنه) objected to Jarīr ibn 'Abdullāh (رضي الله عنه) serving him because the latter was older than he was. From this, we learn three dersler. Firstly, it işaret eder the fazilet and tevazu of Jarīr ibn 'Abdullāh (رضي الله عنه), his iyilik to the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and to those who served the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). Secondly, it teaches us to honour and serve the righteous and those associated with them, even though they may be younger. Thirdly, the fact that the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) served the servants of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) illustrates their degree of sevgi for him.

346.text: Yezid bin Hayyân şöyle anlatır: "Husayn bin Sabra, Amr bin Müslim ve ben Zeyd bin Erkam (رضي الله عنهم)'ı ziyarete gittik..." (Müslim)
346.commentary: In a number of aḥādīth, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) emphasised the önem of holding onto the book of bütünāh. As can be drawn from the analogy of a rope, those who hold on to the rope will be saved, while those who do not will be lost. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) similarly emphasised upon the need for the believers to fulfil the haklar of his family. Their status is extremely high and noble because bütünāh selected them to be part of the noblest of nebevî households, bundan dolayı, they should be honoured and revered. Attacks, objections and criticism from disbelievers and deviated sects regarding their purity and nobility should be refuted.

347.text: Ebû Bekr (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi: "Muhammed (ﷺ)'i, ailesine hürmet ederek hürmet edin." (Buhârî)
347.commentary: Those who honour and sevgi the family of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) will be deemed to have honoured and loved the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). bununla birlikte, such honour and sevgi does not merely entail lip service; rather, it demands following the guidance of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and adopting the noble character of the members of his household. Additionally, such sevgi should not lead to exaggeration and extremism that will lead to perpetration of ameller and ameller that oppose Islāmic teachings.

348.narrator: Abū Mas'ūd 'Uqbah ibn 'Amr al-Badrī al-Anṣārī (رضي الله عنه)
348.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Cemaate, Allah'ın Kitabı'nı en iyi okuyan imam olsun. Kıraatte eşitlerse, sünneti en iyi bilen; onda da eşitlerse, önce hicret eden; onda da eşitlerse, önce Müslüman olan imam olsun." (Müslim)
348.commentary: Bu hadis discusses who is the çoğu worthy of leading the congregation in ṣalāh. Based on this hadis, Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله) and Imām Aḥmad (رحمه الله) maintain that the best reciter should be given preference. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله) and Imām Mālik (رحمه الله), one who is çoğu knowledgeable regarding the Sunnah should be preferred provided he can recite in a şekil that renders his ṣalāh geçerli. The latter contend that recitation of the Qur'ān is limited to a single portion of the ṣalāh whereas knowledge is required for bütün portions of the ṣalāh. ayrıca, during the terminal illness of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) lead the ṣalāh despite the presence of better reciters gibi Ubay ibn Ka'b (رضي الله عنه). The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) also advised that an appointed Imām or one who holds a particular position, enjoys the doğru of precedence in his area and that none should be given preference over him, without his izin.

349.narrator: Abū Mas'ūd 'Uqbah ibn 'Amr al-Badrī al-Anṣārī (رضي الله عنه)
349.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) namazda safları düzeltirken omuzlarımızı sıvazlar ve: "Saflarınızı düzgün tutun, omuzlarınızı aynı hizaya getirin" derdi. (Müslim)
349.commentary: In this hadis, we learn that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) physically and verbally straightened the rows. bununla birlikte, from other aḥādīth we learn that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) sufficed upon a verbal instruction. This difference in approach stemmed from differences in the audience: if the congregation consisted of intelligent people, he would suffice with sözler and if there were reverts or young people who needed to be taught, then he would also physically demonstrate it. The concept of discipline by the straightening of the rows in ṣalāh is a reminder for the Ummah to unite as a single force and speak with a single voice. The heart and the limbs of the body are remarkably linked to her biri other. An inconsistency in one leads to conflict with the other, bundan dolayı uneven rows lead to disunity of hearts. Imām Nawawī (رحمه الله) explained that having the çoğu virtuous and intelligent of people closest to the Imām, is in order to honour them. ayrıca, the Imām may bazen need to appoint a successor and having virtuous people nearby would assist in this regard.

350.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Bana yakın olanlar, akıllı ve olgun olanlarınız, sonra onlara yakın olanlar, sonra onlara yakın olanlar (derece derece)." (Müslim)
350.commentary: The masjid is a place of honour, peace and serenity, and a muṣbütünī's concentration should not be distracted while performing ṣalāh. Market places and shopping malls are not ideal places for Muslims to frequent because of the birçok associated evils gibi intermingling of the sexes, music and materialism.

351.narrator: Abū Yaḥyā and some say, Abū Muḥammad Sahl ibn Abū Ḥathmah al-Anṣārī (رضي الله عنه)
351.text: Sehl bin Ebû Hasme (رضي الله عنه) şöyle anlatır: Abdullah bin Sehl ve Muhayyisa bin Mes'ûd, Hayber'e gittiler. O sırada Hayberlilerle barış vardı. (Buhârî)
351.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) gave preference to the eldest of them to show that those who are elder deserve more saygı than those who are younger.

352.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) Uhud şehitlerinden iki kişiyi aynı kabre koyar ve: "Hangisi daha çok Kur'an bilir?" diye sorar, çok bileni önce kabre koyardı. (Buhârî)
352.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) instructed the Ṣaḥābah to place the Ḥuffāẓ first into the grave, in honour of their noble amel of memorising the Qur'ān. This bize öğretir ki the knowledgeable should be honoured above others and serves as an incentive to learn and memorise as much of the Qur'ān as possible.

353.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Rüyamda misvak kullandığımı gördüm. Bana iki kişi geldi. Biri diğerinden yaşlıydı. Misvakı küçük olana verdim. Bana: 'Büyüğe ver' dendi, ben de büyüğe verdim." (Buhârî)
353.commentary: Older people should be given preference when presented with gifts. They should also be given preference in söz and should be allowed to walk in front of others as a mark of honour. bununla birlikte, according to Muhallab, this form of adab will apply when people are not in an organised format. bundan dolayı, if they are seated, meselâ, then the person on the doğru should be given preference, rather than the one who is older.

354.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Allah'a saygının bir parçası, yaşlı Müslümanı, Kur'an'ı ezberleyip ona göre yaşayanı ve adaletli yöneticiyi saygıyla anmaktır." (Ebû Dâvûd)
354.commentary: "One who bears the Qur'ān" işaret eder a Ḥāfiẓ. The description of bearing the Qur'ān has been used because of the tremendous effort and sebat required in memorising it, comprehending its meanings and practising upon its teachings. "Does not exceed the bounds" demektir ki he does not delve into concepts which are concealed or ambiguous in anlam. "Does not abandon it" demektir ki he does not abandon practising on its teachings, nor does he forsake reciting it.

355.text: Amr bin Şuayb, babasından, o da dedesinden (رضي الله عنه) şöyle rivayet eder: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Küçüklerimize merhamet etmeyen ve büyüklerimize saygı göstermeyen bizden değildir." (Tirmizî, Ebû Dâvûd)
355.commentary: Being merciful to the young means being affectionate, kind and good towards them. One should not be harsh and hard-hearted. From other aḥādīth, we learn that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) joked and even played games with little children. bununla birlikte, this does not mean that one should spoil them or give them bütün that they ask for; rather, it demektir ki one should nurture them in an Islāmic framework by means of affection, sevgi, rahmet and merhamet.

356.text: Âişe (رضي عنها)'ye bir dilenci geldi, ona bir parça ekmek verdi. Sonra güzel giyimli bir adam geldi, onu oturttu ve yemek yedirdi. Durumu kendisine sorulunca: "Resûlullah (ﷺ) bize: 'İnsanlara, bulundukları mevkiye göre muamele edin' buyurdu" dedi. (Ebû Dâvûd)
356.commentary: People should be dealt with according to their age, spirituality, knowledge, respectability and status because people do not bütün enjoy an identical status in society. bundan dolayı, a slave and his master cannot be treated equally, nor can a leader and his subjects. A person of high standing should not be degraded and a person of low standing should not be elevated, but her biri should be given his due doğru.

357.text: Uyeyne bin Hısn, yeğeni Hürr bin Kays'ın yanında misafir kaldı. Hürr, Ömer (رضي الله عنه)'in yakınlarındandı. Ömer (رضي الله عنه), Kur'an okuyanları ve ileri gelenleri yanına alırdı. (Buhârî)
357.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) kept the company of the knowledgeable, pious and upright and would consult with them regarding the affairs of the state. This approach is beneficial because it encourages practising on the Qur'ān and Sunnah, reformation of character and appreciation of the approach and davranış of the wise.

358.narrator: Ebû Saîd Samurah ibn Jundub (رضي الله عنه)
358.text: Enes (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ) zamanında genç bir çocuktum ve O'nun sözlerini ezberlerdim. Sadece, beni konuştuklarımdan engelleyen şey, burada yaşlıların bulunmasıydı. (Buhârî, Müslim)
358.commentary: Samurah (رضي الله عنه) was around twenty years of age at the time of the demise of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). Based on this hadis, Ibn 'bütünān stated that according to the Muḥaddithīn (scholars of aḥādīth) it is mekruh for a person to narrate aḥādīth in an area when another scholar who is more knowledgeable, older, or has a better memory is available. In such cases, the younger scholar should refer people to the senior scholar.

359.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Bir genç, yaşlı bir kimseye yaşından dolayı saygı göstermezse, Allah o gencin yaşlılığında ona saygı gösterecek birini mutlaka gönderir." (Tirmizî)
359.commentary: Bu hadis indicates that güzel ahlâk is an integral component of Islām and that no person can be a good Muslim without it. According to Ibn 'bütünān, the hadis indicates to the elderly person for the pleasure of bütünāh, He will lengthen his life until he reaches that same age and He will appoint someone who will honour him as well. başka bir deyişle, he will be treated in the same yol as he treated his seniors.

360.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in vefatından sonra Ebû Bekr (رضي الله عنه), Ömer (رضي الله عنه)'e: "Haydi Ümmü Eymen (رضي الله عنها)'i ziyarete gidelim" dedi. (Müslim)
360.commentary: Umm Ayman's (رضي الله عنها) asıl name was Barakah bint Tha'labah; bununla birlikte, she was better known by her agnomen, Umm Ayman. When Āminah, the mother of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), passed away, Umm Ayman (رضي الله عنها) cared for him until he came of age. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) later freed her and married her to Zayd ibn Ḥāritha (رضي الله عنه). Usāmah ibn Zayd (رضي الله عنه) was born from this union. Umm Ayman (رضي الله عنها) was a virtuous woman and was highly regarded by the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). She passed away five months after the demise of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) displayed tremendous sevgi, honour and saygı for her. He would regularly visit her and referred to her as his mother. The hadis establishes the uygulama of visiting the pious, even if they may be lower in rank.

361.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Bir adam, başka bir şehirdeki din kardeşini ziyarete gitti. Allah (ﷻ) yoluna bir melek gönderdi..." (Müslim)
361.commentary: Bu hadis illustrates the önem of visiting one's brother solely for the pleasure of bütünāh (ﷻ). When two Muslims meet for bütünāh's (ﷻ) pleasure it creates sevgi and unity and brings a special joy to the heart. Ibn 'bütünān stated that Bu hadis işaret eder the great fazilet of visiting people and loving them for the pleasure of bütünāh (ﷻ), and it is of the greatest of ameller and çoğu virtuous of ameller that draw a person close to bütünāh (ﷻ), if it is void of any prompting of the carnal self.

362.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kim bir hastayı ziyaret eder veya Allah rızası için bir din kardeşini ziyaret ederse, bir melek ona: 'Ne güzel iş yaptın, yürüyüşün hayırlı ve cennette bir yer edindin' der." (Tirmizî)
362.commentary: This short hadis states the enormous sevap of visiting a Muslim brother or a sick person. bununla birlikte, as the hadis states, it should be done solely for the pleasure of bütünāh (ﷻ).

363.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "İyi arkadaşla kötü arkadaşın misali, misk satanla demirci körüğü gibidir. Misk satandan ya satın alırsın veya güzel kokusunu alırsın. Demirci körüğü ise ya elbiseni yakar veya kötü kokusunu alırsın." (Buhârî, Müslim)
363.commentary: The positive effects of righteous company are birçok: one reaps birçok ilâhî rewards and favours, one learns adab and good behaviour, and one earns praise because a person is generally classified according to the company he adopts. The harms of evil company are also birçok: one earns rebuke, one develops evil habits and one ends up in disgraceful situations.

364.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kadın dört şey için nikâhlanır: Malı, soyu, güzelliği ve dini. Dindar olanı tercih et, bereketli olursun." (Buhârî, Müslim)
364.commentary: The hadis fits in with the central Islāmic teaching of making dinî teachings the goal of bütün life endeavours. A woman who is married for her wealth may give a sense of financial security to her husband. Similarly, status and lineage may cause a man to gain pride over the nobility of his wife's family. ayrıca, physical beauty is primarily sensual. These factors bununla birlikte do not necessarily lead to a stable marriage. In comparison, religiosity is based on guidance and truth, bundan dolayı a woman chosen for this reason will in bütün probability lead to a sahih and stable union.

365.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) Cebrail (عليه السلام)'e: "Bizi daha sık ziyaret etmekten seni alıkoyan nedir?" dedi. Bunun üzerine şu âyet indi: "Biz ancak Rabbinin emriyle ineriz..." (Meryem 64) (Buhârî)
365.commentary: The hadis is an indication of the sevgi of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) to meet Jibra'īl (عليه السلام) on a regular basis and his enböyleceiasm to acquire knowledge from him.

366.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Müminlerden başkasını dost edinme. Yemeğini de takva sahiplerinden başkası yemesin." (Ebû Dâvûd, Tirmizî)
366.commentary: Bu hadis prohibits Muslims from befriending and intimately associating with disbelievers because their behaviour, lifestyle and thinking may be detrimental to spirituality. özellikle, inviting evil acquaintances for meals creates sevgi and attachment towards them, bundan dolayı this has been sakındırılan. bazı âlimlere göre, the hikmet behind the hüküm is that feeding the pious bir vesilesidir promoting good, while feeding those who are immoral bir vesilesidir promoting günah.

367.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kişi dostunun dini üzeredir. Öyleyse kiminle dost olduğunuza dikkat edin." (Ebû Dâvûd, Tirmizî)
367.commentary: Bu hadis reiterates the önem of adopting good company and choosing righteous friends. Imām Ghazālī (رحمه الله) has mentioned five qualities that one needs to search for in a friend: 1. He needs to be sane and intelligent. 2. His character needs to be good. 3. He should not be an open sinner because one who does not saygı bütünāh's (ﷻ) laws will not be güvenilir to his fellow man. 4. He should not be an innovator of yanlış practices in Islām. 5. He should not be one who greedily chases the world and its luxuries.

368.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kişi, sevdiği ile beraberdir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
368.commentary: Bu hadis encourages her believer to develop sevgi for the Messengers, Ṣaḥābah, scholars and the righteous. Similarly, a person should choose good friends so that he may enter with them into cennet. This togetherness does not necessitate that the rank of the lover and the beloved be identical, neither does it mean that her iki will be rewarded in an identical şekil. The rewards and ranks of people will differ according to the quantity and quality of their ameller.

369.text: Bir bedevî Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e: "Kıyamet ne zaman?" diye sordu. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Onun için ne hazırladın?" diye sordu. (Buhârî)
369.commentary: The issue of Qiyāmah crossed the minds of the Ṣaḥābah tıpkı... gibi it interests birçok people today. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) wisely turned the attention of the questioner towards a matter of greater fazilet, which is to prepare for the day of Qiyāmah by means of iyilikler. The Ṣaḥābī did not attach much value to his good ameller due to his tevazu and rather declared his sevgi for bütünāh (ﷻ) and His Messenger (ﷺ). bununla birlikte, we have no reason to doubt his good ameller, because one who truly loves bütünāh (ﷻ) and His Messenger (ﷺ) will naturally follow their teachings.

370.text: Bir adam Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e gelip: "Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Bir topluluğu seviyorum ama henüz onlara katılamadım (derecelerine erişemedim)" dedi. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Kişi, sevdiği ile beraberdir" buyurdu. (Buhârî, Müslim)

371.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "İnsanlar, altın ve gümüş madenleri gibi madenlerdir. Câhiliyede hayırlı olanlar, İslâm'da da hayırlıdır, anlayışlı olduklarında." (Buhârî, Müslim)
371.commentary: Mines contain precious gems and they contain worthless dirt. Mankind is the same. bazı people are good and others are not. ayrıca, tıpkı... gibi the valuable gems and worthless dirt are extracted from a mine and exposed to others, the inner goodness or wretchedness of people become apparent to other people. In 'Ālam al-Arwāḥ the souls were gathered and testified to the rubūbiyyat (lordship) of bütünāh (ﷻ). Those that recognised her biri other then, also grouped together in dünya after they were placed into the bodies of men. Similarly, those souls that were not attracted to her biri other, did not group together in dünya.

372.text: Useyr bin Amr (veya Useyr bin Câbir) (رضي الله عنه) şöyle anlatır: "Yemenden Ömer (رضي الله عنه)'e heyetler geldiğinde..." (Müslim)
372.commentary: The relevance of Bu hadis to the chapter lies in the fact that 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) enquired about a pious man from the Tābi'īn and requested his du'ā's, on the advice of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). Being a Ṣaḥābī, 'Umar (رضي الله عنه), was of a higher rank than Uways al-Qarnī (رضي الله عنه), who was a Tābi'ī, but this did not prevent the former from humbling himself and requesting du'ā's from the latter. Serving one's parents is a noble amel which is greatly rewarded by bütünāh (ﷻ). One should request the du'ā's of the ḥujjāj. tevazu is a fazilet.

373.text: Abdullah bin Ömer (رضي الله عنهما) şöyle dedi: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'den umre için izin istedim, izin verdi ve: "Ey kardeşim! Duana beni de kat" buyurdu. (Ebû Dâvûd)
373.commentary: From this hadis, we learn that the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) would seek izin from the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) in matters of önem. This bize öğretir ki students and disciples should seek izin from their teachers and mentors before engaging in any important task. The hadis illustrates the fazilet and status of 'Umar (رضي الله عنه). The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) demonstrated his tevazu by requesting the du'ā's of his juniors. A du'ā' made in the absence of a person in his favour is readily accepted by bütünāh (ﷻ). At places of fazilet in the blessed lands, a ḥājī should make du'ā' for his family, friends and associates.

374.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) Kuba Mescidi'ni binekli veya yaya olarak ziyaret eder ve orada iki rekât namaz kılardı. (Buhârî, Müslim)
374.commentary: Masjid al-Qubā' was the first masjid built in Madīnah Munawwarah. It is about three kilometres from Masjid al-Nabawī. The hadis işaret eder the fazilet of this masjid, visiting it and performing ṣalāh therein. The hadis illustrates the passion of Ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) to emulate the Sunnah of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ).

375.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Üç özellik kimde bulunursa, o imanın tadını bulur: Allah ve Resûlü'nü her şeyden çok sevmek, sevdiğini sırf Allah için sevmek ve Allah kendisini kurtardıktan sonra tekrar küfre dönmekten ateşe atılmaktan korktuğu gibi korkmak." (Buhârî, Müslim)
375.commentary: Bu hadis is among the fundamentals of Islām. sevgi for bütünāh (ﷻ) and His Messenger (ﷺ) is achieved by acting in itaat to bütünāh's (ﷻ) commands. According to the Mufassir Qāḍī Bayḍāwī, this işaret eder intellectual sevgi, which means to give preference to that which an intellectually healthy mind would prefer, even if it is against one's desires. The hadis states that it is better to be thrown into a dünyevî fire than to perpetrate kufr, because kufr will result in azap in the fire of the ahiret, which is birçok times more intense.

376.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Allah'ın (ﷻ) gölgesinden başka gölgenin bulunmadığı kıyamet gününde Allah yedi sınıf insanı gölgelendirir: Adaletli yönetici, Allah'a ibadetle yetişen genç, kalbi mescitlere bağlı kimse, Allah için birbirini seven ve bu sevgiyle bir araya gelip ayrılan iki kişi, güzel ve mevki sahibi bir kadının davetine 'Ben Allah'tan korkarım' diyerek reddeden kimse, sağ elinin verdiğini sol eli bilmeyecek kadar gizli sadaka veren kimse ve tenhada Allah'ı anıp gözleri yaşaran kimse." (Buhârî, Müslim)
376.commentary: On the day of Qiyāmah, the sun will only be a mile above our heads, or even closer. The heat will affect people according to the intensity of their ameller. bazı will have their feet submerged in perspiration, others will be covered to their knees and others will be covered to their hips. bazı people will perspire so much that their perspiration will rise to the level of their mouths and choke them. On this terrifying day, bütünāh (ﷻ) will give shade to people with certain qualities. Bu hadis mentions seven classes of such privileged people.

377.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Allah kıyamet günü: 'Benim rızam için birbirini sevenler nerede? Bugün onları gölgemden başka gölge olmayan günümde gölgelendireceğim' buyurur." (Müslim)
377.commentary: This is a hadis al-Qudsī, i.e. a hadis in which bütünāh (ﷻ) is the speaker. bütünāh (ﷻ) will grant His shade to those who sevgi her biri other because of His greatness and majesty, and not because of any dünyevî motive. Along with their sevgi for her biri other, they korku bütünāh (ﷻ) and are conscious of His greatness. There is a major difference between such sevgi and sevgi yani not coupled with bütünāh-consciousness. The latter form of sevgi is devoid of takvâ and sık sık results in shamelessness and günah.

378.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Nefsim elinde olan Allah'a yemin ederim ki, iman etmedikçe cennete giremezsiniz, birbirinizi sevmedikçe de iman etmiş olmazsınız." (Müslim)
378.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki only believers are entitled to cennet. To become a gerçek believer one must possess mutual sevgi, and frequent greeting with salām will engender that sevgi. The önem of Bu hadis is highlighted by the Messenger of bütünāh's (ﷺ) oath. The salām is also a hallmark of Islām – in dünya and in cennet – for it is not helal to greet a non-Muslim with salām.

379.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Bir adam başka bir şehirdeki kardeşini ziyarete gitti. Allah (ﷻ) yoluna bir melek gönderdi..." (Müslim)
379.commentary: Bu hadis daha önceki bir bölümde ele alınmıştır. Bkz. hadis 361.

380.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) ensar hakkında şöyle buyurdu: "Onları ancak mümin sever, onlara ancak münafık buğzeder. Allah onları seveni sever, onlara buğzedene de buğzeder." (Buhârî, Müslim)
380.commentary: The Anṣār desteklenen the Muhājirīn with everything they had, showing more generosity to them than even blood brothers. The Qur'ān speaks highly of them for their great sacrifice to the cause of Islām, and the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) too advised his Ummah to sevgi them and hold them in their rightful esteem. A believer can only be filled with sevgi and admiration for these giants of Islām. sevgi for them is a testimony of the truth of one's iman because it proves that one is content with those whom bütünāh (ﷻ) and His Messenger (ﷺ) were pleased. Anyone who, in spite of bütün this, harbours any ill feeling towards them is not a believer but a hypocrite. Loving them attracts the sevgi of bütünāh (ﷻ) and one who hates them brings upon himself the anger and nefret of bütünāh (ﷻ).

381.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim: "Allah (ﷻ) şöyle buyurdu: 'Benim rızam için birbirini sevenlere, nurdan minberler vardır. Peygamberler ve şehitler onlara imrenir.'" (Tirmizî)
381.commentary: Bu hadis al-Qudsī bize öğretir ki people who sevgi her biri other because of bütünāh's (ﷻ) majesty will be seated on elevated pulpits of honour, in the ahiret. The Messengers (عليهم السلام) and the martyrs will look upon them with admiration, despite the former being far superior to them. Admiring their positions does not mean that the people on these pulpits will be given a higher rank than those of the Messengers and martyrs.

382.text: Şam Mescidi'ne girdim. Orada parlak dişli bir genç gördüm, etrafında insanlar toplanmıştı. Anlaşmazlığa düştüklerinde ona danışırlardı. (Müslim)
382.commentary: The hadis shows the great status of the Ṣaḥābī Mu'ādh ibn Jabal (رضي الله عنه) and the level he had reached in the field of Islāmic knowledge. His early arrival in the masjid bize öğretir ki an increase in knowledge should be matched with an equal or greater increase in uygulama. One should be eager to fayda from people of knowledge and takvâ even though they may be young. One should not disturb a person occupied in ibadet. One should begin speaking by greeting with salām. One should show saygı to men of knowledge and takvâ. One should verbally express one's sevgi for others. Smiling with people is Sunnah.

383.narrator: Abū Karīmah al-Miqdād ibn Ma'd Yakrib (رضي الله عنه)
383.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Bir kimse kardeşini severse, ona sevdiğini bildirsin." (Ebû Dâvûd, Tirmizî)
383.commentary: It is Mustaḥab (commendable) for a person who loves his Muslim brother to tell him that he loves him. bunun faydası is that sevgi will develop between them, a relationship of well wishing and iyilik will be formed and the bond of brotherhood will be fortified. ayrıca, one who is convinced that he is loved by another will accept his advice when it is offered.

384.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) Muâz'ı elinden tuttu ve: "Ey Muâz! Vallahi seni seviyorum. Ey Muâz! Sana, her namazın sonunda şöyle demeni tavsiye ederim: 'Allah'ım! Seni anmak, Sana şükretmek ve Sana güzelce ibadet etmekte bana yardım et'" buyurdu. (Ebû Dâvûd, Nesâî)
384.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh's (ﷺ) amel of holding Mu'ādh's (رضي الله عنه) hand and telling him that he loved him had the effect of emphasising the ders he was about to impart to him. A student who perceives a sense of affection from his teacher is more likely to accept his teachings. This also shows the extraordinary fazilet of Mu'ādh (رضي الله عنه) and his closeness to the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). The du'ā' taught by the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) bize öğretir ki fulfilling our duty to bütünāh (ﷻ) can only be done with the help of bütünāh (ﷻ) Himself. We should bu nedenle express our weakness and inability before bütünāh (ﷻ) in order to attract His rahmet and assistance.

385.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in yanında oturan bir adam, yanından bir başkası geçti. Oturan adam: "Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Ben bu adamı seviyorum" dedi. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Ona sevdiğini bildirdin mi?" dedi. "Hayır" dedi. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Git, ona bildir" buyurdu. Adam gidip: "Seni Allah için seviyorum" dedi. O da: "Beni kendisi için sevdiğin Allah da seni sevsin" dedi. (Ebû Dâvûd)
385.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), who was a mükemmel teacher, trained and nurtured the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) in unique ways. He would take advantage of opportune moments which would be conducive for them to retain dersler he wished to impart because the setting in which a ders is taught and the style of presentation are important factors for effective teaching. The other Ṣaḥābī's response bize öğretir ki feelings of affection should be reciprocated.

386.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Allah (ﷻ) şöyle buyurdu: 'Benim velî kuluma düşmanlık edene Ben savaş açarım. Kulumu, kendisine farz kıldığım şeylerden daha sevimli bir şeyle bana yaklaşamaz. Kulum nafile ibadetlerle bana yaklaşmaya devam eder, ta ki onu severim. Onu sevdiğim zaman, işiten kulağı, gören gözü, tutan eli ve yürüyen ayağı olurum. Benden bir şey dilerse mutlaka veririm, bana sığınırsa mutlaka onu korurum.'" (Buhârî)
386.commentary: In Bu hadis al-Qudsī, bütünāh (ﷻ) makes known the causes of His sevgi for his servants, the results of that sevgi and the consequences of opposing those whom He loves. In the opening portion of the hadis, bütünāh (ﷻ) declares war on those who harbour enmity towards His friends. A beyan of war from bütünāh (ﷻ) upon any of His creation is indeed a severe chastisement and we should avoid falling into such a situation. To become a friend of bütünāh (ﷻ), one must first fulfil the acts that bütünāh (ﷻ) has made farz upon him, gibi the farz ṣalāh, zakāh, ṣaum and ḥaj. For these acts, a person will be handsomely rewarded. Thereafter a person should engage in optional ibadetler and it is hoped thereby that bütünāh (ﷻ) will soon take him into His special sevgi.

387.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Allah (ﷻ) bir kulu sevdiği zaman, Cebrail'e: 'Allah falancayı seviyor, sen de sev' diye seslenir. Cebrail de onu sever ve gök halkına: 'Allah falancayı seviyor, siz de sevin' diye seslenir. Gök halkı da onu sever. Sonra yeryüzünde onun için kabul (sevilme) vardır." (Buhârî, Müslim)
387.commentary: Bu hadis is desteklenen by a verse of the Qur'ān that states: "The çoğu Merciful will show affection upon those who have īmān and do righteous ameller." (Sūrah Maryam, 96). When bütünāh (ﷻ) loves a person, He decrees goodness and guidance for him and showers him with His favours and rahmet. Jibra'īl (عليه السلام) and the inhabitants of the heavens, şöyle ki the angels, also sevgi him because of bütünāh's (ﷻ) sevgi for him and his itaat to bütünāh (ﷻ). Such a person is then also accepted among the good and righteous people of the earth. They are pleased with him and speak well of him. diğer yandan, when bütünāh (ﷻ) hates a person, He commands Jibra'īl (عليه السلام) to hate him as well and Jibra'īl (عليه السلام) conveys this message to the other angels (عليهم السلام). Such a person is then also hated by people.

388.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) bir askeri birliğe bir komutan gönderdi. Komutan sahâbîlerine namaz kıldırırken kısa okurdu. (Buhârî, Müslim)
388.commentary: Sūrah al-Ikhlāṣ focuses exclusively on the qualities and attributes of bütünāh (ﷻ). It speaks of His Oneness, the dependence of the creation upon Him for the fulfilment of their needs and the impossibility of Him being born to anybody or for anything to be born from Him. When the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) rivayet edilen the Ṣaḥābī's amel to the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), he instructed them to investigate the reason for his frequent recitation of Sūrah al-Ikhlāṣ. We learn from this that the validity of an amel is based on the niyet with which it is done.

389.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kim sabah namazını kılarsa, Allah'ın koruması altındadır. Sakın Allah, korumasından bir şey talep etmesin!" (Müslim)
389.commentary: The hadis demektir ki one who performs Fajr Ṣalāh is under the koruma of bütünāh (ﷻ) and others should not harm him because they will be taken to task for attempting to destroy this ilâhî koruma. Another anlam of the hadis is that the person who performs the Fajr Ṣalāh has started on a good note and is under the koruma of bütünāh (ﷻ); he should not undo this iyilik by committing acts of isyan against bütünāh (ﷻ). The hadis may also mean that one should not omit the Fajr Ṣalāh and thereby break one's pledge with bütünāh, lest bütünāh (ﷻ) questions him for his omission. According to another narration of Muslim, the fazilet mentioned in Bu hadis is restricted to one who performs Fajr ṣalāh in congregation.

390.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Allah'tan başka ilah olmadığına ve Muhammed'in Allah'ın Resûlü olduğuna şehadet edinceye, namazı kılıp zekâtı verinceye kadar insanlarla savaşmakla emrolundum. Bunu yaptıklarında kanlarını ve mallarını benden korumuş olurlar, ancak İslâm'ın hakkı müstesna. Hesapları ise Allah'a aittir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
390.commentary: Göre the scholars, "fighting the people" işaret eder idolaters and not the People of the Book (the Jews and Christians), because the latter have the option of paying the jizyah (a tax which non-Muslims must pay to the Islāmic government in exchange for their koruma). Here the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) as well as the rest of the Ummah have been commanded to judge people according to their apparent ameller and sözler. bundan dolayı, when a person testifies to the kalimah and acknowledges its fundamentals, he is to be accepted as a Muslim and treated as one.

391.narrator: Abū 'Abdillāh Ṭāriq ibn Ashyam (رضي الله عنه)
391.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim: "Kim Allah'tan başka ilah olmadığına şehadet eder ve Allah'tan başka taptıklarını reddederse, malı ve kanı haram olur. Hesapları Allah'a aittir." (Müslim)
391.commentary: The hadis reiterates that any non-Muslim who pronounces the kalimah would be regarded as a Muslim and would enjoy bütün the faydalar of a Muslim. His ihlâs will not be scrutinised, but left to bütünāh (ﷻ) to judge. Despite the fact that only the first part of the kalimah is mentioned in this hadis, it işaret eder the dolu kalimah. yani, it is necessary to accept the Oneness of bütünāh and that Muhammad (ﷺ) is the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷻ).

392.narrator: Abū Ma'bad al-Miqdād ibn al-Aswad (رضي الله عنه)
392.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e: "Söyle bana, bir kâfirle karşılaşıp savaşsak, o bir elimi kesse, sonra bir ağaca sığınıp 'Allah'a teslim oldum' dese, onu öldürür müyüm?" diye sordum. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Onu öldürme" buyurdu. (Buhârî, Müslim)
392.commentary: For a person to be regarded as a Muslim, it is not necessary for him to say the kalimah. If he says or does anything that shows that he is a Muslim, then he will be accepted as such. The secrets of his heart will be left for bütünāh (ﷻ) to judge. The açıklama of "he will be in your position" provided by the author Imām Nawawī (رحمه الله) is the çoğu preferred by the scholars. It demektir ki the person who uttered the sözler of iman will be a Muslim whose blood is inviolable, tıpkı... gibi you, al-Miqdād ibn al-Aswad (رضي الله عنه), were before you killed him.

393.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) bizi Cüheyne kabilesinden Huraka'ya gönderdi. Sabah vakti onlara baskın yaptık. (Buhârî, Müslim)
393.commentary: Usāmah (رضي الله عنه) assumed that the man was a disbeliever and that his beyan of the kalimah was worthless. He thought that it was uttered without sincere inanç and only to avoid being killed. He was under the impression that a person's blood becomes sacred only when he accepts Islām by heart, not by outward expression. Due to his mistake in judgement, Usāmah (رضي الله عنه) was not sinful for killing him and there was no retribution. bununla birlikte, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) emphasised the doğru hüküm for the Ummah to follow, which is to judge people according to their apparent sözler and ameller. We have no access to their hearts; bundan dolayı, it is not helal for us to act according to our assumptions or suspicions.

394.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) bir askeri birliği müşrikler üzerine gönderdi. Savaş başladı. Müşriklerden bir adam Müslümanlardan birine saldırdı. (Buhârî, Müslim)
394.commentary: Bu hadis in bütün probability işaret eder the same incident mentioned in the previous hadis. When Usāmah (رضي الله عنه) asked the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) to seek bağışlanma for him, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) continued repeating, "What will you do when the kalimah appears on the day of Qiyāmah?" This was to emphasise the şiddet of his amel. başka bir deyişle, it was as if the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said to him: 'Who can really intercede for you? How will you protect yourself from the azap of killing a person who recited the kalimah?'

395.text: Abdullah bin Utbe bin Mes'ûd şöyle anlatır: Ömer bin Hattâb (رضي الله عنه)'i şöyle derken işittim: "Bazı kimseler, vahiy yoluyla hükme bağlanırdı. Şimdi vahiy kesildi. Biz, sizin açıktan yaptıklarınıza göre hüküm veriyoruz." (Buhârî)
395.commentary: While the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was living, bütünāh (ﷻ) would reveal information to him about matters of the unseen. bütünāh (ﷻ) would testify to the good qualities in the hearts of sincere people and the nifak in the hearts of the hypocrites. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) would then act according to the information he received by revelation. With the demise of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), revelation ended forever and there was no yol of knowing the secrets that were concealed in the hearts of people. The only yol that remained was to judge people according to their external ameller.

396.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) —ki doğru söyler ve kendisine doğru haber verilirdi— bize şöyle anlattı: "Her birinizin yaratılışı, annesinin karnında kırk gün nutfe olarak, sonra kırk gün aleka (kan pıhtısı) olarak, sonra kırk gün mudga (bir çiğnem et) olarak toplanır. Sonra Allah bir melek gönderir ve ona dört kelime yazması emredilir: Rızkı, eceli, ameli ve şakî veya said olacağı. Sonra ruh üflenir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
396.commentary: The development during pregnancy progresses such that, at the end of four months, a foetus is given a insanî form and develops limbs and senses. An angel is then sent to blow the soul into its body. The angel also writes down the details of four matters pertaining to its destiny. The first is his sustenance, food as well as anything else that the person will utilise in life, whether it is ḥalāl or ḥarām. The second is the time of his death. The third is the ameller he will do, whether good or evil. The fourth is whether he will be wretched and worthy of the cehennem-fire, or fortunate and worthy of cennet. bütün of this information is in the knowledge of bütünāh (ﷻ) from eternity and it is already written in al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ (the korunan Tablet on which bütün destiny is written).

397.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kıyamet günü cehennem yetmiş bin yularla getirilir. Her yuları yetmiş bin melek çeker." (Müslim)
397.commentary: Bu hadis may be taken in its literal sense, which is that cehennem will be brought forward with 70,000 reins pulled by angels; or it may be taken in a figurative sense, to indicate the huge size of cehennem, as it needs to be dragged with so birçok reins. In any case, the object is to warn us of the frightening scene of the cehennem-fire, so that we do our best to avoid being among its inmates.

398.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim: "Cehennem ehlinin en hafif azap göreni, ayaklarının altına iki ateş koru konulup beyninin kaynatıldığı kimsedir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
398.commentary: Göre the narration of Muslim, the person who will be given this lightest azap of bütün the disbelievers will be Abū Ṭālib, the uncle of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). He gave the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) extensive support in his mission, but he left the world without possessing īmān, the factor that decides whether a person will forever remain in cennet or cehennem. "The people of the cehennem-fire" refer to the disbelievers because they will permanently dwell therein. Sinful Muslims will only enter the cehennem-fire for a limited period in order to be purified of their günahlar. The hadis bize öğretir ki even the lightest azap in cehennem will be intolerable.

399.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Cehennem ateşi, kimi topuklarına, kimi dizlerine, kimi beline, kimi boynuna kadar kaplar." (Müslim)
399.commentary: The Fire will envelope the bodies of people in varying degrees according to the şiddet of their günahlar. bununla birlikte, the part of the body not covered in fire will also boil due to the intensity of the fire afflicting the remaining portions of the body.

400.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "İnsanlar, alemlerin Rabbi'nin huzurunda toplanırlar. Kimi alın teri içinde boğulur." (Buhârî)
400.commentary: Bu hadis describes another of the terrifying scenes of the day of Qiyāmah that will be unlike anything in dünya. Everybody will rise from their graves and stand before bütünāh (ﷻ) to receive their sevap or azap. The scholars have provided çeşitli answers to how people will be immersed in farklı levels of perspiration when everybody will be standing together. bütünāh (ﷻ) may create such a situation by causing the ground to rise under the feet of bazı people, forming a mound that will keep them higher than others. It is also possible that bütünāh (ﷻ) will cause her biri person's sweat to be confined around him - defying the laws of physics - tıpkı... gibi He held back the water of the Red Sea for Mūsā (عليه السلام) and his companions.

401.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) bana öyle bir hutbe verdi ki, onun gibisini hiç duymamıştım. Şöyle buyurdu: "Benim bildiklerimi bilseydiniz, az güler çok ağlardınız." (Buhârî, Müslim)
401.commentary: In this hadis, korku is emphasised over ümit, exhorting us to cry excessively out of the korku of bütünāh (ﷻ) and to avoid excessive laughter, which shows hard-heartedness and negligence of the ahiret. The ifade, "if you only knew what I know," işaret eder the difficulties associated with death and the grave, the terrors of the ahiret, the azap for those who günah and the torment of cehennem. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was shown cennet and cehennem-fire. This could mean that these two places were described to him in such detail that he could picture them. bununla birlikte, it is more likely that they were shown to him physically, by removing the barriers between them and himself.

402.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim: "Kıyamet günü güneş mahlûkata yaklaştırılır. Hatta onlara bir mil kadar yaklaşır." (Müslim)
402.commentary: The sun, according to astronomers, is approximately 93 million miles away from the earth. The heat of the sun travels across this great distance and warms our planet, bazen causing extremely high temperatures that are unbearable to insanî beings. On the day of Qiyāmah, when everybody will be standing in wait for the accounting of ameller, the sun will be brought one mile above our heads, or even closer. People will sink in their sweat in proportion to their ameller. The only ümit we have is to be included in the shade that will be provided by bütünāh (ﷻ) to His chosen servants.

403.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kıyamet günü insanlar o kadar terler ki, terleri yetmiş arşın yere batar ve ağızlarına kadar yükselir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
403.commentary: As stated in previous aḥādīth, people will be immersed in farklı levels of perspiration. The worst şart will be that of the disbelievers, then those who committed major günahlar and so on. The Messengers (عليهم السلام), the martyrs and the fortunate among the believing men and women will be protected from this phenomenon altogether and will enjoy the privilege of bütünāh (ﷻ)'s shade. May bütünāh (ﷻ) make us from among them. According to this hadis, the perspiration of bazı people will seep into the ground seventy cubits deep.

404.text: Bir sesin düştüğünü duyunca bize: "Bunun ne olduğunu biliyor musunuz?" diye sordu. "Bu, yetmiş yıl önce cehenneme atılan bir taştır. Şimdi dibine indi. İşte onun sesini duydunuz." (Müslim)
404.commentary: The hadis highlights the enormous depth of cehennem and this necessitates that its azap will be severe and excruciating. May bütünāh (ﷻ) save us! According to this hadis, the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) also heard the sahih along with the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). This would then be counted as a miracle of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم), benzer to the incidents when the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) heard the crying of a tree stump and the tasbīḥ of pebbles in the hand of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ).

405.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Allah (ﷻ), sizin her birinizle tercümansız olarak konuşacak. Kişi sağına bakar, önceden gönderdiği amellerini görür. Soluna bakar, günahlarını görür. Önüne bakar, önünde cehennemi görür." (Buhârî, Müslim)
405.commentary: Bu hadis was discussed in a previous chapter. See hadis 139. The person will look to his left and doğru in order to find a yol of safety from the Fire tıpkı... gibi a person in dünya anxiously looks around him when he is in danger. "You should bu nedenle safeguard yourselves from the cehennem-fire even if it is with half a date," demektir ki one should seek salvation from cehennem by giving even small amounts of charity. It could also mean that one should seek salvation from cehennem by avoiding indulging in even small amounts of oppression and günah.

406.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Ben sizin görmediklerinizi görüyorum. Gök inliyor ve inlemeye hakkı var. Gökte dört parmak yer yoktur ki, bir melek alnını secdeye koymuş olmasın." (Tirmizî)
406.commentary: The sky does not literally groan in pain. Rather, this sahih emphasises the abundance of angels in prostration in awe of Allah (ﷻ). It is benzer to the example of a truck creaking due to a heavy load. The skies are filled with righteous ameller and angels who perform righteous ameller. Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله) deduces from this that the sky is superior to the earth and that places have farklı faziletler according to the ameller that are committed within them. The hadis also işaret eder the great number of angels, who are daima engaged in the ibadet of bütünāh (ﷻ). The phrase "if you only knew what I know," demektir ki if we knew of the immense majesty of bütünāh (ﷻ) and His severe azap for those who disobey Him, we would laugh less and cry more, out of korku.

407.narrator: Abū Barzah Naḍlah ibn 'Ubayd al-Aslamī (رضي الله عنه)
407.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Kıyamet günü kulun ayakları, dört şeyden sorgulanmadıkça yerinden kıpırdamaz: Ömrünü nerede tükettiğinden, ilmiyle ne amel ettiğinden, malını nereden kazanıp nerede harcadığından ve bedenini nerede yıprattığından." (Tirmizî)
407.commentary: On the day of Qiyāmah, her person will stand before bütünāh (ﷻ) to be accountable for his ameller. Nobody will take a step towards cennet or cehennem-fire until four questions are put to him. The Messengers (عليهم السلام) are of course exempted from this, as well as those fortunate believers who will enter cennet without any accountability.

408.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ): "O gün yer, haberlerini anlatır" âyetini okudu ve: "Yerin haberlerinin ne olduğunu biliyor musunuz?" diye sordu. (Tirmizî)
408.commentary: We may commit günahlar thinking that we are alone, but bütünāh (ﷻ) is Ever Watching and aware of bütün that we do. On the Day of Qiyāmah, the earth itself will testify against us. bütünāh (ﷻ) will make objects gibi the earth provide evidence for or against a person who committed good or bad ameller.

409.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Sûr'a üflemekle görevli melek boruya ağız dayamış, ne zaman üfürüleceğini beklerken, ben nasıl rahat edeyim?" (Tirmizî)
409.commentary: Isrāfīl (عليه السلام) is the angel appointed to blow the trumpet at the end of the world, when her soul will die and Qiyāmah will take place. He is already poised with the trumpet in his mouth, awaiting the emir from bütünāh (ﷻ). The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) instructed the Ṣaḥābah to say "ḥasbunā bütünāh wa ni'ma al-wakīl" (bütünāh is sufficient for us and an excellent guardian is He). This was the supplication of Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام) when thrown into the fire.

410.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: "Korkan, gecenin ilk vaktinde yola çıkar. Gecenin ilk vaktinde yola çıkan (hedefine) ulaşır. Dikkat edin! Allah'ın metaı pahalıdır. Dikkat edin! Allah'ın metaı cennettir." (Tirmizî)
410.commentary: In this hadis, a hakiki life situation has been used to explain the önem of hastening towards iyilikler. A traveller may be attacked by an enemy in the darkest hours of the night. One who fears such an attack will begin travelling early in the night, so that he can safely reach his destination. Similarly, our destination is the ahiret, where we ümit to live blissfully in cennet. We must be courageous and hasten to perform good ameller.

411.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim: "Kıyamet günü insanlar yalınayak, çıplak ve sünnetsiz olarak diriltilir." (Buhârî, Müslim)
411.commentary: The hadis indicates towards the şiddet and horror of the day of Qiyāmah and thereby encourages us to hasten towards tövbe and iyilikler. The horror of Qiyāmah will make bütün other matters seem trivial. On that day, people will flee from their near and dear ones and her biri person will be worried about the accounting of his own ameller. On the day of Qiyāmah, only certain elect people will have clothing.

412.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who testifies that there is none worthy of ibadet except Allāh and that He is one and has no partner, that Muḥammad is His kul and Messenger, that 'Īsā is the kul of Allāh and His Messenger and His word which He cast into Maryam and a spirit from Him and that Cennet and cehennem ateşi are true, then Allah (ﷻ) shall enter him into Cennet no matter what his deeds may be."(Bukhārī, Müslüman). Another narration of Müslüman has:"Allah (ﷻ) makes cehennem ateşi unlawful for one who testifies that there is none worthy of ibadet except Allāh and that Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh."
412.commentary: Aḥādīth gibi this one serve to remind us that we should asla lose ümit in the endless rahmet of bütünāh (ﷻ). Once a person has accepted the fundamental beliefs of Islām, he will definitely enter cennet if he dies in this şart. The ifade "bütünāh makes the cehennem-fire unlawful for him" demektir ki he will not be a permanent dweller of the cehennem-fire. 'Īsā (عليه السلام) is given special mention because of the extreme beliefs held by the disbelievers about him.

413.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) says: 'One who does a good deed shall receive a sevap ten times the like thereof, or I will give (him) more. One who commits an evil deed shall be punished the like thereof, or I will bağışla (him). One who comes to Me by a hand-span, I go to him by a cubit. One who comes to Me by a cubit, I go to him by an arm-span. One who comes to Me walking, I go to him running. One who meets Me with günah equivalent to the size of the earth, but associated no partner with Me, I will meet him with a similar amount of bağışlanma.'"(Müslüman)
413.commentary: In Bu hadis al-Qudsī, bütünāh (ﷻ) announces to His servants how He appreciates their eagerness for iyilikler. We also learn about the intense magnitude of His rahmet. When a servant performs a iyilik, He multiplies the sevap ten times or as much as He desires. But if the servant commits an act of isyan, the azap is not multiplied at bütün; rather, he will be punished in proportion to his misdeed, or bütünāh (ﷻ) may even forgive him.

414.text: A Bedouin came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and dedi:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Which two things are obligatory?"He cevap verdi:"One who dies without ascribing partners to Allah (ﷻ) shall enter Cennet and one who dies ascribing partners to Allah (ﷻ) shall enter cehennem ateşi."(Müslüman)
414.commentary: cennet is guaranteed for a person who testifies to the tawḥīd (Oneness) of bütünāh (ﷻ) and the prophethood of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and then fulfils the demands of that testimony, provided he dies in this state of īmān. To fulfil the demands of tawḥīd means to abstain from disobeying bütünāh (ﷻ). If one had disobeyed bütünāh, then he may first be punished in the cehennem-fire before being admitted into cennet. diğer yandan, one who dies in a state of küfür will be cast into the cehennem-fire, to remain there forever.

415.text: One day Resûlullah (ﷺ) was riding and Mu'ādh (رضي الله عنه) was sitting behind him. He dedi:"Ey Muâz!"He cevap verdi:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I am here and what a pleasure it is to be with you."He dedi:"Ey Muâz!"He cevap verdi:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I am here and what a pleasure it is to be with you."He dedi:"Ey Muâz!"He cevap verdi:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I am here and what a pleasure it is to be with you."This happened three times and he then dedi:"One who testifies sincerely from his heart, that there is none worthy of ibadet except Allāh and that Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh, then Allah (ﷻ) makes it unlawful for him to enter cehennem ateşi."He dedi:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Should I not convey this to the people so that they may rejoice?"He cevap verdi:"If you do so they will place their reliance on it."Anas (رضي الله عنه) dedi:"Mu'ādh (رضي الله عنه) rivayet etti this at the time of his death, fearing the günah of concealing knowledge."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
415.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) repeatedly called Mu'ādh (رضي الله عنه) by name in order to get his dolu attention and emphasise the önem of what he was about to tell him.
