Mu'ādh (رضي الله عنه) desired to inform people of this hadis, in order to give them joy and to encourage them towards ihlâs in iman, but the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) wanted his Ummah to strive for the higher stages of the ahiret by engaging in more acts of salih amel and he feared that if they learned of the hadis they may suffice on this fazilet and abandon other iyilikler.

416.narrator: Abu Hurayrah or Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (ra)
416.text: Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) or Abū Sa'īd al-Khudrī (رضي الله عنه) (the narrator is unsure, but such doubt with regard to a Sahâbî is of no consequence because all the Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) were completely reliable) dedi:"During the expedition of Tabūk, the people were suffering from hunger, so they dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! If you permit us, we will slaughter our camels, eat their meat and use the fat.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Alright, you may do so.' But 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) suggested: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! If you do so, our conveyances will decrease. Rather ask them to bring their remaining provisions and supplicate to Allah (ﷻ) so that He puts nimetler in them. In this way Allah (ﷻ) may place barakah (nimetler) in their provisions.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Alright.' He then requested for a leather mat which he spread out and sordu the people to bring their remaining provisions. Some brought a handful of grain, others a handful of dates and yet others a piece of bread, until a few things were gathered on the mat. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) then supplicated for nimetler and dedi to the people: 'Fill your utensils with this.' They began filling their utensils until every single utensil in the army was full. They ate until they were satiated and there was still some left over. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'I testify that there is none worthy of ibadet except Allāh and that I am the Messenger of Allāh. One, who meets Allah (ﷻ) with these two testimonies, without doubting them, will not be prevented from Cennet.'"(Müslüman)
416.commentary: The battle of Tabūk was the last expedition (ghazwah) in which the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) personally took part. It was a long journey in extreme heat and provisions were scarce. When their rations began to run out, 'Umar (رضي الله عنه), who was an advisor to the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), suggested that it would be better to gather the little food that they had and supplicate to bütünāh (ﷻ) to grant barakah therein. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) accepted his suggestion and bütünāh (ﷻ) accepted his du'ā' in their favour.

417.text: 'Itbān ibn Mālik (رضي الله عنه), one of those who participated in the battle of Badr, anlatır:"I used to lead my people, the Banū Sālim, in namaz. When it used to rain a river of water would form between me and them making it difficult to reach their mescid. So I came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and dedi: 'My eyesight is weak and when it rains water flows in the valley between me and my people, making it difficult to cross. I would like you to come to my house and offer namaz at a place which I will make into a place of namaz.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) cevap verdi: 'I will come.' The following day when the sun was quite hot, Resûlullah (ﷺ) and Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) came and Resûlullah (ﷺ) sought permission to enter. I gave him permission to enter. He did not sit down and sordu me: 'Where in your house would you like me to offer namaz?' I indicated to the place where I preferred him to offer namaz. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) stood and dedi the takbīr and we made a row and prayed behind him. He offered two rak'ats of namaz and ended it with salām. We did the same. I then sordu him to remain behind to eat khazīrah which had been prepared for him. When my neighbours heard that Resûlullah (ﷺ) was in my house, they began entering until many people were gathered. One of them sordu: 'Where is Mālik? I do not see him?' Another cevap verdi: 'That man is a münafık. He does not love Allāh and His Messenger.' On hearing this, Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi: 'Do not say that. Do you not see that he testifies that there is none worthy of ibadet except Allāh and says it for the pleasure of Allāh?' The man dedi: 'Allāh and His Messenger know best. As far as we know, his inclinations and conversations are only with the hypocrites.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'One who testifies that there is none worthy of ibadet except Allāh, desiring thereby the pleasure of Allāh, then Allah (ﷻ) makes it unlawful for him to enter cehennem ateşi.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
417.commentary: It was a great honour for 'Itbān (رضي الله عنه) that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) entered his house and performed ṣalāh in it. When people began to speak ill of a Ṣaḥābī named Mālik ibn al-Dukhshum (رضي الله عنه) and accused him of being a hypocrite, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) declared him to be a gerçek believer, on the basis that he had sincerely testified to the kalimah (testimony of iman) for the pleasure of bütünāh (ﷻ). Mālik (رضي الله عنه) was aslında part of the elite group of Ṣaḥābah who took part in the decisive battle of Badr.

418.text: Some prisoners were brought to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and a woman from among them was anxiously searching for her child. As soon as she found an infant among the prisoners, she took hold of it, clutched it to her belly and breast-fed it. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) addressed us diyerek: 'Do you think that this woman will ever cast her child into a fire?' We cevap verdi: 'No, by Allāh.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Indeed Allah (ﷻ) has far more rahmet for His kullar than this woman has for her child.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
418.commentary: This incident took place after the conquest of Makkah, when the Muslims fought the Hawāzin tribe and took prisoners from amongst them. The woman had lost her child, and was frantically going around searching for her child. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) took advantage of the situation to teach the Ṣaḥābah a ders. He explained that the rahmet of bütünāh (ﷻ) towards His servants is much more than the rahmet of a mother for her child.

419.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When Allah (ﷻ) created the creation, He wrote in a book which is with Him above the Throne: 'My rahmet overpowers My anger.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman). Another narration has:"(My rahmet) overpowered My anger,"and another narration has:"(My rahmet) surpassed My anger."
419.commentary: bütünāh's (ﷻ) decision to sevap and fayda an obedient servant is termed as His pleasure and rahmet, whereas the decision to punish and disgrace a disobedient servant is termed as His anger. Among the manifestations of bütünāh's (ﷻ) rahmet are that bütünāh (ﷻ) equally provides sustenance for the obedient and the disobedient, He tolerates those who disbelieve in Him and who disobey Him and He accepts the tövbe of those who repent to Him.

420.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Allah (ﷻ) divided rahmet into one hundred parts. He withheld ninety-nine parts for Himself and sent one part to the earth. It is through this one part that the creation shows rahmet to each other, so that an animal lifts its hoof in korku of hurting its young one."Another narration has:"Allah (ﷻ) has one hundred mercies. He sent down one rahmet that is shared between jinn, men, animals and insects and by virtue of this they show affection and rahmet to each other and a wild animal shows affection to its young. Allah (ﷻ) withheld ninety-nine mercies and by virtue of these He will show rahmet to His kullar on the day of Kıyamet."(Bukhārī, Müslüman). Müslüman also rivayet etti from Salmān al-Fārsī (رضي الله عنه) that Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi:"Allah (ﷻ) has one hundred mercies. One of these is the rahmet by which the creation shows rahmet to each other, while the other ninety-nine are for the day of Kıyamet."
420.commentary: After mentioning that bütün creatures – jinn, humans, animals and insects – show rahmet to one another, reference has been made to an animal with hooves gibi a horse showing rahmet to its foal. bunun sebebi is that horses were the çoğu yaygın domesticated animals for the Ṣaḥābah and they noticed how these animals behaved with their young. These narrations are a source of great ümit and joy for a believer. bütünāh (ﷻ) has already given him enormous bounties in dünya, which include Islām, the Qur'ān, ṣalāh, etc. If bütün of this is the result of just one rahmet, then one can well imagine the blessing of the ninety-nine mercies bütünāh (ﷻ) will grant him in the ahiret.

421.text: From Resûlullah (ﷺ) in what he anlatır from Allah (ﷻ) Who dedi:"A kul committed a günah and dedi: 'Allah'ım! Forgive me my günah.' Allah (ﷻ) dedi: 'My kul committed a günah, but he knows that he has a Sustainer who forgives günahlar and also punishes günahlar.' The kul again committed a günah and dedi: 'Ey Rabbim! Forgive me my günah.' Allah (ﷻ) dedi: 'My kul committed a günah, but he knows that he has a Sustainer who forgives günahlar and also punishes günahlar.' The person again committed a günah and dedi: 'Ey Rabbim! Forgive me my günah.' Allah (ﷻ) dedi: 'My kul committed a günah, but he knows that he has a Sustainer who forgives günahlar and also punishes günahlar. I have forgiven My kul, so he may now do as he likes.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman). The words"He may now do as he likes,"mean that as long as he repents after sinning, Allah (ﷻ) will bağışla him because repentance wipes out previous günahlar.
421.commentary: Bu hadis al-Qudsī önemine delalet eder promptly repenting after committing a günah. Such tövbe should be genuine and not merely be sözler. It needs to be coupled with remorse over the günah, a firm commitment not to return to it and tam separation from it. When a person repents in this şekil and asks bütünāh (ﷻ) to forgive Him, bütünāh (ﷻ) responds with His infinite quality of bağışlanma. The hadis does not mean that a person is allowed to commit as much evil as he likes. It demektir ki if he happens to commit evil but also sincerely repents thereafter, then bütünāh (ﷻ) will forgive him and he will once again have a clean slate.

422.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Nefsim elinde olan Allah'a yemin ederim ki that if you did not günah, Allah (ﷻ) would have removed you and brought another nation which would commit günahlar and then seek Allāh'in bağışlanma so that He could bağışla them."(Müslüman)
422.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki bütünāh (ﷻ) loves to forgive günah – a fact that we gather from other aḥādīth as well. No matter how much evil a person has perpetrated, he should asla lose ümit of the rahmet and bağışlanma of bütünāh (ﷻ), for the door of tawbah (tövbe) is wide open. He should hasten towards tawbah, knowing that he will be welcomed by bütünāh (ﷻ). It is incorrect to assume from Bu hadis yanilām encourages man to günah, because the Qur'ān repeatedly discourages sinning and the mission of the Messengers was to remove men from a life of günah.

423.narrator: Abū Ayyūb Khālid ibn Zayd (رضي الله عنه)
423.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"If you had not committed günahlar, Allah (ﷻ) would have created other creatures which would commit günahlar and then seek bağışlanma so that He could bağışla them."(Müslüman)
423.commentary: It is interesting to note that Abū Ayyūb (رضي الله عنه) only narrated Bu hadis when he was on the verge of death. birçok of the Ṣaḥābah and pious predecessors also narrated such aḥādīth of ümit during their final moments of life. Ibn Mālik (رضي الله عنه) said: "Bu hadis is not an teşvik to commit günahlar; rather, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said this to console the Ṣaḥābah and remove excessive korku from their hearts. They had become so overwhelmed with korku that bazı of them had gone away to mountaintops to seclude themselves in ibadet, bazı of them had forsaken women and bazı had forsaken sleep. Bu hadis directed them to develop ümit in bütünāh's (ﷻ) bağışlanma."

424.text: We were sitting with Resûlullah (ﷺ) together with Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) and 'Umar (رضي الله عنه). The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) then stood up and left us. After quite some time had passed and he still did not return, we began to korku that harm had come to him. We stood up in alarm. I was the first to be alarmed and I went out in search of Resûlullah (ﷺ) until I reached an orchard belonging to the Anṣār."He then related the hadis in full until he finally dedi:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Go and give glad tidings of Cennet to whoever you meet behind this orchard who testifies with full conviction of heart that there is none worthy of ibadet except Allah (ﷻ).'"(Müslüman)
424.commentary: Imām Nawawī (رحمه الله) chose not to narrate the hadis in dolu. From the narration quoted in Muslim, we learn that the Ṣaḥābah went out in search of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) reached an orchard belonging to the Banū al-Najjār clan of the Anṣār. He circled the orchard looking for a yol in, but could not find any entrance. Finally, he noticed a brook flowing into the orchard through a gap beneath the walls. He squeezed through this opening and found the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) inside. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) gave him his sandals as an assurance that he was safe and sent him out with the glad tidings of cennet for whoever testifies that there is none worthy of ibadet but bütünāh (ﷻ) and that Muhammed (ﷺ) is the Messenger of bütünāh.

425.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
425.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) recited the words of Allah (ﷻ) regarding Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام),"Ey Rabbim! They have misguided many people. So whoever followed me, he is of me; and whoever disobeyed me, You are Most forgiving, Most merciful."(Sûre Ibrāhīm, 36) and the words of 'Īsā (عليه السلام):"If You punish them, they are Your kullar. And if You bağışla them, You alone are powerful, wise."(Sûre al-Mā'ida, 118) The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) then raised his hands (in supplication) and dedi:"Allah'ım! My followers, my followers,"and he cried. Allah (ﷻ) dedi:"O Jibra'īl! Go to Muḥammad and, despite your Lord knowing best, ask him why he is crying."Jibra'īl (عليه السلام) came to him and Resûlullah (ﷺ) haber verdi him of his supplication, despite Allah (ﷻ) knowing best. Allah (ﷻ) then dedi:"O Jibra'īl! Go to Muḥammad and say: 'We will please you with regard to your followers and we will not displease you.'"(Müslüman)
425.commentary: Bu hadis illustrates the extreme merhamet of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) for his Ummah and his concern for their well-being. When he recited the verses of the Qur'ān in which the Messengers Ibrāhīm and 'Īsā (عليهما السلام) supplicated to bütünāh (ﷻ) for their respective followers, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) thought of his own followers and shed tears while supplicating for them. bütünāh (ﷻ) consoled him and granted him what he desired with the assurance that He would please him with regard to his Ummah. Imām Nawawī (رحمه الله) said: "Bu hadis is one of the çoğu comforting of aḥādīth for this Ummah."

426.text: I was riding behind Resûlullah (ﷺ) on a donkey when he dedi to him: 'Ey Muâz! Biliyor musunuz what Allāh'in (ﷻ) right is on His kullar and the kullar' right is on Allah (ﷻ)?' I cevap verdi: 'Allāh and His Messenger know best.' He dedi: 'Allāh'in (ﷻ) right on His kullar is that they should ibadet Him and not ascribe partners with Him. And the kullar' right on Allah (ﷻ) is that He does not punish anyone who does not ascribe partners with Him.' I dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Should I not grant people the glad tidings of this?' He cevap verdi: 'No, if you do so, they will rely on it (and abandon good deeds).'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
426.commentary: What does "the servants' doğru on bütünāh (ﷻ)" mean when we know that nobody gerçekte has any doğru over bütünāh (ﷻ), because bütünāh (ﷻ) is not obliged to any of His creation? Imām Qurṭubī (رحمه الله) answered this by stating that it işaret eder the sevap that bütünāh (ﷻ) has promised, out of His iyilik. Since bütünāh (ﷻ) does not go against His vaad, His servants can definitely expect to receive a sevap and this has been referred to as a 'doğru'. We know from other aḥādīth that bütünāh (ﷻ) may punish believers who committed günahlar, even though they did not ascribe partners to bütünāh (ﷻ). Scholars have explained that the entrance of sinful believers in the Fire is not termed as 'adhāb (azap), because 'adhāb means to inflict pain along with humiliation. A believer will only enter the Fire to become purified and eligible for cennet.

427.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a Müslüman is questioned in the grave, he testifies that there is none worthy of ibadet except Allāh and that Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh. This is the meaning of the verse: 'Allāh strengthens the müminler with the firm word in the life of this world and in ahiret.'"(Sûre Ibrāhīm, 27) (Bukhārī, Müslüman)
427.commentary: After a person dies, the two angels Munkar and Nakīr will come to his grave and question him about his Lord, his din and the Messenger that was sent to him. If he is a gerçek Muslim, bütünāh (ﷻ) will enable him to give the doğru replies, while a disbeliever will not be able to do so.

428.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a kâfir does a good deed, he receives sustenance in return for it in this world. As for a mümin, Allah (ﷻ) stores his good deeds for him in ahiret and also rewards him with sustenance in this world because of his obedience."Another narration has:"Allah (ﷻ) does not wrong a mümin for doing a good deed; he is given something for it in this world and rewarded for it in ahiret. As for a kâfir, he receives sustenance in this world for the good deeds which he did for Allāh so that when he reaches ahiret, he will have no good deeds for which he is to be rewarded."(Müslüman)
428.commentary: birçok disbelievers in dünya perform ameller of goodness gibi giving charity, joining family ties and helping people, bununla birlikte, these do not take them closer to bütünāh (ﷻ) because they lack the prerequisite of īmān (iman). bütünāh (ﷻ) gives them a sevap for these ameller in dünya by granting them more wealth or protecting them from harm, but they will not receive any sevap in the ahiret. A believer, diğer yandan, is rewarded for his iyilikler in her iki the worlds.

429.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The similitude of the five daily namazs is like that of an abundantly flowing river at your door in which you bath five times a day."(Müslüman)
429.commentary: Bu hadis emphasises the önem of discharging the duty of ṣalāh and presents glad tidings to those who do so. Ṣalāh performed five times a day has been compared to bathing in a river and thereby cleansing oneself of dirt because, tıpkı... gibi repeated bathing removes bütün physical dirt from the body, regular and doğru performance of ṣalāh cleanses a person from günahlar. According to the genel view, bununla birlikte, this işaret eder minor günahlar, as tawbah (tövbe) is required for the bağışlanma of major günahlar.

430.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"When a Müslüman man passes away and forty people who do not ascribe partners with Allah (ﷻ) attend his funeral namaz, Allah (ﷻ) accepts their intercession in his favour."(Müslüman)
430.commentary: The Janāzah Ṣalāh (funeral prayer) is a prayer in which bağışlanma is sought on behalf of the deceased Muslim. If the number of those who perform the funeral prayer reaches forty, it is hoped that bütünāh (ﷻ) will accept their supplication and forgive the deceased. bazı âlimlere göre, there is greater ümit that bütünāh (ﷻ) will accept intercession on behalf of the deceased, if more righteous people attend his funeral prayer.

431.text: We were about forty people with Resûlullah (ﷺ) in a tent and he sordu: 'Would you like to be a quarter of the inhabitants of Cennet?' We cevap verdi: 'Yes.' He sordu: 'Would you like to be a third of the inhabitants of Cennet?' We cevap verdi: 'Yes.' He dedi: 'By that Being in whose control is the life of Muhammad, I ümit that you will be half the inhabitants of Cennet. This is because only a Müslüman soul shall enter Cennet. In comparison to the polytheists, you are like a strand of white hair on the skin of a black ox, or like a strand of black hair on the skin of a red ox.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
431.commentary: Another hadis states that the inhabitants of cennet will consist of 120 rows of people and 80 of these will be Muslims. This demektir ki the Muslims will be two thirds of the inhabitants of cennet. This variation in numbers between narrations is not a contradiction, but served as a glad tiding to please the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and his Ummah regarding bütünāh's (ﷻ) tremendous rahmet upon them.

432.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"On the day of Kıyamet, Allah (ﷻ) will hand over a Jew or Christian to every Müslüman and say: 'This is your redemption from cehennem ateşi.'"According to another narration, Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi:"A group of Müslümans will be brought on the day of Kıyamet with günahlar the size of mountains and Allah (ﷻ) will bağışla them all."(Müslüman)
432.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki bütünāh (ﷻ) will forgive the günahlar of the Muslims due to His rahmet for them and He will punish the disbelievers in the same proportion because of their günah and küfür. According to 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Azīz (رحمه الله) as well as Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله), Bu hadis is the çoğu encouraging of aḥādīth for a Muslim considering its allusion that her Muslim will gain salvation from cehennem.

433.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"On the day of Kıyamet, a mümin will be brought close to his Sustainer so that He may place him under His rahmet and protection. He will then make him confess to his günahlar by asking him: 'Do you confess to such-and-such a günah? Do you confess to such-and-such a günah?' He will reply: 'Ey Rabbim! I confess.' Allah (ﷻ) will say: 'I concealed them for you in the world and I bağışla you for them today,' and he will then be given his book of good deeds."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
433.commentary: Bu hadis informs us of the tremendous rahmet of bütünāh (ﷻ) upon the believers on the day of Qiyāmah when bütünāh (ﷻ) will obliterate their günahlar and forgive them. bütünāh's (ﷻ) asking them to confess to their günahlar and then forgiving them is an allusion to the verse of the Qur'ān, "An easy reckoning will be taken from him." (Sūrah al-Inshiqāq, 8)

434.text: A man kissed a woman and came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and told him. Allah (ﷻ) then revealed the verse: 'Establish namaz at the two ends of the day and during portions of the night. Verily good deeds wipe out evil deeds.' (Sûre Hūd, 114) The man sordu: 'Is this for me only, O Messenger of Allāh?' He cevap verdi: 'It is for my entire Ummah.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
434.commentary: In this hadis, mention is made of a Ṣaḥābī who committed a minor günah and then requested the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) to cleanse him of it by means of a azap. It was not a major günah that required penal azap, bununla birlikte the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) were such that they regarded even their minor günahlar as major günahlar and they were not content until they had been forgiven or purified of them. The Qur'ānic verse was then revealed stating that ṣalāh obliterates minor günahlar and that there was no need to execute any azap or penalty.

435.text: A man came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I committed a günah which necessitates azap, so mete it out to me.' It was the time of namaz, so he joined Resûlullah (ﷺ) in namaz. When he had completed the namaz, he dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I committed a günah which necessitates azap, so mete out to me the judgment of the Book of Allāh.' He (ﷺ) sordu: 'Were you present with us in the namaz?' He cevap verdi: 'Yes.' He (ﷺ) dedi: 'You have been forgiven.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman). The words"I committed a günah which necessitates azap,"refer to an ordinary günah that is punishable and does not refer to penal punishments of the Sharī'ah such as the azap for committing adultery or consuming alcohol. These latter punishments do not fall off by offering namaz nor is it permissible for the leader to ignore them.
435.commentary: Göre bazı scholars, in order to conceal the günah from others the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) did not delve into and probe his beyan. The hadis also bize öğretir ki it is advisable for a person not to expose his own günahlar, tıpkı... gibi bütünāh (ﷻ) has not exposed them to others.

436.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) is pleased with a kul who eats a morsel of food and then praises Him for it, or drinks a drink of water and then praises Him for it."(Müslüman)
436.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki it is meritorious for a person to praise bütünāh (ﷻ) by saying Alḥamdulillāh, with her morsel and drink because by doing so he recalls bütünāh's (ﷻ) kind bounties upon him. It is also a reminder not to commit günah and thereby displease the Being who provides sustenance.

437.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) extends His hand at night so that the sinner of the day may turn in repentance and He extends His hand during the day so that the sinner of the night may turn in repentance, until the sun rises from the west."(Müslüman)
437.commentary: The "hand of bütünāh" is one of those attributes of bütünāh (ﷻ), which we believe in without questioning. bazı scholars interpret it figuratively by saying that it işaret eder the acceptance of tövbe. Bu hadis encourages us to have ümit in the rahmet of bütünāh (ﷻ) and to hasten towards tövbe.

438.narrator: Abū Najīḥ 'Amr ibn 'Abasah al-Sulamī (رضي الله عنه)
438.text: During the days of ignorance, I believed that people were astray and they were not on the truth because they worshipped idols. Then I heard of a man in Makkah who was speaking of certain things. So I mounted my conveyance and went to him. It was Resûlullah (ﷺ) who was secretly conveying his message while his people openly opposed him. So I planned to meet him secretly and succeeded in meeting him in Makkah. I sordu him: 'What are you?' He cevap verdi: 'I am a Messenger.' I sordu: 'What is a Messenger?' He cevap verdi: 'Allah (ﷻ) has sent me.' I sordu: 'What did He send you with?' He cevap verdi: 'He has sent me with the task of maintaining ties of kinship, destroying idols and that Allah (ﷻ) be accepted as One, without ascribing any partner to Him.' I sordu: 'Who is with you in this?' He cevap verdi: 'A free man and a slave.' At that time, Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) and Bilāl (رضي الله عنه) were with him. I dedi: 'I would like to follow you.' He dedi: 'You will not be able to do so at present. Do you not see my position and the position of my people? Rather return to your people and when you hear that I have prevailed, then come to me.' So I returned to my people and Resûlullah (ﷺ) went to Madīnah while I remained with them. I continued seeking news and enquiring from people when he reached Madīnah..."He dedi:"I dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Inform me about namaz.'"He dedi:"'Perform the morning [Sabah] namaz and then abstain from namaz until the sun has risen to the height of a spear. This is because when the sun rises, it rises between the two horns of Shaiṭān and it is at this time that the unbelievers prostrate before it. Then you may perform namaz because that namaz is witnessed and attended [by angels], until the shadow is equal to the spear. Then abstain from namaz because at that time Hell is ignited. When the shadow begins increasing, you may perform namaz because that namaz is witnessed and attended [by angels], until you perform the İkindi namaz. Then abstain from namaz until the sun sets, because it sets between the two horns of Shaiṭān and it is at this time that the unbelievers prostrate before it.'""I dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Tell me about ablution (wuḍū').' He dedi: 'There is no person among you who brings his ablution water, gargles his mouth, places water in his nose and blows it out without the günahlar of his face, mouth and nose falling away. Then when he washes his face as Allah (ﷻ) ordered him, the günahlar of his face fall away with the water from the sides of his beard. Then when he washes his hands until his elbows, the günahlar of his hands fall off with the water from the tips of his fingers. Then when he passes his wet hands over his head, the günahlar of his head fall off with the water from the ends of his hair. Then when he washes his feet until his ankles, the günahlar of his feet fall off with the water from the tips of his toes. When he then stands up and performs namaz, praises Allah (ﷻ), glorifies Him, expresses His majesty in accordance with His status and devotes his heart to Allah (ﷻ), then he relieves himself of his günahlar like the day his mother gave birth to him.'"(Müslüman)
438.commentary: Bu hadis teaches us the great faziletler of wuḍū' and ṣalāh when performed correctly. The mention of ties of kinship in the same breath with the Oneness of bütünāh (ﷻ) illustrates its pivotal role in Islām. When the physical strength of the believers is weaker than that of the disbelievers, they should conceal their iman in order to avoid unnecessary losses. Ṣalāh should be performed with concentration and kulluk.

439.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When Allah (ﷻ) intends to show rahmet upon a nation, He takes away their Messenger before them and He makes him a forerunner and a predecessor before them; and when He intends to destroy a nation, He punishes them while their Messenger is still alive. He destroys them while he is alive and watching and he is pleased by their destruction because they rejected him and disobeyed his command."(Müslüman)
439.commentary: Bu hadis served as solace and consolation for the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) because his people opposed and disobeyed him when he invited them to the truth of Islām. It was also an teşvik for the Muslims to continue following his message and teachings so that they could be united with him in the ahiret. Equally, it served as a uyarı to the disbelievers to reform their ways for korku that bütünāh (ﷻ) may punish them in dünya as He did to the nations of Lūṭ, Ṣāliḥ and Nūḥ (عليهم السلام).

440.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) dedi: 'I treat My kul according to his expectations of Me. I am with him wherever he remembers Me.' By Allāh, Allah (ﷻ) is more pleased with the repentance of His kul then one of you who finds his lost conveyance and possessions in a barren land. 'Whoever comes close to Me by one span, I go closer to him by one hand span. One who approaches Me by a hand span, I approach him by an arm-span. If he comes to Me walking, I go to him running."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
440.commentary: Bu hadis encourages us to have ümit in the rahmet of bütünāh (ﷻ) and to hasten towards tövbe. According to Imām Qurṭubī (رحمه الله), "I treat My servant according to his expectations of Me" applies to du'ā', tawbah and istighfār. başka bir deyişle, bütünāh (ﷻ) will accept du'ā' and tövbe if a person has the iman that bütünāh (ﷻ) has accepted it. The hadis also tells of bütünāh's (ﷻ) great pleasure at his servant's turning to Him in tövbe.

441.text: Three days before his demise, he heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"None of you should die without having good thoughts about Allah (ﷻ)."(Müslüman)
441.commentary: Bu hadis encourages us to have ümit of bütünāh's (ﷻ) rahmet and not to despair, özellikle at the time of death. Scholars mention that the quality of korku should be dominant in a believer when he is young and healthy, while ümit should be dominant when he is old and nearing his death.

442.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Allah (ﷻ) says: 'O son of Adam! I will bağışla you as long as you continue supplicating to Me and having ümit in Me and I will not mind. O son of Adam! I will bağışla you even if your günahlar reach the height of the skies and you then seek bağışlanma from Me and I will not mind. O son of Adam! If you come to Me with günahlar equivalent to the size of the earth and then you meet Me without having ascribed any partners with Me, I will come to you with the equivalent amount of bağışlanma.'"(Tirmidhī)
442.commentary: Bu hadis reminds us of the overwhelming rahmet of bütünāh (ﷻ). He forgives bütün günahlar except shirk (ascribing partners to bütünāh (ﷻ)). Even if one has committed birçok günahlar, one should not feel despondent. One should turn to bütünāh (ﷻ) in sincere tövbe and bütünāh (ﷻ) will forgive him. Once Sufyān al-Thawrī (رحمه الله) was ill and Ḥammād ibn Salamah (رحمه الله) visited him. Sufyān al-Thawrī (رحمه الله) asked him, "Do you think that bütünāh will forgive a person like myself?" Ḥammād (رحمه الله) replied, "If I had the choice of going to my father for accountability or to bütünāh, I would choose bütünāh because He is more merciful than a father."

443.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If a mümin knew of the azap of Allah (ﷻ), he would have no ümit of attaining His Cennet; and if a kâfir knew of the rahmet of Allah (ﷻ), he would not despair of attaining His Cennet."(Müslüman)
443.commentary: In this hadis, we are warned of the şiddet of bütünāh's (ﷻ) azap so that we may be careful to avoid it and we are told of bütünāh's (ﷻ) tremendous rahmet so that we may remain hopeful of salvation. According to 'bütünāmah Ṭībī (رحمه الله), Bu hadis combines her iki of bütünāh's (ﷻ) qualities of being the Almighty and the Merciful.

444.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When the corpse is laid out and people or men carry it on their shoulders, if it was salih, it says: 'Take me forward, take me forward,' and if it was not salih, it says: 'Destruction to me! Where are you taking it?' Everything except man hears its voice. If he were to hear it, he would fall unconscious."(Bukhārī)
444.commentary: If the deceased was righteous, he will be anxious to proceed to his grave in anticipation of the sevap that bütünāh (ﷻ) has prepared for him and if he was not, he will be afraid to enter his grave. bazı âlimlere göre, everything with the faculty of perception, except man, hears the soul of the deceased when it speaks. It is Sunnah to hasten with the burial of the deceased.

445.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Cennet is closer to you than your sandal straps and cehennem ateşi is just the same."(Bukhārī)
445.commentary: Ibn Jawzī (رحمه الله) stated that Bu hadis demektir ki cennet can be easily acquired with īmān and itaat to bütünāh (ﷻ); similarly, cehennem can be easily acquired by following the base desires and sinning. The hadis also bize öğretir ki we should not avoid doing any iyilik, no matter how insignificant it may be, because we do not know whether bütünāh's (ﷻ) pleasure lies therein. Similarly, we should not indulge in any günah, no matter how insignificant it may be, because we do not know whether bütünāh's (ﷻ) anger lies therein.

446.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: to me:"Recite the Kur'an to me."I dedi:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Should I recite the Kur'an to you when it was revealed to you?"He dedi:"I love to hear it from someone other than myself."So I recited Sûre al-Nisā' to him, until I reached this verse: 'How will it be when We shall bring forth a şahit from every nation and call you to be a şahit over them?' (Sûre al-Nisā', 41) He dedi:"That is sufficient for now."When I turned towards him, his eyes were flowing with tears."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
446.commentary: Bu hadis encourages us to weep out of the korku of bütünāh (ﷻ) when hearing His kelime, the Qur'ān. According to the scholars, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) cried due to his rahmet and concern for his Ummah because he realized that he would need to testify regarding their ameller, bazı of which would not be good and would lead to their azap. It is also possible that he cried because he pictured the difficult scene of Qiyāmah when he would be called to intercede on behalf of his Ummah.

447.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) addressed us in a sermon the like of which I never heard before. He dedi: 'If you only knew what I know, you would laugh little and cry much.' As a result, the Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) covered their faces and wept."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
447.commentary: Bu hadis was discussed in a previous chapter. See hadis 401. It bize öğretir ki the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) wept when they heard advices encouraging the korku of bütünāh (ﷻ). It encourages us to do likewise or at least to adopt the appearance of a weeping person when listening to the sözler of the Qur'ān or advices of the righteous.

448.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A person who cries out of the korku of Allah (ﷻ) will not enter cehennem ateşi until milk returns to the udders. Dust raised up in the path of Allah (ﷻ) and the smoke of cehennem ateşi can never combine."(Tirmidhī)
448.commentary: Rasūlullāh (ﷺ) utilised the example of milk returning to the udder in order to illustrate the impossibility of a person who cries out of the korku of bütünāh (ﷻ) entering the cehennem-fire. The Qur'ān utilises a benzer example to explain an impossibility, "They will not enter cennet until a camel enters through the eye of a needle." (Sūrah al-A'rāf, 40) The second portion of the hadis states that the dust which covers the body while in the yol of bütünāh (ﷻ) and the smoke of the cehennem-fire are opposites and can asla be joined together.

449.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There are seven people to whom Allah (ﷻ) will provide shade beneath His shade on a day when there will be no shade except His shade: a just leader, a youth who grew up in the ibadet of Allah (ﷻ), a person whose heart is attached to the masājid, two people who love each other for the sake of Allah (ﷻ), meeting and parting ways only for the love of Allah (ﷻ), a man who says to a woman of nobility and beauty trying to seduce him, 'I korku Allāh', a person who gives in sadaka and conceals it so that even his left hand does not know what his right hand gives, and a person who engages in the remembrance of Allah (ﷻ) in solitude, while shedding tears."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
449.commentary: Bu hadis has been comprehensively discussed in a previous chapter. See hadis 376. It is relevant to Bu bölüm because it teaches us the fazilet of a person who worships and remembers bütünāh (ﷻ) in solitude and weeps because of His korku. Such korku and weeping will be a source of sevap for him in the ahiret.

450.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in yanına namaz kılarken geldim ve göğsünden kaynayan bir kazanın sesi gibi ses geliyordu. (Ebû Dâvûd, Tirmizî)
450.commentary: Bu hadis describes the intensity of the ibadet of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). His korku of bütünāh (ﷻ) and his superior level of itaat led him to weep and express his utter weakness before his Sustainer. Scholars say that the quality of weeping out of the korku of bütünāh (ﷻ) was so dominant in Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام) that he could be heard weeping from a distance of one mile.

451.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: to Ubayy ibn Ka'b (رضي الله عنه):"Allah (ﷻ) ordered me to recite [Sûre] Lam yakunilladhīna... to you."He sordu:"Did Allah (ﷻ) mention me by name?"He (ﷺ) cevap verdi:"Yes,"and Ubayy (رضي الله عنه) wept. (Bukhārī, Müslüman)
451.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki Ubayy ibn Ka'b (رضي الله عنه) wept out of joy for bütünāh's (ﷻ) emir instructing the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) to recite the Qur'ān to him. It bize öğretir ki to express joy by tearing when receiving a bounty from bütünāh (ﷻ) is completely acceptable, as is weeping because of the realisation that one will asla be able to be sufficiently grateful to bütünāh (ﷻ) for that bounty. Ubayy ibn Ka'b (رضي الله عنه) was the greatest reciter of the Qur'ān amongst the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم).

452.text: After the demise of Resûlullah (ﷺ), Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) dedi to 'Umar (رضي الله عنه):"Let us visit Umm Ayman (رضي الله عنها) as Resûlullah (ﷺ) used to visit her."When they went to her, she began crying, so they sordu her:"Why are you crying? Don't you know that that which is with Allāh is better for Resûlullah (ﷺ)?"She cevap verdi:"I am not crying because I do not know that that which is with Allāh is better for Resûlullah (ﷺ); rather, I am crying because divine revelation has now come to an end."This prompted them to cry as well and they began to cry with her. (Müslüman)
452.commentary: Bu hadis was discussed in a previous chapter. See hadis 360. It bize öğretir ki it is helal to shed tears upon the separation and demise of the pious and that this does not contradict the teaching to be content with the decisions of bütünāh (ﷻ).

453.text: When the illness of Resûlullah (ﷺ) became intense, he was sordu about namaz and he dedi: 'Order Abū Bakr to lead the people in namaz.' 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) dedi: 'Abū Bakr is a soft-hearted person. When he recites the Kur'an, he is overcome by weeping.' He (ﷺ) dedi: 'Order him to lead the namaz.'"Another narration from 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) states that she dedi:"If Abū Bakr stands in your place, people will not hear his recitation because of his crying."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
453.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki weeping while reciting the Qur'ān is a meritorious amel. The hadis also proves that Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) was the çoğu eligible for the khilāfah after the demise of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). The Messenger of bütünāh's (ﷺ) instruction for him to lead the ṣalāh was an indication that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) regarded him as the best of bütün the Ṣaḥābah. 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) said, "The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) chose him for our dinî matters. Why should we not prefer him for our dünyevî matters?"

454.text: Food was brought to 'Abd al-Raḥmān ibn 'Auf (رضي الله عنه) [my father] while he was oruç and he dedi:"Muṣ'ab ibn 'Umayr (رضي الله عنه) was killed and he was better than me. Nothing could be found to enshroud him except a sheet, which was such that if his head was covered with it, his feet were exposed and if his feet were covered with it, his head was exposed. Then there came a time when the treasures of the world were laid out before us,"- or he dedi:"We have now been given so much of the world."-"and we korku that the rewards for our good deeds have been given to us in advance."He then began weeping to such an extent that he left the food. (Bukhārī)
454.commentary: Bu hadis explains that the noble Ṣaḥābī, 'Abd al-Raḥmān ibn 'Auf (رضي الله عنه), was of the opinion that the treasures of the world which were given to them was the sevap for their iyilikler and that they would bu nedenle not receive any sevap in the ahiret. This showed his concern for success in the ahiret. It is advisable to mention the bounties of bütünāh (ﷻ) that one enjoys, so that one may be grateful for them and express ones inability to appreciate them fully. tevazu is a fazilet. Despite 'Abd al-Raḥmān ibn 'Auf (رضي الله عنه) being one of the 'Asharah Mubassharah (the ten Ṣaḥābah who were promised cennet), he regarded Muṣ'ab ibn 'Umayr (رضي الله عنه) to be more virtuous than himself.

455.narrator: Ebû Ümâme Ṣudayy ibn 'Ajlān al-Bāhilī (رضي الله عنه)
455.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There is nothing which Allah (ﷻ) loves more than two drops and two signs: a teardrop that is shed out of the korku of Allah (ﷻ) and a drop of blood that is shed in the path of Allah (ﷻ). As for the two signs, one is a sign left in the path of Allah (ﷻ) and the other is a sign when fulfilling one of the compulsory duties of Allah (ﷻ)."(Tirmidhī)
455.commentary: From this hadis, we learn that bütünāh (ﷻ) loves two drops of fluid. One is that teardrop which falls from the eye of a person due to His korku and the other is that drop of blood that falls from the body of a mujāhid who is injured in His yol. We also learn that bütünāh (ﷻ) loves two signs and effects. One is that footstep taken or injury incurred in the yol of bütünāh (ﷻ). The other is the effect that remains on the body due to an ibadet, gibi cracks on the feet due to wuḍū' in the cold, a dusty body during ḥaj, the effects of ṣalāh on the forehead and weakness as a result of ṣawm or ṣalāh.

456.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) addressed us in a sermon which yaptı our hearts tremble and our eyes tear."(Refer to hadis no. 157)
456.commentary: Bu hadis was discussed in a previous chapter. The dolu narration appears in hadis 157. It teaches us the great effect that the sermons and advices of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) had on the Ṣaḥābah, causing their hearts to tremble and their eyes to shed tears.

457.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sent Abū 'Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrāḥ (رضي الله عنه) to Bahrain in order to collect its jizyah. He returned with the mal from Bahrain and when the Anṣār heard about the arrival of Abū 'Ubaydah (رضي الله عنه), they arrived to offer the Sabah namaz with Resûlullah (ﷺ). When Resûlullah (ﷺ) completed the namaz, he turned around to leave, but the Anṣār presented themselves before him. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) smiled when he saw them and dedi: 'I assume that you heard of Abū 'Ubaydah'in arrival with something from Bahrain?' They cevap verdi: 'Yes, O Messenger of Allāh.' He dedi: 'Glad tidings be to you and ümit for that which will make you happy. By Allāh, I do not korku fakirlik for you, but I korku that the world be laid out before you as it was laid out for those before you and you will compete for it as they competed for it and it will destroy you as it destroyed them.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
457.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki wealth, luxuries and competition in dünyevî possessions sık sık lead a person to commit günah and transgression. One bu nedenle, should strive to cleanse the heart of the sevgi of dünya. The hadis serves as a uyarı to those who are wealthy because wealth brings power and power easily corrupts noble niyetler. The Ṣaḥābah were poor, but because they went out in jihād, the wealth of the world came to them and they enjoyed honour and haysiyet amongst humanity. In contrast, the later generations were wealthy, but because they abandoned their dinî sorumluluklar, they lost what they had and were disgraced amongst humanity.

458.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sat on the pulpit and we sat around him. He dedi:"Part of what I really korku for you after my demise is that the beauty and splendour of the world will be opened up to you."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
458.commentary: The hadis explains that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) feared that the hearts and minds of Muslims would be drawn to the attractions of the world resulting in indifference towards the ahiret. He feared that they would neglect their primary dinî sorumluluklar of jihād and propagating Islām. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was well aware that sevgi for wealth and riches creates enmity, pride and miserliness.

459.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The world is sweet and green and Allah (ﷻ) has made you vicegerents therein in order to observe what you do. So be wary of the world and be wary of women."(Müslüman)
459.commentary: Bu hadis was discussed in a previous chapter. See hadis 70. dünya has been referred to as sweet and green because of its attraction to man. It also indicates to its temporary and perishable nature. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) advised that one should "be wary of the world" because its attractions lead one astray from the straight yol. One should also "be wary of women" because one who becomes engrossed with them is easily distracted from fulfilling his dinî yükümlülükler.

460.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah'ım! There is no life except the life of ahiret."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
460.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said these sözler on the çoğu difficult of occasions and on the happiest of occasions. The former was when the Ṣaḥābah were strenuously digging the trench around Madīnah Munawwarah and he consoled them by saying that their exertion and toils were nothing compared to the everlasting pleasure of the ahiret. The latter was when a great multitude of Ṣaḥābah performed the Farewell Ḥaj and he cautioned them that they should not develop pride because of their numbers and physical strength, but remain focused on the gerçek life of the ahiret. The essence of his message was that the ease and luxuries of dünya do not please an intelligent person because these are transient, rather his focus should be the ahiret which is eternal.

461.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Three things follow the deceased: his family, his mal and his actions. Two of them return and one remains with him. His family and mal return and his actions remain with him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
461.commentary: Bu hadis, kişiyi dünyada iyi ameller işlemeye teşvik eder çünkü ahirete sadece ameli kalır. Aile ve mal geride kalır, yalnızca amel fayda verir.

462.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"An inmate of Hell who had been from the wealthiest of people in this world will be brought on the day of Kıyamet and dipped into cehennem ateşi. He will then be sordu: 'O son of Adam! Did you ever experience any good? Did you ever experience any nimet?' He will say: 'By Allāh, no, my Sustainer.' And an inmate of Cennet who had suffered the most in this world will be brought and dipped into Cennet. He will then be sordu: 'O son of Adam! Did you ever experience any suffering? Did any difficulty ever afflict you?' He will say: 'By Allāh, no, my Sustainer. I never experienced any suffering nor did any difficulty ever afflict me.'"(Müslüman)
462.commentary: The hadis explains that a disbeliever will be dipped very briefly into cehennem and it will cause him to forget her bounty, which he had enjoyed in dünya. His reply that he had asla experienced any bounties in dünya is an indication of the şiddet of cehennem. It is as if bütün the bounties of the world were nothing compared to the brief azap of cehennem. diğer yandan, a person who had suffered much in dünya will be dipped very briefly into cennet and it will cause him to forget her difficulty and hardship he experienced in dünya. başka bir deyişle, a person who gets just one taste of cennet will be so overawed by its bounties that he will regard bütün his suffering in dünya as nothing.

463.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"This world in comparison to ahiret is like dipping your finger in the sea and seeing how much water sticks to it."(Müslüman)
463.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki the quantity of water, which sticks onto ones finger when it is dipped into the sea is like dünya, while the bütün sea is like the ahiret. başka bir deyişle, the insignificance and transient nature of dünya is being compared to the countless bounties and eternity of the ahiret. It is to be noted that this is merely an example that has been mentioned so that man may understand the difference between dünya and the ahiret. gerçekte, there can be no comparison because one is temporary and the other is eternal.

464.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) passed through the market place with people on either side of him. He passed by the dead kid of a goat which had small ears. He held it by its ear and sordu:"Which of you would like to purchase this for one dirham?"The Sahâbe cevap verdi:"We would not like to take it for anything. What could we do with it?"He sordu:"Would you like to have it?"They cevap verdi:"By Allāh, even if it was alive, it would have been defective because of its small ears. How can we like it now that it is dead!"He dedi:"By Allāh, this world is more insignificant in the sight of Allah (ﷻ) than this kid is to you."(Müslüman)
464.commentary: In çeşitli ways and on birçok occasions, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) sakındırılan the Ṣaḥābah from becoming submerged in the sevgi of dünya because this causes a person to desire more of it and commit günahlar without any korku of bütünāh (ﷻ). The Messengers, scholars, the righteous, the ilâhî books and bütün forms of ibadet are excluded from the description of the world being insignificant and worthless.

465.text: I was walking with Resûlullah (ﷺ) on a lava field of Madīnah with Mount Uḥud in front of us. He (ﷺ) dedi: 'O Abū Dharr!' I cevap verdi: 'I am present, Ey Allah'ın Resûlü!' He dedi: 'It would not please me to have gold equal to this mountain of Uḥud and three days pass by with even a single dīnār of it remaining with me, except an amount with which I could pay off debts. Rather, I would distribute it among the kullar of Allah (ﷻ) like this, like this and like this,' and he indicated to his right, his left and behind him. He continued walking and then dedi: 'Those who have a lot of mal (in this world) will have very little (in sevap) on the day of Kıyamet, except for the person who distributes his mal like this, like this and like this,' and he indicated to his right, his left and behind him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
465.commentary: Bu hadis teaches us not to develop sevgi for this temporary world, and to rather spend our wealth in the yol of bütünāh (ﷻ). 'Īsā (عليه السلام) appropriately stated, "Do not make the world your master because it will make you its slave." It should be noted that the hadis does not imply that to be wealthy is haram. It simply demektir ki one should fulfil the haklar of the wealth that bütünāh (ﷻ) bestows upon a person. It is helal for a person to save money for an unseen expense; bununla birlikte, one should not be miserly or wasteful.

466.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If I had gold equal to Mount Uḥud, it would not please me that any of it remains with me for three days, except an amount with which I could pay off debts."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
466.commentary: Bu hadis indicates towards the ultimate degree of abstinence of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ); he would not even allow three days to pass with excess wealth in his possession. Paying off a debt is Farḍ (farz) while charity is Nafl (optional); bundan dolayı, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) gave preference to the settling of debts and kept sufficient wealth for this purpose. One should spend in the yol of bütünāh (ﷻ) during one's lifetime while one is healthy, rather than at the time of death. One should hasten in settling one's debts. A wealthy person who delays in settling debts commits oppression.

467.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Look at those who are below you and do not look at those who are above you. That will be more likely to prevent you from being ungrateful for Allāh'in bounties on you."(Bukhārī, Müslüman) The narration of Bukhārī has:"When any of you sees someone who has been given more than him in mal and physical appearance, he should look at someone who is below him."
467.commentary: Bu hadis provides a prescription for contentment and peace. One should look towards the less fortunate in dünyevî terms to appreciate one's bounties and be grateful to bütünāh. Looking towards those who are wealthy leads to envy and jealousy. In matters of din and the ahiret, one should look towards those who are superior so that one may strive to equal them in salih amel.

468.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"May the slave of the dīnār, the dirham, the velvet cloak and the silk garment be destroyed. If he is given, he is pleased and if he is not given, he is displeased."(Bukhārī)
468.commentary: Bu hadis discourages us from developing excessive sevgi for dünya and its luxuries because one who is a slave to wealth cannot be a gerçek slave to bütünāh. One who becomes engrossed in the wealth of dünya to the extent that he gives preference to it over din, becomes a slave to it and worships it instead of worshipping bütünāh.

469.text: I gördü seventy insanlar of the insanlar of the Ṣuffah and not a single man among them had a rıda. They had either a loincloth or an upper elbise, which they tied around their necks. Some of these garments reached their calves, while others reached their ankles. They would gather it with their hands fearing that their private parts would be exposed."(Bukhārī)
469.commentary: The Ṣuffah was a raised platform in Masjid al-Nabawī on which the poverty stricken Ṣaḥābah would reside in order to learn Islām from the Messenger of bütünāh. Bu hadis highlights the poverty of the Ṣaḥābah of the Ṣuffah; they barely had sufficient clothing to cover their bodies. They chose a life of simplicity and suppressed their desires in order to learn the din of Islām and fayda from it in the ahiret.

470.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The world is a prison for the mümin and a Cennet for the kâfir."(Müslüman)
470.commentary: Bu hadis can be interpreted in çeşitli ways: No matter how much luxury a believer has in dünya, it is minimal compared to that of the ahiret; and no matter how severely a disbeliever suffers in dünya, it is minimal compared to what azap awaits him in the ahiret. Also, tıpkı... gibi a prisoner is confined and restricted in his movements and ameller, a believer is restricted by the commands of bütünāh. In contrast, a disbeliever is free to do as he pleases.

471.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) aldı hold of my shoulders and şöyle dedi: 'Live in this world as if you are a yabancı or one who is travelling on a path.' Ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما) used to say: 'In the evening, do not expect to see the morning and in the morning, do not expect to see the evening. Prepare for your illness while you are healthy and prepare for your death while you are living.'"(Bukhārī)
471.commentary: The hadis imparts çeşitli dersler gibi to hasten towards iyilikler, abandon long-drawn aspirations, capitalize on opportunities, avoid procrastination, utilize the bounties of life and wealth in a spiritually beneficial şekil, be content with little and be prepared for death at any time. The hadis teaches us to prepare for the ahiret, which is eternal and not to expand bütün our energies for this transient world.

472.narrator: Abū al-'Abbās Sahl ibn Sa'd al-Sā'idī (رضي الله عنه)
472.text: A man came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and dedi:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Show me an action which, if I engage in, Allah (ﷻ) will love me and the people will love me."He dedi:"Make do with little of this world and Allah (ﷻ) will love you and make do with little of what people own and people will love you."(ibn Mājah)
472.commentary: The hadis discourages a person from being engrossed in dünya to the extent that its sevgi enters his heart. sevgi of the world is despised from an Islāmic perspective; bununla birlikte, one who loves the world in order to ibadet bütünāh, do iyilikler and assist the creation is not sakındırılan, but rewarded. The hadis also encourages contentment and discourages a person from asking of people.

473.text: What people had acquired of this world and then dedi:"I saw Resûlullah (ﷺ) spending the day twisting and turning due to hunger; he could not even find poor quality dates to fill his stomach."(Müslüman)
473.commentary: Bu hadis and birçok others depict the sacrifice of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and his focus upon the ahiret. Other narrations teach us that the nebevî household would sık sık spend nights without a meal.

474.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) passed away there was nothing in my house which any living creature could eat, except a little barley which was stored on a shelf. I continued eating from it for quite some time, but then I weighed it and it got finished."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
474.commentary: Despite the large amounts of booty that arrived in Madīnah Munawwarah during the final stages of the life of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), he chose to live a life of simplicity and poverty. başka bir deyişle, wealth did not corrupt the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) or change the yol he lived in dünya. This was the excellent example of leadership he set for humanity to emulate.

475.text: 'Amr ibn al-Ḥārith (رضي الله عنه), the brother of Juwayriyah bint al-Ḥārith (رضي الله عنها), the mother of the müminler, anlatır:"At the time of the demise of Resûlullah (ﷺ), he did not leave behind any dīnār, dirham, male slave, female slave, nor anything other than his white mule which he used to ride, his weapons and a portion of land which he had given in sadaka for travellers."(Bukhārī)
475.commentary: Bu hadis mentions that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) left behind almost no possessions at the time of his demise. The land referred to here is that of Fadak, Khaibar and a portion of the land of Banū Nadhīr. The latter was obtained after the battle of Uḥud, but the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) distributed it thereafter. The land of Fadak was made waqf for travellers and he divided the land of Khaibar into three portions: two thirds were for the fayda of the Muslims, while the remaining third was for the fayda of the wives of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ).

476.text: We emigrated with Resûlullah (ﷺ), seeking the pleasure of Allah (ﷻ). Allah (ﷻ) granted us our sevap; some of us died without enjoying any of their sevap and Muṣ'ab ibn 'Umayr (رضي الله عنه) was one of them. He was killed in the battle of Uḥud and left behind a shawl. When we covered his head with it, his feet became exposed and when we covered his feet with it, his head became exposed. So Resûlullah (ﷺ) emretti us to cover his head and to place some grass on his feet. Some of us are picking the fruits which have ripened."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
476.commentary: Bu hadis illustrates the simplicity and doğruluk of the Ṣaḥābah. They sincerely fought alongside the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) for the pleasure of bütünāh and not for any dünyevî motives. bazı of them did not even have a burial shroud that could cover their bodies. The hadis also bize öğretir ki those righteous servants of bütünāh who victoriously return from battle receive the dünyevî rewards of their efforts in the form of booty, as well as an eternal sevap. Those who are blessed with martyrdom will receive their dolu sevap in the ahiret.

477.narrator: Sahl ibn Sa'd al-Sā'idī (رضي الله عنه)
477.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If the world had been worth as much as the wing of a mosquito in the sight of Allah (ﷻ), He would not have given a single sip of water to a kâfir."(Tirmidhī)
477.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki the world has no hakiki worth because bütünāh has given it to His enemies, the disbelievers and it is obvious that an enemy is asla given an item of value as a gift. A mosquito olarak kabul edilir an insignificant and trivial creature and dünya should be regarded in the same yol. bütünāh has not created the world as the ultimate objective of life; rather, it is to be used as a means of achieving the greater objective, which is the ahiret.

478.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Listen! This world is cursed and all that is in it is cursed, except the remembrance of Allah (ﷻ), whatever is beloved to Him, an İslâmic scholar and a student."(Tirmidhī)
478.commentary: "dünya is cursed" demektir ki it is mekruh and despised in the sight of bütünāh. The root letters of the kelime "mal'ūnah" (cursed) are "la'ana" which means to be distant, bundan dolayı in this context it means to be distant from the rahmet of bütünāh. Bu hadis should not be understood to mean that dünya as an entity is in itself accursed; rather, it demektir ki whatever of the world leads one away from bütünāh and His itaat is accursed.

479.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not hanker after property so much that you become engrossed in this world."(Tirmidhī)
479.commentary: Property acquisition and development are despised when these become the focus and objective of life and lead one away from bütünāh's ibadet. bununla birlikte, one who engages in them for the fayda of humanity, while adhering to bütünāh's laws, is not included in the ambit of this hadis. While property development has been singled out, scholars have extended it to include any occupation, skill or employment which man engages in.

480.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
480.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) passed by us while we were repairing a hut of ours. He sordu: 'What is this?' We cevap verdi: 'It has become weak, so we are repairing it.' He dedi: 'I think that death may come more swiftly than this.'"(Narrated by Abū Dāwūd and Tirmidhī through the chain of Bukhārī and Müslüman)
480.commentary: In this hadis, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) indicated that to become engrossed in the construction and architecture of buildings is not appropriate because more urgent matters, gibi death and the ahiret should be given preference. bundan dolayı, one should daima regard death to be imminent and close as this will prevent one from günahlar and encourage one to engage in good.

481.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Every nation has a trial, and the trial of my nation is mal."(Tirmidhī)
481.commentary: The kelime "fitnah" is çoğu commonly translated in a negative context as a trial and tribulation; bununla birlikte, it may also be used in a positive context. In this hadis, it demektir ki the Muslims will be tested by wealth in a benzer yol to an examiner testing the ability of students. Wealth is from the adornments of dünya and man bu nedenle inclines towards it. bununla birlikte, one should be careful that one does not become unmindful of death and the ahiret.

482.narrator: Abū 'Amr, who is also known as Abū 'Abdullāh and Abū Laylā, 'Uthmān ibn 'Affān (رضي الله عنه)
482.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The son of Adam does not have a right except to the following: a house in which to live, a garment with which to cover the private portions of his body and dry bread and water."(Tirmidhī)
482.commentary: One who suffices upon the three things mentioned in Bu hadis will not be questioned in the ahiret for possessing them, if they were acquired in a ḥalāl şekil, because they are essential for survival.

483.text: I came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) while he was reciting Sûre al-Takāthur -"The mutual rivalry for increasing worldly things diverts you."He dedi:"Man says: 'My mal, my mal.' O man! Do you possess any other mal except what you ate and digested, or wore and wore out, or gave in sadaka and sent it forward (for ahiret)?'"(Müslüman)
483.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki man does not personally fayda from the things of dünya other than his food, clothing and good ameller. One should bu nedenle be content with what one has in dünya and do good ameller that will fayda one in the ahiret.

484.text: A man dedi to Resûlullah (ﷺ):"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I love you."He dedi:"Think carefully about what you are diyerek."The man dedi:"By Allāh, I love you,"three times. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"If you really love me, prepare yourself with the shield of fakirlik because fakirlik comes more swiftly to the one who loves me than flood water to its destination."(Tirmidhī)
484.commentary: "Prepare yourself with the shield of poverty," demektir ki tıpkı... gibi a shield protects one from the arrows of an enemy, one should adopt a life of poverty to shield himself from the effects of dünyevî possessions. Bu hadis indicates that the more a person loves the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) the greater will be his detachment from dünya. diğer yandan, excessive involvement with dünyevî riches leads to the development of manevî sicknesses gibi pride, nefret and malice that prevent a person from loving the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ).

485.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Two hungry wolves which are let loose upon a flock of sheep do not cause as much damage as that caused to a man'in religion by his greed for mal and status."(Tirmidhī)
485.commentary: Bu hadis, mal ve makam hırsının kişinin dinine vereceği zararın, koyun sürüsüne salınmış iki aç kurttan daha büyük olduğunu açıklar.

486.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) slept on a straw mat and when he stood up, it would leave marks on the side of his body. We dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! We could get a mattress for you.' He dedi: 'What have I to do with this world? I am merely like a rider in this world who takes shade beneath a tree and then proceeds, leaving it behind.'"(Tirmidhī)
486.commentary: In this hadis, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) compared his life to a musāfir (traveller) who seeks shade from the heat of the sun beneath a tree. tıpkı... gibi his period of rest is short and he swiftly departs, he emphasised that dünya is merely a temporary phase of our existence and not our permanent abode. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) repeatedly refused the wealth and luxuries of dünya and preferred a life of simplicity and sacrifice.

487.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The poor will enter Cennet five-hundred years before the rich."(Tirmidhī)
487.commentary: The rich will be delayed in reaching their final abode because they will be questioned how they earned their wealth and how they had spent it. Their delay will be half a day, which equals five-hundred years of dünya. The poor will enter cennet easily because their accountability will be less, provided they were content with their şart of poverty and did not desire to be like the rich.

488.narrator: İbn Abbâs and 'Imrān ibn al-Ḥuṣayn (رضي الله عنهم)
488.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"I glanced into Cennet and saw that the majority of its inhabitants were the poor and I glanced into Hell and saw that the majority of its inhabitants were women."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
488.commentary: Bu hadis relates what the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) saw on the night of Mi'rāj. It does not necessarily mean that bütün the poor are more virtuous than the wealthy. It demektir ki birçok of the poor will enter cennet due to their takvâ and sabır and not necessarily their poverty. From other narrations, we learn that the reason for birçok women entering cehennem is their evil of cursing others and their isyan to their husbands.

489.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"I stood at the door of Cennet and noticed that the majority who entered it were the destitute, while the wealthy were held back. However, the inmates of cehennem ateşi had already been sent off to cehennem ateşi."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
489.commentary: "Al-Jadd" işaret eder luck and wealth. Bu hadis shows that the poor and destitute will enter cennet before the wealthy who will be held back due to their accountability.

490.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The most truthful statement ever dedi by a poet was that of Labīd: 'Listen! Everything apart from Allah (ﷻ) is baseless.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
490.commentary: The dolu verse of Labīd's poem was: "Everything apart from bütünāh is baseless; and her bounty will definitely be depleted." This demektir ki everything except bütünāh will perish. This conforms to the Qur'ānic verse: "Everything on earth shall perish." (Sūrah al-Raḥmān, 26) The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) asla composed any poetry, bununla birlikte he bazen quoted the beneficial poetry of others. From this, we learn that poetry is in itself not despised. It is teşvik edilen if it is beneficial, otherwise not.

491.text: The family of Muhammed (ﷺ) never ate a full stomach of barley bread for two consecutive days until his demise."(Bukhārī, Müslüman) Another narration has:"The family of Muhammed (ﷺ) never ate a full stomach of wheat bread for three consecutive days from the time he came to Madīnah until his demise."
491.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) chose a life of poverty until his demise despite the world coming to his feet. It contradicts the view of those who say that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) became wealthy towards the end of his life. It is an established fact that booty and riches came to Madīnah Munawwarah as Islām spread, but narrations state that he distributed whatever he received to the poor and destitute. He preferred to fast on one day and eat on the next so that when he was hungry I will remember You and when I am satiated I will praise You and be grateful to You.

492.text: From 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) that she used to say:"By Allāh, O my nephew, we used to see the crescent, then the next crescent, then the next crescent - three crescents in two months - without a fire being lit in the houses of Resûlullah (ﷺ)."I sordu:"O my aunt! What did you live on?"She cevap verdi:"Two black things: dates and water. However, Resûlullah (ﷺ) had some neighbours from the Anṣār who had milk-providing animals. They used to send some of their milk to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and he would give it to us to drink."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
492.commentary: "Without a fire being lit in the houses of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ)" demektir ki his family did not have any food that could be cooked. Water is also called a "black thing" despite being colourless because it is grouped with dates, the çoğu yaygın of which are the black dates of Madīnah Munawwarah. It is helal for a person to relate circumstances and incidents regarding his home to others, if these are not private matters nor do they reveal details that are compulsory to conceal. 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) spoke of her household in order to teach the Ummah the beautiful nebevî example.

493.narrator: Abu Sa'id al-Maqburi from Abu Hurayrah (ra)
493.text: Abū Sa'īd al-Maqburī anlatır from Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) that he passed by some people who had a roasted sheep in front of them. They invited him but he refused to eat, diyerek:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) departed from this world without having filled his stomach with barley bread."(Bukhārī)
493.commentary: Abū Hurairah (رضي الله عنه) refused to eat with them because he recalled the lifestyle of his leader and role model, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). His sevgi for the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) impelled him to emulate his sterling example of indifference to dünya.

494.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) did not eat on a table until his demise, nor did he eat fine sifted flour until his demise."(Bukhārī) Another narration of Bukhārī has:"He never ever gördü a fully roasted koyun."
494.commentary: Bu hadis highlights the simplicity and tevazu of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). He did not eat at a table because tables were a sign of opulence and he preferred to eat while seated on the ground. He did not eat fine sifted flour because this required extra effort in preparation and he was content with basic provisions.

495.text: I saw your Messenger (ﷺ) in such a state that he could not even find low quality dates to fill his stomach."(Müslüman)
495.commentary: The hadis reminds us of the simplicity of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and his indifference to dünyevî comforts. It serves as an teşvik to us to be content with little and to appreciate bütünāh's birçok bounties.

496.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) did not see ekmek yaptı of fine flour since Allah (ﷻ) gönderdi him as a Messenger until Allah (ﷻ) aldı his life."He was sordu:"Did you have sieves in the time of Resûlullah (ﷺ)?"He cevap verdi:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) did not see a sieve since Allah (ﷻ) gönderdi him as a Messenger until Allah (ﷻ) aldı his life."He was sordu:"How did you eat unsieved barley?"He cevap verdi:"We used to grind it and blow away the husk. Whatever remained, we would moisten and knead into dough."(Bukhārī)
496.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) sufficed on the barest minimum of food and drink, yet he would exert himself standing in ibadet until his feet would swell.

497.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) went out one day (or one night) and came across Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) and 'Umar (رضي الله عنه). He sordu them: 'What has caused you to emerge from your homes at this hour?' They cevap verdi: 'Hunger, Ey Allah'ın Resûlü!' He dedi: 'Me too! By the oath of that Being in whose control is my life, that which caused you to emerge from your homes has also caused me to emerge from my home. Come!' So they accompanied him until they came to the home of an Anṣārī person, but he was not at home. When the man'in wife saw Resûlullah (ﷺ), she dedi: 'Welcome, welcome!' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sordu her: 'Where is so-and-so (referring to her husband)?' She cevap verdi: 'He went to fetch some drinking water for us.' Just then the Anṣārī man returned. He looked at Resûlullah (ﷺ) and his two companions and dedi: 'All praise be to Allāh! Today, nobody has more honourable guests than I.' He went and brought back a branch with green, ripe and fully-ripe dates on it, diyerek, 'Eat!' He then took a knife and Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi to him: 'Do not slaughter an animal that gives milk.' So he slaughtered a sheep for them and they ate from it and from that branch of dates, and drank the water. When they were satiated and their thirst was quenched, Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi to Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) and 'Umar (رضي الله عنه): 'By that Being in whose control is my life, you will most certainly be questioned about these bounties on the day of Kıyamet. Hunger caused you to emerge from your homes and you did not return until you acquired these bounties.'"(Müslüman)
497.commentary: In this hadis, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) explained that a person should be grateful for the bounties of bütünāh which he enjoys and that he should be careful that luxurious food and drink do not divert his attention from the reality of the ahiret.

498.text: Khālid ibn 'Umayr al-'Adawī anlatır:"'Utbah ibn Ghazwān (رضي الله عنه), the governor of Baṣrah, addressed us in a sermon. He praised and glorified Allah (ﷻ) and then dedi: 'To proceed: This world has announced that it is coming to an end and retreating swiftly and only a small portion of it will remain like that which remains in the bottom of a container after one has filled and drank it. And you are moving from it to an abode which will never come to an end. So move to it with the best that you can possibly have as it has been related to us that a stone cast into the pit of Hell will continue falling for seventy years without reaching its bottom. By Allāh, it will be filled! Are you surprised? And it has been related to us that the distance between the two frames of the door of Cennet is a journey of forty years, but a day will come when it will be crowded by people. I remember a time when I was one of seven with Resûlullah (ﷺ) and we had no food except the leaves of trees, which caused the corners of our mouths to become ulcerated. I found a sheet which I divided equally between myself and Sa'd ibn Mālik (رضي الله عنه). I used half as a loin cloth and he used the other half. Today, however, each one of us has become a governor over a city. I seek refuge in Allah (ﷻ) from considering myself to be great, while in the sight of Allah (ﷻ) I am insignificant.'"(Müslüman)
498.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki the Ṣaḥābah faithfully followed the noble teachings of their guide and leader, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), regarding upright character and ahlâkî values. Despite their dünyevî success, power did not corrupt them.

499.text: 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) brought before us a sheet and a coarse loin cloth and dedi: 'The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) passed away while wearing these two.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
499.commentary: Bu hadis highlights the simplicity of the Messenger of bütünāh's (ﷺ) dressing. It bize öğretir ki he chose the yol of tevazu in bütün aspects of his life and was not inclined to dünyevî luxuries. 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) revealed these two pieces of his clothing to the people so that they could learn from his sterling example.

500.narrator: Sa'd bin Ebû Vakkās (رضي الله عنه)
500.text: I was the first of the Arabs to shoot an arrow in the path of Allah (ﷻ). We used to go in cihat with Resûlullah (ﷺ) and we had no food except the leaves of Ḥublah and Samur (names of wild trees) and when we would pass stool it was like that of sheep droppings, which had no stickiness."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
500.commentary: The hadis explains that the Ṣaḥābah would set out in jihād and take food along with them, but their provisions would run out and they would then suffice on tree leaves. The hadis highlights the sabır of the Ṣaḥābah in the face of immense hardship and trials. Their fortitude earned them bütünāh's pleasure and this paved the yol for the success and spread of Islām throughout the world.
