His concern for their well-being was amazing. He would further supplicate on their behalf so that their spirits would be raised and they would continue to advance.

972.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) sat on his camel to depart on a journey, he would say the takbīr (Allāhu Akbar – 'Allāh is the greatest') three times. He would then say:"Pure is Allāh who has placed this at our service whereas we would never have been able to control it. And our return will surely be to our Sustainer. O Allāh, we ask You in this journey of ours for salih amel and piety, and actions which You are pleased with. O Allāh, make this journey of ours easy and shorten its distance for us. O Allāh, You alone are the companion in the journey and the guardian in the family. O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from the difficulties of the journey, from any sight which is undesirable and from finding an evil condition upon my return in respect of my mal, family and children."When he returned from a journey, he would say the same and add:"We are returning, repenting, worshipping our Sustainer, and praising Him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī)
972.commentary: This is a very comprehensive supplication in which one praises bütünāh (ﷻ), remembers the ahiret, asks for the ability to carry out noble ameller and abstain from yanlış, and seeks koruma for oneself and one's family.

973.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) embarked on a journey, he would seek refuge from the difficulties of the journey, from an undesirable return, from retrogression after progress, from the supplication of the oppressed, and experiencing an evil condition in respect of family and mal."(Müslüman, Tirmidhī)
973.commentary: Âlimler "el-kevn" kelimesinin anlamını, istikrarlı bir durumdan veya artış halinden dönüş olarak açıklamışlardır.

974.text: 'Alī ibn Rabī'ah anlatır:"I once saw an animal brought to 'Alī ibn Abī Ṭālib (رضي الله عنه) to ride. When he placed his foot in the stirrup, he dedi: 'In the name of Allāh.' When he sat upright on its back, he dedi: 'All praise be to Allāh.' He then dedi: 'Pure is Allāh who has placed this at our service whereas we would never have been able to control it.' And our return will surely be to our Sustainer.' He then dedi: 'All praise be to Allāh' three times, and 'Allāh is the greatest' three times. He then dedi: 'Glory be to You. I have wronged myself so bağışla me. None forgives günahlar besides You.' He then smiled and was sordu: 'O Amīr al-Müminīn, why did you smile?' He cevap verdi: 'I saw Resûlullah (ﷺ) doing as I did and then he smiled. So I sordu him, 'O Messenger of Allāh, why did you smile?' He cevap verdi: 'Your Sustainer marvels at His kul when he says: Forgive me for my günahlar' knowing full well that no one other than I (Allāh) forgives günahlar.'"(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
974.commentary: One should recite bismillāh when mounting one's conveyance. Similarly, one should praise bütünāh (ﷻ) before utilising the bounty of the conveyance He has provided.

975.text: Yokuş çıkarken "Allahu ekber", inerken "Sübhanallah" derdik. (Ebû Dâvûd)
975.commentary: The hikmet of reciting bütünāhu Akbar (bütünāh is the greatest) when ascending is in order to negate the superiority of an elevated place entering the heart. Ascending or being at an elevated point is pleasing to the carnal desires, since there is within it a feeling of greatness which one perceives. We are taught to counter this by remembering the majesty of bütünāh (ﷻ) and that He is greater than everything. When descending, one goes from an elevated place to a lower place. This is a decline or a defect. bununla birlikte, as bütünāh (ﷻ) is free from bütün defects and weaknesses, by reciting Subḥānallāh (Glory be to bütünāh), one declares that there is only loftiness and perfection in the Being of bütünāh (ﷻ), whereas in bütün other objects, there is elevation as well as defects and blemishes.

976.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) ve orduları bir tepeye çıktıklarında "Allahu ekber", tepeden indiklerinde "Sübhanallah" derlerdi. (Ebû Dâvûd)
976.commentary: This is not confined to journeys only. When a person is ascending or descending in any yol gibi climbing stairs or descending in an elevator, these sözler should also be recited.

977.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) would return from Ḥaj or Umre, then each time he ascended a hill or incline, he would say 'Allāhu Akbar' three times and then say:"There is none worthy of ibadet besides Allāh. He is one and has no partner. To Him belongs the kingdom and to Him is all praise. He has power over everything. We are returning, repenting, worshipping, prostrating to our Sustainer and praising Him. Allāh has fulfilled His promise, helped His kul, and He defeated the armies alone."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī)
977.commentary: Müslim'in bir rivayetinde: "Resûlullah (ﷺ) askerî seferlerden, hac veya umreden döndüğünde üç kere tekbir getirirdi."

978.text: A man şöyle dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, I intend embarking on a yolculuk, so please give me some advice."He şöyle dedi:"Regard the korku of Allāh as binding upon yourself, and say the takbīr (Allāhu Akbar) at every incline."When the man turned to leave, he şöyle dedi:"O Allāh, shorten the distance for him and make the yolculuk easy for him."(Tirmidhī)
978.commentary: The Messenger (ﷺ) advised him to adhere to taqwā because while travelling a person generally becomes lax and unmindful of the regulations of Islām. "Shorten the distance" bazı âlimlere göre işaret eder a physical shortening where the earth is folded up. Others interpret it figuratively to mean that bütünāh (ﷻ) grants one the fervour and strength to tam the journey easily, and provides a good conveyance by which he can arrive at his destination in comfort, free from difficulties.

979.text: We were on a journey with Resûlullah (ﷺ) and when we used to climb a valley, we would say 'Lā ilāha illallāh' and 'Allāhu Akbar' with our voices raised. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'O people! Be kind to yourselves. You are not calling upon a being who is deaf or absent. He is with you. He is all-hearing and close.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
979.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) advised the Ṣaḥābah to recite dhikr in a moderate tone and a dignified şekil. There is no need to shout as bütünāh (ﷻ) is bütün-Hearing and, as the Qur'ān explains, He is closer to a person than his jugular vein. The ders taught in Bu hadis is also mentioned in the Qur'ān, "And when My bondsmen ask You about Me, verily I am close by." (Sūrah al-Baqarah, 186) The hadis does not negate the permissibility of dhikr in an audible tone, but prohibits jahr-mufriṭ (performing dhikr in an excessively loud voice).

980.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The supplications of three people are undoubtedly accepted: the supplication of the oppressed, the supplication of a traveller, and the supplication of the father against his child."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah)
980.commentary: The du'ā' of an oppressed person against the oppressor is readily accepted by bütünāh (ﷻ) because of the ihlâs with which it is made. The oppressed person realises that there is none who can assist him but bütünāh (ﷻ), bundan dolayı he focuses fully towards bütünāh (ﷻ). The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "Beware of the supplication of the oppressed, because there is no barrier between it and bütünāh (ﷻ)." (Bukhārī) Scholars state that if one has oppressed or wronged any person, then he should seek his pardon and attempt to undo the yanlış as soon as possible. This applies bilhassa before one proceeds on a journey because it becomes problematic if one does not return from the journey or if one is afflicted by the effects of such a supplication during the journey.

981.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) bir topluluktan korktuğunda şöyle derdi: "Allah'ım! Seni onların karşısına çıkarıyor ve onların şerrinden sana sığınıyoruz." (Ebû Dâvûd, Nesâî)
981.commentary: نُحُور is the plural of نحر (throat) which işaret eder the upper portion of the neck where animals are slaughtered. bu nedenle means, "O bütünāh, we place You at their throats," means, "O bütünāh, we place You as a barrier between us and them. Only You can repel from us their evil and that which is concealed within their bosoms." The throat has been specified because it is generally the point of attack during combat. This du'ā' should be read at times of danger. During a journey, there is a greater korku of being harmed by enemies, bundan dolayı one should focus towards bütünāh (ﷻ) at such a time and recite this du'ā'.

982.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"One who stops over at a place and says, 'I seek refuge with the perfect words of Allāh from the evil of that which He has created,' nothing will harm him until he departs from that place."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
982.commentary: The "mükemmel sözler" refer to the qualities of bütünāh (ﷻ) which have been perpetually associated with bütünāh (ﷻ). They have no weaknesses or shortcomings.

983.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) yolculukta gece olduğunda şöyle derdi: "Ey yeryüzü! Benim Rabbim de senin Rabbin de Allah'tır. Allah'a sığınırım, senin şerrinden, içindekilerin şerrinden ve üzerinde yaratılanların şerrindan." (Ebû Dâvûd)
983.commentary: This is a comprehensive du'ā' in which a person seeks bütünāh's (ﷻ) refuge from her iki physical and manevî enemies. Physical enemies include other humans, animals, jinn, etc. while manevî enemies include Shaiṭān and his offspring.

984.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Travelling is a form of azap. It deprives a person of his food, drink and sleep. So when any of you fulfils the objective of his journey, he should hasten in returning to his family."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
984.commentary: Yolculuk bir azap şekli olarak nitelendirilmiştir çünkü yolculuk sırasında kişi birçok zorluğa katlanmak zorundadır.

985.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any of you is away from home for a long time, he should not return to his family at night."Another narration has that Resûlullah (ﷺ) forbade a man from returning to his family at night. (Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
985.commentary: A man should return during the day and not at night so that his wife may have the opportunity of dressing up and beautifying herself for his return. This will enhance the marital relationship and create a greater desire within them to meet her biri other. Another reason for the yasak of returning at night is that during times of the past, communication was difficult, bundan dolayı if a person entered the house at night and the family members were unaware of his identity, it could cause them to korku that a thief had entered their home. A third reason is that a woman who lives alone may bazen request a male family member to sleep in her home due to korku of being alone. If the husband enters and finds someone he does not expect, he may instinctively kill him. This yasak applies to long journeys. If the destination is close or the wife is aware that her husband will return at a particular time, then there is no harm in him returning home at night.

986.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) would not return to his family at night. He would only arrive in the morning or evening."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
986.commentary: This was the uygulama of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) when returning from a journey.

987.text: We returned with Resûlullah (ﷺ) until we were in sight of Madīnah. He dedi: 'We are returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising Him.' He continued diyerek this until we reached Madīnah."(Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
987.commentary: When returning from a journey, one should continuously recite this du'ā' from the outskirts of one's home town. The du'ā' teaches us not to be proud of our accomplishments on the journey. Instead, we should realise that we are merely bütünāh's (ﷻ) servants and her success is only through His grace and iyilik. We should bu nedenle praise Him and request bağışlanma for our shortcomings. The sequence of the du'ā' is significant. One first repents as a form of purification, then one turns towards good ameller and finally praises bütünāh (ﷻ) for granting him the ability.

988.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) returned from a journey, he would first go to the mescid and offer two rak'āts of namaz. (Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
988.commentary: On returning from a journey, one should first proceed to the local masjid and perform two rak'āts of ṣalāh in gratitude to bütünāh (ﷻ) for granting a safe return and koruma from the difficulties of the journey. Another reason is that by doing so one commences his stay in his home with the ibadet of bütünāh (ﷻ).

989.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"It is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allāh and the Last Day to travel the distance of a day and a night without a maḥram accompanying her."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
989.commentary: A maḥram for a woman işaret eder her husband or a close male relative with whom marriage is haram gibi her brother, father, son, maternal or paternal uncle, grandfather or nephew. Cousins, brothers-in-law, and paternal and maternal aunts' husbands are not her maḥrams. For the purposes of travel a maḥram also needs to have sahih intelligence and must have reached the age of maturity (bulūgh). While Bu hadis mentions one day's journey, others mention two and even three days. Scholars have explained that a woman should asla travel without a maḥram for a distance of three days (yani 77 kilometres or more). bununla birlikte, if there is a korku of evil, shamelessness and immorality, as is generally the case nowadays, then she should not travel for even a day's journey without a maḥram.

990.text: He heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"A man should not be in privacy with a woman unless there is a maḥram with her. A woman should not travel without a maḥram."A man sordu:"O Messenger of Allāh, what if my wife goes out to perform Ḥaj while I have been appointed to go out on such-and-such expedition."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"Go and perform Ḥaj with your wife."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
990.commentary: When a man and woman are in seclusion, there is a great possibility of them being inclined towards her biri other. Another hadis states, "If any man is in solitude with a strange woman, then the third one is Shaiṭān." (Tirmidhī) başka bir deyişle, Shaiṭān inflames and arouses their sexual desires and leads them to commit the worst of evils. According to the Ḥanafī Madh'hab, a woman cannot proceed for even a compulsory Ḥaj without a maḥram, as the Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A woman should not perform Ḥaj except with a maḥram." (Dāraquṭnī) In this case, her Ḥaj will have to be postponed until she can find a suitable maḥram. If she eventually passes away without performing Ḥaj, then she should make a bequest to someone to perform it on her behalf. According to the other Madh'habs, it is permitted for a woman to travel for a compulsory Ḥaj with other women, subject to certain şartlar which are stipulated in the books of jurisprudence. The hikmet of the law prohibiting a woman from travelling alone is to protect her life, honour and haysiyet.

991.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Recite the Kur'an for it will appear on the day of Kıyamet as an intercessor for its adherents."(Müslüman, Bayhaqī, Aḥmad)
991.commentary: Reciting the Qur'ān entails great fazilet. On the day of Qiyāmah, bütünāh (ﷻ) will grant the Qur'ān the ability to speak and it will intercede on behalf of those who used to recite it and practise upon its golden teachings. It will request bütünāh (ﷻ) to forgive and overlook their günahlar and its intercession will be accepted. It is our inanç that bütünāh (ﷻ) will grant the recitation of the Qur'ān a physical form on that day, tıpkı... gibi other ameller will be personified. 'Abdullāh ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) narrates that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "Fasting and the Qur'ān will intercede on behalf of a servant on the day of Qiyāmah. Fasting will say, 'O my Sustainer, I prevented him from eating and drinking in the day, bu nedenle accept my intercession on his behalf.' The Qur'ān will say, 'O my Sustainer, I prevented him from sleep at night, bu nedenle accept my intercession on his behalf.' her iki of their intercessions will be accepted." (Aḥmad, Ḥākim)

992.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"On the day of Kıyamet, the Kur'an will be brought, together with those who used to practise on it in the world, preceded by the Sûres al-Baqarah and Āl 'Imrān arguing on behalf of those who knew them."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
992.commentary: Bu hadis makes it abundantly clear that for a person to fayda from the intercession of the Qur'ān, he has to practise upon its teachings. Mere recitation or memorisation of the text is not sufficient. The content of Sūrah al-Baqarah and Sūrah Āl 'Imrān has to do başlıca with laws, prohibitions and basic beliefs which are necessary for her Muslim. These Sūrahs will argue in favour of those who recited their verses, pondered over them, practised on the commands and abstained from the prohibitions.

993.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The best of you is the one who learns the Kur'an and teaches it."(Bukhārī, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
993.commentary: The Qur'ān is the kelime of bütünāh (ﷻ). The very existence of Islām depends on the koruma and teaching of the Qur'ān, bundan dolayı those who engage in this are the best of people in the sight of bütünāh (ﷻ). There are bununla birlikte farklı levels of üstünlük, the highest of which is to learn the Qur'ān with its anlam and the lowest is to merely learn its sözler. It should be remembered that learning and teaching of the Qur'ān should be done with ihlâs, seeking the pleasure of bütünāh (ﷻ), and one should practise upon the teachings and commands of this blessed book. The narrator of Bu hadis from 'Uthmān (رضي الله عنه) in the narration of Bukhārī is Abū 'Abd al-Raḥmān Sulamī. When narrating this hadis, he would say, "This is the reason for me sitting here." He taught the Qur'ān in the Jāmi' Masjid of Kūfā for more than forty years.

994.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who recites the Kur'an and is fluent in it will be with the noble salih angels. One who recites the Kur'an, and stutters in it and it is difficult for him will receive a double sevap."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
994.commentary: "The noble righteous angels" refer to those angels who are obedient and transmit the message of bütünāh (ﷻ) from the protected tablet to the people. Since those who recite the Qur'ān efficiently resemble these angels by being bearers of the Qur'ān, benefitting the Muslims by reciting it to them and guiding them to what it contains, they will be together in the ahiret. One who is fluent in the Qur'ān işaret eder one who reads it easily while adhering to bütün the laws of tajwīd.

995.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The similitude of a mümin who recites the Kur'an is that of a citron - its scent is fragrant and its taste is good. The similitude of a mümin who does not recite the Kur'an is that of a date - it has no scent but its taste is sweet. The similitude of a münafık who recites the Kur'an is that of a basil - its scent is fragrant but its taste is bitter. The similitude of a münafık who does not recite the Kur'an is that of a colocynth - it has no scent and its taste is bitter."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
995.commentary: The similitudes drawn in Bu hadis are mentioned merely to teach us the value and fazilet of reciting the Qur'ān because, gerçekte, the sweetness of the Qur'ān is incomparable and indescribable. A citron creates a pleasant fragrance in the mouth, purifies the stomach and aids in digestion. Similarly, recitation of the Qur'ān creates a fragrance in the mouth, purifies the internal self and enhances spirituality. Medical experts say that citron improves the memory, and recitation of the Qur'ān does the same.

996.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Through this Book, Allāh elevates some people and degrades others."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
996.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki those who fulfil the haklar of the Qur'ān will be elevated whilst those who turn away from it will be disgraced and humiliated. Amīr ibn Wāthīlah stated that 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) appointed Nāfi' ibn 'Abd al-Ḥārith as the governor of Makkah Mukarramah. Once he asked him, "Who have you appointed as governor in Makkah Mukarramah in your absence?" He replied, "Ibn Abzā." "Who is that?" enquired 'Umar (رضي الله عنه). "One of our slaves," was the reply. 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) asked in astonishment, "You placed a slave in charge of the people?" He replied, "O Amīr al-Mu'minīn, he recites the book of bütünāh (ﷻ) and has knowledge of inheritance." On hearing this, 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) remarked, "You have done well. I heard the Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'bütünāh elevates bazı people through this Book and degrades others through it.'" (Muslim)

997.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Envy is not lawful except with regard to two people: a person to whom Allāh taught the Kur'an and he upholds it day and night, and a person to whom Allāh gave mal and he spends it day and night."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
997.commentary: Bu hadis daha önceki bir bölümde ele alınmıştır. Bkz. hadis 572. Bize sürekli olarak Allah'ı anmayı ve O'na şükretmeyi öğretir.

998.text: A man was reciting Sûre al-Kahf and alongside him was his horse which was tied with two ropes. A cloud overshadowed him, and began drawing nearer to him causing his horse to flee from it. In the morning, he went to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and related the incident to him. He dedi: 'That was tranquillity which descended because of the Kur'an.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
998.commentary: While sakīnah has been translated as tranquillity, it can also refer to the special rahmet of bütünāh (ﷻ), haysiyet, angels or a gold utensil of cennet which cleanses the hearts of the believers. The effect of this sakīnah is that a person's īmān increases as mentioned in a verse of the Qur'ān, "He sends down sakīnah in the hearts of the believers so that their īmān increases." (Sūrah Fatḥ, 4)

999.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who recites a letter of the Book of Allāh receives a sevap, and each sevap is multiplied tenfold. I do not say that alif lām mīm is a letter, but alif is a letter, lām is a letter, and mīm is a letter."(Tirmidhī)
999.commentary: Bu hadis, Kur'an okumanın büyük faziletini ispat eder. Kişinin bildiği duaları okuyarak sevap kazanacağı ve Allah'a yaklaşacağı belirtilmiştir.

1000.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who has nothing of the Kur'an in his bosom is like a deserted house."(Tirmidhī)
1000.commentary: Bakımsız bir ev, topluma hiçbir fayda sağlamaz, aksine bir lanettir çünkü şeytanlara ve yırtıcılara barınak olur.

1001.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
1001.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who adhered to the Kur'an will be told: 'Recite and continue ascending. Recite slowly as you used to recite in the world. Your position will be at the last verse which you recite.'"(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1001.commentary: "One who adhered to the Qur'ān" işaret eder a ḥāfiẓ as is mentioned in another narration, bununla birlikte one who recites it regularly may also be implied. From other aḥādīth, we learn that there are as birçok levels in cennet as the number of verses of the Qur'ān.

1002.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Adhere to this Kur'an. I take an oath by that Being in whose control is the life of Muḥammad that it slips away faster than a camel whose rope is loosened."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Ḥākim)
1002.commentary: Bir devesine bakan kişi ihmal ve dikkatsizlik gösterirse, deve kaçar ve kaybolur. Dinin korunması da sürekli dikkat gerektirir.

1003.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The similitude of one who adheres to the Kur'an is that of a tied camel: if he adheres to it, it will remain with him, and if he lets it free, it will go away."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Mālik)
1003.commentary: Whether a person has memorised the bütün Qur'ān or certain portions of it, these should be revised regularly so that they are not forgotten.

1004.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Allāh does not listen to anything as much as He listens to the recitation of a Messenger with a good voice, reciting the Kur'an in a beautiful and loud tone."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1004.commentary: "Reciting the Qur'ān in a beautiful and loud tone," according to Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله) means to recite it with a grief-stricken and elegant voice, since the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "Beautify the Qur'ān with your voices." (Bukhārī)

1005.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: to him:"You have been given one of the flutes of the family of Dāwūd (عليه السلام)."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1005.commentary: "The family of Dāwūd" işaret eder Dāwūd (عليه السلام) himself, since he was bestowed with an exceptionally melodious voice. When he would recite the Zabūr or perform the dhikr of bütünāh (ﷻ), the birds would stop flying and join him in his recitation and the mountains would reverberate.

1006.text: I heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) reciting (Sûre) al-Tīn wal-Zaytūn in the Yatsı namaz and I did not hear anyone with a more beautiful voice than his."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1006.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was mükemmel in her saygı. tıpkı... gibi his character and outward appearance were exceptionally beautiful, so too was his voice.

1007.narrator: Abū Lubābah Bashīr ibn 'Abd al-Mundhir (رضي الله عنه)
1007.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who does not recite the Kur'an in a melodious voice is not one of us."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1007.commentary: The phrase "is not one of us" demektir ki such a person does not follow the uygulama or yöntem of the Messenger (ﷺ). The uygulama of the Messenger (ﷺ) was to recite melodiously.

1008.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: to me: 'Recite the Kur'an to me.' I dedi: 'O Messenger of Allāh, should I recite it to you when it was revealed to you?' He dedi: 'I like to listen to it from someone other than myself.' So I recited Sûre al-Nisā' to him until I reached this verse, 'How will it be when We will bring a şahit from every nation, and We will bring you as a şahit against them?' He dedi to me: 'That is sufficient for now.' When I turned to him, his eyes were flowing with tears."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1008.commentary: The fayda of listening to the recitation of others is that it gives one the opportunity to ponder over the anlam. The eyes of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) flowed with tears because that particular verse reminded him about the day of Qiyāmah.

1009.narrator: Ebû Saîd Rāfi' ibn al-Mu'allā (رضي الله عنه)
1009.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: to me: 'Should I not teach you the greatest sūrah in the Kur'an before you leave the mescid?' He then held my hand. When we were about to leave, I dedi: 'O Messenger of Allāh, you dedi, 'I will teach you the greatest sūrah in the Kur'an.' He dedi: 'Al-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbil 'ālamīn, these are the seven frequently repeated verses and the great Kur'an which I was given.'"(Bukhārī)
1009.commentary: Sūrah al-Fātiḥah is referred to as the greatest sūrah because it contains bütün the primary themes of the Qur'ān, şöyle ki tawḥīd, risālah and ākhirah.

1010.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: with regard to Qul huwallāhu aḥad (Sûre al-Ikhlāṣ):"By that Being in whose control is my life, it is equivalent to a third of the Kur'an."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1010.commentary: Sūrah al-Ikhlāṣ is referred to as a third of the Qur'ān because it discusses one of the three main themes of the Qur'ān: recognition of bütünāh (ﷻ), knowledge of the ahiret, and knowledge of the straight yol.

1011.text: A man heard another man repeatedly reciting Qul huwallāhu aḥad (Sûre al-Ikhlāṣ). In the morning, he gitti to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and mentioned this to him, and it was as if he thought this to be insignificant. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) şöyle dedi:"By that Being in whose control is my life, it is equivalent to a third of the Kur'an."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1011.commentary: Since the sūrah is quite short in size and is recited very commonly, the Ṣaḥābī regarded it as insignificant. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) rectified his erroneous perception.

1012.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: with regard to Qul huwallāhu aḥad (Sûre al-Ikhlāṣ):"It is equivalent to a third of the Kur'an."(Müslüman)
1012.commentary: Bu hadis, İhlâs Suresi'nin büyük faziletini teyit eder. Bu sure Kur'an'ın üçte birine denktir.

1013.text: A man dedi:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I love this Sûre, Qul huwallāhu aḥad (Sûre al-Ikhlāṣ)."He dedi:"Your love for it will take you to Cennet."(at-Tirmidhī)
1013.commentary: bütünāh (ﷻ) will enter into cennet a person who loves this sūrah, since it expounds upon the greatness and grandeur of bütünāh (ﷻ), and bütünāh (ﷻ) loves those who praise Him.

1014.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Have you not seen the verses revealed this night, the like of which have never been seen before? Qul A'ūdhu birabbil falaq (Sûre al-Falaq) and Qul a'ūdhu birabbin nās (Sûre al-Nās)."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1014.commentary: In no other tam sūrah of the Qur'ān is koruma sought as it is done in these two sūrahs, bundan dolayı the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said regarding them: "the like of which have asla been seen before."

1015.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to seek refuge from jinn and the (evil of) human eye until Sûre al-Falaq and Sûre al-Nās were revealed. When they were revealed, he okudu them and ayrıldı reciting anything else."(Tirmidhī)
1015.commentary: Prior to the revelation of these two sūrahs, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) used to seek koruma from the jinn and the evil eye. bununla birlikte, after these two sūrahs were revealed, he sufficed on these sūrahs.

1016.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The Kur'an contains a Sûre of thirty verses which interceded on behalf of a person until he was forgiven. The Sûre is Tabārakalladhī biyadihil mulk (Sûre al-Mulk)."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1016.commentary: Mülk Suresi, onu düzenli okuyan kişiye şefaat edecektir. Resûlullah (ﷺ) bu surenin kabir azabından koruduğunu belirtmiştir.

1017.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If one recites the last two verses of Sûre al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1017.commentary: Yani that they will protect him from harm on that night, or it is said that they will suffice him from spending the night in ibadet. Due to bütün of these faydalar, these two verses should be recited at night before sleeping.

1018.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not turn your homes into graves. Shaiṭān flees from the house in which Sûre al-Baqarah is recited."(Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1018.commentary: The hadis teaches us an effective remedy for saving our homes from the evil of Shaiṭān, şöyle ki reciting Sūrah al-Baqarah.

1019.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"O Abū al-Mundhir! Biliyor musunuz which verse of the Book of Allāh that you have is the greatest?"I cevap verdi:"Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa al-Ḥayyu al-Qayyūm."He tapped me on my chest and dedi:"May knowledge benefit you, O Abū al-Mundhir!"(Müslüman)
1019.commentary: Āyat al-Kursī is referred to as the greatest verse because it expounds upon the important themes of tawḥīd, the grandeur of bütünāh (ﷻ), and the attributes of bütünāh (ﷻ).

1020.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) verdi me the responsibility of safeguarding the zekât of Ramaḍān. Someone geldi to me and began taking handfuls of yemek. I caught him - this was the third time - and he şöyle dedi: 'Let me go, and I will teach you some words through which Allāh will benefit you.' I sordu: 'What are they?' He şöyle dedi: 'When you go to bed, recite Āyat al-Kursī. A guardian from Allāh will be appointed over you, and Shaiṭān will not come near you until the next morning.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) şöyle dedi: 'He konuştu the hak despite being a great liar. That was Shaiṭān.'"(Bukhārī)
1020.commentary: Bu hadis, yatmadan önce Âyetü'l-Kürsî okumanın faydasını anlatır. Onu okuyan kişiye Allah tarafından bir koruyucu gönderilir ve sabaha kadar şeytan yaklaşamaz.

1021.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who memorises the first ten verses of Sûre al-Kahf will be protected from Dajjāl."Another narration has:"The last ten verses of Sûre al-Kahf."(Müslüman)
1021.commentary: Dajjāl will appear before Qiyāmah. bütünāh (ﷻ) will grant him the ability to display certain supernatural feats which will cause those zayıf in iman to renegade from Islām. The şiddet of his evil can be gauged from the fact that bütün the Messengers (عليهم السلام) warned their respective nations about him. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) also described him in great detail and mentioned that one of the ways to protect ourselves from his evil is to memorise and recite the first and last ten verses of Sūrah al-Kahf.

1022.text: While Jibrā'īl (عليه السلام) was sitting with Resûlullah (ﷺ), he heard a sound above him. He raised his head and dedi:"This is a door of the sky which has been opened today and which was never opened before."An angel descended from it and Jibrā'īl (عليه السلام) dedi:"This is an angel that has descended to earth, and that has never descended before today."The angel greeted and dedi:"Bear the glad tidings of two lights which you have been given and no Messenger before you was given: the opening chapter of the Book (Sûre al-Fātiḥah) and the final verses of Sûre al-Baqarah. You will not recite a single letter of them without being granted them (i.e. their sevap)."(Müslüman)
1022.commentary: That such a door had asla opened before and that this angel had asla descended prior to this, was to show the special rank and status of these two portions of the Qur'ān. The "two lights" refer to that light on the day of Qiyāmah which will guide a person into cennet. They could also refer to the lights of guidance in dünya for a person who ponders over the meanings of these sūrahs. bundan dolayı, by reciting these two portions of the Qur'ān with ihlâs, one will be granted that which they contain, şöyle ki guidance, bağışlanma and success in dünya and the ahiret.

1023.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A group of people do not gather in one of the houses of Allāh to recite the Book of Allāh and study it among themselves without tranquillity descending upon them, rahmet engulfing them, the angels encircling them, and Allāh mentioning them to those who are with Him."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1023.commentary: This is a section of the hadis which was mentioned in dolu in a previous chapter. See hadis 245. It is repeated here to show the fazilet of reciting and learning the Qur'ān. It mentions four great faydalar of such Qur'ānic gatherings: tranquillity descends, rahmet engulfs, angels encircle, and bütünāh mentions them to His pure angels. While the hadis encourages study of the Qur'ān, it does not refer to self-study or self-opinionated discussions regarding the Qur'ān. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "Whoever says anything in matters of the Qur'ān without knowledge should prepare his abode in cehennem." (Tirmidhī)

1024.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"My Ummah will be called on the day of Kıyamet with their foreheads and limbs radiantly white due to the effects of wuḍū'. So whoever of you is able to increase the extent of his whiteness should do so."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1024.commentary: tıpkı... gibi a horse whose limbs are white is unique from other horses, the Ummah of Muhammed (ﷺ) will be unique from other nations on the day of Qiyāmah, as their foreheads and limbs will emit a special radiance. The hadis encourages us to wash our limbs correctly and thoroughly while performing wuḍū'.

1025.text: I heard my bosom friend (the Messenger of Allāh ﷺ) diyerek:"The jewellery of a mümin shall extend as far as his wuḍū' water reaches."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1025.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki whichever limbs were washed during wuḍū' will be beautified with the jewels of cennet in the ahiret. ayrıca, the more mükemmel one's wuḍū' is, the better one's limbs will be adorned.

1026.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who performs wuḍū' and performs it well, his günahlar exit his body, even from beneath his nails."(Müslüman)
1026.commentary: The phrase "and performs it well" alludes to the fact that he does not suffice on the Farā'iḍ (compulsory ameller) of wuḍū', but he also ensures that bütün the Sunnah and Mustaḥab ameller are performed, and he abstains from anything yani Makrūh (undesirable). The closer the wuḍū' is to the Sunnah, the more günahlar will be forgiven.

1027.text: I saw Resûlullah (ﷺ) performing wuḍū' as I am performing wuḍū' now. He then dedi: 'One who performs wuḍū' like this, is forgiven for his past günahlar, and his namaz and walking to the mescid are an additional sevap.'"(Müslüman)
1027.commentary: As mentioned in the previous hadis, bağışlanma of günahlar işaret eder minor günahlar relating to the haklar of bütünāh (ﷻ). The hadis shows the fazilet of performing wuḍū' at home and then proceeding to the masjid. As wuḍū' forgives bütün minor günahlar, the sevap for walking to the masjid and performing ṣalāh, will be an increase in one's rank in the ahiret.

1028.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a Müslüman slave - or mümin - performs wuḍū', and washes his face, every günah to which his eyes looked leaves his face with the water - or with the last drop of water. When he washes his hands, every günah which his hands committed leaves his hands with the water - or with the last drop of water. When he washes his feet, every günah towards which his feet walked leaves his feet with the water - or with the last drop of water. This continues until he emerges completely purified of günahlar."(Müslüman)
1028.commentary: Bu hadis reinforces that wuḍū' purifies the external body of physical impurities and the internal body of günahlar. The drops of water removing günahlar is an expression used to convey bağışlanma of günahlar because günahlar are abstract and have no physical form.

1029.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) went to the graveyard and dedi:"Peace be upon you, O abode of müminler. If Allāh wills, we will join you. I wish that we had seen our brothers."The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) sordu:"Are we not your brothers, O Messenger of Allāh?"He cevap verdi:"You are my Sahâbe. Our brothers are those who have not come as yet."The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) sordu:"How will you recognise those of your Ummah who have not come as yet, O Messenger of Allāh?"He cevap verdi:"Tell me, if a person owns a horse with a white forehead and whiteness on its legs and it is among horses that are pitch black, will he not recognise his horse?"The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) cevap verdi:"Indeed, O Messenger of Allāh."He dedi:"They will come with radiant faces and limbs due to performing wuḍū' and I will precede them to the Fountain (Ḥauḍ al-Kauthar)."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1029.commentary: The Ummah of the Messenger (ﷺ) is truly honoured that he (ﷺ) will await their arrival. ayrıca, he (ﷺ) will request bütünāh (ﷻ) for their bağışlanma and an increase in their ranks before they come to him.

1030.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Size haber vereyim mi of something by which Allāh will wipe out günahlar and by which He will raise ranks?"The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) dedi:"Indeed, O Messenger of Allāh."He dedi:"Performing a thorough wuḍū' in adverse circumstances, taking many steps to the mescids, and waiting for a namaz after having performed a namaz. That is ribāṭ! That is ribāṭ!"(Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1030.commentary: "Performing a thorough wuḍū' in adverse circumstances," includes performing wuḍū' in severe cold or due to such illness which prevents a person from moving about easily. Ribāṭ işaret eder guarding the Islāmic borders so that a foreign enemy cannot enter and attack. bundan dolayı, by engaging in the three ameller mentioned here, man is protected from Shaiṭān who is his internal enemy. A second view is that since a person who is regular in performing these ameller expects bağışlanma for his günahlar, an increase in his rewards and admission into cennet, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) compared him to a person guarding the Islāmic borders expecting martyrdom and bağışlanma.

1031.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Purity is half of faith."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1031.commentary: The hadis has been repeated here to show the fazilet of purity and wuḍū'. "Purity is half of iman," may have one of birkaç meanings: Īmān (iman) işaret eder ṣalāh, bundan dolayı the hadis demektir ki wuḍū' is an integral part of ṣalāh. başka bir deyişle, ṣalāh is not geçerli without wuḍū'. Purity is of farklı forms: purity of the external body from dirt and ḥadath (major and minor impurities), purity of the limbs from günah, purity of the heart from evil qualities, and purity of the internal self from everything besides bütünāh (ﷻ). These forms of purity constitute half of īmān. The remaining half is to further beautify oneself with outward purity, noble ameller, güzel ahlâk and focussing towards bütünāh (ﷻ).

1032.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Whoever among you performs wuḍū' and does a thorough wuḍū' and then says, 'I testify that there is none worthy of ibadet besides Allāh, who is one and has no partner, and I testify that Muhammed (ﷺ) is His kul and Messenger,' the eight doors of Cennet will be opened for him and he can enter from whichever of them he desires."(Müslüman, Aḥmad). Tirmidhī adds:"O Allāh, make me of those who repent and make me of those who are purified."
1032.commentary: The hadis encourages a believer to perform wuḍū' thoroughly and to recite the specified du'ā' after doing so. A thorough wuḍū' işaret eder performing wuḍū' with bütün its requisites, fulfilling the Farā'iḍ, Sunnah and Mustaḥab ameller, and abstaining from bütün yani Makrūh. Scholars have stated that "there is none worthy of ibadet besides bütünāh," işaret eder tawḥīd al-Dhāt (unity in the Being of bütünāh ﷻ); "who is one" işaret eder tawḥīd al-Ṣifāt (unity in the attributes of bütünāh ﷻ); and "has no partner" işaret eder tawḥīd al-Af'āl (unity in the ameller of bütünāh ﷻ).

1033.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If people only knew the rewards of the adhān and the first row (of namaz) and they had no way of attaining them but to draw lots, they would certainly have drawn lots. If they only knew the rewards for going early for namaz, they would have raced each other in getting there. If they only knew the rewards for performing the Yatsı and Sabah namazs, they would attend them even if they had to crawl."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1033.commentary: Bu hadis explains the fazilet and sevap of four ameller: Calling out the adhān, performing ṣalāh in the first row behind the Imām, proceeding early for ṣalāh, and performing 'Ishā' and Fajr ṣalāh in congregation. 'Ishā' and Fajr ṣalāh require the çoğu effort because they are performed at the ends of the day when people are asleep or retiring to bed. For this reason they were the çoğu difficult of ṣalāhs for the hypocrites.

1034.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"The mu'adhdhins will have the longest necks of all people on the day of Kıyamet."(Müslüman, Ibn Mājah, Al-Bayhaqī)
1034.commentary: Scholars have provided çeşitli reasons why the mu'adhdhins will have the "longest necks": People will be drowning in their perspiration on the day of Qiyāmah in accordance to their günahlar. Those with long necks will be saved from this difficulty. The mu'adhdhins will be leaders. The Arabs used to refer to their leaders as people with long necks. On that day, the mu'adhdhins will have great ümit of attaining the rahmet of bütünāh (ﷻ) and His abundant rewards. For this reason, they will stretch out their necks in anticipation of what they will receive. It is an expression anlam that bütünāh (ﷻ) will grant them His proximity and saygı. Their necks will not be elongated gerçekte. bununla birlikte, others will be extremely thirsty on that day, due to which their necks will be folded in. The mu'adhdhins will not be thirsty, böylece their necks will remain normal, but appear longer than the necks of others.

1035.narrator: Abdullāh ibn 'Abd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Ṣa'ṣa'ah narrates that Abū Sa'īd al-Khudrī (رضي الله عنه)
1035.text: To him:"I see that you love sheep and the desert land. So when you are among your sheep - or in your desert land - and you call out the adhān for namaz, raise your voice. Every jinn, human or anything else within range that hears the voice of the mu'adhdhin will testify in his favour on the day of Kıyamet."Abū Sa'īd (رضي الله عنه) dedi:"I heard this from Resûlullah (ﷺ)."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1035.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki one should call out the adhān with a loud voice because bütün animals, plants and lands to which one's voice reaches will testify in his favour. Even though bütünāh (ﷻ) is fully aware of everything, this testimony will be taken to make apparent one's fazilet and high rank before bütün of the creation. Even if a person is alone or on journey, one should endeavour to call out the adhān and iqāmah before performing ṣalāh because of the promised faziletler.

1036.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When the call to namaz is made, Shaiṭān retreats and passes wind so that he does not hear the call. When the call is completed, he returns until the iqāmah is made, when he again retreats. When the iqāmah is completed, he returns to whisper to the person, 'Think of this, think of that' - regarding that which he had not thought of previously - until the person does not know how many rak'āts he has performed."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1036.commentary: Shaiṭān "passes wind" when he runs away, he cannot control himself and passes wind. He does so purposely due to his evil nature and nefret for the adhān. He intends to oppose the purity of ṣalāh with that which is impure. Shaiṭān whispers to a person who is engaged in ṣalāh in order to divert his heart towards dünyevî matters, and thereby deprive him of concentration and kulluk. A question may be posed here: why does Shaiṭān flee when adhān is called out, but not during ṣalāh? Scholars have provided çeşitli answers: There is great awe and grandeur in the sözler of the adhān. This and the proclamation of tawḥīd frightens Shaiṭān. Adhān as well as iqāmah is an invitation to the ibadet of bütünāh (ﷻ). Shaiṭān is unable to match it, due to its power and strength, bundan dolayı he flees from it. Shaiṭān does not want to testify in favour of any person on the day of Qiyāmah who had called out the adhān.

1037.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
1037.text: He heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"When you hear the mu'adhdhin, repeat what he says and then send salutations upon me. A person who sends one salutation upon me, Allāh sends ten upon him. Then ask Allāh to grant me al-Wasīlah. It is a stage in Cennet which is reserved for one of the kullar of Allāh, and I ümit that it will be me. Intercession is guaranteed for one who asks for al-Wasīlah for me."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Nasā'ī)
1037.commentary: The hadis explains the great fazilet of reciting the du'ā' after adhān. The stage of al-Wasīlah in cennet is undoubtedly reserved for the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), bununla birlikte, he expressed the ümit of him being the one to achieve it, due to his tevazu and unassuming nature. The Messenger (ﷺ) further requested his Ummah to supplicate that he receives al-Wasīlah due to his tevazu and to display his neediness before bütünāh (ﷻ). Another reason for this was that his Ummah could fayda by means of the du'ā' and be rewarded for reciting it.

1038.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When you hear the call to namaz, repeat the words of the mu'adhdhin."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1038.commentary: Repeating the sözler of the mu'adhdhin demektir ki one should repeat her phrase of the mu'adhdhin except "Ḥayya 'alaṣ ṣalāh" and "Ḥayya 'alal falāḥ." In these two cases, the reply should be "Lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā billāh." It is Mustaḥab and a great fazilet to repeat the sözler of the adhān whether a person is in a state of purity or not. böylece a woman in the state of menses (ḥaiḍ) as well as a person in the state of greater impurity (ḥadath akbar) should reply to it. Amongst the times when one may not reply is when relieving oneself, engaging in conjugal relations, and while performing Farḍ or Nafl ṣalāh. In such cases, one may reply after completion of these ameller provided that a long time has not elapsed.

1039.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"My intercession will be permitted on the day of Kıyamet for one who says when he hears the call to namaz, 'O Allāh, Lord of this perfect call and established namaz, grant Muhammed (ﷺ) al-Wasīlah and superiority, and raise him to the praiseworthy position which You promised him.'"(Bukhārī)
1039.commentary: The call is "mükemmel" because it will not change or be modified until Qiyāmah or because it has no flaws and incorporates the necessary tenets of inanç for a Muslim. The ṣalāh is "established" means it will continue until Qiyāmah. Intercession being guaranteed for a person is a glad tiding of cennet and death on īmān because intercession will not be accepted for those who are not Muslims. "The praiseworthy position which You promised him," işaret eder that time on the day of Qiyāmah when the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) will be made to stand on Maqām Maḥmūd to intercede on behalf of the bütün creation for the commencement of reckoning.

1040.narrator: Sa'd bin Ebû Vakkās (رضي الله عنه)
1040.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The günahlar of a person are forgiven who, when he hears the mu'adhdhin, says, 'I testify that there is none worthy of ibadet besides Allāh, He is one and has no partner, and that Muḥammad is His kul and Messenger. I am pleased with Allāh as Sustainer, Muhammed (ﷺ) as Messenger, and İslâm as religion.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ḥākim, Tirmidhī)
1040.commentary: While bazı âlimler der ki this du'ā' should be recited after the mu'adhdhin calls out "Ash hadu bütünā ilāha illallāh", the preferred view is that it should be recited after the adhān is completed.

1041.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A dua between the adhān and the iqāmah is not rejected."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1041.commentary: The narration of Tirmidhī adds: The Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) enquired, "What should we ask for, O Messenger of bütünāh?" He (ﷺ) replied, "Ask bütünāh for 'āfiyah (well-being) in dünya and the ahiret." Ibn 'Arabī (رحمه الله) stated, "After the adhān, the doors of rahmet open. For this reason, supplications are readily accepted." bununla birlikte, such acceptance is restricted to those who fulfil the etiquettes and şartlar of du'ā'.

1042.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Will any dirt remain on the body of a person who has a river at his door step and he baths therein five times a day?"The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) cevap verdi:"No dirt will remain on his body."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"It is the same with the five namazs. Allāh wipes out günahlar through them."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1042.commentary: Bu hadis explains the fayda of performing the five daily ṣalāhs. Running water is generally free from dirt and the deeper it runs, the cleaner and purer it is. Similarly, ṣalāh which is performed with the doğru etiquettes and kulluk purifies the soul of günahlar. tıpkı... gibi a person who baths in a river five times a day will be cleansed of physical dirt on his body, a person who performs ṣalāh five times daily, is cleansed of the manevî dirt of günah. Bathing in pure water, generally removes the grime and dirt which is on the surface, bununla birlikte dirt which is firmly stuck to the body, will only be removed by scrubbing and utilizing a cleaning agent gibi soap. In the same yol, ṣalāh will cause minor günahlar to be forgiven, but major günahlar will only be forgiven by sincere tövbe.

1043.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The similitude of the five namazs is that of an extensively flowing river at your door in which you bath five times a day."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1043.commentary: Resûlullah (ﷺ) akan bir nehir örneğiyle amelî bir kavram öğretti. Günde beş defa yıkanan kişi nasıl temizlenirse, beş vakit namaz da günahları temizler.

1044.text: A man kissed a woman. He came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and told him about it. Allah (ﷻ) revealed the following verse:"Establish namaz at the two ends of the day and some portions of the night. Surely, good deeds wipe out evil deeds."The man sordu:"Is this for me only?"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"It is for my entire Ummah."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1044.commentary: Another narration provides the background of this hadis. A Ṣaḥābī narrates that a woman came to purchase bazı dates from him. He said to her, "I have superior quality dates at home. Come and have a look." When she entered, he kissed her. Subsequently, he was overcome with utanç and proceeded to the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and narrated what had happened. (Al-Sunan al-Kubrā of Nasā'ī)

1045.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The five namazs, and Cuma to Cuma is an expiation for whatever is committed between them as long as major günahlar are avoided."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1045.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki minor günahlar are forgiven when a person performs his five daily ṣalāhs and Jumu'ah. For the bağışlanma of major günahlar, sincere tövbe is required. One may question why Jumu'ah has been included when the five daily ṣalāhs are sufficient to forgive bütün minor günahlar? Scholars have answered this as follows: Mullā 'Alī Qārī (رحمه الله) stated that through ṣalāh one's günahlar are forgiven, bununla birlikte if any günah remains, it is forgiven through the performance of Jumu'ah ṣalāh; if no günah had remained, then additional rewards are written in one's favour. Shaikh Muḥaddith 'Abd al-Ḥaqq Dehlawī (رحمه الله) stated that if the five daily ṣalāhs are defective and the minor günahlar are not forgiven, then through the blessings of the Jumu'ah ṣalāh, such günahlar will be forgiven.

1046.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"When the time for a compulsory namaz enters and a Müslüman excels in his wuḍū', tevazu, and bowing down, then it is an expiation for the günahlar that were committed before it as long as a major günah was not committed. This applies perpetually."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1046.commentary: Bu hadis specifies three aspects related to ṣalāh regarding which one needs to strive for perfection: wuḍū', khushū' (tevazu) and rukū' (bowing down). A thorough wuḍū' işaret eder üstünlük in bütün aspects prior to the commencement of ṣalāh. A thorough rukū' işaret eder üstünlük in the external postures of a person during ṣalāh, and tevazu işaret eder üstünlük in the internal state. As Muslims, we are fortunate to be blessed with the opportunity of communicating with our Creator five times a day.

1047.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who performs the two cool namazs will enter Cennet."The two cool namazs refer to the Sabah and İkindi namazs. (Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1047.commentary: "Cool ṣalāhs" refer to the Fajr and 'Aṣr ṣalāhs because they are performed at such a time of the day when the heat is relatively diminished. The sevap of cennet mentioned here could refer to direct entry into cennet without any azap, or it could mean that one will enter it after retribution. It serves as a glad tiding for one who is punctual in these ṣalāhs that he will leave dünya on Islām, since only a Muslim will enter cennet.

1048.narrator: Abū Zuhayr 'Umārah ibn Ruwaybah (رضي الله عنه)
1048.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"No person who performs namaz before sunrise and before sunset will enter cehennem ateşi,"meaning Sabah and İkindi. (Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1048.commentary: The time of Fajr is when one is enjoying sleep, and that of 'Aṣr is when one is concluding the affairs of the day, bundan dolayı these two ṣalāhs are difficult to perform. One who adheres to them will adhere to the remaining ṣalāhs to a greater extent. ayrıca, it is more likely that such a person will not commit major günahlar and günahlar related to the haklar of others. Now when his minor günahlar are expiated by means of ṣalāh, he will not enter the cehennem-Fire.

1049.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who performs the Sabah namaz is under the protection of Allāh. So, Ey Âdemoğlu, let not Allāh seek from you anything regarding His protection."(Müslüman, Ibn Mājah, Tirmidhī)
1049.commentary: The ifade "under the koruma of bütünāh," can have one of two meanings: 1. It is an teşvik to perform the Fajr ṣalāh because one who is unmindful of it will be deprived of the koruma of bütünāh (ﷻ) and called to account for his weakness. 2. One who performs the Fajr ṣalāh is under the koruma of bütünāh (ﷻ), bundan dolayı others should abstain from causing any physical, monetary or manevî harm to him since bütünāh (ﷻ) will take them to task.

1050.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The angels of the night and those of the day take turns in coming to you. They gather for the Sabah namaz and the İkindi namaz. The angels who were with you during the night then ascend and Allāh asks them – despite knowing better regarding them – 'How were My kullar when you left them?' The angels reply: 'When we left them, they were performing namaz and when we came to them, they were performing namaz.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī, Mālik)
1050.commentary: That two groups of angels gather for Fajr and 'Aṣr as compared to one group for the remaining ṣalāhs shows the fazilet of these two ṣalāhs and their times. A question may arise here: why does bütünāh (ﷻ) ask the angels about the ameller of man when He is fully aware of everything? Scholars explain that when bütünāh (ﷻ) created Ādam (عليه السلام), the angels objected, stating that they were sufficient for bütünāh's (ﷻ) ibadet, while man would cause nothing but corruption and bloodshed. bundan dolayı, bütünāh (ﷻ) boasts before the angels about man's sacrificing his needs and desires in order to submit before Him. The objective of this questioning and answering is bu nedenle to honour those who perform ṣalāh, and to make apparent their status and the value of their ibadet.

1051.text: We were with Resûlullah (ﷺ) and he looked at the full moon. He dedi:"You will see your Sustainer as you are looking at this moon and you will not be overcrowded when seeing Him. So if it is possible for you not to be overwhelmed to the point of missing namaz before sunrise and before sunset, then do so."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd). Another narration has:"He looked at the moon on the fourteenth night."
1051.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki one who performs the Fajr and 'Aṣr ṣalāhs will be specifically rewarded by viewing bütünāh (ﷻ) in cennet, bundan dolayı one should be extra careful to perform them regularly. For a believer to view bütünāh (ﷻ), will be the greatest bounty in cennet. The disbelievers and hypocrites will be deprived of this bounty. "You will not be overcrowded when seeing Him" because He will be seen from her side. The comparison with the moon is merely to explain the phenomenon in insanî terms because, gerçekte, bütünāh (ﷻ) is free of time and space.

1052.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who omits the İkindi namaz has in fact destroyed his actions."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1052.commentary: Bu hadis has been interpreted in çeşitli ways: 1. Omitting any ṣalāh, özellikle the 'Aṣr ṣalāh is a major günah, which will destroy the rewards of the amel. 2. One who regards omitting the 'Aṣr ṣalāh as helal destroys bütün his good ameller because he has left the fold of Islām. 3. A person who omits the 'Aṣr ṣalāh due to bazı dünyevî engagement will be deprived of the fayda and blessings of that engagement.

1053.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who goes to the mescid morning and evening, Allāh prepares for him a welcome reception in Cennet each morning and evening that he goes."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1053.commentary: The sevap mentioned in Bu hadis also applies to those proceeding to the masjid for ṣalāh, reciting the Qur'ān, teaching or learning Islāmic knowledge and performing I'tikāf. When such a huge sevap is on offer for merely proceeding to the masjid, one can well imagine the rewards for the asıl performance of ṣalāh and other ibadetler in the masjid. tıpkı... gibi a host prepares a special meal for a visiting guest, bütünāh (ﷻ) prepares a gracious reception and meal in cennet for those who visit His home, the masjid. The meal is not given in dünya because the world cannot bear even one of the bounties of cennet.

1054.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who purifies himself at his home and then proceeds to one of the Houses of Allāh to fulfil one of the obligations of Allāh, then each footstep he takes removes a günah and the other elevates his rank."(Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1054.commentary: The hadis teaches us the önem of performing wuḍū' at home and then proceeding to the masjid. In another hadis, Abū Umāmah (رضي الله عنه) narrates that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "One who emerges from his house in a purified state for an farz ṣalāh, his sevap is like that of a Ḥājī (pilgrim) in iḥrām." (Abū Dāwūd) The narration of Bukhārī adds the sözler, "Nothing makes him leave his home except ṣalāh." bundan dolayı, the sevap mentioned in Bu hadis will be confined to a person proceeding to the masjid for ṣalāh. her biri footstep towards the masjid wipes out a minor günah yani related to the haklar of bütünāh (ﷻ) and the next increases his rank in cennet.

1055.text: There was a person from the Anṣār and I do not know of anyone who lived further away from the mescid than him, but he never missed a namaz. It was suggested to him:"You should purchase a donkey which you could ride in the dark and in the intense heat?"He cevap verdi:"Even if my house was next door to the mescid, it would not make me happy. I prefer that my footsteps while proceeding to the mescid and while returning to my family be recorded in my favour."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"Allāh has granted you the sevap of all of this."(Müslüman)
1055.commentary: Mescitten uzakta yaşayanlar, mescide yürümenin büyük faziletlerini takdir etmelidir. Her adım bir sevaptır ve günahları siler.

1056.text: A piece of land became vacant around the mescid so the Banū Salimah decided to move near the mescid. This news reached Resûlullah (ﷺ) and he dedi to them:"It has reached me that you intend moving near the mescid?"They cevap verdi:"Yes, O Messenger of Allāh, we intend doing so."He dedi:"O Banī Salimah, remain in your homes. Your footsteps are being recorded. Remain in your homes. Your footsteps are being recorded."They cevap verdi:"It would not please us to move."(Müslüman, Bukhārī)
1056.commentary: Mescitten uzakta yaşayanlar, mescide yürümenin büyük faziletlerini takdir etmelidir. Her adım kişinin derecesini yükseltir.

1057.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The people who receive the greatest sevap for namaz are those who live furthest away and then the next furthest. One who waits for the namaz so that he could perform it with the Imām receives a greater sevap than one who performs it and then goes to sleep."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1057.commentary: The further away a person's house is from the masjid, the more footsteps he will have to take to reach there. Since the effort and sacrifice is more, the sevap will be proportionately more. bununla birlikte, this applies only to those who are able to come for ṣalāh. For those who are zayıf and ill, and living at a distance will cause them to miss ṣalāh in the masjid, then it is best for them to live as close as possible to the masjid. Ṣalāh in congregation is far superior to ṣalāh performed individually. bu nedenle, waiting in anticipation for the Imām so that ṣalāh can be performed in congregation is superior to performing ṣalāh individually and then resting.

1058.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Give glad tidings of complete radiance on the day of Kıyamet for those who walk in the dark to the masājid."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1058.commentary: There will be extreme darkness on the day of Qiyāmah. On that day, a person will fayda from the radiance acquired through ameller performed in dünya. Amongst the ameller which will provide radiance is that of walking to the masjid in the dark, at the times of 'Ishā' and Fajr. The Qur'ān alludes to this, "Their radiance shall travel ahead of them." (Sūrah Taḥrīm, 8). Such radiance will assist a person on the bridge of Ṣirāṭ, when one will require light to cross over it.

1059.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Size haber vereyim mi of something by which Allāh will wipe out günahlar and by which He will raise ranks?"The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) dedi:"Indeed, O Messenger of Allāh."He dedi:"Performing a thorough wuḍū' in adverse circumstances, taking many steps to the masājid, and waiting for a namaz after having performed a namaz. That is ribāṭ! That is ribāṭ."(Müslüman)
1059.commentary: Bu hadis daha önce zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 131. Yatsı ve sabah namazının faziletine dikkat çekmek için burada tekrarlanmıştır.

1060.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If you see a person who frequents the mescid, then testify that he is a person of īmān. Allāh says: 'Only those should attend the masājid of Allāh who believe in Allāh and the Last Day.'"(Sûre al-Taubah, 18) (Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah, Aḥmad)
1060.commentary: The hadis teaches us the fazilet of frequenting the masjid for ibadetler, dhikr, tilāwah, seeking and imparting knowledge, performing I'tikāf, etc. and that these are signs of a person's īmān. Other scholars have mentioned that this fazilet also applies to one who is involved in the construction, maintenance, koruma or cleanliness of a masjid. The broader context of Bu hadis bize öğretir ki a masjid should be the lifeblood of a community. The heart and soul of her Muslim in the community should be attached to the masjid. Apart from ibadetler, the masjid should serve as a base for community decisions, consultations, education, propagation, supplication and reconciliation, aslında any such activity which will strengthen one's sevgi for bütünāh (ﷻ) and unite people for bütünāh's (ﷻ) sake.

1061.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"You are considered to be in namaz as long as it is namaz that keeps you waiting and nothing else prevents you from returning to your family."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1061.commentary: The hadis demektir ki a person will receive the sevap of performing ṣalāh as long as he is sitting in the masjid waiting for ṣalāh to begin. If one engages ayrıcaal ibadetler while waiting, gibi dhikr and tilāwah, then his rewards will increase further.

1062.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The angels supplicate for each of you as long as you remain at the spot where you performed namaz and your wuḍū' does not break, diyerek , 'O Allāh, bağışla him. O Allāh, have rahmet on him.'"(Bukhārī)
1062.commentary: The hadis demektir ki after a person completes his ṣalāh, he receives the du'ās of the angels as long as he remains in the masjid in the state of purity. One should avail of this sevap by at least remaining for a az sayıda moments after ṣalāh. If one remains in his place of ṣalāh waiting for the next ṣalāh, then he will attain the faziletler mentioned in this and the previous hadis.

1063.text: Once Resûlullah (ﷺ) delayed the Yatsı namaz until half the night had passed. After performing the namaz, he turned to us and dedi:"The people have performed their namaz and gone to sleep, but you were in namaz for the duration of time you were waiting for it."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1063.commentary: Bu hadis işaret eder the superiority of those who wait for ṣalāh in congregation over those who perform it individually. It should be noted that delaying the 'Ishā' ṣalāh was not a yaygın uygulama of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), bununla birlikte due to circumstances, this did occur on bazı occasions.

1064.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"namaz offered in congregation is twenty-seven times superior to namaz offered individually."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1064.commentary: Bu hadis mentions a sevap of twenty-seven times more while other narrations mention twenty-five. Scholars have explained this apparent contradiction in çeşitli ways. bazı of these are as follows: 1. The difference stems from differences in the quality of the ṣalāh and the ihlâs of the person performing it. 2. The sevap for ṣalāh in which the qirā'ah is recited aloud (jahrī) is twenty-seven times more, while that in which the qirā'ah is recited softly (sirrī) is twenty-five times more. 3. The sevap was originally twenty-five times more, bununla birlikte bütünāh (ﷻ) increased it due to His grace.

1065.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A person'in namaz in congregation is twenty-five times superior to his namaz in his house or in his business. This is because one who performs a perfect wuḍū' and then goes to the mescid with the sole purpose of performing namaz, then for every step that he takes, he is elevated by one rank and one günah is removed from him. When he now performs his namaz, the angels continue supplicating for him for the duration he is in his place of namaz, and his wuḍū' does not break, diyerek, 'O Allāh, send salutations to him. O Allāh, have rahmet upon him.' And he is considered to be in namaz as long as he waits for the namaz to begin."(Bukhārī)
1065.commentary: Scholars mention çeşitli faydalar and wisdoms of performing ṣalāh in congregation. bazı of these are as follows: 1. The gathering of Muslims to ibadet bütünāh (ﷻ) and supplicate to Him, readily draws bütünāh's (ﷻ) acceptance and causes His rahmet to descend. 2. When bütün the Muslims of a community dâhil the yaygın folk, the learned, the travellers, the young and the old gather together with the aim of pleasing bütünāh (ﷻ), then this serves as an impressive exhibition of the grandeur and power of Islām. This will easily enable the Muslims to defeat their enemies. 3. A gathering of Muslims allows them to become aware of her biri others şartlar and circumstances, so that they may share their difficulties and problems. This will strengthen their dinî brotherhood and sevgi based on īmān.

1066.text: A blind man came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, I do not have a guide to lead me to the mescid."He then sordu Resûlullah (ﷺ) to grant him the concession of performing his namaz at his home, and he granted him the concession. When he turned to leave, Resûlullah (ﷺ) called him back and sordu him:"Do you hear the call to namaz?"He cevap verdi:"Yes."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"Then respond to it."(Müslüman)
1066.commentary: From the above two aḥādīth we learn that although it is helal for the blind not to perform ṣalāh in congregation, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) commanded the blind to perform their ṣalāh in congregation so that they could practise on the absolute law ('azīmah), which draws greater ilâhî rewards, as compared to concessionary law (rukhṣah). It was also possible that he (ﷺ) wanted to illustrate the önem of congregational ṣalāh in the masjid.

1067.narrator: Abdullāh – and according to others, 'Amr ibn Qays, who was well-known as Ibn Umm Maktūm, the mu'adhdhin, said: "O Messenger of Allāh, there are many dangerous creatures and wild beasts in Madīnah." The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ)
1067.text: "Hayye ale's-salâh, hayye ale'l-felâh (Namaza gelin, kurtuluşa gelin) işitiyorsunuz, öyleyse gelin." (Ebû Dâvûd)
1067.commentary: From the above two aḥādīth we learn that although it is helal for the blind not to perform ṣalāh in congregation, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) commanded the blind to perform their ṣalāh in congregation so that they could practise on the absolute law ('azīmah), which draws greater ilâhî rewards, as compared to concessionary law (rukhṣah). It was also possible that he (ﷺ) wanted to illustrate the önem of congregational ṣalāh in the masjid.

1068.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Nefsim elinde olan Allah'a yemin ederim ki, I seriously considered issuing an order for firewood to be collected, the call to namaz to be given and a person appointed to lead the people in namaz, while I go to those people (who are absent from the mescid) and burn down their houses."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1068.commentary: Ṣalāh in congregation is a pivotal element of Islām. bununla birlikte, the scholars have differed with regard to its hukukî status. The Ẓāhiriyyah and bazı of the followers of Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal (رحمه الله) stated that congregation is a prerequisite for the ṣalāh to be geçerli. Imām Aḥmad (رحمه الله) and bazı of the followers of Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله) were of the opinion that it is Farḍ Kifāyah. This was also the opinion of Imām Ṭaḥāwī (رحمه الله), a high ranking Ḥanafī jurist and hadis scholar. The majority of the Ḥanafī scholars, gibi Ibn Humām (رحمه الله), are of the opinion that it is Wājib or Sunnah Mu'akkadah. Those who say that it is Farḍ prove their case by the şiddet of this hadis. Those who say that it is of a lower status than Farḍ say that the hadis does not prove it being Farḍ because the Messenger (ﷺ) did not punish those who omitted it; he merely threatened to punish them. The latter scholars also state that the uyarı was directed at the hypocrites and not the Ṣaḥābah, who would asla have left ṣalāh in congregation with the Messenger (ﷺ) in their midst.

1069.text: One who would like to meet Allah (ﷻ) tomorrow as a Müslüman should safeguard these namazs where the call is made for them is made. Allāh prescribed for your Messenger (ﷺ) the Sunan al-Hudā (ways of guidance) and these (namazs) are from among the ways of guidance. If you were to offer them in your houses as this person who remains behind offers them in his house, you would be abandoning the Sünnet of your Messenger. And if you abandon the Sünnet of your Messenger, you will go astray. I recall that none except a münafık whose hypocrisy was well-known would stay away. And a person would be brought (to the mescid) being supported between two people until he was made to stand in the row."(Müslüman) Another narration has:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) taught us the ways of guidance, and performing namaz in a mescid where the call is given is one of the ways of guidance."(Nasā'ī)
1069.commentary: The hadis encourages us to perform ṣalāh in congregation as those who do not do so are easily misguided. It also bize öğretir ki regularly abandoning congregational ṣalāh bir işaretidir nifak. The ameller of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) can broadly be classified into two types: 1. Sunan al-Hudā - those ameller which the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) performed as an ibadet. 2. Sunan al-Zawā'id - those ameller which the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) performed as a alışkanlık. Sunan al-Hudā is further divided into two types: 1. Sunnah Mu'akkadah - those Sunnahs which the Messenger (ﷺ) emphasised and performed with punctuality. 2. Sunnah Ghair Mu'akkadah - those Sunnahs which the Messenger (ﷺ) did not emphasise, and which he occasionally omitted. Ṣalāh in congregation is amongst the Sunan al-Hudā and is Wājib or Sunnah Mu'akkadah.

1070.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"If there are three people in a village or desert region and the congregational namaz is not established between them, then Shaiṭān most certainly overpowers them. You must therefore adhere to the Müslüman congregation because a wolf devours the sheep that strays."(Abū Dāwūd, Nasā'ī)
1070.commentary: Bu hadis emphasises the önem of congregational ṣalāh. Unity in ṣalāh is strength, while abandoning congregational ṣalāh induces weakness because Shaiṭān has the ability to influence individuals as he wishes. It is to be noted that congregational ṣalāh applies to men only. Women should perform their ṣalāh individually at home. 'Ā'ishah, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "If the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had seen the things introduced by the women, he would have definitely prevented them from going to the masjid, as the women of Banī Isrā'īl were prevented." (Muslim) It is also narrated that Umm Ḥumayd (رضي الله عنها), the wife of Abū Ḥumayd al-Sā'idī (رضي الله عنه) came to the Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I like to perform ṣalāh with you." He said, "I know that you like to perform ṣalāh with me, but your ṣalāh in your room is better for you than your ṣalāh in your courtyard is better for you than your ṣalāh in your house, and your ṣalāh in your house is better for you than your ṣalāh in the masjid of your people, and your ṣalāh in the masjid of your people is better for you than your ṣalāh in my masjid." So she issued orders that a place of ṣalāh be prepared for her in the furthest and darkest part of her house, and she used to perform ṣalāh there until she met bütünāh." (Ṣaḥīḥ ibn Ḥibbān)

1071.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"One who performs the Yatsı namaz in congregation, it is as if he has spent half the night in ibadet; and one who performs the Sabah namaz in congregation, it is as if he has spent the entire night in ibadet."(Müslüman) A narration of Tirmidhī has: 'Uthmān ibn 'Affān (رضي الله عنه) anlatır that Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi:"One who performs the Yatsı namaz in congregation receives the sevap of spending half the night in ibadet; and one who performs the Yatsı and Sabah namazs in congregation receives the sevap of spending the entire night in ibadet."(Tirmidhī)
1071.commentary: Sabah ve yatsı namazları özel bir fazilete sahiptir çünkü münafıklara zor gelir. Bu namazları cemaatle kılan, büyük bir sevap kazanır.

1072.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If people only knew the rewards for the Yatsı and Sabah namazs, they would attend them even if they had to crawl on their stomachs."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1072.commentary: Bu hadis was discussed previously. See hadis 1033. It is repeated here to stress the önem of attending Fajr and 'Ishā' ṣalāhs in congregation.

1073.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The most difficult namaz on the hypocrites is the Yatsı and Sabah namazs. If they only knew the rewards for them, they would have attended them even if they had to crawl."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1073.commentary: Yatsı ve sabah namazları münafıklar için bilhassa zordur çünkü yatsı gece karanlığında, sabah ise uykunun en tatlı olduğu zamanda kılınır.

1074.text: I sordu Resûlullah (ﷺ): 'Which is the best of actions?' He cevap verdi: 'namaz at its prescribed time.' I sordu: 'Then what?' He dedi: 'Obedience to one'in parents.' I sordu: 'Then what?' He dedi: 'Jihād in the path of Allāh.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1074.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 312. It is repeated here to show the önem of performing ṣalāh at its appointed time. This is such a fundamental emir of Islām that, according to Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله), if a person omits ṣalāh in its appointed time due to laziness, he should be killed if he does not repent. Together with ṣalāh, the hadis highlights the pivotal Islāmic teachings of being respectful to parents and jihād in the yol of bütünāh (ﷻ).

1075.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"İslâm is based on five pillars: testifying that there is none worthy of ibadet besides Allāh and that Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh, establishing namaz, giving zekât, Ḥaj to the House (Ka'bah), and oruç in Ramaḍān."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1075.commentary: In this hadis, Islām has been compared to a building which has five rükünler. tıpkı... gibi any building cannot exist without rükünler, Islām cannot exist without these five fundamental elements. A person who denies any of them is a disbeliever. If one omits any of them due to negligence, but testifies to their compulsion, he olarak kabul edilir a flagrant sinner.
