1076.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"I have been emretti to fight the people until they testify that there is none worthy of ibadet except Allāh and Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh, they establish namaz and pay zekât. When they do that, they will have protected their lives and mal from me except if justified by a right of İslâm. And their accountability is left to Allāh."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1076.commentary: Bu hadis emphasizes the foundational önem of the testimony of iman, establishing prayer, and paying zakāh as the core outward signs of Islām. Once a person fulfills these yükümlülükler, their life and property are protected under Islāmic law, and their inner iman and ihlâs is a matter between them and bütünāh.

1077.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sent me (as a governor to Yemen). He advised me diyerek: 'You are going to the people of the Book. Invite them to testify that there is none worthy of ibadet except Allāh and that I am the Messenger of Allāh. If they accept this, then inform them that Allāh made five daily namazs compulsory on them. If they accept this, then inform them that Allāh made zekât compulsory on them and it is to be taken from their rich and given to the poor amongst them. If they accept this, then refrain from taking their precious mal (as zekât) and beware of the supplication of the oppressed for there is no barrier between it and Allāh.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1077.commentary: The hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 208. It is repeated here to illustrate the önem of ṣalāh. It bize öğretir ki after īmān in bütünāh (ﷻ) and His Messenger (ﷺ), the çoğu important dinî duty is ṣalāh.

1078.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"The differentiating factor between a man and polytheism and disbelief is the abandoning of namaz."(Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1078.commentary: Bu hadis shows the şiddet of abandoning ṣalāh. Although âlimlerin çoğunluğu issue the verdict of küfür only against a person who rejects the farz nature of ṣalāh, these sözler of the Messenger (ﷺ) serve as a severe uyarı to those who omit ṣalāh. It should be noted that bazı of the eminent Ṣaḥābah were of the opinion that the verdict of küfür can be issued against the person who intentionally omits ṣalāh. Among them were 'Umar, Ibn Mas'ūd and Ibn 'Abbās (رضي الله عنهم). Among the jurists who held this view were Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, Isḥāq ibn Rāḥwayh and Ibn Mubārak (رحمهم الله). According to Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله) and Imām Mālik (رحمه الله), such a person is not a disbeliever, but the death penalty will be meted out to him as azap. According to other Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) and Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله), he will be jailed and punished until he realises his error and begins performing his ṣalāh.

1079.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The treaty between us and them (the hypocrites) hinges upon namaz. One who abandons it has committed (kufr) disbelief."(Tirmidhī, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1079.commentary: Hypocrites have küfür in their hearts, but outwardly proclaim to be Muslims. bununla birlikte, as long as they perform ṣalāh, their lives and wealth should be protected by the Muslim government, since they resemble the Muslims. Their internal state of küfür is left to bütünāh (ﷻ) to judge. For Muslims, the hadis serves as an teşvik to asla abandon ṣalāh because this is a quality of the hypocrites and disbelievers.

1080.text: Shaqīq ibn 'Abdillāh, an eminent Tābi'ī by consensus, şöyle dedi:"The Sahâbe of Muhammed (ﷺ) did not regard the abandoning of any action as kufr (disbelief) except namaz."(Tirmidhī)
1080.commentary: The term Ṣaḥābah here does not refer to bütün the Ṣaḥābah of the Messenger (ﷺ), but to a group amongst them who held this inanç. The majority of the Ṣaḥābah were of the view that only a person who regards omitting ṣalāh as helal will become a disbeliever. As for one who does not perform ṣalāh due to negligence or laziness, he will be regarded as a flagrant sinner.

1081.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The first thing that a person will be called to account for on the day of Kıyamet is his namaz. If it is in order, he will be successful and triumphant. If it is not in order, he will be unsuccessful and a failure. If there is any deficiency in his obligatory prayers, Allāh will say: 'See if My kul has any optional actions so that they may complete the deficiency in the obligatory prayers.' The remainder of his deeds will then be assessed in the same way."(Tirmidhī, Abū Dāwūd, Bayhaqī, Nasā'ī)
1081.commentary: If a person omits a Farḍ ṣalāh, the Nafl ṣalāh of his bütün life will not be able to compensate for that omission. bununla birlikte, if there is bazı deficiency in one's Farḍ ṣalāh, then this can be recompensed by one's Nafl ṣalāh. One should bu nedenle attempt to perform extra Nafl ṣalāh wheasla the opportunity exists. According to another narration, the first thing one will be called to account for on the day of Qiyāmah will be unjust murder. There is no contradiction here because the first thing one will be called to account for with regards to bütünāh's (ﷻ) haklar will be ṣalāh, while the first thing one will be called to account for with regards to people's haklar will be unjust murder.

1082.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) came out to us and dedi:"Do you not want to form your rows as the angels form their rows before their Sustainer?"We sordu:"O Messenger of Allāh, how do the angels form their rows before their Sustainer?"He dedi:"They fill the front rows and stand close together in the row."(Müslüman, Ibn Mājah, Aḥmad)
1082.commentary: Bu hadis, cemaatle namaz kılanları ön safları doldurmaya ve safları sık tutmaya teşvik eder. Ön saflarda olmak daha faziletlidir.

1083.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If people only knew the rewards of the call (to namaz) and the first row, and could find no way of attaining them except by drawing lots, they would have drawn lots."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1083.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 1033. It is repeated here to highlight the fazilet of the first row. The closer one is to the Imām the more one will fayda through hearing the Imām's recitation, observing his movements, drawing from his guidance, and gaining from bütünāh's (ﷻ) rahmet and the du'ās of the angels. Despite the great faziletler of the first row, it is important to note that one should not inconvenience others by forcing one's yol to reach it.

1084.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The best of rows for the men is the first row and the worst is the last row. The best of rows for the women is the last row and the worst is the first row."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah)
1084.commentary: Bu hadis işaret eder the early period of Islām when it was helal for women to attend the masjid for ṣalāh. This izin was later revoked. It illustrates the extent to which Islām dislikes the intermingling of sexes.

1085.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) gördü some of his Sahâbe lagging behind, so he şöyle dedi to them:"Come forward and follow me, and those behind you should follow you. If insanlar persist in lagging behind, Allāh will cause them to lag further behind."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1085.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) noticed bazı of his Ṣaḥābah lagging behind from the front row, so he teşvik edilen them to draw forward, or else they would be deprived of bütünāh's (ﷻ) rahmet, ilâhî rewards and entrance into cennet. From this advice, scholars explain that Muslims should daima advance and hasten in matters of good.

1086.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to pass his hand over our shoulders in namaz and say: 'Straighten (your rows) and do not stand unevenly or else your hearts will become disunited. Let those of you who are mature and intelligent stand nearest to me, then those who are closest to them, and then those who are closest to them.'"(Müslüman)
1086.commentary: Bu hadis teaches us to straighten the rows in ṣalāh and that people of knowledge and sahih anlayış should perform their ṣalāh directly behind the Imām. Those who are young in age or who are not as knowledgeable should perform their ṣalāh further back. çeşitli reasons have been given for this: 1. The elderly should be afforded greater honour. 2. The Imām may bazen need to appoint another person to tam the ṣalāh and those who are knowledgeable will be çoğu able to do so. 3. Those who are learned will be more capable of correcting the Imām's errors. 4. Those of sahih intelligence will carefully observe the ṣalāh of the Imām, remember it, practise upon it, and teach it to others.

1087.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Straighten your rows because the straightening of the row contributes to the perfection of namaz."A narration of Bukhārī has:"Straightening of the row contributes to the establishing of namaz."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1087.commentary: The Qur'ān commands us to establish ṣalāh (أقيموا الصلوة) and not merely to perform it. Included in the establishment of ṣalāh is to perform bütün its postures correctly, and to fulfil its çeşitli Sunnah and Mustaḥab ameller. Among these is the straightening of the rows. Scholars have regarded straightening of the rows as the çoğu emphasised Sunnah of ṣalāh, and bazı have even declared it to be Wājib. Straightening of the rows reflects perfection, itaat, unity of hearts and contributes towards a pleasant sight for onlookers.

1088.text: When the iqāmah was made, Resûlullah (ﷺ) turned towards us and dedi: 'Straighten your rows and stand close together for I can see you behind me.'"Another narration of Bukhārī has:"We used to make our shoulders and feet touch each others shoulders and feet."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1088.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) had the miraculous ability of observing those who were performing ṣalāh behind him, despite him facing the Qiblah. The touching of the shoulders and feet is mentioned to emphasise the extent to which they filled the gaps between them. It does not mean that their shoulders and feet would physically touch those of the person next to them while performing ṣalāh. Those who are of the opinion that joining the feet in ṣalāh is Wājib (compulsory) are incorrect for the following reasons: 1. The sözler which describe the joining of feet are not the sözler of the Messenger (ﷺ), but those of the narrator. 2. The aḥādīth on this topic do not indicate that this posture was maintained throughout the ṣalāh as the aim was merely to straighten the rows. 3. That this arrangement is to be confined to qiyām (the standing posture) only, lacks proof, and if it is to be extended to bütün the postures of ṣalāh, it would be impossible to practise upon. 4. In a narration of Abū Dāwūd, the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) are described as having also joined their knees. Why has this been excluded from the hüküm? 5. These aḥādīth are only intended to show that the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) attempted to straighten their rows and fill the gaps on the instruction of the Messenger (ﷺ). 6. There is no proof to show that one should increase the space between his feet during ṣalāh. 7. Narrations mention that the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) would place their shoes between their feet and those of the person next to them, bundan dolayı their feet would not touch her biri other. 8. None of the four Madhāhib advocate such a standing arrangement.

1089.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"You should straighten your rows or Allāh will cause disagreements between you."A narration of Müslüman has: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to straighten our rows to such an extent that it was as if spears could be straightened by them. This continued until he saw that we understood it. Then, one day, he came, stood up for namaz and was about to say the takbīr when he saw a person'in chest protruding from the row. He dedi:"O kullar of Allāh, you should straighten your rows or Allāh will cause disagreements between you."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1089.commentary: While the term "bütünāh will cause disagreements between you" has been translated as "bütünāh will cause disagreements between you" it could also mean, "bütünāh will disfigure your faces." The Arabs regarded it as an art to make their spears and arrows perfectly straight, bundan dolayı it became proverbial among them to compare the straightening of an object with that of a spear or arrow. The hadis, bu nedenle, emphasises the extent to which the rows of ṣalāh were straightened. Imām Nawawī (رحمه الله) stated that the hadis demektir ki uneven rows lead to enmity, nefret and disunity because uneven rows are a reflection of external disunity, and this in turn leads to internal disunity. Scholars further state that uneven rows give rise to evils and tribulations, disunity in kelime and purpose, and deterioration of the grandeur of Islām and Muslims, resulting in their enemies gaining ascendency over them.

1090.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) safların arasında bir uçtan diğer uca yürür, eliyle göğüslerimizi ve omuzlarımızı düzeltir ve: "Saflarınızı sık tutun, birbirinize karışmayın, yoksa kalpleriniz de ayrı düşer" derdi. (Müslim)
1090.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki the shoulders and feet of those in congregational ṣalāh should be in a straight line. If outwardly there is no conformity, then the hearts will become disunited, because the effects of outward ameller reach the heart. bütünāh (ﷻ) and His angels sending salutations on those who perform ṣalāh in the front rows demektir ki bütünāh (ﷻ) sends His rahmet upon them and the angels supplicate and seek bağışlanma for them.

1091.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Straighten the rows, stand shoulder to shoulder, fill the gaps, be gentle in directing your brothers to straighten the rows, and do not leave gaps for Shaiṭān. Allāh will join with the person who joins the rows and sever with the person who severs the rows."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1091.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki one should not form a new row if there is an empty space in an existing row. While the term "be gentle in directing your brothers" has been translated as, "be gentle in directing your brothers to straighten the rows," it could also mean that one who is requested to straighten the row or to fill a gap should willingly comply. "bütünāh will join with the person who joins the rows" demektir ki bütünāh (ﷻ) will shower His rahmet on him, be pleased with him, and send His favours upon him. bütünāh will "sever with the person who severs the rows" demektir ki bütünāh (ﷻ) will be displeased with him, He will not increase his rewards, and He will distance him from the highest stages of cennet.

1092.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Stand closely together in your rows, bring them close to each other, and ensure that the necks are in line. Nefsim elinde olan Allah'a yemin ederim ki, I see Shaiṭān entering through the gaps in the row as if he is a small black sheep."(Abū Dāwūd, Bayhaqī)
1092.commentary: The instruction to "bring them close to her biri other," demektir ki there should not be an excessive distance between two rows of the congregation. Scholars have stated that the distance should not exceed three arms-lengths. Shaiṭān aims to destroy our kulluk and concentration in ṣalāh, bundan dolayı he utilises gaps to infiltrate. The hadis could be literally interpreted to mean that Shaiṭān moves between the rows attempting to create enmity in the hearts of the worshippers by belittling the önem of straightening the rows. It can also be interpreted figuratively to mean that Shaiṭān whispers evil thoughts into the hearts and minds of the worshippers.

1093.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Fill the front row, then the row that is behind it. If any row is to be incomplete, it should be the last row."(Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah, Bayhaqī)
1093.commentary: Bu hadis, cemaate ön safları doldurmayı, sonra arkaya geçmeyi öğütler. Saflarda boşluk bırakılmamalıdır.

1094.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh and His angels send salutations to the right hand side of the rows."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1094.commentary: When a person joins the congregation, and he finds an equal number of people to the doğru and left of the Imām, then he should stand to the doğru. bununla birlikte, if there are more people to the doğru, then he should stand to the left of the Imām in order to balance the rows.

1095.text: When we used to perform namaz behind Resûlullah (ﷺ), we preferred standing on his right so that he would turn his face towards us. I heard him say: 'Ey Rabbim, save me from Your azap on the day when You resurrect – or You gather – Your kullar.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1095.commentary: İmam namazdan sonra dönüp cemaate yüzünü dönmelidir. Duaların gizli yapılması daha faziletlidir.

1096.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Let the Imām be at the centre and fill the gaps."(Abū Dāwūd, Bayhaqī)
1096.commentary: "Let the Imām be at the centre" demektir ki the Imām should be placed at the centre of the ṣalāh area and those following him should be in equal number on either side of him. The çoğu virtuous position is directly behind the Imām, then one position to his doğru and one to his left and so forth until the row is tam. The second row should also commence from the centre and continue as mentioned above. The emir to fill the gaps is to ensure that Shaiṭān does not enter the rows and spread his evil amongst the congregation.

1097.narrator: The Mother of the Believers Umm Ḥabībah Ramlah bint Abī Sufyān (رضي الله عنها)
1097.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"A Müslüman who performs twelve rak'āts of optional namaz every day, apart from the obligatory namaz, Allāh builds a house for him in Cennet - or a house is built for him in Cennet."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1097.commentary: Bu on iki rekât, sünnet-i müekkede olan namazları ifade eder: Öğleden önce dört, öğleden sonra iki, akşamdan sonra iki, yatsıdan sonra iki ve sabah namazından önce iki rekât.

1098.text: I performed with Resûlullah (ﷺ) two rak'āts before Ẓuhr, two rak'āts after Ẓuhr, two rak'āts after Cuma, two rak'āts after Akşam and two rak'āts after Yatsı."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1098.commentary: Performing these rak'āts, dâhil two rak'āts before Fajr was the daily uygulama of Ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنه). This was also the view of Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله) who regarded these ten rak'āts as Sunnah Mu'akkadah. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله), a total of twelve rak'āts are Sunnah Mu'akkadah, with four rak'āts being necessary before Ẓuhr instead of two. Refer to chapter 199 for a detailed açıklama on this difference of opinion between the scholars.

1099.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There is a namaz between every two adhāns. There is a namaz between every two adhāns."When he dedi it the third time, he added,"For whoever wills."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī). The words"between two adhāns"refer to the adhān and the iqāmah.
1099.commentary: Bu hadis indicates that optional prayers may be performed between the adhan and iqamah for any of the farz prayers. The ifade "for whoever wills" clarifies that these prayers are müstehap but not farz.

1100.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) öğle namazından önce dört rekât ve sabah namazından önce iki rekâtı terk etmezdi. (Buhârî)
1100.commentary: birçok aḥādīth emphasise the önem of the two rak'āts before Fajr. For this reason, bazı scholars state that they are the çoğu emphasised of bütün the Sunnah ṣalāhs.

1101.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) hiçbir nafile namaza, sabah namazının iki rekât sünnetine olduğu kadar devamlı değildi. (Buhârî, Müslim)
1101.commentary: In another narration, Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) narrates that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "Do not omit the two rak'āts of Fajr even if horses trample you." (Abū Dāwūd) 'bütünāmah Qutbuddīn (رحمه الله) stated that the Messenger (ﷺ) gave so much of önem to the two rak'āts of Fajr that he would not omit them under any circumstances, whether at home or while travelling.

1102.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The two rak'āts of Sabah are better than this world and whatever it contains."Another narration has:"They are more beloved to me than the entire world."(Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Bayhaqī, Ḥākim)
1102.commentary: "They are more beloved to me" is an indication that these are extremely beloved to bütünāh (ﷻ) since the Messenger (ﷺ) would only sevgi that which was beloved to his Master.

1103.text: Abū 'Abdillāh Bilāl ibn Rabāḥ (رضي الله عنه), the mu'adhdhin of Resûlullah (ﷺ), anlatır that he went to Resûlullah (ﷺ) to inform him that it was time for the Sabah namaz. 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) engaged Bilāl in something which she sordu him about to the extent that morning entered. Bilāl then stood up and haber verdi him of the time of namaz and followed it with the adhān. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) did not come out immediately. When he came out, he led the people in namaz and Bilāl then haber verdi him that 'Ā'ishah had engaged him in something which she had sordu him about to the extent that morning entered. He was therefore delayed in coming to him. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi to him:"I was performing the two rak'āts of Sabah."He dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, it was well into morning time."He dedi:"Even if I had been further into morning time, I would have performed these two rak'āts and done so in a beautiful and excellent manner."(Abū Dāwūd)
1103.commentary: Bu hadis is mentioned here to point out the önem of the two rak'āts of Fajr. One should endeavour to perform them irrespective of the amount of time available. Only if one fears the time of Fajr elapsing, can one omit them. bununla birlikte, if one omits them, one should perform them as qaḍā' after the sun rises considerably.

1104.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform two short rak'āts between the adhān and iqāmah of the Sabah namaz. Another narration has:"When he heard the adhān, he would perform two rak'āts of the Sabah namaz. He would shorten them to such an extent that I would think to myself: 'Did he recite Sûre al-Fātiḥah in them?'"Another narration has:"He used to perform two rak'āts when he heard the adhān and he would shorten them."A narration has,"at the break of dawn."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1104.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) would shorten these rak'āts so that he could perform the Farḍ ṣalāh with added enböyleceiasm and concentration. It is bu nedenle Mustaḥab for others to also shorten these two rak'āts.

1105.text: When the mu'adhdhin called out the adhān for Sabah and dawn appeared, Resûlullah (ﷺ) would perform two short rak'āts of namaz. (Bukhārī, Müslüman). A narration of Müslüman has:"When the dawn appeared, Resûlullah (ﷺ) would only perform two short rak'āts of namaz."
1105.commentary: Bu hadis, Peygamber (ﷺ)'in ezandan sonra iki rekât kısa sünnet kıldığını teyit eder. Bu sünneti hafif kılmak müstehaptır.

1106.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform namaz at night in units of two rak'āts, and he would add one rak'āt to his last two rak'āts making it an odd number in the last part of the night. He would perform two rak'āts before the Sabah namaz and it was as if the adhān was still in his ears. (Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1106.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki the Messenger (ﷺ) would offer Tahajjud ṣalāh in units of two rak'āts, and when he (ﷺ) felt that the time of Fajr was drawing near, he would add on one rak'āt to his last two rak'āts to make it a total of three rak'āts Witr. This is the view of Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله). According to Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله), Imām Mālik (رحمه الله) and Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal (رحمه الله), the hadis indicates that Witr should be a single rak'āt. Based on this hadis, it is best that the Witr of 'Ishā' be performed after the Tahajjud ṣalāh, bununla birlikte, if there is a korku of omitting the Witr ṣalāh at that time, it is best that one performs it before sleeping.

1107.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) used to perform the two rak'āts of Sabah, he used to recite in the first rak'āt"Say, 'We believe in Allāh, in what has been revealed to us...'"(Sûre al-Baqarah, 136) and in the second rak'āt"Come to a word that is common between us and you..."(Sûre Āl 'Imrān, 64). Another narration has that he used to recite from Sûre Āl 'Imrān in the second rak'āt:"We believe in Allāh and be şahit that we are certainly Müslümans."(Sûre Āl 'Imrān, 52) (Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1107.commentary: In the first rak'āt, the Messenger (ﷺ) would bazen recite Bu âyet of Sūrah al-Baqarah after Sūrah al-Fātiḥah: "Say, 'We believe in bütünāh, in what has been revealed to us and in what was revealed to Ibrāhīm, Ismā'īl, Isḥāq, Ya'qūb and the descendants, and what was granted to Mūsā, 'Īsā and what was granted to bütün the Messengers from their Sustainer. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are obedient to bütünāh.'" (Sūrah al-Baqarah, 136). In the second rak'āt, he (ﷺ) would recite one of the following two verses of Sūrah Āl 'Imrān after Sūrah al-Fātiḥah: "When 'Īsā sensed küfür from them, he said, 'Who will be my helpers towards bütünāh?' The disciples replied, 'We shall be the helpers of bütünāh. We believe in bütünāh, and you be the witness that we are indeed Muslims.'" (Sūrah Āl 'Imrān, 52) "Say, 'O people of the Book! Come to a kelime yani yaygın between us and You; that we ibadet none but bütünāh, that we do not ascribe anyone as equal to Him and that we do not take her biri other as gods besides bütünāh.' If they turn away, then say, 'Be witness that we are certainly Muslims.'" (Sūrah Āl 'Imrān, 64)

1108.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) recited Sûre al-Kâfirūn and Sûre al-Ikhlāṣ in the two rak'āts of Sabah namaz. (Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Nasā'ī)
1108.commentary: Bu hadis, Peygamber (ﷺ)'in sabah sünnetinde Kâfirûn ve İhlâs surelerini okuduğunu gösterir. Bu sureleri okumak faziletlidir.

1109.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i bir ay boyunca dikkatle izledim. Kâfirûn Suresi'ni ve İhlâs Suresi'ni okurdu. (Tirmizî)
1109.commentary: The sūrahs çoğu commonly recited by the Messenger (ﷺ) in the two Sunnah rak'āts before the Farḍ were Sūrah al-Kāfirūn and Sūrah al-Ikhlāṣ. Sūrah al-Kāfirūn is a beyan of absolute aversion from the ways of polytheism, whilst Sūrah al-Ikhlāṣ is an exposition of the oneness of bütünāh (ﷻ) (tawḥīd). başka bir deyişle, her iki deal with beliefs which are crucial to one's salvation in the ahiret. Ibn Nujaim (رحمه الله) stated in Baḥr-al-Rā'iq that one should regularly recite these two sūrahs, in the Sunnah ṣalāh before Fajr, bununla birlikte one should occasionally also recite other sūrahs.

1110.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) had kıldı the two rak'āts of Sabah, he would lie down on his right side."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1110.commentary: Göre the majority of the scholars, lying down before the Farḍ of Fajr ṣalāh is to gain rest after Tahajjud and if one does so to remove tiredness, he will be rewarded. According to Imām Shāfi'ī and others, a person should rest at this time whether he is tired or not.

1111.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform eleven rak'āts of namaz from the time he completed Yatsı until Sabah. He would make salām between every two rak'āts and add one rak'āt making the total number of rak'āts an odd number. When the mu'adhdhin was silent after calling out the adhān of the Sabah namaz, and dawn seemed clear to him, and the mu'adhdhin had come to him, he would stand up and perform two short rak'āts of namaz. He would then lie down on his right side until the mu'adhdhin came to him to call out the iqāmah."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Nasā'ī)
1111.commentary: Bu hadis ve önceki hadisten, Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in sabah sünnetinden sonra sağ tarafına yatarak istirahat ettiğini öğreniyoruz.

1112.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any of you has performed the two rak'āts of Sabah, he should lie down on his right side."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1112.commentary: Bu hadis teaches that after performing the two Sunnah rak'āts of Fajr, one should lie down on his doğru side before the Fard ṣalāh. This was the regular uygulama of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). Scholars differ on whether this lying down is Sunnah or merely helal. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah, it is not necessary but is done to separate the Sunnah from the Fard. According to other scholars, this uygulama is Sunnah for one who has performed Tahajjud ṣalāh, as it provides rest before the Fajr prayer.

1113.text: I performed two rak'āts before the Ẓuhr namaz and two rak'āts after it with Resûlullah (ﷺ)."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1113.commentary: Regarding the Sunnah number of rak'āts before the Ẓuhr ṣalāh, scholars have farklı views based on farklı aḥādīth. According to the Ḥanafī scholars and Imām Mālik (رحمه الله), there are four rak'āts Sunnah Mu'akkadah. According to the view of Imām Aḥmad (رحمه الله) and the recognised view of Imām Shāfi'ī, there are two rak'āts of Sunnah Mu'akkadah. The above hadis is used as proof by the latter mentioned scholars. The Ḥanafī scholars and Imām Mālik (رحمه الله) utilise the aḥādīth that follow as proof of four rak'āts.

1114.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) öğle namazından önce dört rekâtı terk etmezdi. (Buhârî, Ahmed)
1114.commentary: Bu hadis, öğle namazından önceki dört rekât sünnetin önemli olduğunu söyleyen âlimler için delil teşkil eder.

1115.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform four rak'āts in my house before the Ẓuhr namaz, and then go out and lead the people in namaz. He would then return and perform two rak'āts. He used to lead the people for the Akşam namaz, then return and perform two rak'āts. He used to lead the people for the Yatsı namaz, come into my house and perform two rak'āts."(Müslüman)
1115.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki the Messenger (ﷺ) used to generally perform the Sunnah ṣalāhs that followed the Farḍ, at home. This carries greater fazilet as compared to performing them in the masjid, bununla birlikte if there is a korku that one will be distracted from performing them once he reaches home, then he should perform them in the masjid.

1116.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh will make unlawful for cehennem ateşi one who safeguards the four rak'āts before the Ẓuhr namaz and the four rak'āts after it."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1116.commentary: The four rak'āts after Ẓuhr, bazı âlimlere göre, refer to an additional four rak'āts after the two Sunnah. Mullā 'Alī Qārī (رحمه الله), bununla birlikte, stated that the two Sunnah are included in the four. bundan dolayı, one should perform an additional two rak'āts of Nafl ṣalāh ayrıca to the two Sunnah rak'āts to earn this fazilet.

1117.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform four rak'āts after mid-day before the Ẓuhr namaz, and he şöyle dedi:"It is a time wherein the doors of the heavens are opened and I therefore prefer my good deed to ascend at that time."(Tirmidhī)
1117.commentary: bazı scholars are of the view that these four rak'āts refer to the four rak'āts of Sunnah Mu'akkadah prior to the Ẓuhr ṣalāh. bununla birlikte, the majority of the scholars are of the view that these refer to the ṣalāh of zawāl which the Messenger (ﷺ) used to perform immediately after zawāl.

1118.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) öğle namazından önce dört rekât kılmazsa, onları sonra kılardı. (Tirmizî)
1118.commentary: Bu hadis illustrates the önem which the Messenger (ﷺ) afforded to this ṣalāh. According to the çoğu preferred view, if one does not perform it before the Farḍ of Ẓuhr, one should perform it after the two Sunnah. A narration of 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) states, "When the Messenger (ﷺ) missed the four rak'āts before Ẓuhr, he would perform them after the two rak'āts after Ẓuhr." (Ibn Mājah)

1119.narrator: Ali bin Ebû Tâlib (رضي الله عنه)
1119.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform four rak'āts before the İkindi namaz. He would separate them by sending salām to the close angels, and the Müslümans and müminler who follow them."(Tirmidhī)
1119.commentary: "He would separate them," bazı âlimlere göre, işaret eder the tashahhud which is genellikle recited after two rak'āts. In this case, the four rak'āts would be performed together with a single salām at the end. bununla birlikte, according to Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله) and Imām Aḥmad (رحمه الله), it demektir ki the ṣalāh should be performed in units of two rak'āts her biri.

1120.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"May Allāh have rahmet upon the person who performs four rak'āts before the İkindi namaz."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1120.commentary: While Bu hadis has been translated as a du'ā' of rahmet for the person who performs these four rak'āts before 'Aṣr ṣalāh, it may also serve as a report informing us that bütünāh (ﷻ) showers His rahmet on such a person.

1121.narrator: Ali bin Ebû Tâlib (رضي الله عنه)
1121.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform two rak'āts before the İkindi namaz. (Abū Dāwūd)
1121.commentary: There are çeşitli narrations regarding the Sunnah ṣalāh before 'Aṣr. bazı show that the Messenger (ﷺ) performed two rak'āts whilst others show that he performed four rak'āts. After studying bütün these narrations, scholars mention that this ṣalāh is Sunnah Ghair Mu'akkadah and that one has the choice to perform two or four rak'āts, with four being more superior.

1122.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Perform namaz before the Akşam namaz,"and the third time he dedi,"for whoever wishes to do so."(Bukhārī, Bayhaqī)
1122.commentary: From çeşitli sahih aḥādīth, it is established that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) used to perform two rak'āts after 'Aṣr and before Maghrib, bundan dolayı according to Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله) and Imām Aḥmad (رحمه الله), these two rak'āts are helal for bütün to perform. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله) and Imām Mālik (رحمه الله), this was a speciality of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and is Makrūh for the rest of the Ummah.

1123.text: I saw senior Sahâbe of Resûlullah (ﷺ) hastening towards the pillars of the mescid at the time of Akşam."(Bukhārī)
1123.commentary: The rükünler in the masjid of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) were trunks of date-palm trees. The Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) used to hasten towards these trunks to perform ṣalāh behind them so that those who were passing in front of them would not cross them while they were in ṣalāh.

1124.text: We used to perform two rak'āts after sunset before the Akşam namaz during the era of Resûlullah (ﷺ)."Anas (رضي الله عنه) was sordu:"Did Resûlullah (ﷺ) perform these two rak'āts?"He cevap verdi:"He used to see us performing them, and he neither emretti us nor yasakladı us."(Müslüman, Dārimī)
1124.commentary: Göre the Shāfi'ī and Ḥanbalī scholars, these two rak'āts are Mustaḥab or helal. The Ḥanafī and Mālikī scholars discourage the performance of two rak'āts before the Maghrib ṣalāh. They base their opinion on the narration which states that the Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Between her adhān and iqāmah are two rak'āts, except Maghrib ṣalāh." (Dāraquṭnī and Bayhaqī)

1125.text: When we were in Madīnah and the mu'adhdhin called out the adhān for the Akşam namaz, the Sahâbe would hasten towards the pillars and perform two rak'āts. If a stranger would enter the mescid he would assume that the Akşam namaz was over because of the large number of people performing these two rak'āts."(Müslüman, Tirmidhī)
1125.commentary: Göre Ibn Ḥummām (رحمه الله) and 'bütünāmah Kashmīrī (رحمه الله) it is helal to perform them but it is preferable to abstain for two reasons: 1. Great emphasis has been placed upon hastening with the Maghrib ṣalāh. 2. The majority of the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) did not perform them as stated by Abū Sa'īd Khudrī (رضي الله عنه).

1126.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any of you performs the Cuma namaz, he should perform four rak'āts after it."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1126.commentary: There are three views with regards to the Sunnah ṣalāh after Jumu'ah: 1. It is Sunnah to perform two rak'āts. This is the view of Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله) and Imām Aḥmad (رحمه الله). The above hadis of Ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) proves their position. 2. It is Sunnah to perform four rak'āts. This is the view of Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله). The hadis of Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) supports this view. 3. It is Sunnah to perform six rak'āts. This is the view of Imām Abū Yūsuf (رحمه الله) and Imām Muḥammad (رحمه الله), the students of Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله). The verdict according to the Ḥanafī school is based on this view, since it incorporates bütün the narrations related to the topic.

1127.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) would not perform any namaz after the Cuma namaz until after he had left. He would then perform two rak'āts in his house. (Müslüman, Nasā'ī, Bayhaqī)
1127.commentary: Farz namazdan sonra aynı yerde sünnet namazı kılmamalı, biraz hareket edip başka bir yerde kılmalıdır. Bu, mescidin farklı yerlerinin şahitlik etmesi içindir.

1128.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"O people, perform your namaz in your homes. The best namaz is a man'in namaz in his home, except for the obligatory namaz."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1128.commentary: There are çeşitli advantages of performing the Sunnah and Nafl ṣalāh in the home. Firstly, it repels pride and inculcates ihlâs. Secondly, it draws ilâhî blessings and rahmet in the home. Thirdly, it causes Shaiṭān to flee. bununla birlikte, scholars have mentioned that if one fears distraction and negligence in the home, then it is preferable to perform these ṣalāhs in the masjid.

1129.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Perform some of your namazs in your homes and do not make them into graveyards."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1129.commentary: The emir not to convert homes into graveyards could mean that the deceased should not be buried in homes, but in the graveyard. It could also mean that if ṣalāh is not performed in the home, then it will be benzer to a graveyard where no iyilikler can be performed. It is best to allocate a place for ṣalāh in the home. 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) narrates, "The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) commanded us to build a place of ṣalāh in our homes, to keep it clean and to keep it scented." (Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)

1130.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Any of you who performs his namaz in his mescid, should perform some of his namaz in his home as Allāh will place nimetler in his home because of his namaz."(Müslüman, Ibn Mājah, Aḥmad)
1130.commentary: The performance of Sunnah and Nafl ṣalāh in one's home draws ilâhî goodness and blessings. This hüküm applies to those who return home immediately after the Farḍ ṣalāh. If a person does not return home or is in I'tikāf, then these ṣalāhs should be performed in the masjid.

1131.text: 'Umar ibn 'Aṭā' anlatır that Nāfi' ibn Jubayr sent him to al-Sā'ib, the son of Namir'in sister, to ask him about something that Mu'āwiyah had seen him doing regarding namaz. He dedi:"Yes, I performed the Cuma namaz with him in the enclosure. When the Imām dedi the salām, I stood up in my place and performed namaz. When he entered, he called for me and dedi: 'Do not again do what you just did. Once you have performed the Cuma namaz, do not perform another namaz immediately after until you have spoken or moved away. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) ordered us to do so, that is not to perform any namaz immediately after the obligatory namaz until we had spoken or moved away.'"(Müslüman)
1131.commentary: A مَقْصُورَة işaret eder a special room in one of the corners of the masjid which is made for the Imām. Mu'āwiyah (رضي الله عنه) would perform ṣalāh there after the Khawārij attempted to assassinate him. After the Farḍ ṣalāh, a person should not perform Sunnah ṣalāh in the same place. He should move away or at least speak to someone so that others may be able to differentiate between the Sunnah and Farḍ ṣalāh.

1132.text: Vitir namazı farz namazlar gibi farz değildir. Ancak Resûlullah (ﷺ) onu sünnet olarak belirlemiş ve şöyle buyurmuştur: "Şüphesiz Allah tektir, tek olanı sever, ey Kur'an ehli! Vitir kılın." (Ebû Dâvûd, Tirmizî, Nesâî, Hâkim)
1132.commentary: bütünāh (ﷻ) loves odd numbers, bundan dolayı we find that birçok of the ameller of ibadet are odd in number, gibi the circuits in ṭawāf, sa'ī between Ṣafā and Marwā, pelting of the Jamarāt, number of tasbīḥāts in ṣalāh and so forth. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله), Witr ṣalāh is Wājib, whereas according to the other three Imāms, it is Sunnah Mu'akkadah. bununla birlikte, bütün the scholars stress upon the önem of performing it.

1133.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) performed the Witr namaz at all portions of the night: the first portion, the middle and the last. His Witr namaz would extend to the last portion of the night."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1133.commentary: Bu hadis vitir namazının vaktini gösterir. Yatsı namazından sonra imsak vaktine kadar herhangi bir zamanda kılınabilir.

1134.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Make the Witr namaz the last of your namazs at night."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1134.commentary: It is best and çoğu virtuous that the last ṣalāh to be performed at night be the Witr ṣalāh. bunun sebebi is that the Witr ṣalāh is superior to Sunnah, Nafl and Tahajjud ṣalāh, bundan dolayı it is best that one ends his good ameller with that which is çoğu superior. As for the two rak'āts which the Messenger (ﷺ) generally performed after Witr, while sitting, this was the completion of the Witr tıpkı... gibi the Sunnah are a completion of the Farḍ ṣalāh. These Sunnah and Nafl ṣalāhs compensate for any shortcomings in the Farḍ and Witr respectively.

1135.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Perform the Witr namaz before the morning."(Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah)
1135.commentary: Göre the Ḥanafī scholars, Witr ṣalāh is Wājib, bundan dolayı one who misses it, has to perform qaḍā' of it in compensation. According to the other Imāms, since Witr is Sunnah, there is no qaḍā' if it is omitted.

1136.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform his namaz at night while she was lying down in front of him. When only the Witr namaz remained, he would wake her up and she would perform the Witr namaz. Another narration has:"When only the Witr namaz remained, he would say: 'O 'Ā'ishah, wake up and perform the Witr namaz.'"(Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1136.commentary: Since Witr is of greater önem than Sunnah ṣalāhs, according to the Ḥanafī scholars, the Messenger (ﷺ) stressed its performance to 'Ā'ishāh (رضي الله عنها). It is helal for a person to perform ṣalāh when another person is sleeping in front of him.

1137.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Perform the Witr namaz before the break of dawn."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1137.commentary: Bu hadis vitir namazını tan yerinin ağarmasından önce kılmayı vurgular. Vitir namazını geciktirmemek müstehaptır.

1138.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who fears that he will not wake up in the last part of the night should perform the Witr namaz in the first part. One who intends waking up in the last part should perform the Witr namaz in the last part. namaz performed in the last part of the night is attended (by the angels), and that is the best."(Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1138.commentary: The best time to perform Witr is the last portion of the night. bununla birlikte, if a person fears that he will not wake up, then he should perform it before sleeping, so that it does not become qaḍā'. The last portion of the night is blessed because the angels descend at that time. One who performs ṣalāh then is granted blessings and rahmet from bütünāh (ﷻ).

1139.text: My bosom friend, (Resûlullah (ﷺ)) advised me to fast three days in every month, to perform two rak'āts of Ṣalāt al-Ḍuḥā and that I perform the Witr namaz before going to sleep."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad). Performing the Witr namaz before going to sleep is preferable for one who fears that he will not be able to wake up in the latter part of the night. If he feels he will be able to wake up, then it will be preferable for him to perform it in the latter part of the night.
1139.commentary: Bu hadis bizi üç şeyi yapmaya teşvik eder: Duha namazını kılmak, vitirden önce üç günde bir oruç tutmak ve vitir namazını kılmak.

1140.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Every morning, sadaka is due on behalf of every joint of your body. Every tasbīḥ (Subḥānallāh - glorification of Allāh) is sadaka; every taḥmīd (alḥamdulillāh - praise of Allāh) is sadaka; every tahlīl (lā ilāha illallāh - proclamation of the oneness of Allāh) is sadaka; every takbīr (Allāhu akbar - expression of the greatness of Allāh) is sadaka; commanding good is sadaka; and forbidding evil is sadaka. However, two rak'āts of namaz at mid-morning (Ṣalāt al-Ḍuḥā) suffices for all of this."(Müslüman)
1140.commentary: Bu hadis daha önce zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 118. Duha namazının faziletini göstermek için burada tekrarlanmıştır.

1141.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform four rak'āts for Ṣalāt al-Ḍuḥā and he would add on as many as Allāh willed."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1141.commentary: Bu hadis, Peygamber (ﷺ)'in Duha namazı için en az dört rekât kıldığını ve dilediği kadar artırabileceğini gösterir.

1142.narrator: Umm Hāni' Fākhitah bint Abī Ṭālib (رضي الله عنها)
1142.text: I went to Resûlullah (ﷺ) during the conquest of Makkah and found him performing ghusl. When he completed his ghusl, he performed eight rak'āts and that was Ṣalāt al-Ḍuḥā."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1142.commentary: Ṣalāt al-Ḍuḥā has çok sayıda faziletler. One of these is mentioned in a hadis narrated by Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) wherein the Messenger (ﷺ) said, "One who safeguards the two rak'āts of Ṣalāt al-Ḍuḥā, his günahlar will be forgiven, even if they equal the foam of the ocean." (Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah)

1143.text: He saw some people performing Ṣalāt al-Ḍuḥā, so he dedi:"Do they not know that namaz performed at a time other than now is better? The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'The namaz of those who repent to Allāh is performed when it is relatively hot.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1143.commentary: The time to perform Ṣalat al-Ḍuḥā is from after sunrise until midday, bununla birlikte the best time is when it is quite hot. In this hadis, the people performed it as soon as the time commenced, bundan dolayı Zayd (رضي الله عنه) advised them to perform it just before midday. It is also müstehap to perform 2 or 4 rak'āts immediately after sunrise. (Tirmidhī) This ṣalāh is generally referred to as Ṣalāt al-Ishrāq.

1144.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any of you enters the mescid, he should not sit down before performing two rak'āts."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1144.commentary: Bir kişi mescide girdiğinde, oturmadan önce iki rekât tahiyyetü'l-mescid namazı kılmalıdır. Bu, mescidin hakkıdır ve sünnettir.

1145.text: I came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) when he was in the mescid. He dedi: 'Perform two rak'āts.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Ibn Mājah, Aḥmad)
1145.commentary: Bu hadis, mescide girerken iki rekât namaz kılma emrini teyit eder. Bu namaz, mescidin hürmetine saygıdır.

1146.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sordu Bilāl (رضي الله عنه):"O Bilāl, tell me about the action of which you are most hopeful in İslâm as I heard your footsteps ahead of me in Cennet."Bilāl (رضي الله عنه) cevap verdi:"I have not done any action of which I am most hopeful except that whenever I perform wuḍū', at any time of day or night, I perform after that wuḍū' the namaz that Allāh destined that I should perform."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1146.commentary: Bu hadis explains the great sevap of entrance into cennet for one who punctually performs two rak'āts after wuḍū'. While the kelime طُهُوراً has been translated as wuḍū' it can equally apply to ghusl and tayammum, since purity is attained by bütün these methods.

1147.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday. On this day Ādam (عليه السلام) was created, on it he was admitted into Cennet, and on it he was removed from it (Cennet)."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1147.commentary: In other narrations, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) also referred to the day of Jumu'ah as Sayyid Al-Ayyām and he stated that it is greater in the sight of bütünāh (ﷻ) than the two 'Īds. bazı scholars are of the view that the day of 'Arafah is the çoğu virtuous of days. They reconcile between the çeşitli narrations by asserting that Jumu'ah is the best day of the week and 'Arafah is the best day of the year.

1148.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who performs a thorough wuḍū', then goes for Cuma, listens (to the sermon) and remains silent, will have his günahlar forgiven from then until the next Cuma and three days more. One who plays with pebbles has engaged in a futile activity."(Müslüman)
1148.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki a person's minor günahlar of ten days are forgiven by performing Jumu'ah. It also bize öğretir ki one should be focussed to the Jumu'ah sermon and avoid her form of söz and activity which diverts one's attention from the sermon.

1149.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The five daily namazs, one Cuma until the next Cuma, and one Ramaḍān until the next Ramaḍān will expiate whatever is between them provided the major günahlar are avoided."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1149.commentary: Jumu'ah ṣalāh, Ramaḍān and performing noble ameller result in the bağışlanma of günahlar, provided that one abstains from major günahlar. From this we also learn that such noble ameller only result in the bağışlanma of minor günahlar. For the bağışlanma of major günahlar, sincere tövbe is required.

1150.text: Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) and Ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما) narrate that they heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) say, while sitting on his pulpit:"People should stop abandoning the Cuma namaz or else Allāh will seal their hearts and they will definitely be included among the heedless."(Müslüman, Ibn Mājah, Nasā'ī)
1150.commentary: Scholars state that the sealing of the heart is an expression to show that the heart becomes hardened and unresponsive to advice. Other scholars state that it işaret eder the creation of küfür in the heart. On the basis of this hadis, scholars have stated that Jumu'ah ṣalāh is Farḍ 'Ain. Those who are musāfir as well as women and children are excluded from this farz.

1151.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any of you comes to the Cuma namaz, he should first perform a ghusl."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Mālik)
1151.commentary: Göre çoğu scholars dâhil Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله), Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله) and Imām Aḥmad (رحمه الله), it is Sunnah to perform ghusl on the day of Jumu'ah. Other scholars are of the opinion that it is Wājib (compulsory).

1152.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Performing a ghusl on Cuma is obligatory upon every mature person."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd). The word"obligatory"in this context refers to a self-imposed obligation. For example, a person says to another:"Your right is obligatory upon me."Allāh knows best.
1152.commentary: The aḥādīth mention great faziletler for performing ghusl on the day of Jumu'ah. meselâ, Abū Bakr Ṣiddīq (رضي الله عنه) and 'Imrān ibn Ḥusain (رضي الله عنه) narrate that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "The günahlar and wrongs of one who performs a ghusl on the day of Jumu'ah are forgiven." (Ṭabrānī)

1153.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who performs wuḍū' on the day of Cuma it is good and a nimet, but one who performs ghusl, then ghusl is best."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Nasā'ī, Ibn Mājah)
1153.commentary: Bu hadis as well as birçok others prove that it is helal to perform wuḍū' and proceed for Jumu'ah. bununla birlikte, it is more meritorious to perform ghusl. It is also best that one performs his Jumu'ah ṣalāh with the wuḍū' made during ghusl.

1154.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A person who performs ghusl on the day of Cuma, purifies himself to the best of his ability, applies oil or puts on any perfume he has in his house, then goes out and does not separate between two people, performs whatever namaz is prescribed for him, and is silent when the Imām speaks, then he is forgiven for günahlar committed from then until the next Cuma."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1154.commentary: To purify oneself işaret eder trimming the moustache, clipping the nails, removing the pubic and underarm hair, and wearing clean clothing. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) used to clip his nails and shorten his moustache on the day of Jumu'ah before emerging for ṣalāh.

1155.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who performs ghusl on the day of Cuma, like the ghusl of janābah (major impurity), then proceeds in the first hour, it is as if he has sacrificed a camel. One who proceeds in the second hour, it is as if he has sacrificed a cow. One who proceeds in the third hour, it is as if he has sacrificed a horned ram. One who proceeds in the fourth hour, it is as if he has sacrificed a fowl. One who proceeds in the fifth hour, it is as if he has sacrificed an egg. But, once the Imām comes forward, the angels gather to listen to the advice."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1155.commentary: Bu hadis, Cuma günü namaza erken gitmeyi teşvik eder. Erken giden, büyük sevap kazanır ve hutbeyi kaçırmaz.

1156.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) mentioned the day of Cuma and dedi:"In it is a time when Allāh grants a Müslüman kul standing in namaz whatever he asks for."He indicated with his hand that it was a short time. (Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1156.commentary: There are around fifty farklı views regarding this special moment on the day of Jumu'ah. bununla birlikte, the following two are the çoğu accepted because they are backed by aḥādīth: 1. It is from the time the Imām sits on the pulpit for the sermon until the completion of the ṣalāh. 2. It is shortly before sunset.

1157.narrator: Abū Burdah ibn Abī Mūsā al-Ash'arī (رضي الله عنه)
1157.text: 'Abdullāh ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما) sordu:"Did you hear your father narrating anything from Resûlullah (ﷺ) regarding the special time on the day of Cuma?"I cevap verdi:"Yes. I heard him say that he heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek: 'It is from the time the Imām sits (on the pulpit) until the namaz is completed.'"(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Bayhaqī)
1157.commentary: There are around fifty farklı views regarding this special moment on the day of Jumu'ah. bununla birlikte, the following two are the çoğu accepted because they are backed by aḥādīth. 1. It is from the time the Imām sits on the pulpit for the sermon until the completion of the ṣalāh. 2. It is shortly before sunset. This is the view of 'Abdullāh ibn Salām (رضي الله عنه), Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه), Imām Aḥmad (رحمه الله) and birçok other scholars.

1158.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The best of your days is the day of Cuma, so send abundant salutations to me in it, as your salutations are presented to me."(Abū Dāwūd, Nasā'ī, Ibn Mājah)
1158.commentary: "Your salutations are presented to me" applies to those who recite salutations upon the Messenger (ﷺ) while not in close physical proximity to him. As for those who recite salutations in Masjid al-Nabawī, he (ﷺ) hears them directly as mentioned in the narration of Bayhaqī. The hadis encourages us to send abundant salutations upon the Messenger (ﷺ) on Jumu'ah. bunun sebebi is that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) en hayırlısıdır creation and the day of Jumu'ah en hayırlısıdır days.

1159.narrator: Sa'd bin Ebû Vakkās (رضي الله عنه)
1159.text: We departed from Makkah towards Madīnah with Resûlullah (ﷺ). When we were near 'Azwarā, he dismounted, raised his hands, supplicated to Allāh for some time and fell into prostration for a long time. He then stood up, raised his hands in supplication for some time, and again fell into prostration. He did this three times and dedi: 'I sordu my Sustainer and interceded on behalf of my Ummah. So He gave me a third of my Ummah. So I fell in prostration in şükür to my Sustainer. I then raised my head and sordu Him for my Ummah. He gave me another third of my Ummah. So I fell in prostration in şükür to my Sustainer. I then raised my head and sordu Him for my Ummah. He gave me the final third. So I fell in prostration to my Sustainer."(Abū Dāwūd)
1159.commentary: In this hadis, the Messenger (ﷺ) interceded for his Ummah so that they could bütün enter cennet and none of them would remain in the cehennem-fire forever. His request was granted. According to the Ḥanafī scholars, a prostration of gratitude is Mustaḥab for a person who has acquired a new bounty gibi wealth or children, or if a calamity has been averted from him. One should praise bütünāh (ﷻ) and recite tasbīḥ in the sajdah, then recite takbīr and raise one's head as is done when performing sajdah tilāwah. It is superior, bununla birlikte, to perform two rak'āts of Nafl ṣalāh as this is a more tam expression of gratitude.

1160.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to stand in namaz at night until his feet would become swollen. I sordu him:"Why do you do this when all your past and future günahlar have been forgiven?"He cevap verdi:"Should I not be a grateful kul?"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1160.commentary: 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) thought that the reason for the Messenger (ﷺ) performing excessive ibadetler was in order to seek bağışlanma. bununla birlikte, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) explained that ayrıca to seeking bağışlanma there was another more superior reason, şöyle ki to be grateful that bütünāh (ﷻ) had granted him the ability to perform ibadetler. The more favours bütünāh (ﷻ) bestows upon a person, the greater should be his gratitude in the form of ibadet.

1161.text: One night Resûlullah (ﷺ) came to him and Fāṭimah and dedi:"Are you not going to perform namaz?"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1161.commentary: Ibn Jarīr (رحمه الله) stated that the Messenger (ﷺ) would not have awoken his daughter and cousin at a time which bütünāh (ﷻ) had made for rest, if he had not known the great fazilet of Tahajjud ṣalāh. The fact that he chose for them this fazilet over their comfort proves its önem.

1162.narrator: Sālim ibn 'Abdillāh ibn 'Umar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb (رضي الله عنهما)
1162.text: From his father that Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi:"What an excellent man 'Abdullāh is, if only he performs namaz at night."Sālim dedi:"After hearing this, 'Abdullāh would sleep very little at night."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1162.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki Tahajjud bir vesilesidir perfecting one's spirituality and character.

1163.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
1163.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"O 'Abdullāh, do not be like so-and-so person who used to engage in night ibadet and then abandoned it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1163.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki we should perform optional ibadet in moderation. It is inappropriate to commence a good amel, gibi night ibadet, and then abandon it.

1164.text: A person who slept the entire night until the morning was mentioned in the presence of Resûlullah (ﷺ). He (ﷺ) dedi:"Shaiṭān urinated in his ears,' or he dedi, 'in his ear'."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī)
1164.commentary: Göre bazı scholars, this işaret eder a person who does not perform Fajr ṣalāh. According to others, it işaret eder a person who does not perform Tahajjud. hadis scholars state that, "Shaiṭān urinated in his ears," may have the following meanings: 1. Shaiṭān literally urinates in his ears. 2. It işaret eder a person becoming lazy. 3. It işaret eder Shaiṭān gaining control over a person. 4. It is benzer to the knots used in black magic as described in Sūrah al-Falaq. 5. Shaiṭān has destroyed such a person.

1165.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Shaiṭān ties three knots at the back of your head when you are asleep. Upon every knot, he stamps the words, 'You have a long night ahead of you, so continue sleeping.' If he wakes up and remembers Allāh, one knot is opened. If he performs wuḍū', another knot is opened. If he performs namaz, all the knots are opened. So in the morning he is energetic and cheerful. Otherwise, he wakes up in a bad mood, and lazy."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Ibn Mājah, Bayhaqī)
1165.commentary: Bu hadis explains the önem of Fajr and Tahajjud ṣalāh. "Shaiṭān ties three knots" can have one of the following meanings: 1. It işaret eder a physical knot with a rope which holds a person down. 2. It işaret eder a person becoming lazy. 3. It işaret eder Shaiṭān gaining control over a person. 4. It is benzer to the knots used in black magic. One who awakens for Fajr is cheerful for the following reasons: 1. He knows that bütünāh (ﷻ) has enabled him to ibadet Him. 2. He is hopeful that bütünāh (ﷻ) will sevap and grant him blessings for his ibadet. 3. He knows that bütünāh (ﷻ) will assist him and guide him in his tasks of the day. 4. He is freed from the yokes of Shaiṭān.

1166.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"O people, make the salām common, provide food to the people, perform namaz at night when the people are asleep, and you will enter Cennet in peace."(Tirmidhī, Dārimī)
1166.commentary: Bu hadis daha önceki bir bölümde zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 849. Burada namazda safları sık tutmanın önemini göstermek için tekrarlanmıştır.

1167.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The best fast after Ramaḍān is that of the month of Allāh, al-Muḥarram; and the best namaz after the obligatory namaz is the night namaz."(Müslüman, Nasā'ī)
1167.commentary: The çoğu virtuous of optional ṣalāhs is Tahajjud because it is performed at night and the darkness of the night enhances concentration and tranquillity. This ṣalāh is extremely difficult upon the desires because one has to abandon the warmth of a bed. It is also performed in seclusion, bundan dolayı it prevents pride and ostentation. ayrıca, a person who performs Tahajjud will perform his Farḍ ṣalāh with additional concentration and kulluk.

1168.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The night namaz should be in units of two rak'āts, and if you korku the break of dawn, then add one rak'āt to make it into Witr."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1168.commentary: bütün scholars agree that one may perform Tahajjud ṣalāh in units of two or four, bununla birlikte according to Imām Abū Yūsuf (رحمه الله) and Imām Muḥammad (رحمه الله), two is best, while according to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله), four is best.

1169.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform the night namaz in units of two rak'āts and then add one rak'āt to make it into Witr. (Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah)
1169.commentary: bütün scholars agree that one may perform Tahajjud ṣalāh in units of two or four, bununla birlikte according to Imām Abū Yūsuf (رحمه الله) and Imām Muḥammad (رحمه الله), two is best, while according to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله), four is best.

1170.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to abstain from oruç in a month until we thought that he would not fast in it at all; and at times he used to fast until we thought that he would not break his fast in it at all. If you wanted to see him performing namaz at night you would see him doing so, and if you wanted to see him sleeping you would see him doing so."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1170.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) did not have a fixed alışkanlık of performing optional ṣalāh or observing fasts on particular days. At times he would fast for birçok days and at other times he would not fast. Similarly, he bazen would perform ṣalāh for lengthy periods and at other times he would not. His approach was not excessively harsh upon his carnal self, neither was it excessively lenient. He chose a moderate yol so that his Ummah would not be overburdened.

1171.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) gece on bir rekât namaz kılardı. Secdede o kadar uzun kalırdı ki, biriniz elli âyet okuyana kadar sürerdi. Uykudan önce de iki rekât kılardı. (Buhârî)
1171.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki it is Mustaḥab to lengthen one's sajdah in the night ṣalāh. It is a posture that brings one closest to bütünāh (ﷻ) because it is one of utmost tevazu and submissiveness. The Messenger (ﷺ) would lie down on his doğru so that the Ummah could imitate him and it would serve as a reminder of the posture one will be in when lying down in the grave. This will also lead to increased concentration and kulluk in ṣalāh.

1172.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) would not perform more than eleven rak'āts during Ramaḍān or in any other month. He would perform four rak'āts - do not even ask about their beauty and length – and then another four rak'āts - do not even ask about their beauty and length. He would then perform three rak'āts. I sordu: 'O Messenger of Allāh, do you sleep before performing Witr namaz?' He cevap verdi: 'O 'Ā'ishah, my eyes sleep but my heart does not sleep.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1172.commentary: Bu hadis teaches the following: 1. One should lengthen and beautify one's optional ṣalāh by performing it with kulluk and bütün the Sunnah and Mustaḥab ameller. 2. It was a speciality of the Messengers (عليهم السلام) that after sleeping, their wuḍū' would not be nullified. 3. Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله) deduces from Bu hadis that to perform Tahajjud ṣalāh in units of four is superior, since it involves more effort compared to two rak'āts. While the genel uygulama of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was to perform not more than eleven rak'āts, there were nights when he performed more.

1173.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to sleep in the first part of the night, and stand up in namaz in the latter part."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1173.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki it is best to sleep for the first portion of the night and then wake up and perform Tahajjud ṣalāh in the latter portion of the night.

1174.text: I performed namaz with Resûlullah (ﷺ) one night. He remained standing (in namaz) for so long that I wanted to do something bad."He was sordu:"What did you intend doing?"He cevap verdi:"I wanted to sit down and leave him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1174.commentary: The hadis gives an idea of how lengthy the Messenger's (ﷺ) night ṣalāh was. It also bize öğretir ki it is helal to perform Nafl ṣalāh in a group provided that it is not announced. ayrıca, if a muqtadī cannot stand behind the Imām due to tiredness or illness, he may sit down.

1175.text: I performed namaz with Resûlullah (ﷺ) one night and he began by reciting Sûre al-Baqarah. I thought to myself that he would go into rukū' after reciting 100 verses, but he continued reciting. I then thought that he would complete the Sûre in the namaz (two rak'āts), but he continued. I then thought that he would go into rukū' at the end of the Sûre, but he began reciting Sûre al-Nisā' and completed the entire Sûre. He then began reciting Sûre Āl 'Imrān and completed the entire Sûre. His recitation was slow and measured. When he recited a verse containing glorification, he glorified Allah (ﷻ). When he recited a verse of request, he sordu from Allah (ﷻ). When he recited a verse seeking refuge, he sought refuge (in Allah (ﷻ)). He then went into rukū' and dedi: 'سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ (Glory be to my Sustainer, the Mighty)'. His rukū' was similar to his standing. He then dedi: 'سَمِعَ اللهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ (Allāh hears the one who praises Him. O our Sustainer! All praise is due to You)'. He then remained standing for a long time, almost as long as his rukū'. He then prostrated and dedi: 'سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى (Glory be to my Sustainer, the Most High)'. His prostration was almost as long as his standing."(Müslüman)
1175.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 102. It is repeated here to show how lengthy and splendid the Messenger's (ﷺ) night ṣalāh was. His kulluk in her posture of the ṣalāh can be appreciated from the length of his qirā'ah, rukū' and sajdah. The hadis also bize öğretir ki it is helal in Nafl ṣalāh to make du'ā' after reciting a verse dealing with ümit, korku, etc.

1176.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) was sordu:"Which namaz is the best?"He cevap verdi:"One with the longest standing position."(Müslüman)
1176.commentary: Bu hadise dayanarak İmam Ebû Hanîfe (رحمه الله), namazda uzun kıyamın, çok sayıda namaz kılmaktan daha faziletli olduğu sonucuna varmıştır.

1177.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
1177.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The most beloved namaz to Allāh is the namaz of Dāwūd (عليه السلام) and the most beloved fast to Allāh is the fast of Dāwūd (عليه السلام). He used to sleep for half the night, remain in ibadet for one third of it, and sleep for one sixth of it. He used to fast on one day and not on the next."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1177.commentary: Dāwūd (عليه السلام) used to sleep for two-thirds of the night and then ibadet for the remainder. This olarak kabul edilir the best because when a person rests sufficiently, then he will be able to ibadet His Creator with greater enböyleceiasm and fervour. Fasting on alternate days entails greater sacrifice since the body does not become accustomed to fasting. It is also beneficial for the physical body and genel health because one gains strength by not fasting on alternate days.

1178.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"There is a certain hour during the night wherein whatever good of this world and ahiret a Müslüman asks Allah (ﷻ) for, Allāh will give it to him. This happens every night."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1178.commentary: The fact that this fazilet is found her night shows the superiority of night over day. ilâhî tajalliyāt (radiance) are found her night, whereas in the day, it is found only on the day of Jumu'ah. bütünāh (ﷻ) has kept this hour hidden like the night of Qadr is hidden and the special moment on the day of Jumu'ah when du'ās are accepted is hidden.

1179.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any of you stands up for ibadet at night, he should commence his namaz with two short rak'āts."(Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1179.commentary: Scholars state that the first two rak'āts should be short so that the effect of sleep does not remain and one will gain the energy and enböyleceiasm for the remaining ibadet.

1180.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) used to stand up for ibadet at night, he would commence his namaz with two short rak'āts."(Müslüman, Nasā'ī)
1180.commentary: Scholars state that the first two rak'āts should be short so that the effect of sleep does not remain and one will gain the energy and enböyleceiasm for the remaining ibadet.

1181.text: If Resûlullah (ﷺ) missed out the night namaz because of illness or some other reason, he would offer twelve rak'āts during the day."(Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1181.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki if one misses out an optional ibadet due to bazı reason, then he should perform it later so that the alışkanlık remains and he is not deprived of its blessings.

1182.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who sleeps through his habitual ibadet or any part thereof (at night), and then recites it between the Sabah and Ẓuhr namazs, it will be recorded for him as if he had read it at night."(Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Abū Dāwūd)
1182.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 153. It is the rahmet of bütünāh (ﷻ) that He grants the dolu sevap of an amel if it is performed before the Ẓuhr ṣalāh for one who is ill at night or overpowered by sleep.

1183.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"May Allāh show rahmet upon a man who gets up at night and performs namaz. He wakes up his wife, and if she refuses, he sprinkles some water on her face. May Allāh show rahmet upon a woman who gets up at night and performs namaz. She wakes up her husband, and if he refuses, she sprinkles some water on his face."(Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah, Aḥmad)
1183.commentary: The appeal of the ilâhî is that spouses should assist one another in ameller of ibadet and the itaat of bütünāh (ﷻ) tıpkı... gibi they assist her biri other in dünyevî matters. gibisistance should include advice, teşvik and motivation.

1184.text: Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) and Abū Sa'īd (رضي الله عنه) narrate that Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle dedi:"When a man wakes up his hanım at night and they both perform two rak'āts of namaz together, they are recorded among the men and women who remember Allāh."(Abū Dāwūd)
1184.commentary: "They are recorded among the men and women who remember bütünāh," is a reference to a verse of the Qur'ān in which bütünāh (ﷻ) describes the qualities of the believing men and women, "...and men who remember bütünāh in abundance and women who remember bütünāh, bütünāh has prepared bağışlanma and an immense sevap for them." (Sūrah al-Aḥzāb, 35)

1185.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If any of you dozes off while in namaz, he should lie down until his sleepiness disappears. If any of you performs namaz while he is sleepy, it is possible that he intends seeking bağışlanma, but he curses himself."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1185.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki one who is sleepy should lie down because the main objective of ṣalāh is concentration and this will only be possible when one is energetic and free from tiredness. The sign of a person who is sleepy is when he can hear the söz of others, but he cannot understand its anlam.

1186.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any of you gets up at night and his recitation of the Kur'an is incoherent and he does not know what he is diyerek, then he should lie down."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1186.commentary: tıpkı... gibi one is prohibited from performing ṣalāh when one is sleepy, one should abstain from doing so when one lacks concentration and focus. This applies to bütün ṣalāh whether Nafl, Sunnah or Farḍ, bununla birlikte one should ensure that the stipulated time for ṣalāh does not elapse.

1187.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who stands up for ibadet in Ramaḍān with faith and in expectation of sevap, will be forgiven for his past günahlar."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1187.commentary: The phrase "with iman and in expectation of sevap," demektir ki a person should acknowledge the sevap for fulfilling this emir of bütünāh (ﷻ) and he should perform it with ihlâs and in anticipation of sevap. bağışlanma of günahlar işaret eder minor günahlar. As for major günahlar, tawbah and istighfār are required.

1188.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to encourage the night namaz in Ramaḍān without commanding them to do it as an obligatory duty. He would say: 'One who stands up for ibadet in Ramaḍān with faith and in expectation of sevap, will be forgiven for his past günahlar.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
1188.commentary: Based on this hadis, scholars have deduced that Tarāwīḥ is Sunnah Mu'akkadah. It is also established from other aḥādīth that the Messenger (ﷺ) performed Tarāwīḥ ṣalāh in congregation for three nights. Thereafter he said, "I korku that it may become compulsory upon you," and he did not lead the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) in Tarāwīḥ in the masjid. After the demise of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), this korku no longer remained, bundan dolayı 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) instituted twenty rak'āts of congregational Tarāwīḥ ṣalāh.

1189.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who stands up for ibadet on the night of Qadr with faith and in expectation of sevap, will have his past günahlar forgiven."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1189.commentary: While the kelime قَامَ in Arabic means to stand in ṣalāh, other ibadetler like tilāwah, dhikr and du'ā' are also included in its implication. The bare minimum is that a person should perform his 'Ishā' and Fajr ṣalāhs in congregation. According to bütün the scholars, bağışlanma işaret eder minor günahlar.

1190.text: Some Sahâbe of Resûlullah (ﷺ) were shown in a dream that the night of Qadr is in the last seven nights (of Ramaḍān). The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"I see that your dreams coincide regarding the last seven nights. One who seeks the night of Qadr should seek it in the last seven nights."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1190.commentary: The last seven nights could mean the 21st to the 27th of Ramaḍān, or the 23rd to the 30th of Ramaḍān. According to çoğu scholars, the second view is preferred. It is advisable to search for this night by engaging ayrıcaal ibadet during the last ten nights of Ramaḍān, özellikle the odd nights.

1191.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform I'tikāf in the last ten nights of Ramaḍān and he would say: 'Seek the night of Qadr in the last ten nights of Ramaḍān.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī)
1191.commentary: It is Sunnah to perform I'tikāf in the last ten nights of Ramaḍān. Because one who spends his time in I'tikāf is regarded to be in ibadet bütün the time, such a person is fortunate to receive the sevap of ibadet on the night of Qadr.

1192.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Seek the night of Qadr during the odd nights of the last ten nights of Ramaḍān."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1192.commentary: There are close to fifty farklı opinions in regard to which night is the night of Qadr. While bazı scholars state that the night is restricted to a özel night, others state that it rotates throughout the year. bazı say that it occurs her Ramaḍān and it rotates in the odd nights of the last ten nights. It is advisable to search for this night by engaging ayrıcaal ibadet during the last ten nights of Ramaḍān, özellikle the odd nights.

1193.text: When the last ten nights of Ramaḍān commenced, Resûlullah (ﷺ) would spend the night in ibadet, wake up his family, intensify his ibadet, and fasten his loin cloth."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1193.commentary: Bu hadis demektir ki the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) would generally not engage in ibadet the bütün night, bununla birlikte in the last ten nights of Ramaḍān he would. bu nedenle, during the month of Ramaḍān and özellikle the last ten nights, one should exert oneself in ibadet. "He would fasten his loin cloth," demektir ki he would exert himself in ibadet, or that he would abstain from conjugal relations with his spouses.

1194.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to strive in ibadet in Ramaḍān as compared to other months, and in the last ten nights of Ramaḍān as compared the other nights."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
1194.commentary: The month of Ramaḍān is more virtuous than other months, and the last ten nights of it are even more virtuous. A person should bu nedenle strive to perform ibadetler in this month, özellikle in the last ten days.

1195.text: "Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Kadir gecesinin hangi gece olduğunu bilseydim, o gece nasıl dua etmeliyim?" dedim. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Şöyle de: Allah'ım! Sen affedicisin, affetmeyi seversin, beni affet" buyurdu. (Tirmizî, İbn Mâce)
1195.commentary: "If I were to know the night of Qadr" demektir ki "if I were to see the signs of the night." The hadis bize öğretir ki the greatest objective in the life of a Muslim should be to gain bağışlanma and purity from günahlar.

1196.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If it was not for my korku of overburdening my Ummah – or the people – I would have ordered them to use the miswāk for every namaz."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1196.commentary: The faydalar of the miswāk are birçok, bununla birlikte because the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) possessed extreme merhamet for his Ummah, he did not make it compulsory upon them to utilise it. If it was compulsory, they would have been punished for not using it due to negligence. It is advised to use it before ṣalāh because ṣalāh bir çeşididir communication with bütünāh (ﷻ) and it is only appropriate that one converses with bütünāh (ﷻ) while one's person is pure and clean.

1197.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) used to wake up for the night namaz, he would clean his mouth with the miswāk."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1197.commentary: When a person sleeps, the taste in his mouth changes due to the foul smell emitting from his stomach, bundan dolayı the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) would utilise a miswāk as soon as he woke up from his sleep. To utilise a miswāk as soon as one awakens is Mustaḥab, and to utilise it at the time of wuḍū' is Sunnah.
