1198.text: We used to prepare the Messenger of Allāh'in (ﷺ) miswāk and wuḍū' water and Allāh would make him wake up at whatever time of the night He willed. He would then use the miswāk, perform wuḍū' and perform namaz."(Müslüman, Nasā'ī)
1198.commentary: The pure wives of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) understood the wishes of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and acted to please him. Since he loved to utilise a miswāk when awakening, they would prepare it in advance.

1199.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"I have repeatedly advised you to use the miswāk."(Bukhārī)
1199.commentary: That the Messenger (ﷺ) stressed the use of the miswāk highlights its önem.

1200.text: Shurayḥ ibn Hānī' anlatır:"I sordu 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها): 'What did Resûlullah (ﷺ) do first when he entered his house?' She cevap verdi: 'He used the miswāk.'"(Müslüman)
1200.commentary: tıpkı... gibi a person leaves his home in a clean and presentable şekil, when he returns home he should do the same. Ibn Ḥajar (رحمه الله) stated, "Bu hadis emphasises that her person should make miswāk on entering his home, since this will create a fragrance in his mouth and will lead to a better relationship with his spouse."

1201.text: I went to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and the end of the miswāk was on his tongue."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1201.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki it is Mustaḥab to use the miswāk on the tongue. Shāh Waliyullāh (رحمه الله) stated that a person should use the miswāk even at the extreme rear of the mouth in order to expel the phlegm that accumulates in the throat. When using the miswāk it is best to commence with the doğru side of the upper jaw and then the left side. Thereafter one should do the doğru side of the lower jaw and then the left side.

1202.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The miswāk is purification for the mouth and pleasing to the Sustainer."(Nasā'ī, Ibn Mājah, Aḥmad)
1202.commentary: From this hadis, we learn that two types of faydalar accrue from the use of the miswāk: dünyevî faydalar pertaining to health and the insanî body, and manevî faydalar in the ahiret. The miswāk pleases bütünāh (ﷻ) because it is a Mustaḥab amel and also because it contributes to a fragrant mouth which is used to converse with bütünāh (ﷻ) in ṣalāh.

1203.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The natural disposition of man includes five things - or five things are from the natural disposition of man: circumcision, shaving the pubic hair, clipping the nails, removing the hair from the armpits, and clipping the moustache."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī)
1203.commentary: Fiṭrah (natural disposition) işaret eder the long-standing Sunnah chosen by the Messengers (عليهم السلام) and which conformed to bütün the previous ilâhî religions.

1204.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Ten things are from man'in natural disposition: clipping the moustache, lengthening the beard, using the miswāk, inserting water into the nose, clipping the nails, washing the joints, removing the hair from the armpits, shaving the pubic region, and washing the private parts after relieving oneself."The narrator dedi:"I forgot the tenth thing, but it is most probably rinsing the mouth when performing wuḍū'."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah)
1204.commentary: In the above three aḥādīth, çeşitli things have been specified to be part of the natural disposition of man. These include inserting water into the nose in order to clean it at the time of wuḍū', rinsing the mouth which is Sunnah in wuḍū' and compulsory in ghusl, clipping nails with the doğru hand, washing joints as dirt generally collects at these points, plucking armpit hair (shaving is also helal), shaving pubic hair, and washing the private parts after relieving oneself.

1205.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Clip the moustaches and lengthen the beards."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1205.commentary: The kelime "Aḥfū" means to trim or clip closely. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) commanded the trimming of the moustache and the lengthening of the beard. To keep a fist length beard is Wājib (compulsory) âlimlerin çoğunluğuna göre. The uygulama of keeping a beard is her iki an act of itaat to the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) as well as an emulation of his noble uygulama. It distinguishes a Muslim from the disbelievers, as the Messenger (ﷺ) said: "Oppose the polytheists." It is a demonstration of sevgi for bütünāh (ﷻ) and His Messenger (ﷺ).

1206.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"İslâm is based on five pillars: testifying that there is none worthy of ibadet besides Allāh and that Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh, establishing namaz, giving zekât, performing Hac to the House (Ka'bah), and oruç in Ramaḍān."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1206.commentary: Bu rivayet was mentioned previously. See hadis 1075. It is repeated here to highlight the fact that zakāh is one of the five rükünler of Islām. In the Qur'ān and aḥādīth, giving of zakāh is generally mentioned after ṣalāh due to its great status. Ṣalāh is the çoğu important bodily ibadet, while zakāh is the çoğu important monetary ibadet.

1207.text: A man from Najd came to Resûlullah (ﷺ). His hair was dishevelled. We could hear his voice due to its intensity, but we could not understand what he was diyerek, until he came close to Resûlullah (ﷺ). He was asking about İslâm. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'It is to perform five namazs daily.' He sordu: 'Do I have to perform any more than these?' He cevap verdi: 'No, unless you want to perform optional namaz.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'And to fast the month of Ramaḍān.' He sordu: 'Do I have to fast any more than that?' He cevap verdi: 'No, unless you wish to fast voluntarily.' The man then turned and left diyerek: 'By Allāh I will not increase on this nor decrease from it.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'He will be successful if he has spoken the truth.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1207.commentary: Ḥāfiẓ Ibn Rajab (رحمه الله), while commenting on this hadis, explained that the rükünler of Islām are benzer to the rükünler of a castle or palace which hold up the bütün building by supporting one another. If bütün are standing firm and güçlü, the weight of the bütün palace will be distributed equally between them. bununla birlikte, if any rükün collapses, her one of the remaining rükünler will have to support an additional weight which will finally result in the weakening of bütün the rükünler and, eventually, the weakening of the bütün structure.

1208.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sent Mu'ādh (رضي الله عنه) to Yemen, diyerek:"Invite them to testify that there is none worthy of ibadet except Allāh and that I am the Messenger of Allāh. If they accept this, then inform them that Allah (ﷻ) made five daily namazs compulsory on them. If they accept this, then inform them that Allāh made zekât compulsory on them and it is to be taken from their rich and given to the poor amongst them."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1208.commentary: Bu hadis önemini gösterir zakāh and explains that the affluent should distribute their zakāh amongst the poor in their own communities. Only the poor have been mentioned despite the fact that eight categories of people may accept zakāh because the poor are generally the greatest recipients of zakāh.

1209.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"I have been emretti to fight the people until they testify that there is none worthy of ibadet except Allāh and Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh, they establish namaz and give zekât. When they do that, they will have protected their lives and mal from me except if justified by a right of İslâm. And their accountability is left to Allāh."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1209.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 390. It has been repeated here to show the şiddet of not giving zakāh. Its önem in Islām can be gauged from the fact that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was prepared to fight those who claim to be Muslims, but refuse to give zakāh.

1210.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) passed away and Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) became the khalīf, some Arabs became apostates. 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) dedi to Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه): 'How can you fight the people when Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi: I have been ordered to fight the people until they testify that there is none worthy of ibadet besides Allāh. Whoever says this, will have protected his mal and life from me except if justified by a right (of İslâm), and their accountability is left to Allāh?' Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) dedi: 'By Allāh, I will fight the one who makes a distinction between namaz and zekât, because zekât is the right which is due on mal. By Allāh, if they refuse to give a rope (in zekât) which they used to give to Resûlullah (ﷺ), I will fight them for refusing to give it.' 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) dedi: 'By Allāh, I then realised that since Allāh had expanded the breast of Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) to fight, I accepted it as the truth.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Ibn Mājah, Bayhaqī)
1210.commentary: After the demise of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), four types of apostasy took place: bazı reverted to polytheism, bazı denied the finality of the prophethood, bazı denied the compulsion of zakāh feeling it was only confined to the era of the Messenger (ﷺ), and bazı refused to give the khalīf their zakāh saying they could distribute it themselves. Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) correctly concluded that those who denied zakāh are apostates and should be fought.

1211.text: A man sordu Resûlullah (ﷺ):"Tell me of an action that will ensure my entrance into Cennet."He cevap verdi:"That you ibadet Allāh without ascribing any partner with Him, establish namaz, give zekât, and maintain ties of kinship."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1211.commentary: Four ameller have been mentioned in Bu hadis for entrance into cennet: sahih beliefs, ṣalāh, zakāh and maintaining ties of kinship. sahih beliefs are the core of Islām and then come the haklar of bütünāh (ﷻ) and the haklar of fellow insanî beings. Ṣalāh entails a bodily ibadet, while zakāh entails a monetary ibadet. Maintaining ties of kinship işaret eder fulfilling the haklar of fellow insanî beings.

1212.text: A Bedouin came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, tell me about an action, which if I do, I will enter Cennet."He dedi:"Worship Allāh without ascribing any partner with Him, establish namaz, give the obligatory zekât, and fast in Ramaḍān."He dedi:"Nefsim elinde olan Allah'a yemin ederim ki, I will do no more than this."When he turned to leave, Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi:"One who would like to see one of the inhabitants of Cennet should look at this person."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1212.commentary: Since this Ṣaḥābī had recently accepted Islām, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) sufficed with that which was compulsory for him to practise upon. With time, he would become accustomed to the compulsory ameller, and his heart would be naturally inclined towards progress and optional ibadetler. This bize öğretir ki those who invite to Islām should gradually explain the laws of Islām to others, so that they do not regard Islām as a burden.

1213.text: I pledged allegiance to Resûlullah (ﷺ) to establish namaz, give zekât, and give good advice to every Müslüman."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1213.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 182. It is repeated here to show the önem of zakāh. Scholars state that ṣalāh and zakāh have been mentioned as they are the çoğu important physical and monetary ibadetler, bununla birlikte, bütün the injunctions of Islām are applicable.

1214.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Any person who owns gold and silver and does not give what is due on them, then on the day of Kıyamet, these will be made into slabs of fire, then heated in cehennem ateşi and his side, forehead and back will be stamped with them. Every time they become cool, they will be heated for him for the duration of a day that is equal to 50,000 years until the accounting of deeds is completed and he will be shown his path, either towards Cennet or towards cehennem ateşi."Someone sordu:"O Messenger of Allāh, what about camels?"He cevap verdi:"A person who owns camels and does not fulfil what is due upon them - and one of their rights is that they be milked on the day they are given drinking water - then on the day of Kıyamet he will be flung on his face in a wide open field. His camels will be the largest size they had ever been and not a single young camel will be missing from them. They will trample him with their hooves and bite him with their mouths. When the last of them have passed over him, then the first of them will return to him for the duration of a day that is equal to 50,000 years until the accounting of deeds is completed and he will be shown his path, either towards Cennet or towards cehennem ateşi."Someone sordu:"O Messenger of Allāh, what about cattle and sheep?"He cevap verdi:"A person who owns cattle and sheep and does not fulfil what is due upon them, then on the day of Kıyamet, he will be flung on his face in a wide open field. Not a single one of them will be missing from them, and none of them will have crooked horns, missing horns or broken horns. They will all poke him with their horns and trample him with their hooves. When the last of them have passed over him, then the first of them will return to him for the duration of a day that is equal to 50,000 years until the accounting of deeds is completed and he will be shown his path, either towards Cennet or towards cehennem ateşi."... Someone sordu:"O Messenger of Allāh, what about donkeys?"He cevap verdi:"Nothing has been revealed to me about donkeys apart from this unique and comprehensive verse: 'Whoever does an atom'in weight of good, will see it. Whoever does an atom'in weight of evil, will see it.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1214.commentary: Bu hadis contains a severe uyarı for one who withholds zakāh. Such a person will be punished on the day of Qiyāmah with the very same wealth he had withheld, in order to increase his sorrow and anguish. The phrase, "his side, forehead and back will be stamped with them," is a reference to the verse of the Qur'ān: "The day when it will be heated in the fire of cehennem and their foreheads, their sides and their backs will be branded with it. 'yani what you used to hoard for yourselves, so taste what you used to hoard.'" (Sūrah al-Tawbah, 35)

1215.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) dedi: 'Every action of the son of Ādam is for himself except oruç. It is for Me and I will give the sevap for it.' Fasting is a shield. When any of you is oruç, he should not be obscene nor raise his voice. If anyone is abusive towards him or fights him, he should say: 'I am oruç.' I take an oath by that Being in whose control is the life of Muḥammad, that the smell that emanates from the mouth of a oruç person is more fragrant to Allah (ﷻ) than the fragrance of musk. There are two occasions of joy for the oruç person: when he breaks his fast he rejoices, and when he meets his Sustainer he will rejoice on account of his fast."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1215.commentary: The faziletler of fasting are birçok. Fasting protects a person from going astray in dünya by following his desires, and it saves him from the cehennem-Fire in the ahiret. "Fasting is a shield" because it protects one from indulging in the fulfilment of desires, böylece shielding him from the cehennem-Fire. bütünāh (ﷻ) rewards a fasting person differently from others. bundan dolayı he declares that "fasting is for Me and I will give the sevap for it." bazı of the reasons for this unique sevap are: the degree of ihlâs found in fasting is not found in any other form of ibadet because fasting has no hakiki external form, it is an amel free of pride and boasting, and by fasting one imitates a quality of bütünāh (ﷻ) which is independence of food and drink.

1216.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who spends a pair in the path of Allāh will be summoned from the doors of Cennet: 'O kul of Allāh, this (door) is much better (for you).' One who was regular with his namaz will be called from the door of namaz. One who was regular with cihat will be called from the door of cihat. One who was regular with oruç will be called from the door of al-Rayyān. One who was regular with sadaka will be called from the door of sadaka."Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, may my parents be sacrificed for you. One who is called from any of these doors will have no further need, but will anyone be called from all these doors?"He cevap verdi:"Yes, and I ümit that you will be among them."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1216.commentary: Spending a pair may refer to giving two horses, slaves, camels, etc. in the yol of bütünāh (ﷻ). bazı scholars suggest that it işaret eder giving a male and female animal so that their offspring may cause one to receive the rewards of perpetual ṣadaqah. There are çeşitli doors in cennet and a person will be called to enter the door based on the form of ibadet in which he was çoğu dominantly engaged. Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) gained perfection in bütün forms of ibadet.

1217.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There is a door in Cennet known as al-Rayyān. Those who fast will enter it on the day of Kıyamet, and none besides them will enter it. It will be dedi: 'Where are those who used to fast?' They will stand up and none besides them will enter it. Once they have entered, it will be locked and no one else will enter it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Ibn Mājah, Bayhaqī)
1217.commentary: Scholars state that the fazilet mentioned here is restricted to those who fast optional fasts ayrıca to the fasts of Ramaḍān. The kelime al-Rayyān literally means to be quenched and satiated. It is significant that the door is not called the door of fasting, but the door of satiation. This indicates that the one who endured thirst in the world due to fasting will asla again experience thirst in the ahiret.

1218.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a kullar fasts for a single day in the path of Allāh, Allāh keeps his face at a distance of seventy years' journey away from cehennem ateşi on account of that day."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī, Dārimī)
1218.commentary: Scholars state that bütünāh (ﷻ) will recompense such a person by keeping him away from the heat of the ahiret because he experienced the heat of fasting in the summer months and on hot days. "In the yol of bütünāh," may refer to jihād against the disbelievers or, bazı âlimlere göre, any activity in the yol of bütünāh (ﷻ) gibi Ḥajj, 'Umrah or to propagate the kelime of bütünāh (ﷻ).

1219.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who fasts in Ramaḍān motivated by faith and in expectation of a sevap, will have his past günahlar forgiven."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1219.commentary: By the blessings of the Ramaḍān fasts, bütün a person's minor günahlar are forgiven. If he has no günahlar in his account, then his rank in the ahiret is increased.

1220.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When Ramaḍān comes, the doors of Cennet are opened, the doors of cehennem ateşi are locked, and the Shayāṭīn are chained."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1220.commentary: The fayda of "the doors of cennet being opened" is that more angels descend and praise those who are fasting. The fayda of "the Shayāṭīn being chained" is that they cannot lead the believers towards günah. bazı âlimlere göre, bütün the Shayāṭīn are chained, while according to others, only the extremely rebellious ones are chained. When her iki the enemies of man, şöyle ki his base desires and Shaiṭān are suppressed by fasting and chaining respectively, it allows man to excel in worshipping bütünāh (ﷻ) and gaining the quality of taqwā.

1221.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Commence oruç with the sighting (of the new moon) and end oruç with the sighting (of the new moon). If it (the new moon) is concealed from you (because of clouds), complete thirty days of Sha'bān."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī)
1221.commentary: The hadis demektir ki as long as one does not physically sight the moon or receive news of its sighting by güvenilir testimony on the 29th, he should regard the month to be incomplete. In such a scenario, only after the completion of thirty days, will the next month commence. Islām has stipulated the asıl sighting (ru'yā) of the new moon (hilāl) as the principle for the kararlılık of the commencement of the Islāmic month. Astronomical calculations are not a substitute for the sighting of the moon according to the ijmā' (consensus) of the scholars.

1222.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) was the most generous of people, and he was most generous in Ramaḍān when Jibra'īl would meet him. Jibra'īl used to meet him every night of Ramaḍān and study the Kur'an with him. When he would meet Jibra'īl, Resûlullah (ﷺ) used to be more generous with good deeds than the blowing wind."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1222.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was the çoğu generous of people. birçok examples of his generosity are found in the books of aḥādīth. bununla birlikte in Ramaḍān, his generosity knew no bounds. One of the reasons for this is that the blessedness of Ramaḍān encourages one to do noble ameller. Secondly, as angels have no desire for dünyevî wealth, the Messenger's (ﷺ) increased interaction with Jibra'īl in Ramaḍān influenced him to spend more in charity. The Messenger's (ﷺ) generosity is compared to a güçlü wind because of their similarity in intensity, continuity and genel impact.

1223.text: When the last ten nights of Ramaḍān commenced, Resûlullah (ﷺ) would spend the night in ibadet, wake up his family, and fasten his loin cloth."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1223.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 1193. It is repeated here to show the intensity of the Messenger's (ﷺ) ibadet during the last ten nights of Ramaḍān, and the teşvik he gave to his family members to do the same.

1224.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"None of you should fast one or two days before Ramaḍān except a person who normally fasts on such a day. He may fast on that day."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1224.commentary: One is prohibited from fasting one or two days before Ramaḍān as this will outwardly seem that one is adding to the fasts of Ramaḍān. bununla birlikte, if one is in the alışkanlık of fasting on that day, şöyle ki a Monday and Thursday, or her alternate day, then there is no harm in fasting.

1225.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not fast before Ramaḍān. Commence the fast with the sighting of the new moon and end the fast with the sighting of the new moon. If clouds conceal its sighting, then complete thirty days."(Tirmidhī, Nasā'ī)
1225.commentary: Scholars state that it is Wājib 'alal-kifāyah for the Muslims to search for the moon on the 29th of Sha'bān and Ramaḍān, so that they commence and end their fasts on the doğru days.

1226.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When half the month of Sha'bān remains, do not fast."(Tirmidhī)
1226.commentary: Yasağın sebebi, Ramazan'dan hemen önce oruç tutmanın, Ramazan orucuna güçsüz başlamaya yol açabileceği ve şüpheli günlerde oruç tutmanın sünnete aykırı olmasıdır.

1227.narrator: Abū al-Yaqẓān 'Ammār ibn Yāsir (رضي الله عنهما)
1227.text: Şüpheli günde oruç tutan, Ebû'l-Kâsım (ﷺ)'e isyan etmiş olur." (Ebû Dâvûd, Tirmizî)
1227.commentary: The day in which there is doubt is the 30th of Sha'bān because it is possible that Ramaḍān may have commenced. As long as the moon is not sighted or there are no güvenilir witnesses, it is Makrūh to keep any Farḍ, Wājib or Nafl fast on this day. bununla birlikte, a person who is in the alışkanlık of fasting on that day is allowed to do so, meselâ one who fasts her Monday and Thursday, or her alternate day.

1228.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) saw the new moon, he would say,"O Allāh, let this new moon appear before us with peace, faith, security and İslâm. My Sustainer and your Sustainer is Allāh. Let this moon be one of guidance and goodness."(Tirmidhī, Dārimī, Abū Dāwūd)
1228.commentary: Scholars state that one who sees the new moon should recite any of the Sunnah du'ās, gibi the one mentioned in this hadis, in emulation of the noble uygulama of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). In this du'ā' one seeks koruma from bütün dangers, illnesses and loss, while requesting bütünāh (ﷻ) for istikrar on īmān and Islām. The beyan, "my Sustainer and your Sustainer is bütünāh" demektir ki "we are her iki subservient to the will of bütünāh." This is to ward off the incorrect inanç of bazı people who claim that the moon can fayda and harm.

1229.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Have suḥūr as there is nimet in it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1229.commentary: Suḥūr işaret eder the food eaten before dawn. While bazı are of the opinion that it begins after half the night has passed, it is better to delay it until shortly before Fajr. One should bununla birlikte ensure that one does not delay it to such an extent that it extends into the time of Fajr. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) teşvik edilen suḥūr in a number of narrations, bundan dolayı if no food is available to consume for suḥūr, a person should at least eat a date or have a sip of water.

1230.text: We had suḥūr with Resûlullah (ﷺ) and then proceeded to perform namaz."Someone sordu him:"What was the time span between the two?"He cevap verdi:"The time it takes to recite fifty verses."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1230.commentary: Bu hadis gives us an idea of the timespan between suḥūr and the Fajr ṣalāh. It takes approximately 10-15 minutes to recite fifty verses of the Qur'ān, bundan dolayı the suḥūr should be delayed to shortly before dawn. The Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) used to indicate time periods by means of righteous ameller, gibi the recitation of fifty verses of the Qur'ān, the slaughtering of a camel and distribution of its meat, etc.

1231.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) had two mu'adh-dhins: Bilāl (رضي الله عنه) and Ibn Umm Maktūm (رضي الله عنه). The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Bilāl calls out the adhān at night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktūm calls out the adhān.' Ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) dedi: 'The time span between the two adhāns was only long enough for one of them to come down and the other to climb up.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1231.commentary: Resûlullah (ﷺ) döneminde Ramazan ayında iki fazla ezan okunurdu. Bunlardan biri sahur vaktini bildirir, diğeri iftar vaktini bildirirdi.

1232.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The difference between our oruç and the oruç of the people of the Book is in the partaking of suḥūr."(Müslüman)
1232.commentary: The Jews and Christians would eat before sleeping because it was haram for them to awaken, eat and then fast. The same hüküm was found in the beginning stages of Islām, and later abrogated. bundan dolayı, suḥūr is one of the specialities of the Ummah of the Messenger (ﷺ).

1233.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"People will remain on goodness as long as they hasten to break the fast."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
1233.commentary: It is Mustaḥab for the fasting person to hasten in breaking his fast after the setting of the sun is established. There are çeşitli wisdoms in this: opposing the ways of the Jews, Christians and Shī'as, making things easier for people by granting them more strength for ibadetler, saving people from excesses and extremes and preventing the boundaries of Islām from being eroded.

1234.text: Abū 'Aṭiyyah anlatır:"Masrūq and I went to 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) and Masrūq dedi to her: 'There are two Sahâbe of Resûlullah (ﷺ) and neither of them slacken in doing good. One of them hastens in performing Akşam namaz and in breaking the fast, while the other delays in performing Akşam namaz and in breaking the fast.' She sordu: 'Who hastens in performing Akşam namaz and breaking the fast?' He cevap verdi: 'Abdullāh – i.e. Ibn Mas'ūd.' She dedi: 'This is what Resûlullah (ﷺ) used to do.'"(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1234.commentary: "İki sahâbî" ifadesi Abdullah bin Mes'ûd (رضي الله عنه) ve Ebû Mûsâ el-Eş'arî (رضي الله عنه)'ye atıfta bulunur. İkisi de Ömer (رضي الله عنه) tarafından teravih namazını kıldırmak üzere gönderilmişti.

1235.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) dedi: 'The most beloved of My kullar to Me are those who are quickest in breaking the fast.'"(Tirmidhī)
1235.commentary: One can attain the sevgi of bütünāh (ﷻ) by following in the blessed footsteps of His beloved Messenger (ﷺ), and one of the ways of doing so is to hasten in breaking one's fast.

1236.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When the night advances from this side, the day withdraws from this side, and the sun sets, then the oruç person has broken his fast."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1236.commentary: "Oruçlu kişi orucunu bozmuştur" ifadesi iki anlama gelebilir: Ya oruçlu kişiye orucu bozmanın caiz olduğu bildirilmektedir ya da bu bir bilgi verme ifadesidir.

1237.narrator: Abū Ibrāhīm 'Abdullāh ibn Abī Aufā (رضي الله عنهما)
1237.text: We were on a journey with Resûlullah (ﷺ) while he was oruç. When the sun set, he dedi to someone: 'O so-and-so person, dismount and prepare some sawīq for us.' He dedi: 'O Messenger of Allāh, would you not like to wait for the night?' He dedi: 'Dismount and prepare some sawīq for us.' He dedi: 'It is still daytime.' He dedi: 'Dismount and prepare some sawīq for us.' So he dismounted and prepared the sawīq. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) drank it and dedi: 'When you see the night advancing from this side, then the oruç person has broken his fast,' and he pointed with his hand towards the east."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1237.commentary: Bu hadis, önceki hadisler gibi, bir kişinin orucunu açmak için acele etmesi gerektiğini vurgular. İftarı geciktirmek sünnete aykırıdır.

1238.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any of you breaks his fast, he should do so with dates. If he does not find any dates, then he should break his fast with water because it purifies."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah, Aḥmad)
1238.commentary: Orucu hurmayla açmak beden için faydalıdır çünkü mide boşken hurma hemen enerji verir ve sindirimi kolaydır.

1239.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) namazdan önce taze hurmayla orucunu açardı. Taze hurma bulamazsa kuru hurmayla, o da yoksa birkaç yudum suyla açardı. (Tirmizî, Ebû Dâvûd)
1239.commentary: The chemical composition of dates shows that they contain çeşitli minerals which are beneficial for the body. bazı of these are sodium, potassium, calcium, magnesium, copper, iron, phosphorus, sulphur and chlorine. They also contain proteins, fats, carbohydrates and calories. Also, when fasting from morning to evening, the temperature of the body decreases and dates provide the required balance. Dates are rich in iron, which faydalar those who have a deficiency of iron in the blood.

1240.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any of you fasts, he should not engage in futile conversations nor raise his voice. If anyone is abusive towards him or fights him, he should say: 'I am oruç.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1240.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 1215. It explains that a fasting person should abstain from any such söz or amel which is contrary to the haysiyet and restraint required of him. Instead of utilising the tongue and limbs in sinful avenues, one should engage in Qur'ān tilāwah, dhikr, du'ā', etc.

1241.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh does not require a person to abstain from food and drink if he does not abstain from speaking lies and acting upon them."(Bukhārī, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1241.commentary: Bu hadis indicates that a fasting person who indulges in lies will not receive any ilâhî sevap for his endeavours even though he will be absolved of the compulsion of the fast. While the hadis only mentions lies, her sinful söz is included gibi yanlış testimony, backbiting, slandering, vulgar language, futile conversation, arguing, etc. Basically, a fasting person needs to abstain from her form of söz which bütünāh (ﷻ) has haram.

1242.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If any of you eats or drinks forgetfully, he should complete his fast, as Allāh fed him and made him drink."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1242.commentary: If a fasting person forgetfully eats, drinks or engages in conjugal relations, his fast will not be nullified, whether it is a Farḍ, Nafl or Qaḍā fast. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "One who breaks his fast in Ramaḍān forgetfully, then there is no Qaḍā or kaffārah upon him." (Ibn Ḥibbān, Ḥākim) bununla birlikte according to Imām Mālik (رحمه الله), if a person eats forgetfully in Ramaḍān, he will be required to perform a Qaḍā of that fast.

1243.text: I sordu: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Tell me about wuḍū'.' He dedi: 'Perform wuḍū' thoroughly, pass water between the fingers, and place water into the nose thoroughly, unless you are oruç.'"(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah, Bayhaqī)
1243.commentary: In this hadis, the Ṣaḥābī asked the Messenger (ﷺ) how he could mükemmel his wuḍū'. The Messenger (ﷺ) advised him to adhere to bütün the Sunnah and Mustaḥab ameller, to perform khilāl of the fingers, and to place water into the nose thoroughly. This last instruction demektir ki water should be allowed to reach up to the soft part of the nose. bununla birlikte, while fasting one should not place water as high up into the nose nor gargle intensely because if water goes down the throat the fast will be nullified.

1244.text: At times Resûlullah (ﷺ) would rise in the morning in a state of janābah (major impurity) due to engaging in conjugal relations with his wife. He would perform ghusl and fast."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1244.commentary: The hadis explains that a person in the state of major impurity, does not need to perform ghusl before the time of Fajr enters for his fast to be geçerli. He may make his niyet to fast in this state, and then perform a ghusl after the time of suḥūr has expired. bütün the four Imāms agree upon this.

1245.narrator: Âişe and Umm Salamah (رضي الله عنهما)
1245.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to rise in the morning in a state of janābah (major impurity) not due to a wet dream and he would then fast."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1245.commentary: This hüküm also applies to a person who has a wet dream before the commencement of the fast. bunun sebebi is that when a person is allowed to begin the fast after sexual relations which is a voluntary amel, then to a greater extent will he be allowed to fast after having a wet dream which is an involuntary amel. One should not delay a compulsory ghusl unnecessarily.

1246.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The best fast after Ramaḍān is the month of Allāh, al-Muḥarram, and the best namaz after the obligatory namazs is the night namaz."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1246.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 1167. bazı scholars mention that the fazilet of al-Muḥarram is due to the fast of 'Āshūrā', while others state that the fazilet is associated with fasting on any of the days during this month. Al-Muḥarram has been referred to as "the month of bütünāh" despite bütün the months being the months of bütünāh (ﷻ). This is due to the honour and saygı of this month, tıpkı... gibi the Qur'ān mentions the "camel of bütünāh" and the "house of bütünāh" as a sign of saygı.

1247.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) hiçbir ayda Şaban ayında olduğu kadar çok oruç tutmazdı. Şaban'ın çoğunu oruçlu geçirirdi. (Buhârî, Müslim)
1247.commentary: Another hadis highlights the reason why the Messenger (ﷺ) fasted in Sha'bān. Usāmah (رضي الله عنه) asked the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ): "I do not see you fasting in any other month as you fast in Sha'bān?" He replied, "This is a month between Rajab and Ramaḍān which people are unmindful of. It is a month in which my ameller are presented in the court of the Sustainer of the Universe. I like that my ameller be presented while I am in the state of fasting." (Nasā'ī)

1248.text: Mujībah al-Bāhiliyyah anlatır from her father or her uncle that he went to Resûlullah (ﷺ). He then left and returned to him a year later, when his condition and appearance had changed. He dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, do you not recognise me?"He sordu:"Who are you?"He cevap verdi:"I am the Bāhilī who had come to you last year."He sordu:"What has changed your appearance? You were good in appearance."He dedi:"From the time I left you, I abstained from eating food except at night."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"You have tortured yourself."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) then dedi:"You should fast in the month of sabır (i.e. Ramaḍān) and one day of every month."He dedi:"Allow me to do more as I have the strength."He dedi:"Fast for two days."He dedi:"Allow me to do more."He dedi:"Fast for three days."He dedi:"Allow me to do more."He dedi:"Fast in the sacred months then stop. Fast in the sacred months then stop."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) spoke while pointing with his three fingers by joining them together and then separating them."(Abū Dāwūd)
1248.commentary: It is Mustaḥab to keep optional fasts, as an expression of sevgi for bütünāh (ﷻ) and His Messenger (ﷺ), özellikle in the sacred months (al-Muḥarram, Rajab, Dhul Qa'dah and Dhul Ḥijjah). bununla birlikte, it is Makrūh to fast throughout the year if one fears harm coming to himself or if it will cause others to be deprived of their haklar. For one who is safe from these two fears, it is helal to fast for the bütün year besides the five prohibited days. "You have tortured yourself," demektir ki you have harmed yourself by opposing the nebevî teachings.

1249.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There are no days in which good actions are more beloved to Allāh than during these days,"namely the first ten days of Dhul Ḥijjah. The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) sordu:"O Messenger of Allāh, not even cihat in the path of Allāh?"He cevap verdi:"Not even cihat in the path of Allāh except for a person who goes for cihat with his life and his mal and returns with nothing."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1249.commentary: The first ten days of Dhul Ḥijjah are greatly meritorious. bütünāh (ﷻ) has taken an oath on these blessed days to show their greatness: "By the dawn and the ten nights." (Sūrah al-Fajr, 1-2). birçok commentators of the Qur'ān are of the view that these nights refer to the first ten nights of Dhul Ḥijjah. Goods ameller done during these days draw great rewards. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "There are no days more beloved to bütünāh for His ibadet than the ten days of Dhul Ḥijjah. The fast of her day equals a year, and the ibadet of her biri night equals Lailat al-Qadr." (Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah)

1250.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) was sordu about oruç on the day of 'Arafah. He dedi:"It expiates the günahlar of the past year and the coming year."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1250.commentary: The day of 'Arafah, şöyle ki the 9th of Dhul Ḥijjah, is a day of great blessings. It was the day when the verse on the completion and perfection of Islām was given to the Muslims. In a narration, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "The çoğu virtuous of days is the day of 'Arafah." (Ibn Ḥibbān) The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) also said, "There is no day in which bütünāh (ﷻ) frees more of his servants from the cehennem-Fire than the day of 'Arafah." (Tirmidhī) The fast referred to in Bu hadis is not for those who are performing Ḥaj because it will deprive them of the strength needed to perform dhikr, talbīyah, du'ā' and the remaining rites of Ḥaj.

1251.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) fasted on the day of 'Āshūrā' and ordered it be fasted."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1251.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) went through four stages regarding the fast of 'Āshūrā'. First, he would fast whilst in Makkah Mukarramah, but would not emir others to do so. (Bukhārī) Second, when he arrived in Madīnah Munawwarah, he saw the Jews and Christians fasting and honouring this day. When he enquired why, he was told that this was the day in which bütünāh (ﷻ) had saved Mūsā (عليه السلام) and his people from the tyranny of Fir'awn and his army. Mūsā (عليه السلام), out of gratitude, would fast on this day. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "We have a greater doğru to Mūsā (عليه السلام) than you." He then commanded the Ṣaḥābah to fast on that day. (Bukhārī) Third, when the fasting in Ramaḍān became compulsory, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) gave the Ṣaḥābah the choice to fast on this day. He no longer commanded it but merely mentioned its fazilet.

1252.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) was sordu about oruç on the day of 'Āshūrā'. He dedi:"It is expiation for the past year."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1252.commentary: One may question why only the past year's günahlar are forgiven with the fast of 'Āshūrā' whilst the previous and coming year's günahlar are forgiven with the fast of 'Arafah. One answer on this is that fasting on the day of 'Arafah is from the din of Muhammed (ﷺ), whilst the fast of 'Āshūrā' is from the din of Mūsā (عليه السلام), bu nedenle, fasting on the day of 'Arafah is more virtuous.

1253.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If I remain alive until next year, I will fast on the 9th."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1253.commentary: When the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) arrived in Madīnah Munawwarah after the Hijrah, he preferred conformity with the Jews and Christians in matters wherein he was not provided with a particular emir, özellikle when such a course of amel was contrary to that of the idol-worshippers. bununla birlikte, after Makkah Mukarramah was conquered and Islām spread, he preferred to oppose the ways of even the Jews and Christians, showing yanilāmic ideals and values are unique.

1254.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who fasts for the month of Ramaḍān and then follows it with six fasts in Shawwāl, it is as if he had fasted for the entire year."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah)
1254.commentary: The phrase, "six fasts" is genel and indicates that a person may fast any six days of Shawwāl. bununla birlikte, it is preferable that the fasts be kept immediately after 'Īd al-Fiṭr. Scholars have mentioned çeşitli faydalar of fasting these six extra fasts: fasting thirty days of Ramaḍān followed by another six in Shawwāl equals thirty-six in total, and a believer's ameller are multiplied by ten, bundan dolayı one will attain the sevap of fasting for the bütün year; the fasting of Sha'bān and Shawwāl are benzer to the Sunnah ṣalāhs before and after the Farḍ ṣalāh, in making up for any deficiencies in the latter; one who fasts in Shawwāl shows that he did not regard the Ramaḍān fasts as a burden, and that his good ameller have not terminated with the termination of Ramaḍān.

1255.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) was sordu about oruç on Mondays. He dedi:"That is the day on which I was born, and the day on which I was commissioned as a Messenger – or when revelation descended upon me."(Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1255.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was born in Rabī' al-Awwal on a Monday and revelation commenced on a Monday, the 17th Ramaḍān. her iki of these events were great bounties in their own doğru, bundan dolayı, as an expression of gratitude, one may fast on Mondays.

1256.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Actions are presented on Mondays and Thursdays, so I like my actions to be presented while I am oruç."(Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah)
1256.commentary: Müslim'in bir hadisi daha fazla detay verir: "İnsanların amelleri haftada iki kere Pazartesi ve Perşembe günleri Allah'a arz edilir."

1257.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) Pazartesi ve Perşembe günleri oruç tutmayı dört gözle beklerdi. (Tirmizî, Nesâî, İbn Mâce)
1257.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) would eagerly look forward to fasting on Mondays and Thursdays due to the faziletler associated with these days.

1258.text: My bosom friend (Muhammed (ﷺ)) advised me to do three things: to fast for three days every month, to perform two rak'āts of Ṣalāt al-Ḍuḥā, and to perform the Witr namaz before sleeping."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1258.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 1139. It is repeated here to highlight the önem of fasting for three days her month. One may fast on any three days during the month, bununla birlikte the best days are those of the Ayyām al-Bīḍ. It is best to fast on the 'Ayyām al-Bīḍ', which are the 13th, 14th and 15th of her month. Others state the 12th, 13th and 14th. The more sahih and popular opinion is the first opinion.

1259.text: My beloved friend (Muhammed (ﷺ)) advised me to do three things and I will not omit them as long as I live: to fast for three days every month, to perform the Ṣalāt al-Ḍuḥā, and that I should not sleep until I perform the Witr namaz."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1259.commentary: Those who are not in the alışkanlık of awakening in the last portion of the night to perform Tahajjud ṣalāh, should perform their Witr before sleeping. Otherwise, it is best to perform the Witr ṣalāh in the last portion of the night.

1260.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
1260.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Fasting for three days every month is equivalent to oruç the entire year."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1260.commentary: On kat sevap verilen bir amel olduğu için, ayda üç gün oruç tutarak kişi tüm ayı oruçlu geçirmiş gibi sevap kazanır.

1261.text: Mu'ādhah al-'Adawiyyah anlatır that she sordu 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها):"Did Resûlullah (ﷺ) keep fast for three days every month?"She cevap verdi:"Yes."I sordu:"Which part of the month did he fast?"She cevap verdi:"He did not fast any specific days of the month."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah)
1261.commentary: Bu hadis, kişinin ayın herhangi üç gününde oruç tutabileceğini gösterir. Bununla birlikte, eyyâm-ı bîz (13, 14, 15. günler) daha faziletlidir.

1262.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If you fast for three days a month, fast on the 13th, 14th and 15th."(Tirmidhī, Nasā'ī)
1262.commentary: bazı scholars have suggested that these days are called Ayyām al-Bīḍ, because when a person fasts during them, the darkness of his günahlar will be removed and his ahiret will be illuminated with sevap.

1263.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) eyyâm-ı bîz'da (on üç, on dört ve on beşinci günlerde) oruç tutmamızı emrederdi. (Nesâî)
1263.commentary: Scholars have suggested that the hikmet of fasting on these days is that when light encompasses the night due to the dolu moon, it is appropriate to fill the day with ibadetler. Others have suggested that we are commanded to gain closeness to bütünāh (ﷻ) during these days because an eclipse, when it occurs, normally occurs during these nights.

1264.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) evde veya yolculukta eyyâm-ı bîz orucunu terk etmezdi. (Nesâî)
1264.commentary: Bu hadis highlights the önem the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) gave to fasting on the Ayyām al-Bīḍ, as he would not omit them whether at home or travelling.

1265.narrator: Zeyd bin Hâlid el-Cühenî (رضي الله عنه)
1265.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who feeds a oruç person at ifṭār receives a sevap similar to his without the sevap of the oruç person decreasing in any way."(Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah, Dārimī)
1265.commentary: The hadis provides teşvik to feed a fasting person. One of the faydalar of this noble amel is that it generates sevgi and unity amongst Muslims. It also serves to assist a Muslim in an act of itaat. It is bütünāh's (ﷻ) rahmet that He grants such great rewards for such small acts of iyilik. Another hadis sheds further light on this virtuous amel. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "One who feeds a fasting person at ifṭār, it bir vesilesidir bağışlanma for him and özgürlük from the Fire. He will receive a benzer sevap as the fasting person without the sevap of the fasting person decreasing in any yol." The Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) asked, "O Messenger of bütünāh, not bütün of us have the ability to feed a fasting person." The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) replied, "bütünāh gives this sevap to the one who gives a fasting person even a date, a sip of water or a sip of milk." (Ibn Khuzaymah, Bayhaqī)

1266.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) came to her and she presented him with some food. He dedi:"Eat!"She cevap verdi:"I am oruç."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"The angels supplicate for a oruç person when people eat in his presence until they finish."Or perhaps he dedi:"Until they are satiated."(Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah, Aḥmad, Dārimī)
1266.commentary: The angels seek bağışlanma and supplicate for rahmet on behalf of those who are fasting when food is eaten in their presence, because of their sabır and sacrifice. Leaders should visit their subordinates.

1267.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) went to Sa'd ibn 'Ubādah (رضي الله عنه) who brought some bread and olive oil to him. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) ate and dedi: 'May you host those who are oruç for ifṭār, may salih people eat your food, and may the angels supplicate for you.'"(Abū Dāwūd)
1267.commentary: It is Mustaḥab for the fasting person to supplicate with these sözler for the one who presents him with food for ifṭār. "May you host those who are fasting for ifṭār," is a du'ā' which means, "May bütünāh grant you the sevap of those who feed a fasting person." "May righteous people eat your food," is a du'ā' for good health, 'āfiyah (well-being), abundance of provisions and the company of the pious. "May the angels supplicate for you," is a du'ā' for istikrar on īmān because angels only supplicate for people of īmān. It is an effective du'ā' because the du'ās of the angels are readily accepted by bütünāh (ﷻ). It is not contrary to generosity for a host to present his guest with whatever food he can easily acquire.

1268.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform I'tikāf for the last ten days of Ramaḍān."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1268.commentary: I'tikāf means to remain in a masjid for the purpose of ibadet and to gain the closeness of bütünāh (ﷻ) by engaging in iyilikler. That the Messenger (ﷺ) consistently performed I'tikāf her year shows that it is Sunnah Mu'akkadah in the last ten days of Ramaḍān. bazı of the wisdoms and faydalar of I'tikāf are as follows: in a masjid, one is saved from evil company and faydalar from the company of the pious and those who perform extra ibadetler gibi Tahajjud, tilāwah, dhikr, etc.; one's heart is freed of dünyevî thoughts and has the opportunity of focussing towards bütünāh (ﷻ), granting one the ability to attain the gerçek radiance and blessings of ibadet; one is saved from the birçok günahlar which generally arise due to meeting people and being involved in business endeavours; the house of bütünāh (ﷻ) is a fortified area where Shaiṭān cannot influence a person as he normally does elsewhere; one who is in I'tikāf, is perpetually in the remembrance and ibadet of bütünāh (ﷻ) tıpkı the angels; as long as one remains in I'tikāf, one attains the sevap of ibadet, even if one is sleeping; as one is considered to be in perpetual ibadet, one receives the sevap of ibadet on Lailat al-Qadr. Imām Zuhrī (رحمه الله) stated that I'tikāf was an ibadet which the Messenger (ﷺ) asla omitted from the time he arrived in Madīnah Munawwarah until the end of his life. This indicates the önem he gave to it.

1269.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform I'tikāf for the last ten days of Ramaḍān until Allāh brought about his demise. Thereafter, his wives performed I'tikāf after him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1269.commentary: During the last ten days of Ramaḍān, I'tikāf is Sunnah for women tıpkı... gibi it is for men. Bu hadis explains that after the demise of the Messenger (ﷺ), the noble wives of the Messenger (ﷺ) would sit in I'tikāf. A woman should confine herself to a specified place in her home and dedicate herself to ṣalāh and other ibadetler during this time. As fasting is a şart for I'tikāf, she may not sit in I'tikāf if she is in her menstrual period. A married woman also requires the consent of her husband to perform I'tikāf.

1270.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to perform I'tikāf for ten days every Ramaḍān. In the year of his demise, he kıldı I'tikāf for twenty days."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
1270.commentary: When the Messenger (ﷺ) realised that his demise was close he doubled his efforts in ibadet. bundan dolayı, he revised the Qur'ān with Jibra'īl twice in the last year of his life as opposed to once. Similarly, as mentioned in this hadis, he doubled the amount of time he spent in I'tikāf. This serves as a ders for the Ummah to increase in ibadet during old age.

1271.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"İslâm is based on five pillars: testifying that there is none worthy of ibadet besides Allāh and that Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh, establishing namaz, giving zekât, Ḥaj to the House (Ka'bah), and oruç in Ramaḍān."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1271.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 1075. It is repeated here to show that Ḥaj is one of the fundamental rükünler of Islām. One who denies its farz leaves the fold of Islām.

1272.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) addressed us diyerek: 'O people, Allāh made the Ḥaj obligatory upon you, so perform Ḥaj.' A man sordu: 'Every year, O Messenger of Allāh?' He remained silent and the person sordu the question three times. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) then dedi: 'If I dedi yes, then it would become obligatory, and you would not be able to do it.' He then dedi: 'Leave me as I am, as long as I leave you as you are. Those before you were destroyed because of their excessive questioning and arguing with their Messengers. When I order you to do something, do it as best you can. When I prohibit you from doing something, abstain from it.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1272.commentary: It is compulsory, for a person who has the ability, to perform Ḥaj once in a lifetime. The principle of doing good to the best of one's ability and abstaining totally from yanlış, is a pivotal principle of Islām. birçok laws and regulations are derived from it. özetle, it demektir ki a person should practise upon the commands of bütünāh according to his ability, bununla birlikte günahlar and prohibitions should be abandoned in totality.

1273.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) was sordu:"Which is the best of actions?"He cevap verdi:"Belief in Allāh and His Messenger."He was sordu:"Then what?"He cevap verdi:"Jihād in the path of Allāh."He was sordu:"Then what?"He cevap verdi:"A Ḥaj Mabrūr."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1273.commentary: The kelime "Mabrūr" is derived from the kelime birr which means itaat. bu nedenle, a Ḥaj Mabrūr işaret eder that Ḥaj in which a person does not commit any act of isyan, even if it be minor. bazı scholars have stated that it is a Ḥaj in which there is no show and ostentation. Another view is that it işaret eder an accepted Ḥaj. Bu hadis shows the noble status of Ḥaj in Islām as well as the great sevap it entails. This is on şart that a person performs Ḥaj with ihlâs and abstains from bütün forms of günah.

1274.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"One who performs Ḥaj without committing any obscenity or immorality returns as he was on the day his mother gave birth to him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1274.commentary: Obscenity (رفث) işaret eder sexual intercourse, uttering obscenities or discussing obscene matters with the opposite gender. Immorality (فسق) işaret eder bütün forms of günah, fighting and immoral behaviour. According to the majority of the scholars, major as well as minor günahlar are forgiven when performing Ḥaj. bununla birlikte, the haklar of bütünāh gibi missed ṣalāhs, fasts, zakāh, etc., and the haklar of people gibi debts, trusts, etc. will still have to be discharged, after performing Ḥaj. başka bir deyişle, the günah is forgiven but the doğru is not waived.

1275.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One Umre to the next Umre is expiation for whatever is committed between them, and there is no sevap for a Ḥaj Mabrūr except Cennet."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Mālik, Bayhaqī)
1275.commentary: Bu hadis mentions the sevap of performing Ḥaj and 'Umrah. The fayda for one who performs a Ḥaj Mabrūr is that he will be inspired to repent from bütün his günahlar, and he will be granted the ability to abstain from these günahlar for the remainder of his life, or repent from them if he indulges in them. He will bu nedenle enter cennet, as the hadis states. According to Imām Shāfi'ī, it is Farḍ to perform 'Umrah tıpkı... gibi it is Farḍ to perform Ḥaj. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah, to perform 'Umrah once in a lifetime is Sunnah Mu'akkadah.

1276.text: "Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Biz cihadı amellerin en faziletlisi sayıyoruz. Cihada çıkmayalım mı?" dedim. Resûlullah (ﷺ): "Hayır, Allah yolunda cihad en faziletli ameldir" buyurdu. Ancak hac ve umre için izin istediğimde: "Allah'ım! Onu bağışla, ona merhamet et" diyerek elini kaldırdı. (Nesâî)
1276.commentary: Bu hadis explains that, for women, the greatest form of jihād is a Ḥaj Mabrūr. aslında the narration of Bukhārī clearly states, "Your jihād is Ḥaj."

1277.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There is no day on which Allāh frees more kullar from the Hell-Fire than the day of 'Arafah."(Müslüman, Ibn Mājah, Nasā'ī, Dāraquṭnī)
1277.commentary: The day of 'Arafah is a day when bütünāh's rahmet descends in torrents. bütünāh boasts about His servants before the angels and forgives people more than He does on other occasions.

1278.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"An Umre performed in Ramaḍān is equivalent to Ḥaj or a Ḥaj with me."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Abū Dāwūd)
1278.commentary: Bu hadis, Ramazan'da umre yapmanın büyük faziletini gösterir. Ramazan'da umrenin sevabı hac sevabına denktir.

1279.text: A woman dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, Allāh made the Ḥaj obligatory on His kullar. It is obligatory on my father now that he is an old man and cannot remain firm on a conveyance. Can I perform the Ḥaj on his behalf?"He cevap verdi:"Yes."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1279.commentary: Scholars state that one may perform Ḥaj on behalf of another if the latter pays his expenses and commands him to go, or makes a bequest to this effect at the time of his death. bazı âlimlere göre, parents are excluded from this rule, bundan dolayı if children want to perform Ḥaj on their parent's behalf, they may do so, even if they were not commanded or the parent did not make a bequest to this effect. The hadis proves the önem of Ḥaj as it highlights that if a person is unable to perform Ḥaj, then he should appoint someone on his behalf to do so.

1280.text: He gitti to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and şöyle dedi:"My baba is an yaşlı adam. He cannot perform Ḥaj, Umre or undertake a yolculuk."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) şöyle dedi:"Perform Ḥaj and Umre on behalf of your baba."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah, Nasā'ī)
1280.commentary: If Ḥaj is Farḍ on a person, and he is unable to perform it due to bazı excuse which will remain until death, gibi old age, blindness or paralysis, then another person may perform Ḥaj on his behalf. This is acceptable on şart that the excused person instructs the other to perform Ḥaj and pays for bütün his expenses.

1281.text: Yedi yaşımdayken Resûlullah (ﷺ) ile Veda Haccı'nda hacca götürüldüm." (Buhârî)
1281.commentary: Göre the majority of the scholars, if an immature child performs Ḥaj, it will be geçerli and regarded as an optional Ḥaj. After he reaches maturity, he will have to repeat the Ḥaj if it is compulsory upon him. The fayda of a child performing Ḥaj is that he will become accustomed to the rites of Ḥaj.

1282.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) met a group of travellers at al-Rawḥā' and sordu:"Who are you?"They cevap verdi:"We are Müslümans,"and they then sordu him,"Who are you?"He cevap verdi:"I am the Messenger of Allāh."A woman (from among them) lifted up her child and sordu:"Can this one perform Ḥaj?"He cevap verdi:"Yes, and you will receive the sevap."(Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Bayhaqī)
1282.commentary: Ḥaj is not compulsory upon an immature child, and if he performs Ḥaj it will be regarded as an optional Ḥaj. Scholars state that any good amel performed by a child is written in his favour, whereas no günah is written against him if he does a yanlış amel. Similarly, the rewards of a child's good ameller are recorded in his guardian's favour, but not his günahlar.

1283.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) kıldı Ḥaj on a deve which also served to carry his belongings."(Bukhārī, Abū Dāwūd)
1283.commentary: This işaret eder Ḥajjat al-Wadā' as the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) did not perform any other Ḥaj after migrating to Madīnah Munawwarah. The hadis demektir ki the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) did not have any separate camel for his food and possessions. The camel that he rode was used to carry his provisions. This işaret eder the tevazu of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) and his indifference to possessions of this dünya hayatı.

1284.text: 'Ukāz, Mijannah and Dhul Majāz were markets in the days of ignorance and people considered it a günah to conduct business during the Ḥaj period. Then the verse was revealed: 'There is no günah on you to seek the bounty of your Sustainer,' during the Ḥaj season."(Bukhārī)
1284.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki conducting business during the period of Ḥaj is helal. Scholars, bununla birlikte mention, that it is best for a Ḥājī not to engage in business as it diverts one's focus from bütünāh. The market of 'Ukāz was held in the first twenty days of Dhul Qa'dah between Najd and Ṭā'if, Mijannah was held in the last ten days of Dhul Qa'dah close to Makkah Mukarramah and Dhul Majāz' was held in the first eight days of Dhul Ḥijjah. Thereafter bütün the pilgrims would go to Mīnā.

1285.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) was sordu:"Which action is the best?"He cevap verdi:"Belief in Allāh and His Messenger."He was sordu:"Then what?"He cevap verdi:"Jihād in the path of Allāh."He was sordu:"Then what?"He cevap verdi:"A Ḥaj Mabrūr."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1285.commentary: In çeşitli aḥādīth, farklı ameller are said to be çoğu superior. These differences can be attributed to differences in time, circumstances and the type of person who posed the question. meselâ, ṣalāh is generally more virtuous than giving charity, bununla birlikte when people are faced with starvation, then the sevap of giving charity will surpass that of ṣalāh. Similarly, in the beginning of Islām, jihād was amongst the çoğu virtuous of ameller because it led to the establishment and consolidation of Islām.

1286.text: I sordu Resûlullah (ﷺ): 'Which action is the most beloved to Allāh?' He cevap verdi: 'namaz at its prescribed time.' I sordu: 'Then what?' He dedi: 'Obedience to parents.' I sordu: 'Then what?' He dedi: 'Jihād in the path of Allāh.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1286.commentary: 'bütünāmah Qurṭubī stated that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) specifically mentioned these three ameller since they are symbolic of the other ibadetler. A person who does not perform his Farḍ ṣalāhs, despite it being so easy and so greatly meritorious, will to a greater extent leave out other ibadetler. A person who is not obedient to his parents, despite their haklar being so birçok, will be less obedient to others. A person who abstains from jihād with the disbelievers despite their extreme enmity for Islām will to a greater extent abstain from jihād against sinners and wrongdoers.

1287.text: I sordu: 'O Messenger of Allāh, which action is the best?' He cevap verdi: 'Belief in Allāh and cihat in His path.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī, Bayhaqī)
1287.commentary: Bu hadis, iman ve cihadın İslâm'daki yüksek mertebesini gösterir. Cihad, İslâm'ın en faziletli amellerindendir.

1288.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Going out in the path of Allāh in the morning or in the evening is better than the world and whatever it contains."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī)
1288.commentary: The sözler of the hadis imply that even a short while spent in the yol of bütünāh is great in the sight of bütünāh. The sevap in cennet has been compared with dünyevî riches simply because the latter are perceivable and loved by man. gerçekte, there can be no comparison because the treasures of cennet far exceed those of dünya, and the bounties of dünya are temporary whilst the treasures of the ahiret are eternal. One who attains the lowest stage in cennet will be given a space equal to ten times dünya.

1289.text: A man came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and sordu:"Who is the best of people?"He cevap verdi:"A mümin who wages cihat with his life and mal in the path of Allāh."The man sordu:"Then who?"He cevap verdi:"A mümin residing (alone) in a valley, worshiping Allāh and sparing the people from his evil."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī)
1289.commentary: A hadis with benzer wording was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 598. It is repeated here to show the fazilet of jihād. It bize öğretir ki the best of people are those who strive with their lives and wealth to bring Islām alive in the world. bununla birlikte, if a person cannot do so due to korku of harm coming to his din, then it will be best to ibadet bütünāh in solitude. He should keep away from people with the niyet that they are saved from his evil, and not because they are evil as this indicates vanity.

1290.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Guarding the İslâmic borders for one day in the path of Allāh is better than this world and whatever is on it. The place in Cennet of one of your whips is better than the world and whatever is on it. An evening or morning spent in the path of Allāh is better than the world and whatever is on it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Ibn Mājah)
1290.commentary: Bu hadis encourages us to guard the Islāmic frontiers and engage in jihād to spread the kelime of bütünāh. A whip occupies a very small area, bundan dolayı the hadis shows the immense treasures of cennet compared to the paltry wealth of this fleeting world.

1291.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim: 'Guarding the İslâmic borders for a day and night is better than oruç and night ibadet for a month. If one passes away while doing so, the actions that he used to do will continue to be recorded in his favour, his sustenance will continue, and he will be safe from the tribulations of the grave.'"(Müslüman, Nasā'ī)
1291.commentary: The hadis mentions three faziletler of one who guards the Islāmic borders. Firstly, his ilâhî rewards will perpetually accrue in his favour. Secondly, he will continue receiving his sustenance in cennet tıpkı... gibi the martyrs receive the fruits of cennet. Thirdly, he will be saved from tribulations in the grave. Scholars deduce from Bu hadis that a murābiṭ (one who guards the Islāmic borders) will not be questioned in the grave. Others state that he will be questioned, but in such a şekil that will not frighten him. The reason for ribāṭ being better than fasting and staying awake in ibadet is that ribāṭ protects the din and property of birçok, whereas the fayda of fasting and individual ibadet is confined to an individual.

1292.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The actions of every deceased person are sealed except for a murābiṭ in the path of Allāh. His actions continue increasing until the day of Kıyamet and he is saved from the trials and tribulations of the grave."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1292.commentary: That bütünāh guarantees a murābiṭ cennet is based on the Qur'ānic verse, "Indeed bütünāh has purchased from the believers their lives and wealth so that they may have cennet. They fight in bütünāh's yol killing and being killed. This is bütünāh's vaad yani binding in the Tawrāh, the Injīl and the Qur'ān. Who fulfils their vaad better than bütünāh? So rejoice with your bargain that you have made. This is the supreme success." (Sūrah Tawbah, 111)

1293.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim: 'Guarding the İslâmic borders for a single day in the path of Allāh is better than a thousand days in other places.'"(Tirmidhī, Nasā'ī, Dārimī)
1293.commentary: Bu hadis, İslâm sınırlarını tek bir gün bile korumanın büyük faziletini vurgular. Ribât, dünya ve ahiret hayırlarını toplar.

1294.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh takes responsibility for the person who goes out in His path: I guarantee one who goes out for no other reason than cihat in My path, belief in Me and affirmation of My Messengers of either admitting him into Cennet or returning him to his home from which he left after acquiring sevap or booty. I take an oath by that Being in whose control is the life of Muḥammad, any injury sustained in the path of Allāh will appear on the day of Kıyamet as it was on the day that it was inflicted. Its colour will be that of blood, but its fragrance will be that of musk. I take an oath by that Being in whose control is the life of Muḥammad, if it were not that it would cause difficulty to the Müslümans, I would never stay behind from any military expedition in the path of Allāh. However, I do not have the means to provide them with conveyances and neither do they have the means, and they would find it difficult to remain behind if I went out. I take an oath by that Being in whose control is the life of Muḥammad, I would love to wage cihat in the path of Allāh and be killed, and then wage cihat and be killed, and then wage cihat and be killed."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1294.commentary: Bu hadis explains that ihlâs in jihād earns a person one of two bounties: cennet, or booty and sevap in the ahiret. It also highlights the fervour for jihād and martyrdom which the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) possessed. During his life, he did not participate in bazı battles because there were bazı Ṣaḥābah who could not participate due to poverty, and if the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) had gone out, their sorrow at being left behind would have caused them much difficulty. This again was indicative of his sevgi and affection for the Ummah. Scholars state that the sweet fragrance emitting from the wounds of a mujāhid on the day of Qiyāmah will be in order to reveal his honour of sacrificing his life for bütünāh's pleasure.

1295.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Every person who is injured in the path of Allāh, will come on the day of Kıyamet with his wound bleeding. Its colour will be that of blood, but its fragrance will be that of musk."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1295.commentary: Bu hadis highlights the special status which will be granted to those who are injured in the yol of bütünāh. tıpkı... gibi they bled in dünya, they will be brought forward bleeding on the day of Qiyāmah in order to show their status and fazilet. For this reason, scholars state that a martyr should be buried with his blood and clothing, without being given a ghusl.

1296.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A Müslüman who fights in the path of Allāh for the time taken between two milkings of a camel, Cennet becomes incumbent for him. One who suffers an injury or is afflicted by a misfortune in the path of Allāh, it will appear on the day of Kıyamet as severest as it ever was: its colour will be that of saffron and its fragrance will be that of musk."(Tirmidhī, Abū Dāwūd, Nasā'ī)
1296.commentary: The time period between two milkings of a camel is extremely short, bundan dolayı if a person engages in jihād for even such a minimal period, cennet becomes incumbent for him. This will of course depend on his ihlâs.

1297.text: One of the Sahâbe of Resûlullah (ﷺ) passed by a valley in which there was a spring of sweet water. He was attracted to it and dedi to himself:"If only I could withdraw from the people and settle in this valley. But, I will not do so until I ask the Messenger of Allāh'in (ﷺ) permission."He mentioned it to Resûlullah (ﷺ) who dedi to him:"Do not do it. The standing of any of you in the path of Allāh is better than his namaz in his house for seventy years. Would you not love Allāh to bağışla you and admit you into Cennet? Wage cihat in the path of Allāh. One who fights in the path of Allāh for the time taken between two milkings of a camel, Cennet becomes incumbent for him."(Tirmidhī, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī, Ḥākim)
1297.commentary: Göre the majority of the scholars, jihād is the best bodily ibadet at a time when the disbelievers attack the Muslim lands and there is genuine korku that they will gain dominance over the Muslims. bununla birlikte until şartlar do not reach this stage, ṣalāh will be the best bodily ibadet. One should daima seek guidance from the senior scholars tıpkı... gibi the Ṣaḥābah sought izin from the Messenger (ﷺ) before embarking on any new venture. Living among people and bearing their difficulties is more virtuous than staying in solitude. This was the genel uygulama of the Messengers, the Ṣaḥābah and those who came after them. bununla birlikte, if it becomes difficult to preserve one's din, then it will be helal to adopt solitude.

1298.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) was sordu:"What is equal to cihat in the path of Allāh?"He cevap verdi:"You will not be able to do it."The Sahâbe repeated the question twice or thrice, and each time he cevap verdi:"You will not be able to do it."He then dedi:"A mujāhid in the path of Allāh is like that person who fasts (during the day), worships at night, remains devoted to the verses of Allāh, and does not abandon oruç nor namaz until the mujāhid in the path of Allāh returns."In the narration of Bukhārī: A man dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, guide me to an action that is equal to cihat."He cevap verdi:"I cannot find it."He then dedi:"Are you able, when the mujāhid goes out, to enter your mescid and stand in namaz without stopping and fast without breaking your fast?"The man dedi:"Who can do that?"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1298.commentary: The mujāhid in the yol of bütünāh earns the sevap of a person who fasts throughout the day and worships throughout the night. If a person wishes to earn this sevap without going out in jihād, he will have to continually fast and stand in ibadet until the mujāhid returns. This is of course humanly impossible.

1299.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One of the best livelihoods that people can have is that of a man who holds on to the reins of his horse in the path of Allāh, jumping onto its back; whenever he hears of a battle or danger, he hurries towards it, seeking the killing or death that he expects. (Another is that of) a man who tends to sheep at the top of one of these mountains or the bottom of one of these valleys, establishing namaz, giving zekât, and worshipping his Sustainer until death comes to him. He does not meddle in the affairs of people except in good."(Müslüman)
1299.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 601. It has been repeated here to show the fazilet of being prepared for jihād at bütün times. It also mentions the fazilet of a person who remains in solitude at a time when he needs to protect his iman.

1300.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There are one hundred stages in Cennet which Allāh has prepared for the mujāhidīn in the path of Allāh. The distance between one stage and the next is like the distance between the heavens and the earth."(Bukhārī)
1300.commentary: Bu hadis shows the lofty ranks which the mujāhidīn will receive in the ahiret because of their noble objective of spreading the din of bütünāh.

1301.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Cennet is incumbent for one who is pleased with Allāh as Sustainer, İslâm as religion, and Muhammed (ﷺ) as Messenger."Abū Sa'īd was amazed by this, so he dedi:"Repeat it to me, O Messenger of Allāh."He repeated it and then dedi:"There is something else by which Allāh raises a kul by a hundred stages in Cennet, and the distance between one stage and the next is like the distance between the heavens and the earth."He sordu:"What is it, O Messenger of Allāh?"He cevap verdi:"Jihād in the path of Allāh. Jihād in the path of Allāh."(Müslüman, Nasā'ī, Ḥākim)
1301.commentary: Göre the ameller of people, they will be awarded farklı ranks and stages in cennet. A Muslim should be desirous of doing as birçok good ameller as possible so that he may be granted the highest of ranks. One such good amel by which one can attain a lofty rank is to engage in jihād.

1302.narrator: Abū Bakr ibn Abī Mūsā al-Ash'arī narrates: While my father was in the face of the enemy, I heard him saying: "The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ)
1302.text: 'The doors of Cennet are beneath the shadows of the swords.'"A man with tattered clothing stood up and dedi:"O Abū Mūsā, did you really hear Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek this?"He cevap verdi:"Yes."So he returned to his companions and dedi:"I hereby convey my greetings to you."He then broke the sheath of his sword, threw it away and walked with his sword towards the enemy striking with it until he was killed."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
1302.commentary: "The doors of cennet are beneath the shadows of the swords," explains the fazilet of jihād in the yol of bütünāh by means of a vivid description. One is teşvik edilen to proceed close to the enemy so that his sword is over the enemies heads, and by striking their necks, one will be rewarded with cennet. Another possible anlam of the expression is that if one is attacked by the disbelievers with their swords above him and he passes away, he will be admitted directly into cennet.

1303.narrator: Abd al-Raḥmān ibn Jabr (رضي الله عنه)
1303.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The Hell-fire will not touch a kul whose feet become dusty in the path of Allāh."(Bukhārī, Bayhaqī)
1303.commentary: The hadis demektir ki when one proceeds in the yol of bütünāh, the dust particles which settle on his body will prevent the fire of cehennem from burning him. Even though the primary focus of Bu hadis is the mujāhidīn who fight in the yol of bütünāh, the vastness of the term, "in the yol of bütünāh", may include those who go out to seek knowledge, those who proceed for Ḥaj and those who spread the din of bütünāh.

1304.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A person who cries out of the korku of Allāh will not enter cehennem ateşi until milk returns to the udders. Dust in the path of Allāh and the smoke of cehennem ateşi can never combine for a kul of Allāh."(Tirmidhī, Nasā'ī, Ibn Mājah)
1304.commentary: Abū 'Imrān narrated that Abū al-Jild stated, "I read that Dāwūd asked bütünāh, 'O bütünāh, what is the sevap for a person who cries due to Your korku until his tears flow on his face?' bütünāh replied, 'I will protect his face from the flames of the cehennem-Fire and I will grant him safety on the day of terror.'" The phrase "until milk returns to the udders," is used as an example to show the impossibility of a person who cries out of the korku of bütünāh entering the cehennem-fire. The reference to smoke instead of the fire itself, indicates the tremendous distance such a person will be from the cehennem-fire.

1305.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"There are two types of eyes which cehennem ateşi will not touch: an eye which cries out of the korku of Allāh and an eye which keeps guard in the path of Allāh."(Tirmidhī)
1305.commentary: These two groups of people will be saved from the Fire of cehennem because they possessed gerçek inanç in bütünāh and were daima conscious of His presence. If this is their sevap, one can only imagine the sevap of those who expend their dolu energies for defending and propagating Islām. The eyes are mentioned because they were utilised to perform the iyilik and were the cause of his salvation. The kelime خشية has been used in Bu hadis to show that it işaret eder such korku which is based on the recognition of bütünāh and His grandeur, and not natural korku which one has for a wild animal, etc.

1306.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who equips a mujāhid in the path of Allāh has gone out in cihat himself. One who takes care of a mujāhid'in family in his absence has gone out in cihat himself."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī, Dārimī)
