1306.commentary: Bu hadis encourages Muslims to aid and assist one another in acts of salih amel and takvâ. bundan dolayı, those who equip a mujāhid or see to the needs of his family will receive the sevap of proceeding in the yol of bütünāh. Seeing to their needs includes spending on them, defending them, or assisting them in any yol.

1307.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The best form of sadaka is the shade of a tent in the path of Allāh, the gift of a kul in the path of Allāh, or providing a strong camel in the path of Allāh."(Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1307.commentary: Bu hadis provides teşvik for Muslims to assist the mujāhidīn with goods of comfort and strength which will assist them in their cause. The shade of a tent işaret eder a tent by which the mujāhidīn may gain comfort and rest. The gift of a servant işaret eder a servant who will assist and serve the mujāhidīn. Providing a güçlü camel means providing a camel which will serve as a source of milk, transportation and food for the mujāhidīn.

1308.text: A youth from the Banū Aslam tribe dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, I want to go out in cihat but I do not have anything to equip myself."He dedi:"Go to so and-so person who made preparations (for cihat) but fell ill."The youth went to him and dedi:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) has conveyed his greetings to you and dedi that you should give me the equipment which you prepared (for cihat)."He called out to his wife and dedi:"Give him whatever equipment I prepared and do not withhold anything. By Allāh, if you withhold anything from him, you will not be blessed therein."(Müslüman)
1308.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 176. It is repeated here to highlight the fazilet of going out in jihād. It bize öğretir ki if a person is unable to go out in jihād for bazı reason, then he should assist others to do so. One who assists others will gain barakah in his own wealth.

1309.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sent an order to the Banū Liḥyān, diyerek:"For every two men, one of them should go out and the sevap will be shared between the two."Another narration of Müslüman states:"One man from every two men should go out."He then dedi to the one who remained behind:"Whoever among you takes good care of the family and property of the one who goes out will receive half the sevap of the one who goes out."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1309.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki if there is no need for bütün the people to go out in jihād, then bazı should remain behind to see to the needs of the community. The two narrations seem to contradict her biri other. The first states that her iki will receive the same sevap while the second states that one will receive half the sevap. Scholars have explained this as follows: 1. The kelime "half" in the second narration is an addition by a narrator, bundan dolayı it is not part of the original hadis. 2. Ibn Ḥajar stated that when the dolu sevap is divided between the two, her biri of them will receive an equal portion, şöyle ki half.

1310.text: A man who was covered in steel armour came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, should I go out to fight or should I embrace İslâm?"He cevap verdi:"Embrace İslâm and then go out to fight."The man embraced İslâm and went out to fight and was killed. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"His action was little but his sevap is great."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1310.commentary: The hadis highlights the great fazilet of attaining martyrdom in the yol of bütünāh. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) told him to first embrace Islām and then go out to fight because Islām is a prerequisite for the acceptance of any good amel. If the person had fought without being a Muslim, his jihād would not have earned ilâhî sevap.

1311.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"No one who enters Cennet would like to return to this world even if he possesses everything that is on the earth, except for a martyr. He will desire to return to this world and be killed ten times because of the honour that he experiences."Another narration has:"Because of the virtue of martyrdom which he experiences."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1311.commentary: Bu hadis işaret eder the fazilet of martyrdom in the yol of bütünāh and encourages participation in jihād. After experiencing the bounties of the ahiret, no person - except a martyr - will desire to return to dünya as he will realise that it is a place of defects, deficiencies, imperfections, pain and sorrow, whereas cennet is a place of perfection, üstünlük, enjoyment and bliss.

1312.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
1312.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh forgives every wrong of a martyr except debts."Another narration has:"Being killed in the path of Allāh expiates everything except debts."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1312.commentary: Scholars state that, in a broader context, debts refer to bütün haklar which one owes to fellow insanî beings. başka bir deyişle, the hadis demektir ki a martyr will be forgiven for bütün his wrongs pertaining to the haklar of bütünāh, bununla birlikte the haklar of people will still have to be fulfilled, whether monetary or otherwise.

1313.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) stood up among them and mentioned that cihat in the path of Allāh and belief in Allāh were the best of actions. So a man stood up and dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, tell me, if I am killed in the path of Allāh, will that expiate my günahlar?"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"Yes. If you are killed in the path of Allāh and you are patient, expecting Allāh'in sevap, advancing and not fleeing."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) then dedi:"What did you just ask?"He dedi:"Tell me, if I am killed in the path of Allāh, will that expiate my günahlar?"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"Yes, if you are patient, expecting Allāh'in sevap, advancing and not fleeing - except for debts. Jibra'īl told me this."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Nasā'ī, Dārimī)
1313.commentary: Giving one's life in the yol of bütünāh is the greatest manifestation of one's kölelik and sacrifice, bundan dolayı bütünāh is extremely pleased on witnessing this and forgives bütün günahlar out of His iyilik. bağışlanma of günahlar is conditional upon ihlâs. bundan dolayı, one who fights for reasons gibi fame, gaining booty or unjust patriotism to one's tribe or country will not gain this sevap. 'bütünāmah Qurṭubī stated that debts here apply to those people who are able to pay their debts but do not do so. As for those who intend to pay, but do not possess the means, it is hoped that through the rahmet of bütünāh, He will please their creditors on the day of Qiyāmah.

1314.text: A man sordu:"O Messenger of Allāh, where will I be if I am killed?"He cevap verdi:"In Cennet."The man then threw down some dates that were in his hand and fought until he was killed. (Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1314.commentary: Bu hadis daha önce zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 89.

1315.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) and his Sahâbe proceeded and reached Badr before the polytheists. The polytheists then arrived. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"None of you should proceed with anything unless I approve."The polytheists drew near and Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi:"Rise towards Cennet whose breadth is the heavens and the earth."'Umayr ibn al-Ḥumām dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, the width of Cennet is like that of the heavens and the earth?"He cevap verdi:"Yes."He dedi:"Excellent, excellent!"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sordu him:"Why did you say, 'Excellent, excellent?'"He cevap verdi:"By Allāh, nothing except the ümit that I will be from among its inhabitants."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"You are from among its inhabitants."He then took out some dates from his pouch and began eating them, but then dedi:"If I live long enough to eat these dates, it will be a life too long."He tossed aside the dates he had with him and fought the enemy until he was killed. (Müslüman)
1315.commentary: The hadis teaches us the fazilet of fighting in the yol of bütünāh. It also gives us a glimpse into the lives of the Ṣaḥābah. Their enböyleceiasm to sacrifice their lives in jihād due to their īmān in bütünāh and His Messenger's (ﷺ) promises was extraordinary. cennet is far greater in size than the heavens and the earth, but this description is used here so that man may understand the size of cennet according to his level of perception.

1316.text: Some people came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) requesting him to send some men who would teach them the Kur'an and the Sünnet. So he sent them seventy men from the Anṣār who were known as the Qurrā' (expert reciters of the Kur'an). Among them was my uncle, Ḥarām. During the night, they would recite, study and learn the Kur'an among themselves. During the day, they would bring water and place it in the mescid. They would also gather firewood which they would sell and use the proceeds to purchase food for the people of Ṣuffah and the poor. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sent them, but those people ambushed them and killed them before they could reach their destination. They dedi:"O Allāh, convey our message to our Messenger that we have met You, we are pleased with You, and You are pleased with us."A person came to Ḥarām, the uncle of Anas, from behind and stabbed him with a spear so that it went right through him. Ḥarām dedi:"By the Sustainer of the Ka'bah, I have achieved my goal."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"Your brothers have been killed and they dedi: 'O Allāh, convey to our Messenger that we have met You, we are pleased with You, and You are pleased with us.'"(Bukhārī, Ḥākim)
1316.commentary: Bu hadis describes the incident of the seventy Qurrā' who were martyred while on their yol to teach the Qur'ān to a group of people from Najd. While travelling, they were ambushed and murdered by the enemy of bütünāh, Amir ibn Ṭufail, and a group of people from the tribes of Ra'l, Zakwān and Sulaym. It highlights the courage of the Ṣaḥābah who were daima ready to serve Islām by sacrificing their lives. They were pleased with the decision of bütünāh and bütünāh honoured them by sending revelation to the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) informing him of their sevap.

1317.text: My uncle, Anas ibn al-Naḍr (رضي الله عنه), was not present for the battle of Badr and he dedi: 'O Messenger of Allāh, I was absent from the first battle in which you fought against the polytheists. If Allāh gives me the opportunity to fight the polytheists, Allāh will show what I will do.' When the battle of Uḥud took place, the Müslümans were exposed (when a group of them left their posts), so he dedi: 'O Allāh, I ask You to excuse what these people (i.e. Müslümans) have done and I absolve myself to You from what these people (i.e. polytheists) have done.' He then advanced and Sa'd ibn Mu'ādh met him, so he dedi: 'O Sa'd ibn Mu'ādh, by the Lord of the Ka'bah, I desire Cennet. I can smell its fragrance from a place closer than Mount Uḥud.' Sa'd (رضي الله عنه) dedi: 'O Messenger of Allāh, I was unable to do what he did.' Anas (رضي الله عنه) says: 'We found him with more than 80 sword strikes, spear stabs and arrow shots. We found that he had been killed and that the polytheists had mutilated his body. None could recognise him except his sister who looked at his fingertips.' Anas (رضي الله عنه) says: 'We believed that this verse was revealed with regard to him and others like him:"Among the müminler there are men who are true to the pledge which they made to Allāh..."' (Sûre al-Aḥzāb, 23)"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1317.commentary: Bu hadis daha önce zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 109. Burada Allah yolunda öldürülenlerin diriler arasında rızıklandırıldığını göstermek için tekrarlanmıştır.

1318.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Last night I dreamt that two men came to me and we climbed a tree together. They then led me into a house that was most beautiful and magnificent. I have never seen a house more beautiful than it. They dedi: 'This house is the house of the martyrs.'"(Bukhārī)
1318.commentary: The hadis highlights the lofty rank of the martyrs. The dreams of the Messengers are gerçek. Angels are able to appear in insanî form.

1319.text: Umm al-Rubayyi' bint al-Barā', the mother of Ḥārithah ibn Surāqah, came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, will you not tell me about Ḥārithah?"He had been killed at the battle of Badr."If he is in Cennet, I will exercise sabır. If it is otherwise, I will cry profusely for him."He cevap verdi:"O mother of Ḥārithah, there are many levels in Cennet and your son has achieved the highest - al-Firdaus."(Bukhārī, Tirmidhī)
1319.commentary: cennet has birçok stages. The martyrs, due to their ultimate sacrifice of life, are honoured with the highest stage, şöyle ki al-Firdaus. In another hadis, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) advised, "When you ask bütünāh, then ask for al-Firdaus. It is the highest stage in cennet. Above it is the throne of al-Raḥmān. From it, flow the rivers of cennet." The Ṣaḥābiyah chose to cry over her son if he was not in cennet because this was before the battle of Badr and the law of yasak was revealed after the battle of Uḥud.

1320.text: My father was brought to Resûlullah (ﷺ), and his body had been mutilated. He was placed before Resûlullah (ﷺ). I was about to uncover his face but my people stopped me. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'The angels are shading him with their wings.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1320.commentary: Bu olay Uhud Savaşı sırasında müşriklerin Resûlullah (ﷺ)'e karşı işledikleri vahşeti anlatır.

1321.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who sincerely requests Allāh for martyrdom, Allāh will make him reach the ranks of the martyrs even if he dies on his bed."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1321.commentary: Bu hadis daha önce zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 57. Burada sabır ve sebatın faziletini vurgulamak için tekrarlanmıştır.

1322.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who sincerely seeks martyrdom will receive its sevap even if he does not die as a martyr."(Müslüman)
1322.commentary: Bu hadis reiterates the previous hadis, emphasizing that sincere niyetler are rewarded by bütünāh even if the amel is not carried out.

1323.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The pain of death which a martyr experiences is like the pain which one of you experiences from the bite of an ant."(Tirmidhī, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1323.commentary: tıpkı... gibi a person does not feel the bite of an ant, a martyr in the yol of bütünāh experiences no hakiki pain at the time of death. bunun sebebi is that he is made to witness the enjoyments prepared for him in cennet, and bütün other difficulties seem insignificant and trivial in comparison.

1324.narrator: Abdullāh ibn Abī Aufā (رضي الله عنهما)
1324.text: On one occasion when Resûlullah (ﷺ) confronted the enemy, he waited until the sun passed its zenith. He then stood up and dedi:"O people, do not desire to meet the enemy. Ask Allāh for well-being. But when you do meet the enemy, remain steadfast. Know that Cennet lies beneath the shade of the swords."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) then dedi:"O Allāh, the One who revealed the Book, the One who sends clouds and the One who defeats the armies of disbelievers, defeat them and help us against them."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1324.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 53. Revelation of the book işaret eder a bounty of the ahiret, şöyle ki Islām. The clouds refer to a dünyevî bounty, şöyle ki rain which brings sustenance. Defeating the enemy brings bounties relating to dünya and the ahiret. The Messenger's (ﷺ) praising the being who grants bütün these bounties serves as a mükemmel prelude to the request made in the du'ā'.

1325.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Two things are not rejected – or rarely rejected – a supplication at the time of the call to namaz (adhān) and in battle when they are fighting the enemy."(Abū Dāwūd, Bayhaqī)
1325.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki it is desirable to supplicate at these two times when du'ās are readily accepted. Scholars state that the hadis also indicates that one should focus one's attention towards bütünāh when seeking help and victory. At the time of ṣalāh, one's hidden enemy, şöyle ki Shaiṭān, tries to cause manevî harm, and at the time of war, one's open enemy tries to cause physical harm. bundan dolayı, at these times, bütünāh's special assistance comes to those who turn their attention to Him.

1326.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) used to go out on cihat, he would say: 'O Allāh, You are my support and You are my helper. Through Your help I move, through Your help I advance against the düşman, and through Your help I fight.'"(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1326.commentary: On occasions of difficulty gibi war, one's tevekkül should be placed on bütünāh as was the noble uygulama of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ). This does not negate the utilization of means and weapons which should also be utilised, bununla birlikte one's güven and tevekkül should be upon bütünāh.

1327.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) bir topluluktan korktuğunda şöyle derdi: "Allah'ım! Seni onların karşısına çıkarıyor ve onların şerrinden sana sığınıyoruz." (Ebû Dâvûd)
1327.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki a person should seek refuge in the names of bütünāh and turn towards Him in times of korku and worry. There is an indication in Bu hadis that ilâhî help will come when a person forgets himself and places dolu güven in bütünāh. This du'ā' has been proven to be extremely beneficial at times of korku and difficulty. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) would recite it and it has also been the uygulama of our pious elders.

1328.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Goodness will remain attached to the forelocks of horses until the day of Kıyamet."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1328.commentary: The horses referred to here are those which are bred and nurtured for use in the yol of bütünāh. The mention of forelocks may be a reference to the horse as a tüm because the Arabs are known to mention a part, but intend the tüm entity. Alternatively, the forelock has been mentioned as it is the front portion of a horse and fazilet lies in that horse which advances against the enemy, instead of fleeing.

1329.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Goodness will remain attached to the forelocks of horses until the day of Kıyamet: the sevap (in ahiret) and booty."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1329.commentary: These aḥādīth encourage the rearing and training of horses for jihād. Even in today's world of tanks, combat vehicles, fighter jets, etc. horses are invaluable in jihād. They are able to climb mountains, descend into gorges and ravines, and enter narrow passes which cannot be entered by other means of conveyance. bütünāh has referred to horses in the Qur'ān, "By the horses that pant as they gallop. By the sparks that fly from the striking of their hooves. By their assault at dawn causing the dust to fly. And penetrating the midst of the enemies ranks." (Sūrah al-'Ādiyāt, 1-5)

1330.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who keeps a horse in the path of Allāh, due to faith in Allāh and in affirmation of His promise, its food, water, dung and urine will be in his scale on the day of Kıyamet."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1330.commentary: Bu hadis encourages the breeding and training of horses for jihād with the aim of pleasing bütünāh and believing in the sevap that He has promised. While explaining the fazilet of jihād, the hadis also throws light upon the önem of a noble niyet. bütünāh is so pleased with this amel that her expenditure in the nurturing and training of the horse will be weighed as iyilikler in favour of the owner. Even its droppings will earn him ilâhî rewards.

1331.text: A man came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) with a bridled camel and dedi:"This is for the path of Allāh."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"For you on the day of Kıyamet will be seven hundred camels, all of them bridled."(Müslüman)
1331.commentary: Bu hadis encourages giving in the yol of bütünāh and shows the tremendous sevap which awaits such a person in the ahiret. It also indicates that the sevap will be in accordance with the amel, bundan dolayı the sevap of gifting a bridled camel will be seven hundred bridled camels.

1332.text: Abū Ḥammād ('Uqbah ibn 'Āmir) (رضي الله عنه) anlatır: I heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek while he was on the pulpit:"'Prepare against them whatever force you can.' Power is in shooting. Power is in shooting. Power is in shooting."(Müslüman)
1332.commentary: In the hadis, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) quoted a verse of the Qur'ān and then explained its anlam. He repeated his açıklama thrice to emphasise its önem. The hadis encourages Muslims to gain proficiency in shooting. In her era, the instruments used for shooting are farklı. In the era of the Messenger (ﷺ), bows and arrows were utilised. In today's modern era, bullets, bombs, missiles, etc. are utilised, bundan dolayı Muslims need to acquire these weapons and become proficient in using them.

1333.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Many lands will soon be opened to you and Allāh will suffice for you. So none of you should show any weakness in shooting with his arrows."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1333.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) gave the glad tidings of victory to the Ṣaḥābah, but reminded them that even when vast lands were conquered, they should asla become complacent and abandon the knowledge of combat and warfare.

1334.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who is taught archery and then gives it up is not of us - or he has disobeyed."(Müslüman)
1334.commentary: Bu hadis provides a severe uyarı for those who abandon archery after having learnt it. bunun sebebi is that a person who has learnt archery has attained a great bounty and is able to defend the din of bütünāh by attacking the enemy. By abandoning it, he displays ingratitude for this great bounty.

1335.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Allāh will admit three people into Cennet on account of a single arrow: one who makes it, hoping for good while making it, one who shoots it, and one who hands it over to be shot. So shoot and ride. I prefer you shooting than riding. One who gives up shooting out of aversion for it, after having learnt it, has abandoned a nimet – or he dedi – he rejected it."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Nasā'ī)
1335.commentary: Muslims are teşvik edilen to manufacture the best of weapons for combat. Such weapons should be efficiently utilised in battle and those who cannot utilise them should assist those who can. The qualifying clause of "out of aversion for it" shows that if a person abandons archery due to a geçerli reason gibi illness or old age, then there is no günah.

1336.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) passed by a grup of insanlar who were competing with one another in archery. He şöyle dedi:"Shoot, O Banū Ismā'īl! Your baba was an archer."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1336.commentary: Ibrāhīm had two sons, Ismā'īl and Isḥāq. The Arabs are from the progeny of Ismā'īl. Bu hadis bize öğretir ki Ismā'īl engaged in archery. The Ṣaḥābah were also teşvik edilen to engage in archery in emulation of their forefather, since an intelligent person normally tries to follow in the footsteps of his righteous father.

1337.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"One who shoots an arrow in the path of Allāh receives the sevap of freeing a slave."(Tirmidhī, Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah)
1337.commentary: Bu hadis mentions the sevap of shooting a single arrow in the yol of bütünāh. A Muslim should desire to participate in jihād and shoot as birçok times as he can, so that his rewards may be multiplied. In another hadis, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) stated, "One who shoots an arrow in the yol of bütünāh, it will be a means of light for him on the day of Qiyāmah, whether it reaches its target or not." (Ṭabrānī)

1338.narrator: Abū Yaḥyā Khuraym ibn Fātik (رضي الله عنه)
1338.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who spends anything in the path of Allāh receives a sevap which is multiplied 700 times."(Tirmidhī, Nasā'ī)
1338.commentary: Bu hadis mentions the fazilet of spending wealth in the yol of bütünāh. ayrıca to the sevap of seven hundred, the Qur'ān further states, "And bütünāh increases for whomsoever He wishes." Another hadis has, "One who spends in the yol of bütünāh will receive a sevap of seven hundred in exchange. One who spends on his family or himself, visits the ill, or removes a harmful object from the yol, then this is a iyilik for which he will receive a sevap of ten in exchange." (Nasā'ī, Aḥmad)

1339.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a kul fasts for one day in the path of Allāh, Allāh separates him by seventy years from cehennem ateşi on account of that day."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1339.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki an ibadet done in the yol of bütünāh is rewarded manifold by bütünāh because of the combining of two ibadetler. bununla birlikte, if a person fears weakness by fasting while in the yol of bütünāh, then it is better that he abstains from it.

1340.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who fasts for one day in the path of Allāh, Allāh places between him and cehennem ateşi a trench that is as wide as the distance between the heavens and the earth."(Tirmidhī, Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1340.commentary: Bu hadis emphasizes the great sevap for fasting while in the yol of bütünāh.

1341.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who passes away without going out for cihat and without even having the thought of going out for cihat, then he passes away with a trait of hypocrisy."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1341.commentary: 'bütünāmah Qurṭubī stated, "If a person is not able to do any righteous amel, then he should at least make a determined niyet to perform it when he has the ability in the future. This will serve as a substitute for his amel. If the amel is non-existent within him inwardly and outwardly, then it is the trait of a hypocrite who does not do a righteous amel nor does he intend doing it. This applies bilhassa to jihād through which bütünāh honours Islām and makes it triumph over bütün other religions."

1342.text: Jābir ibn 'Abdullāh al-Anṣārī (رضي الله عنه) anlatır:"We were once with Resûlullah (ﷺ) on a military expedition when he dedi: 'There are some people who remained behind in Madīnah. You did not traverse any path nor cross any valley except that they were with you; it was only that illness kept them back.'"Another narration has:"A valid excuse kept them back."Another narration has:"except that they shared the sevap with you."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah)
1342.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 4. It is repeated here to highlight that if a person is unable to participate in jihād due to bazı geçerli excuse, then he should at least make a sincere niyet to do so if he has the ability in the future. His niyet will draw for him a sevap benzer to those who engage in jihād. Imām Nawawī stated, "Bu hadis indicates to the fazilet of an niyet when engaging in noble ameller. One who intends engaging in jihād or any other righteous amel but is prevented due to bazı reason will be granted the sevap of his niyet. The more sorrowful he is over the lost opportunity and the greater he desires to be with the mujāhidīn, the greater will be his sevap." It is the grace and iyilik of bütünāh that He rewards ameller as well as niyetler.

1343.text: A Bedouin came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, a person fights to gain booty, another fights for fame, and another fights so that his rank may be known."Another narration has:"He fights for bravery, and another fights to protect his family honour."Another narration has:"He fights in anger. Which of them is in the path of Allāh?"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) cevap verdi:"One who fights so that the word of Allāh may reign supreme is the one who is in the path of Allāh."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1343.commentary: A hadis with benzer wording was mentioned previously. See hadis 8. It highlights that the promised sevap for jihād is restricted to those whose niyetler are doğru. The objective of engaging in jihād should be to establish adalet, remove oppression and establish the message of bütünāh in the world. Any dünyevî motives, gibi those mentioned in the hadis, will deprive a person of the promised sevap from bütünāh.

1344.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنه)
1344.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any group or military squadron goes out for cihat and acquires booty and returns safely, its members receive two thirds of their rewards (in this world). When any group or military squadron goes out for cihat and does not acquire booty, and its members are wounded, they receive their rewards in full."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1344.commentary: Bu hadis alludes to three groups of people: firstly, those who go out in jihād to fight the disbelievers and are martyred receive the greatest sevap; secondly, those who are wounded and receive no booty, but their sevap is less than the first group; and finally, those who return safely from the battlefield and also gain booty, receive the least sevap. The reason that those who receive no booty are more greatly rewarded is that they sacrificed their lives for bütünāh's pleasure and received nothing of dünya. This is desteklenen by the verse of the Qur'ān, "Should you be martyred in the yol of bütünāh or die, then verily the bağışlanma from bütünāh and His rahmet are better than bütün that they amass." (Sūrah Āl 'Imrān, 157)

1345.text: A man şöyle dedi:"O Messenger of Allāh, grant me permission to seyahat."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) cevap verdi:"The travelling of my Ummah is cihat in the path of Allāh."(Abū Dāwūd, Bayhaqī, Ḥākim)
1345.commentary: The questioner here requested izin to abandon the enjoyments of the world and settle down in bazı remote place so that he could overcome his sensual desires. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) directed him to a superior amel which would help to meet his objective to a greater extent, şöyle ki jihād in the yol of bütünāh. ayrıca to cleansing of the inner self, jihād defeats the power of küfür and enables Islām to gain ascendency. It is also possible that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) did not allow him to do as he wished because jihād was compulsory upon the Muslims at that time. To travel for a geçerli reason gibi business, seeking knowledge or visiting family is helal. Touring and travel for un-Islāmic purposes is not helal.

1346.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنه)
1346.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Returning from cihat is like going out in cihat."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1346.commentary: Those who return from jihād receive the promised ilâhî sevap whether they engaged the enemy or not. bunun sebebi is that their niyet in going out was the pleasure of bütünāh. ayrıca, a gerçek mujāhid returns home with the aim of strengthening and reinforcing himself so that he can again return to the battlefield when the need arises.

1347.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) returned from the expedition to Tabūk, the people went to meet him and I went with some children to meet him at Thanīyyat al-Wadā'."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī) Bukhārī anlatır:"We went with the children to Thanīyyat al-Wadā' to meet Resûlullah (ﷺ)."(Bukhārī)
1347.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki it is desirable to go out and welcome travellers and those returning from the yol of bütünāh. It is also desirable to accompany the travellers and mujāhidīn for bazı distance to bid farewell to them as they leave.

1348.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If one does not go out in cihat, nor equips a mujāhid, nor sees to the needs of the mujāhid'in family, Allāh will afflict him with a calamity before the day of Kıyamet."(Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah, Bayhaqī)
1348.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki Muslims should either participate in jihād, assist the mujāhidīn or take care of the families of the mujāhidīn. Muslims who abandon jihād will be afflicted with a calamity because of their deficiency in a Wājib aspect of Islām.

1349.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Fight the polytheists with your mal, your lives and your tongues."(Abū Dāwūd, Nasā'ī, Aḥmad)
1349.commentary: A person should be prepared to engage in jihād in bütün its farklı forms with the niyet of protecting and establishing Islām. Such engagement may be financial, physical or verbal. Financial engagement includes purchasing or sponsoring weapons, armour, equipment, etc. Physical engagement means to personally participate in battle. Verbal engagement includes proclaiming the misguidance and the evil of günah by means of sahih proofs, expressing disapproval regarding küfür and encouraging others to defend Islām and fight the enemy.

1350.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) günün başında savaşa başlamazsa, öğle geçene kadar erteler, sonra savaşırdı. (Ebû Dâvûd, Tirmizî)
1350.commentary: Bu hadis mentions two times which are çoğu appropriate for fighting: the early morning, and after midday. The Messenger (ﷺ) teşvik edilen these times as a military strategy. At her iki these times bütünāh's assistance descends more than at other times. In the early morning, the believers are fresh and energetic, the climate is cool, and ilâhî blessings are birçok. After midday, when the wind blows, it brings cool weather which makes it easier to carry weapons and for animals to run. With regard to the winds, bütünāh used the winds to destroy the nation of 'Ād. Similarly, bütünāh utilised winds to the fayda of the Muslims in the battle of Aḥzāb, as the Qur'ān states, "O you who believe! Remember bütünāh's favour when the armies approached you against which We sent a wind and troops that you could not see. bütünāh is watchful over what you do." (Sūrah al-Aḥzāb, 9)

1351.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not desire to meet the enemy, and ask Allāh for well-being. But when you do meet the enemy, remain steadfast."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1351.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 53. It has been repeated in Bu bölüm to show that one should not desire to confront the enemy because this may create overconfidence and pride which are harmful to the spirituality and spirit of jihād. bütünāh's help and assistance is with those who are zayıf, broken-hearted and placed into a calamity, not those who are proud and boastful of their strength. The hadis, bununla birlikte, also says that if fighting does occur, one should not flee from the battlefield.

1352.text: Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) and Jābir (رضي الله عنه) narrate that Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi:"War is deception."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1352.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said these sözler to Nu'aym ibn Mas'ūd during the battle of Aḥzāb, when the latter requested izin to create disunity between the çeşitli enemy clans. According to çoğu scholars, the hadis demektir ki it is lawful to deceive the enemy and to utilise such strategies which will weaken the enemy in battle. An example of such deception in war is to feign defeat so that the enemy is drawn towards the Muslim army, and then to suddenly attack them. bununla birlikte, scholars have also mentioned that any such strategy should not entail breaking a covenant or peace treaty. The hadis also indicates that one should utilise one's mind and intelligence in war situations. gerçekte, intelligence does greater harm to the enemy than bravery.

1353.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There are five categories of martyrs: one who dies in a plague, one who dies of a stomach ailment, one who drowns, one who is killed by a falling object, and one who is martyred in the path of Allāh."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1353.commentary: While Bu hadis mentions only 5 categories of martyrs, other aḥādīth mention more. 'bütünāmah Suyūṭī mentioned 38 categories of people who will be granted the status of martyrdom. The first four categories mentioned in Bu hadis are martyrs of the second category, şöyle ki Shahīd Nāqiṣ. bundan dolayı, the special rules and rites for a martyr in dünya will not apply to them. It is bütünāh's rahmet that He grants them the lofty position of martyrdom in the ahiret due to the şiddet of their deaths and their intense pain.

1354.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Who do you consider to be a martyr among you?"The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) cevap verdi:"O Messenger of Allāh, one who is killed in the path of Allāh is a martyr."He dedi:"In that case, the martyrs in my Ummah will be very few."The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) sordu:"Then who are the martyrs, O Messenger of Allāh?"He dedi:"One who is killed in the path of Allāh is a martyr. One who dies in the path of Allāh is a martyr. One who dies in a plague is a martyr. One who dies of a stomach ailment is a martyr. One who drowns is a martyr."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ṭabrānī)
1354.commentary: "One who dies in the yol of bütünāh" işaret eder one who dies without being killed by the enemy, but due to a secondary reason gibi falling off his horse. Such a person will be a martyr of the second category, şöyle ki a Shahīd Nāqiṣ.

1355.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
1355.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who is killed defending his property is a martyr."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1355.commentary: The hadis mentions that any Muslim who is unjustly killed while defending his din, family, wealth or property will receive the sevap of a martyr. Money has been mentioned first, because man, by nature, is greedy for another's wealth, and the hadis seeks to emphasise the şiddet of seizing or usurping the wealth of others.

1356.narrator: Abu al-A'war Sa'id ibn Zayd ibn 'Amr ibn Nufayl (ra)
1356.text: Abū al-A'war Sa'īd ibn Zayd ibn 'Amr ibn Nufayl (رضي الله عنه) - one of the ten who were given glad tidings of Cennet in this world - anlatır: I heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"One who is killed defending his property is a martyr. One who is killed defending his life is a martyr. One who is killed defending his religion is a martyr. One who is killed defending his family is a martyr."(Tirmidhī, Abū Dāwūd, Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1356.commentary: Aşere-i Mübeşşere, daha hayatta iken cennetle müjdelenen on sahâbîyi ifade eder. Bu, onların faziletini ve yüksek mertebesini gösterir.

1357.text: A man came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and sordu:"O Messenger of Allāh, what do you say about a person who comes to me and wants to seize my mal?"He cevap verdi:"Do not give him your mal."He sordu:"What if he fights me?"He cevap verdi:"Fight back."He sordu:"What if he kills me?"He cevap verdi:"Then you will be a martyr."He sordu:"What if I kill him?"He cevap verdi:"He will be in cehennem ateşi."(Müslüman)
1357.commentary: A Muslim is not a coward. He is teşvik edilen to fight in defence of his din, honour, life, family and wealth. If in the process of defending himself, he is killed, he will be a martyr, and his assailant will be flung into cehennem forever if he was a disbeliever, or until he is cleansed of his günah if he was a believer.

1358.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: to me:"If one frees a Müslüman slave, for every limb of his, Allāh will free one of his limbs from cehennem ateşi, even his private part."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī)
1358.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki freeing a slave is amongst the çoğu virtuous of ameller. It saves one from the cehennem-Fire and grants entry into cennet. It was for these reasons that the Ṣaḥābah would free birçok slaves. It is narrated that 'Abd al-Raḥmān ibn 'Awf freed 30000 slaves. Ibn Umar freed more than 1000 slaves. The private part is the means of committing birçok wrongs, bundan dolayı it is mentioned to show that bütünāh will forgive bütün these wrongs by fazilet of freeing a slave. It is best to free a slave whose limbs are perfectly sahih, even though there is great fazilet for freeing a slave who is physically disabled or castrated.

1359.text: I sordu: 'O Messenger of Allāh, which is the best of actions?' He cevap verdi: 'Belief in Allāh and waging cihat in His path.' I sordu: 'Which is the best slave to set free?' He cevap verdi: 'A slave that is most valued by his masters and the one with the highest price.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1359.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 117. It işaret eder the basic principle that the greater the value of an item, the greater will be its sevap when it is spent in the yol of bütünāh.

1360.text: Al-Ma'rūr ibn Suwayd anlatır:"I saw Abū Dharr (رضي الله عنه) wearing a garment and his slave was wearing one similar to his. I sordu him regarding this and he told me that during the era of Resûlullah (ﷺ) he had once verbally abused a man by insulting his mother. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'You are a man who still has some traces of jāhilīyyah (ignorance). They are your brothers and under your authority. Allāh placed them under your care. One who has to care for his brother should feed him from what he eats and clothe him from what he wears. Do not impose upon them that which they cannot bear. If you do impose upon them such tasks, then assist them.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1360.commentary: Bu hadis encourages us to be kind towards our servants and slaves. Amongst the acts of iyilik is to feed and clothe them as one does for himself. This is Mustaḥab (commendable). bununla birlikte, providing them with sufficient food and clothing is Wājib (compulsory). Scholars state that Abū Dharr had verbally abused Bilāl. The Messenger (ﷺ) bu nedenle advised him saying that taunting a person because of family lineage, or being proud over one's ancestry is a trait of the era of ignorance. Islām came to destroy such senseless ideas and taught that the basis of honour in the sight of bütünāh is taqwā (consciousness of bütünāh). Abū Dharr accepted the advice of the Messenger (ﷺ) and bundan dolayıforth dressed his servant in the same clothing he wore.

1361.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If a kul of one of you brings your food to you and you are unable to seat him with you, then give him a morsel or two, or a bite or two because he prepared it for you."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1361.commentary: A servant who prepares the food bears the difficulty of the task of preparing it and also smells the aroma that emanates from it. He should be made to sit with the master and eat as this inculcates tevazu, establishes eşitlik and draws ilâhî blessings. If this is not possible, a portion of it should be given to the servant.

1362.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a slave is a well-wisher to his master and worships Allāh well, he receives a double sevap."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Bayhaqī)
1362.commentary: A righteous slave who endeavours to fulfil the haklar of bütünāh and those of his master will be granted a double sevap for her amel which he does, since his effort and sacrifice is greater than a free person. bazı âlimlere göre, his itaat to his master equals itaat to bütünāh because bütünāh commanded itaat to his master, bundan dolayı the double sevap. Being a "well-wisher" entails serving his master in the best possible yol and protecting his property. "Worshiping bütünāh well" means fulfilling bütün the şartlar and etiquettes associated with ibadet.

1363.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A salih slave receives a double sevap."By the oath of that Being in whose control is the life of Abū Hurayrah, if it were not for cihat in the path of Allāh, Ḥaj, and obedience to my mother, I would have loved to die as a slave. (Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1363.commentary: A righteous slave who endeavours to fulfil the haklar of bütünāh and those of his master will be granted a double sevap for her amel which he does, since his effort and sacrifice is greater than a free person.

1364.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A slave who worships his Sustainer well, fulfils the right of his master and gives him good advice and obeys him receives a double sevap."(Bukhārī)
1364.commentary: Scholars have stated that it is compulsory for a slave to obey the instructions of his master as long as they do not contravene the laws of bütünāh.

1365.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Three types of people receive a double sevap: a person from the people of the Book who believed in his Messenger and in Muhammed (ﷺ); a slave who fulfils the right of Allāh and the right of his masters; and a person who had a slave-woman, taught her good manners and provided her with a good education, then freed her and married her. He receives a double sevap."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1365.commentary: While Bu hadis mentions three types of people who will receive a double sevap, scholars have listed birçok others. 'bütünāmah Suyūṭī has mentioned thirty such people. A person from the people of the Book who initially believed in his Messenger and then decides to believe in Muhammed (ﷺ) makes a resolution of courage. His sevap is doubled because of his sacrifice, or because he brought iman in two Messengers of bütünāh.

1366.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Engaging in ibadet during turbulent times is like emigrating to me."(Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1366.commentary: One who remains steadfast at a time of trials, corruption and evil will receive the sevap of those who migrated to Madīnah Munawwarah when Hijrah was compulsory. tıpkı... gibi the emigrants fled from those who attempted to stop them from upholding Islām, one who engages in ibadet during trying times flees towards the ibadet of bütünāh. The hadis could also mean that when evil and corruption have become widespread in the world, and one remains steadfast on Islām, then his sacrifice is benzer to that of those who migrated to Madīnah Munawwarah.

1367.text: A man came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) to request payment of a debt from him. He spoke rudely to Resûlullah (ﷺ), so his Sahâbe went forward to stop him. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'One to whom a right is due is permitted to speak.' He then dedi: 'Give him a camel of the same age as the one he had given me.' The Sahâbe dedi: 'We can only find a camel that is older (and more valuable) than his.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Give it to him. The best of you are those who are most generous in settling debts.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1367.commentary: A creditor has the doğru to act with a degree of şiddet when the debtor delays in payment. bununla birlikte, it is best to be gentle in retrieving the debt. When paying back a loan it is better to give more than what is due. bununla birlikte, if the creditor demands more or makes the extra amount a precondition, then this olarak kabul edilir interest and is strictly haram.

1368.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"May Allāh be merciful to a person who is lenient when he sells, when he buys, and when he requests for payment."(Bukhārī)
1368.commentary: It is desirable to be lenient and soft-natured when engaging in a business transaction. Buyers, sellers and creditors should abstain from any such söz or amel which may create displeasure in the opposite party. hoşgörü also demektir ki the buyer should pay a bit more, the seller should decrease the price slightly, and the creditor should grant respite or lessen the amount owed to him.

1369.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"One who would like Allāh to save him from the ordeals of the day of Kıyamet should give respite to one in difficulty or he should waive the debt."(Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1369.commentary: Bu hadis Kur'an âyetiyle uyumludur: "Eğer borçlu darlık içindeyse, ona genişleyinceye kadar mühlet verin. Borcu sadaka olarak bağışlamanız sizin için daha hayırlıdır." (Bakara 2:280)

1370.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There was a person who used to give people on credit. He used to say to his son: 'When you come across someone in financial difficulty, pardon him, perhaps Allāh will pardon us.' When he met Allāh, He pardoned him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī, Aḥmad)
1370.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki if a Muslim learns to overlook the weaknesses of others and forgives them, bütünāh will overlook his shortcomings and forgive him when he is çoğu in need of it. One should asla regard any amel as insignificant because it can be the cause of one's bağışlanma in the ahiret.

1371.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A person from the nations before you was called to account. Not a single good deed of his was found, except that, being wealthy, he used to deal with people (in business) and he used to order his sons to pardon those in financial difficulties. Allāh dedi: 'We have a greater right to pardon than him. Pardon him.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1371.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) would narrate incidents of previous nations in order to encourage the Ṣaḥābah towards good ameller because it is in the nature of man to be touched when hearing of the noble ameller of others. The hadis confirms the verse of the Qur'ān: "Forgive and overlook. Do you not sevgi that bütünāh forgives you?" (Sūrah Nūr, 22)

1372.text: One of the kullar to whom Allāh had given mal will be brought forward and He will ask him: 'What did you do in the world?' He will say - and they cannot conceal anything from Allāh - 'Ey Rabbim, You granted me mal and I used to do business with people. It was part of my nature to overlook. I used to be lenient with the wealthy, and I used to give respite to those in difficulty.' Allāh will say: 'I have a greater right to do so than you. Pardon My kul.'"'Uqbah ibn 'Āmir and Abū Mas'ūd (رضي الله عنهما) dedi:"This is how we heard it from the mouth of Resûlullah (ﷺ)."(Müslüman)
1372.commentary: bütünāh rewards a person in the ahiret according to his ameller in dünya.

1373.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who gives respite to a person in difficulty or waives his debt, Allāh will provide him with shade on the day of Kıyamet beneath the shade of His Throne. It will be a day when there will be no shade except His shade."(Tirmidhī, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1373.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki by giving respite to one in difficulty and relieving him from the worry of his debts, one will be saved from the heat of the sun on that day when it will be a mile above the heads of man and people will be drowning in their perspiration.

1374.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) purchased a camel from him. He then weighed the amount to pay him, and gave extra. (Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1374.commentary: The scholars of hadis state that Bu hadis is a reference to the incident when the Muslims were returning from the battle of Dhāt al-Riqā' and Jābir's camel was moving slowly. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) urged it along and it began to run. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) then requested to purchase it from Jābir who accepted the offer but requested for izin to ride it back to Madīnah Munawwarah. When Jābir later brought the camel, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) paid the price, gave him an extra amount as a gift and then returned the camel to him.

1375.narrator: Abū Ṣafwān Suwayd ibn Qays (رضي الله عنه)
1375.text: Makhramah al-'Abdī and I brought some garments from Ḥajar. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) geldi to us and discussed the price of a trouser with us. I had a person who was paid to weigh. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) şöyle dedi to him: 'Weigh and give extra.'"(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah)
1375.commentary: Bu hadis teaches us the following laws regarding transactions: 1. The price must be agreed upon before the merchandise is handed over. If the price is not fixed in advance, it sık sık leads to disputes. Such a transaction will be regarded as bay' fāsid (a corrupt transaction). 2. It is established that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) bought trousers. bununla birlikte, there are no ṣaḥīḥ narrations to show that he actually wore them. Adopting the sublime teachings of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) in our business dealings will lead to a better society and encourage non-Muslims towards Islām.

1376.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When Allāh desires good for a person, He bestows him with profound understanding of the religion."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1376.commentary: Bu hadis highlights the fazilet of knowledge. It encourages us to gain profound anlayış of knowledge because such anlayış will guide a person to obey bütünāh. The hadis also indicates that beneficial knowledge bir işaretidir the good fortune of a person and that bütünāh has desired goodness for him. Sufyān Thawrī stated, "I do not know of anything more virtuous than acquiring knowledge." The "profound anlayış of the din" is referred to as faqāhah and one who is blessed with this is called a faqīh. Ḥasan Baṣrī stated: "A faqīh is one who turns away from the world, is desirous of the ahiret, has profound anlayış of his din, is continuously engaged in the ibadet of his Sustainer, is abstinent, does not cause any harm in saygı of the Muslims, abstains from their wealth and is a well-wisher for them bütün." Those who are blessed with the anlayış of din are fortunate indeed.

1377.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Jealousy is not permitted except in two cases: for a person to whom Allāh gave mal and enabled him to use it for the truth; and for a person to whom Allāh gave wisdom and he judges by it and teaches it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Ibn Mājah)
1377.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki a Muslim should daima seek knowledge, practise upon it and impart it to others. According to birçok verses of the Qur'ān and çeşitli aḥādīth, jealousy is known to be an evil trait and is bu nedenle absolutely haram. Jealousy here işaret eder ghibṭah (envy), as Imām Nawawī explained. There is a difference between jealousy and envy. One who is jealous in saygı of the bounty of another feels that the latter should be deprived of it, while one who is envious simply desires that he too should be blessed with it. Ghibṭah is helal in dünyevî matters and commendable in dinî matters. "hikmet" işaret eder the anlayış of the Qur'ān as mentioned in another narration, since the Qur'ān is the source of bütün goodness.

1378.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The example of the guidance and knowledge with which Allāh sent me is like that of abundant rain which falls on the earth. Some of it is fertile and it absorbs the water and causes grass and vegetation to grow. Some of it is hard and holds the water enabling Allāh to allow people to use it. They drink from it, give it to their animals to drink and use it for irrigation. Some of it is barren land and it neither stores the water nor allows vegetation to grow. The first type of land is an example of a person who understands the religion of Allāh and that with which Allāh has sent me, hence he acquires knowledge and conveys it to others; and the last type of land is an example of a person who pays no attention to knowledge and does not accept the guidance of Allāh with which I have been sent."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1378.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 162. It is repeated here to emphasise the önem of acquiring comprehensive knowledge of Islām. The similitude of three types of people has been mentioned here. One who faydalar himself by means of knowledge and teaches it to others is like fertile land, which grows crops and allows other creatures to fayda from it. One who only bears knowledge, but does not fayda thereby is like hard ground, which only stores water for others. One who faydalar neither himself nor others by means of knowledge is like a barren land. her Muslim should strive to be like that portion of fertile land that faydalar itself and others.

1379.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: to 'Alī (رضي الله عنه):"By Allāh, if Allāh guides a single person through you, it will be better for you than red camels."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1379.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 175. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said these sözler to 'Alī when he gave him the flag and sent him to fight the people of Khaibar if they refused to accept the message of Islām. The hadis highlights the fazilet of inviting people towards Islām and its teachings, bununla birlikte, this is only possible after attaining sahih knowledge.

1380.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
1380.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Convey from me even if it is a single verse. Relate from the Banī Isrā'īl, there is no harm. One who deliberately fabricates a lie against me should prepare his abode in cehennem ateşi."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Dārimī)
1380.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki we should try and convey whatever Islāmic knowledge we possess to others. It is not necessary for one to be an expert in bütün the Islāmic sciences before one can convey the message of Islām. bununla birlikte, it is important that whatever one conveys is acquired from güvenilir scholars and sahih literature. While the phrase "single verse" may seem to refer to only the Qur'ān, it also encompasses the knowledge of aḥādīth and Fiqh. It is helal to narrate the incidents of the Banī Isrā'īl because of the dersler and advices they contain. bununla birlikte, one may not relate their laws and regulations since these have been abrogated. Also, it is not helal to narrate incidents that are yanlış or uydurma or that are contrary to the principles of Islām. Attributing such sözler or statements to the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) which are not established from him is amongst the çoğu serious of major günahlar because it misleads people and bir işaretidir audacity.

1381.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh will make the path to Cennet easy for one who treads a path in search of knowledge."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1381.commentary: Scholars have mentioned the following meanings of this hadis: 1. bütünāh makes the road to cennet easy for one who leaves his home, family members and comforts in order to seek knowledge, due to his sacrifice. 2. bütünāh grants the ability to practise upon Islām to one who bears difficulties in the yol of knowledge, and this makes it easy for him to enter cennet. 3. Attaining beneficial knowledge bir vesilesidir entering cennet. The hadis işaret eder the fazilet of seeking knowledge. Knowledge places within the heart of a believer a radiance by which he is able to discern truth from falsehood.

1382.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who invites towards guidance will receive the same sevap as those who follow him without their sevap being decreased in any way."(Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah)
1382.commentary: Inviting towards guidance and goodness was the outstanding quality of her Messenger of bütünāh, bundan dolayı the rewards of it are enormous. It is bütünāh's grace that the dolu rewards of those who practise are given to the one who conveyed the message. If the message is conveyed, but people do not practise upon it, the inviter is still rewarded by bütünāh for his invitation and niyet.

1383.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a man passes away, his deeds are terminated except for three: perpetual sadaka, knowledge from which benefit can be derived, and a salih child who supplicates for him."(Müslüman)
1383.commentary: Other aḥādīth mention birçok more such ameller, bundan dolayı they are not confined to three. "Perpetual charity" işaret eder the establishment of an initiative whose effects continue to fayda others even after one's demise, gibi a masjid, madrasah, travellers-inn, hospital, digging of a water-well, planting a tree, etc. "Knowledge from which fayda may be derived" işaret eder teaching, writing and distributing sahih literature. A parent who endeavours to teach his child salih amel faydalar by the latter's du'ās after the former's demise. One of the aims of marriage should be to be blessed with pious offspring. Du'ā' and charity fayda the deceased.

1384.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"This world is cursed and all that is in it is cursed, except the remembrance of Allāh, whatever is beloved to Him, an İslâmic scholar and a student."(Tirmidhī)
1384.commentary: Bu hadis daha önce zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 478. Dünyanın kendisi kötü değildir çünkü Allah onu yaratmıştır. Kötü olan, dünyaya aşırı bağlılık ve ahireti unutmaktır.

1385.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who goes out in search of knowledge is in the path of Allāh until he returns."(Tirmidhī)
1385.commentary: The seeker of knowledge receives the same sevap as a mujāhid since the objective of her iki is to revive Islām, defeat Shaiṭān, sacrifice their lives and wealth, and restrain their carnal desires. Another narration has: "One who passes away whilst seeking such knowledge which revives Islām, then between him and the Messengers will be one stage in cennet." (Dārimī) The phrase "until he returns" indicates that when the student of knowledge returns, he is elevated in rank and status. bunun sebebi is obvious: he is now crowned with Islāmic knowledge which he previously lacked. Imām Ghazālī stated, "Knowledge in these narrations işaret eder beneficial knowledge which increases a person's korku of bütünāh and decreases his inclination towards the world. Any such knowledge which does not invite you from dünya to the ahiret is worthy of being called ignorance. böylece, seek koruma from knowledge which does not fayda."

1386.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A mümin is never satiated with doing good until he enters Cennet."(Tirmidhī)
1386.commentary: Scholars state that the realm of knowledge is so vast that if a person has to acquire knowledge for a hundred thousand years without wasting a second of his time, he will not reach its depths. Khiḍr said to Mūsā when they noticed a sparrow sipping water from the ocean, "O Mūsā, my knowledge and your knowledge compared to the knowledge of bütünāh does not even equal the water in the beak of this bird compared to the ocean." (Bukhārī) An intelligent person will asla be satiated with knowledge. The more his knowledge increases, the more his thirst for knowledge increases. The hadis suggests that a person should continue acquiring knowledge and doing righteous ameller until death overtakes him.

1387.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The superiority of a scholar over a worshipper is like my superiority over the lowest among you."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) then dedi:"Allāh, His angels, the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth, even an ant in its hole and the fish, send special mercies upon the person who teaches people good."(Tirmidhī, Dārimī, Ṭabrānī)
1387.commentary: A scholar who will be blessed with the faziletler mentioned in Bu hadis is one who acquires beneficial knowledge and then fulfils the haklar of that knowledge by practising on its dictates, spreading it, and guiding people to the yol of goodness and success. Such a scholar is superior to a worshipper because the latter faydalar only himself, whereas the former faydalar himself and others and allows his knowledge to continue benefitting future generations. The hadis highlights the noble status of the scholars and their great fazilet in the sight of bütünāh. Through them, bütünāh enlivens the hearts of men tıpkı... gibi beneficial rain enlivens the earth. bütün the creation of the heavens and the earth "sending special mercies" demektir ki they supplicate for the teacher of knowledge because when knowledge spreads and people begin practising upon it, then ilâhî blessings descend upon bütün of bütünāh's creation. The ant and fish have been specifically mentioned to indicate that bütün the creatures on land and sea supplicate for such a teacher, irrespective of their size.

1388.text: Abū Dardā' (رضي الله عنه) says: I heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"Allāh will make the path to Cennet easy for one who treads a path in search of knowledge. The angels lower their wings for the seeker of knowledge out of pleasure for what he is doing. All the creatures of the heavens and the earth seek bağışlanma for the scholar, even the fish in the water. The superiority of the scholar over a worshipper is like the superiority of the full moon over all the stars. The scholars are the inheritors of the Messengers. The Messengers did not bequeath dinars nor dirhams; they bequeathed only knowledge. So whoever takes it, has taken an ample share."(Tirmidhī, Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah)
1388.commentary: bütünāh eases the yol to cennet for a seeker of knowledge because cennet can only be attained by performing righteous ameller, which require sahih knowledge. The scholars of hadis have interpreted "the angels lowering their wings for a seeker of knowledge" as follows: 1. The apparent anlam is intended, şöyle ki that the angels literally lower their wings in his honour, benzer to a red carpet being laid out for a prominent personality. 2. The angels interrupt their flight in order to participate in the gatherings of knowledge. 3. The angels humble themselves before the students of knowledge. 4. The angels salute these noble guests of bütünāh, tıpkı... gibi royal guests are saluted. Such a favourable reception by the sinless angels is a sign that the seekers of knowledge have gained bütünāh's pleasure because angels are the special deputed servants of bütünāh. A scholar is likened to the dolu moon which illuminates the bütün universe because the fayda of his knowledge extends to others and the bütün universe is illuminated with it. In comparison, a worshipper faydalar only himself. The scholars are the inheritors of the Messengers since they inherit nebevî knowledge. Their inheritance is inviting to bütünāh with hikmet and good counsel, sabır and hoşgörü in the face of difficulties, proclaiming the truth and guiding mankind to salih amel.

1389.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"May Allāh illuminate the countenance of a person who hears something from us and conveys it as he heard it. Many a person who receives the message retains more than the one who first heard it."(Tirmidhī)
1389.commentary: This du'ā' of the Messenger (ﷺ) serves as teşvik to memorise and propagate aḥādīth. That the Messenger (ﷺ) honoured one who does so by dâhil him in his blessed du'ā' indicates the fazilet of the amel. The scholars have rightly stated that if there was no other fayda of learning and teaching hadis apart from the blessings of this du'ā', then it would have been sufficient. The hadis alludes to two types of people who are engaged in serving the knowledge of prophethood: the muḥaddithīn (hadis scholars) who merely convey the sözler of the Messenger (ﷺ) to future generations; and the fuqahā (jurists) who delve into the meanings of the aḥādīth in order to extract hükümler. This bize öğretir ki the memorisation of aḥādīth is farklı from the anlayış of aḥādīth. başka bir deyişle, one who has memorised aḥādīth may not be an expert in deriving hükümler from them.

1390.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who is sordu about knowledge and conceals it will be bridled with a bridle of fire on the day of Kıyamet."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad, Ṭabrānī)
1390.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki it is compulsory to convey necessary Islāmic knowledge, and concealing it is amongst the major günahlar which will draw a severe azap in the ahiret. bütünāh states in the Qur'ān: "Do not mix the truth with lies and do not knowingly conceal the truth." (Sūrah al-Baqarah, 42). "Knowledge" here işaret eder such Islāmic knowledge which the questioner requires and is compulsory to provide. A scholar may, bununla birlikte, adopt silence under certain circumstances: 1. He does not know the answer or is doubtful. 2. The questioner is not sincere and has an ulterior motive. 3. The questioner will not be able to comprehend the answer. 4. There are others present who can answer the question.

1391.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who acquires knowledge by which the pleasure of Allāh is sought, in order to acquire worldly gains, will not experience the fragrance of Cennet on the day of Kıyamet."(Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah, Aḥmad)
1391.commentary: Bu hadis highlights the need for ihlâs when acquiring Islāmic knowledge. "Knowledge" here işaret eder Islāmic knowledge and not dünyevî knowledge or prohibited knowledge gibi magic, witchcraft, etc. There is no günah in learning helal dünyevî knowledge in order to acquire dünyevî faydalar, bununla birlikte it is best to learn such knowledge with noble niyetler gibi to serve the creation and earn Ḥalāl sustenance. birçok aḥādīth with a benzer message have been narrated. meselâ: "One who seeks knowledge so that he can compete with the scholars, argue with the ignorant, or turn the attention of the people towards himself, bütünāh will enter him into the cehennem-fire." (Ibn Mājah) The fact that an insincere person will not experience the fragrance of cennet is to emphasise that he will not enter into cennet with those who will initially enter because one who cannot attain the fragrance of an object, is as if he does not acquire the object itself.

1392.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
1392.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Allāh will not take away knowledge by snatching it away from the people, but He will take it away by taking away the scholars. When no scholar remains, the people will appoint the ignorant as their leaders. When they will be questioned, they will give a verdict without any knowledge. They will go astray and they will lead others astray."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1392.commentary: Bu hadis teaches us the following dersler: 1. The scholars are the flag-bearers of Islām and gerçek knowledge is stored within their bosoms. 2. The scholars of Islām are honoured by bütünāh and He will asla snatch their knowledge away from them. 3. Islāmic knowledge cannot be acquired by self-study. 4. birçok should acquire sahih knowledge so that scholars may be in large numbers allowing people to fayda more easily. 5. Islāmic knowledge should asla be sought from a person who does not possess the necessary knowledge and qualifications. 6. One should not pass Islāmic hükümler and judgements without adequate knowledge.

1393.text: On the night of his ascension (Mi'rāj), two bowls were presented to Resûlullah (ﷺ), one containing wine and the other containing milk. He looked at both and took the milk. Jibrā'īl dedi: 'All praise be to Allāh who guided you to fiṭrah (the natural way). If you had chosen the wine, your Ummah would have gone astray.'"(Müslüman)
1393.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki a person should praise bütünāh wheasla he is granted the ability to perform any righteous amel. Wine is the mother of bütün evil. It clouds the intellect and leads one to countless günahlar. It is symbolic of misguidance and ignorance. If the Messenger (ﷺ) chose it, his Ummah would have fallen into günah and misguidance. In contrast, milk is pure, easy to digest, and beneficial for the body. It is symbolic of istikrar, tawḥīd and a noble end result. bundan dolayı when the Messenger (ﷺ) chose it, he chose fiṭrah, şöyle ki Islām and istikrar.

1394.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Every important matter which is not commenced with, 'All praise be to Allāh' is defective."(Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah, Ṭabrānī)
1394.commentary: Bu hadis advises us to commence her important amel with Alḥamdulillāh (praise of bütünāh). Other aḥādīth mention that one should commence with Bismillāh. It is bu nedenle best to recite her iki Bismillāh and Alḥamdulillāh. Commencing with Bismillāh and Alḥamdulillāh is Mustaḥab when the amel is helal, commendable or compulsory. If the amel is Makrūh, then to recite these sözler is Makrūh, and if the amel is Ḥarām, then to recite these sözler is also Ḥarām. If a virtuous amel is not preceded with bütünāh's praise it is "defective" or devoid of blessings and goodness.

1395.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a kul'in child passes away, Allāh says to His angels: 'Have you taken the child of My kul?' They reply: 'Yes.' He then asks: 'Have you taken the fruit of his heart?' They reply: 'Yes.' He then asks: 'What did My kul say?' They reply: 'He praised You and dedi: To Allāh we belong and to Him is our return.' Allāh says: 'Build for My kul a house in Cennet and name it Bayt al-Ḥamd (the house of praise).'"(Tirmidhī)
1395.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 922. It highlights that the sevap for exercising sabır is extremely great. It also bize öğretir ki a person should be pleased with the decision of bütünāh in bütün şartlar. Why does bütünāh question the angels when He is aware of everything? The reason is that when bütünāh created man, the angels objected saying that man would cause corruption and bloodshed on earth. Now, when man exercises sabır in difficulty and further praises bütünāh, He boasts about it to the angels in the form of a dialogue.

1396.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh is pleased with a kul who eats a morsel of food and praises Him for it, and who takes a sip of a drink and praises Him for it."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
1396.commentary: It is impossible to repay bütünāh for the innumerable bounties which He bestows upon us her second of the day. As an example, millions of bütünāh's creations are utilised for producing her morsel of food that we eat and for the water that we drink. Even after it is consumed, bütünāh has made a system of digestion and excretion. If any one of these systems has to malfunction, man will die. bu nedenle, it is only appropriate that we show appreciation to bütünāh and acknowledge His favours. For this, we should recite the appropriate du'ās before and after meals as they include the praises of bütünāh.

1397.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنهما)
1397.text: He heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"One who sends one salutation upon me, Allāh sends ten mercies upon him on account of it."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1397.commentary: Bu hadis confirms the verse of the Qur'ān: "Whoever brings a good amel, receives ten times as much." (Sūrah al-An'ām, 160). bütünāh showers His special mercies upon a person who recites ṣalawāt, and He mentions him to the high-ranking angels. Being mentioned and remembered by bütünāh en büyüğüdür bounties as there can be no greater honour than this. Bu hadis mentions a sevap of ten, while another hadis mentions seventy. Scholars have given three answers to this apparent contradiction: 1. bütünāh first rewarded the Ummah by ten and then increased it to seventy due to His iyilik. 2. The exact sevap depends on the occasion and the ihlâs of the person who recites it. 3. The sevap of seventy applies to the day of Jumu'ah because bazı narrations state that ameller done on Jumu'ah are multiplied seventy times.

1398.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The people who will be closest to me on the day of Kıyamet will be those who sent the most salutations upon me."(Tirmidhī)
1398.commentary: "The people who will be closest to me on the day of Qiyāmah" may either mean that they will be in close physical proximity to the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) or that they will be çoğu eligible for his intercession. "çoğu salutations," according to 'bütünāmah Sakhāwi, işaret eder a minimum of three hundred ṣalawāt daily. According to a narration of Ṭabrānī, a person will be entitled to the intercession of the Messenger (ﷺ) if he recites ṣalawāt at least ten times her morning and her evening.

1399.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The best day for you is the day of Cuma. So send abundant salutations upon me on this day because your salutations are presented to me."The Sahâbe sordu:"O Messenger of Allāh, how will our salutations be presented to you when you have been reduced to dust?"He cevap verdi:"Allāh has yasakladı the bodies of the Messengers for the earth."(Abū Dāwūd, Nasā'ī, Ibn Mājah)
1399.commentary: Ibn Qayyim stated that ṣalawāt on the day of Jumu'ah is greater in fazilet than other days because the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) en hayırlısıdır creation and Jumu'ah is the best day of the week. birçok narrations mention the fazilet of reciting eighty ṣalawāt on the day of Jumu'ah. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "The recitation of ṣalawāt upon me will be a source of light on the ṣirāṭ. One who sends eighty ṣalawāt on me on Jumu'ah, eighty years of his günahlar will be forgiven." (Ṭabrānī, Dāraquṭnī). "Your salutations are presented to me," demektir ki the ṣalawāt of a person who recites it at a distance from the Messenger (ﷺ) are conveyed to him by the angels. The Messenger (ﷺ) said, "bütünāh has appointed çeşitli angels who traverse the limits of the earth and convey to me the salāms of the followers of my Ummah." (Aḥmad, Nasā'ī). As for those who recite it when they are close to the Messenger (ﷺ), he hears it because he is alive in his grave. The Messenger (ﷺ) said, "bütünāh has appointed over my grave an angel to whom He has granted the gift of hearing the söz of the creation. Whoever sends ṣalawāt upon me until the day of Qiyāmah, this angel will convey it to me together with the person's name and his father's name." (Ṭabrānī in Kabīr). From Bu hadis and others, the scholars have deduced that the Messengers are alive in their graves.

1400.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"May that person be humiliated who, when my name is mentioned in his presence, does not send salutations upon me."(Tirmidhī, Ḥākim, Ibn Ḥibbān)
1400.commentary: Bu hadis is part of another longer hadis which reads: "May that person be humiliated who, when my name is mentioned in his presence, does not send salutations upon me. And may that person be humiliated who, despite Ramaḍān coming and going, does not acquire bağışlanma from bütünāh. And may that person be humiliated who finds one or her iki of his parents in old age, yet they do not become a means of him entering cennet." (Tirmidhī). One who considers the tremendous sacrifice of the Messenger (ﷺ) will not hesitate to send salutations upon him. He left his home and family and migrated to Madīnah Munawwarah, he was stoned in Ṭā'if, he was injured at Uḥud, he supplicated for his Ummah on his death bed, and on the day of Qiyāmah he will not be at ease until her individual of his Ummah will be saved. One who does not appreciate such iyilik and sacrifice is truly unfortunate.

1401.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not make my grave a place of celebration. Send salutations upon me because your salutations reach me wherever you are."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1401.commentary: "Do not make my grave a place of celebration," can have one of three meanings: 1. Do not make my grave a manifestation of the day of 'Īd in which izin is granted for extra joy and happiness because this is contrary to the required adab. The object of coming to the grave of the Messenger (ﷺ) is to derive dersler and convey ṣalawāt. The nations of the past engaged in celebrations at the graves of their pious and they then made them places of ibadet. For this reason, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "O bütünāh, do not make my grave an idol which will be worshipped. The anger of bütünāh was intense upon that nation which made the graves of their Messengers places of ibadet." (Mu'aṭṭā). 2. The kelime 'Īd is derived from the kelime i'tiyād which means to make a alışkanlık of something. bundan dolayı, the hadis demektir ki one should not visit the grave as a ritual since this will lead to saygısızlık. One should regard her visit as a tremendous opportunity and a great ibadet. 3. Do not make visiting my grave like 'Īd which occurs only twice a year. başka bir deyişle, we are teşvik edilen to visit the blessed resting place of the Messenger (ﷺ) regularly.

1402.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"No person sends greetings of peace upon me without Allāh returning my soul to me so that I may return the greeting to him."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1402.commentary: Bu hadis encourages us to send abundant ṣalawāt and salām upon the Messenger (ﷺ) so that we can be blessed with the honour of a reply by the çoğu honourable of bütünāh's creation. It is an established fact that her soul has to taste death. The bodies of people other than the Messengers decompose with time and only the soul remains in the life of Barzakh.
