One who kills himself with something, will be punished with it on the day of Kıyamet. A person does not have to fulfil an oath for something which he does not own. Cursing a mümin is like killing him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1552.commentary: Cursing a believer is likened to killing him because one passes the verdict of him being perpetually wretched. ayrıca, killing another person deprives him of dünyevî bounties, while cursing a person seeks to deprive him of bounties in the ahiret by distancing him from bütünāh's rahmet.

1553.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"It is not appropriate for a ṣiddīq (truthful person) to be one who constantly curses."(Müslüman)
1553.commentary: A ṣiddīq is a person who is extremely truthful. There is no contradiction between his söz and ameller. According to the ṣūfīs, ṣiddīqīyah is the highest level after prophethood, bundan dolayı a ṣiddīq brings people closer to bütünāh like the Messengers did. ayrıca, a truthful believer is one who should have rahmet for others and one who assists them in goodness and takvâ. One who curses others does not fit this description.

1554.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Those who constantly curse will not be intercessors nor witnesses on the day of Kıyamet."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1554.commentary: On the Day of Qiyāmah, the past nations will deny that their Messengers conveyed the message of bütünāh to them. The followers of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) will then be granted the great honour to step forward as witnesses on behalf of the past Messengers and they will testify in their favour, having the Qur'ān as their proof. Bu hadis mentions that one who curses cannot be such a witness. He also cannot be an intercessor on behalf of sinful believers. aslında, he is a sinner in the sight of bütünāh and has no hakiki status in His sight.

1555.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not curse each other with the curse of Allāh, His wrath, or cehennem ateşi."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
1555.commentary: The hadis advises that believers should asla curse one another with sözler gibi, "May bütünāh's curse be upon you, may bütünāh's anger be upon you, may bütünāh burn you in cehennem-Fire, etc." because it is a severe günah.

1556.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A mümin is not one who insults, curses, and utters obscene and immoral speech."(Tirmidhī)
1556.commentary: Bu hadis will be mentioned in a future chapter. See hadis 1734. It bize öğretir ki a gerçek believer does not possess the evil traits mentioned here because he knows that he will have to stand before bütünāh on the day of Qiyāmah and answer for his ameller. Instead, a believer watches his utterances and utilises sözler of sevgi, iyilik and supplication.

1557.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a kul curses something, the curse rises to the heavens, but the doors of the heavens are locked preventing it (from entering). It then falls to the earth, but the doors of the earth are also shut preventing it (from entering). It then moves to the right and to the left. When it does not find an entrance, it returns to the object that was cursed if it was worthy of it (the curse). Otherwise, it returns to the one who had cursed."(Abū Dāwūd)
1557.commentary: A curse rises to the heavens but is blocked because the doors of the heavens allow only pure sözler and noble ameller to enter. It is bu nedenle forced to return to the earth and afflict the one who was cursed, if he is deserving of the curse. If not, it afflicts the one who uttered the curse. The hadis serves as a uyarı against cursing people unnecessarily.

1558.text: During one of the journeys of Resûlullah (ﷺ), there was an Anṣārī woman riding on her camel. She became agitated with it and cursed it. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) heard this and dedi: 'Unload the goods from it and set it free because it is cursed.' 'Imrān dedi: 'It is as if I can still see it now walking among the people with no one turning to it.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1558.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki we should not utter curses, even upon animals. If an animal causes harm and difficulty, one should exercise sabır.

1559.narrator: Abū Barzah Naḍlah ibn 'Ubayd al-Aslamī (رضي الله عنه)
1559.text: A young girl was once riding on a camel with some goods of people and Resûlullah (ﷺ) came into her sight. The mountains restricted them, so she dedi (to the camel): 'Move faster. Allah'ım! Curse it.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'A camel that has been cursed may no longer travel with us.'"(Müslüman)
1559.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was an embodiment of rahmet for the bütün mankind, bundan dolayı an accursed object which is distant from the rahmet of bütünāh could not accompany him. In a broader context, the hadis bize öğretir ki we should avoid befriending flagrant sinners, and avoid evil places because these invite the curses of bütünāh.

1560.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Verbally abusing a Müslüman is a günah and killing him is disbelief."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1560.commentary: "Verbally abusing a Muslim is a günah" because a Muslim enjoys great status in the sight of bütünāh. The phrase "killing a Muslim is küfür" has been interpreted in çeşitli ways: 1. küfür (kufr) işaret eder being ungrateful for the bounties of bütünāh - killing another destroys this opportunity. 2. Killing a person is benzer in günah and yasak to küfür. 3. To regard killing a Muslim as helal is an act of küfür.

1561.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a person accuses another of günah or disbelief, it reverts back to him if the accused is not deserving of it."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1561.commentary: Başka bir deyişle, by wrongly addressing another by the title of fāsiq (flagrant sinner), the speaker will himself become a sinner. It could also mean that one will eventually become a sinner if he continues to utter such sözler to others. Similarly, a believer who işaret eder another believer as a kāfir (disbeliever) while regarding it to be helal, will become a disbeliever himself.

1562.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When two people verbally abuse one another, the günah will be upon the one who initiated it unless the wronged one exceeds the bounds."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1562.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki one who initiates verbal abuse towards another will be the oppressor and sinner. The oppressed has been granted izin to take retribution in a like şekil, bununla birlikte if he exceeds the bounds, then he will become the oppressor. For this reason, scholars state that one should preferably forgive others and adopt the quality of sabır.

1563.text: A person who had consumed alcohol was brought to Resûlullah (ﷺ). He şöyle dedi:"Beat him!"Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi:"Some of us beat him with our hands, some beat him with their shoes, and some beat him with their clothes. As he was departing, someone şöyle dedi: 'May Allāh disgrace you!' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) şöyle dedi: 'Do not say that. Do not help Shaiṭān against him.'"(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1563.commentary: During the eras of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), Abū Bakr (رضي الله عنه) and the beginning era of 'Umar (رضي الله عنه), if a person who was caught drinking was brought forward, he would be beaten as Bu hadis explains. "Do not help Shaiṭān against him" may mean: 1. Shaiṭān beautifies evil ameller so that man may fall prey to them and become disgraced. By saying such evil sözler to the sinner, one disgraces him, allowing Shaiṭān to fulfil his objective. 2. If the supplication "May bütünāh disgrace you" is accepted by bütünāh, then bütünāh's help leaves him and Shaiṭān gains dolu control over him.

1564.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"One who accuses his slave of fornication, will have the ḥadd azap meted out to him on the day of Kıyamet unless his accusation was correct."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1564.commentary: A slave frequently does not have the ability to demand his haklar in dünya, bununla birlikte, bütünāh is perfectly just. He will definitely punish an oppressive master on the day of Qiyāmah.

1565.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not verbally abuse the dead because they have reached what they sent ahead."(Bukhārī, Nasā'ī)
1565.commentary: Bu demektir ki that the deceased have reached the place where they will have to give an account of their ameller. If they were people of salih amel they will be rewarded, and if they were disobedient sinners they will be punished. Abusing them will not change this. ayrıca, bazen bütünāh grants a favourable and positive end to a sinful believer which people are unaware of, bundan dolayı for the living to condemn him will be incorrect. It is entirely prohibited to speak ill of a deceased Muslim.

1566.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنه)
1566.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A Müslüman is one from whose tongue and hands other Müslümans are safe, and an emigrant (muhājir) is one who abstains from what Allāh has yasakladı."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1566.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 1512. It bize öğretir ki a gerçek believer is one who does not cause harm to any of bütünāh's creation and abstains from the isyan of bütünāh. In this yol, he fulfils the haklar of bütünāh and that of the creation.

1567.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنه)
1567.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who desires to be far away from cehennem ateşi and be admitted into Cennet should pass away while believing in Allāh and the Last Day, and should treat people as he would like them to treat him."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1567.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki a person should remain steadfast on doğru beliefs and righteous ameller until death overtakes him. bütünāh states: "O you who believe! korku bütünāh as He should be feared and do not die except as Muslims." (Sūrah Āl 'Imrān, 102) It also bize öğretir ki a believer should treat others as he would like to be treated.

1568.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not bear malice towards one another, do not harbour jealousy for one another, do not turn your backs upon one another, do not sever ties with one another. O kullar of Allāh! Remain as brothers. It is not lawful for a Müslüman to sever ties with his brother for more than three days."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1568.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 235. In essence, it teaches that Muslims are prohibited from bütün such matters which cause disunity, separation and weakness among them. "Do not turn your backs upon one another" demektir ki a Muslim should not physically turn his back away from another Muslim out of arrogance, or it could mean that one should not speak ill of his brother in his absence.

1569.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The doors of Cennet are opened on Mondays and Thursdays and every kul who does not ascribe any partner with Allāh is forgiven except for the person who harbours enmity towards his brother. It will be dedi: 'Leave the two until they reconcile. Leave the two until they reconcile.'"Another narration has:"Actions are presented (before Allāh) every Thursday and Monday."(Müslüman, Mālik)
1569.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki enmity prevents a person from receiving bütünāh's bağışlanma. Enmity for the sake of bütünāh is, bununla birlikte, excluded from this uyarı as the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "The çoğu beloved amel in the sight of bütünāh is to sevgi for His sake and to hate for His sake." (Musnad Aḥmad)

1570.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Beware of jealousy because jealousy devours good deeds just as fire devours wood,"or he dedi:"dry grass."(Abū Dāwūd)
1570.commentary: Bu hadis, kıskançlığın kişinin iyi amellerini, ateşin odunu yaktığı gibi yok ettiğini açıklar. Kıskançlık büyük bir manevi hastalıktır.

1571.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Beware of suspicion because suspicion is the worst of lies. Do not eavesdrop. Do not spy on one another. Do not harbour jealousy for one another. Do not bear malice towards one another. Do not turn your backs upon one another. O kullar of Allāh! Remain as brothers as He emretti you. A Müslüman is the brother of another Müslüman. He neither wrongs him, belittles him, nor abandons helping him. Piety is here,"and he pointed to his chest three times."It is sufficient to be regarded as a günah when a person despises his Müslüman brother. The blood, mal and honour of every Müslüman is unlawful to another Müslüman. Allāh does not look at your bodies nor your forms, but He looks at your hearts and your actions."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1571.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 235. It prohibits çeşitli sosyal evils and encourages believers to deal with her biri other kindly and cordially. The suspicion which Islām forbids işaret eder such thoughts which a person cultivates in his mind by continuously reminiscing over them without any evidence. Eavesdropping is haram in bütün its forms gibi listening from behind a barrier or pretending to be asleep and listening in on a private discussion, tapping a phone, etc.

1572.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"If you investigate the private matters of the Müslümans, you will destroy them or almost destroy them."(Abū Dāwūd)
1572.commentary: her insanî being has faults. If her person begins pursuing the faults of others, no güven will remain amongst people and society will be reduced to chaos. ayrıca, if one probes the faults of others and then makes them aware of such faults, their sense of utanç will decrease prompting them to commit those evils openly.

1573.text: A man was brought to him and he was told:"This is so-and-so and alcohol is dripping from his beard."He cevap verdi:"We are yasakladı from spying, but if something becomes apparent to us, we will take the person to task for it."(Abū Dāwūd)
1573.commentary: Bu hadiste İbn Mes'ûd (رضي الله عنه), bir Müslümanın suçu sabit olana kadar suçlanamayacağını uygulamalı olarak göstermiştir.

1574.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Beware of suspicion because suspicion is the worst of lies."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1574.commentary: A person should entertain good thoughts about her Muslim unless something is conclusively proven to the contrary. Unsubstantiated evil-thoughts lead a person to eavesdrop and spy because a diseased heart is not contented with suspicion - it requires hakiki evidence. bundan dolayı, such evil-thoughts are sinful. Imām Jaṣṣāṣ stated that suspicion is of four types: 1. Farḍ - To entertain good thoughts about bütünāh, the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), the believers and those who one generally mixes with and there are no reasonable grounds for thinking evil of them. 2. Wājib - These are necessary because without them life will be impossible. 3. helal - When there are clear negative signs in the ameller or dealings of people, one is permitted to entertain such thoughts regarding them. 4. Prohibited - This includes entertaining evil thoughts about another without any reason, to daima search for faults in another, to think evil of those who are outwardly pious, and to think of the worst of two options.

1575.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"It is sufficient as an evil for a person to ridicule his Müslüman brother."(Müslüman, Tirmidhī)
1575.commentary: To ridicule any Muslim or regard him as inferior to oneself is a major günah because her Muslim is worthy of honour and saygı. Even if a Muslim commits günah, one should not ridicule him, but advise him so that he returns to the straight yol. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "One who condemns his brother due to any günah, then he will not pass away until he performs the very same günah." (Tirmidhī)

1576.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who has an atom'in weight of kibir in his heart will not enter Cennet."A person sordu:"And (what if) a man likes his clothes and shoes to be beautiful?"He cevap verdi:"Allāh is beautiful and He loves beauty. Pride means to renounce truth and belittle people."(Müslüman)
1576.commentary: Bu hadis was discussed in a previous chapter. See hadis 612. bütünāh dislikes a insanî being exhibiting pride since greatness and grandeur belong to Him alone. Instead, a insanî being should possess the qualities of kölelik and tevazu. The hadis explains that pride results in a person rejecting the truth and despising others. Even if one is commanded to despise the ameller of another according to Islāmic teachings, one should not despise the person because it is possible that he may repent sometime before his death and enter cennet.

1577.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A man says: 'By Allāh, Allāh will never bağışla so-and-so.' So Allāh says: 'Who is he that takes an oath on Me that I will never bağışla so-and-so? I have forgiven him whereas your deeds have come to nothing.'"(Müslüman)
1577.commentary: When a person engages in ibadetler, he should asla regard himself as superior to others. Even worse than this is to assert that bütünāh will not forgive any particular person as this is, bir yandan boastful, and on the other it appears to challenge bütünāh's quality of being the One who forgives. On a broader scale it bize öğretir ki a person should asla pass judgements in matters which are exclusively in bütünāh's domain. The hadis also bize öğretir ki the bağışlanma and rahmet of bütünāh is extremely vast.

1578.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not rejoice over your brother'in misfortune. Allāh may be merciful to him and put you to the test."(Tirmidhī)
1578.commentary: The previously quoted hadis of Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) in the chapter on spying is also applicable here: "The blood, wealth and honour of her Muslim is unlawful to another Muslim." The demand of Muslim brotherhood is that one feels pain when his brother feels pain, and one rejoices when his brother rejoices. bundan dolayı, to express joy at the pain of a Muslim brother is contrary to Islām and noble character.

1579.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There are two things people do which are actions of disbelief (kufr) in relation to them: ridiculing lineage and wailing over the dead."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1579.commentary: "Ridiculing lineage" means to refer to another's family mockingly gibi by saying, 'Your father was a barber', 'Your mother was a washerwoman', 'You are from a low caste or from such-and-such village', etc. "Wailing over the dead" is prohibited when it exceeds the bounds of Sharī'ah, meselâ, by screaming aloud, hitting one's body and tearing one's clothing. If a person is sorrowful or cries due to the separation of a family member or friend, it is totally helal. "küfür" here does not literally mean that one who does these two ameller will become a disbeliever. Rather, it demektir ki these ameller lead a person on the yol of küfür or that by engaging in them one displays ingratitude for bütünāh's bounties.

1580.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who takes up arms against us is not of us. One who deceives us is not of us."Another narration has:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) passed by a heap of grain. He inserted his hand into it and his fingers perceived some wetness. He sordu: 'O seller of this grain! What is this?' The man cevap verdi: 'It got wet with the rain, O Messenger of Allāh.' He dedi: 'So why did you not put it (the wet portion) on top of the heap so that people could see it?! One who deceives us is not of us.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1580.commentary: The hadis forbids bütün forms of deception. This includes breaching of a güven and bütün such methods employed in business to mislead a customer gibi mixing items of inferior quality with items of superior quality to lend quantity to it, to conceal a fault in a commodity, to intentionally mislabel an item, to change the speed odometer of a car, etc. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said, "One who sells a defective item without disclosing the defect to the customer, then he (the seller) will continuously remain under bütünāh's wrath and the angels will continue cursing him." (Ibn Mājah)

1581.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not deceive one another by pretending to purchase merely to raise the price."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1581.commentary: This işaret eder the scenario when a seller appoints someone to pretend to be a buyer so that genuine buyers are deceived. This yanlış buyer continues raising the price so that the seller makes more money when the item is sold. It is not helal because it bir çeşididir deception and creates enmity between people.

1582.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) forbade deceiving others by pretending to purchase merely to raise the price. (Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1582.commentary: Bu hadis, neceş (aldatıcı teklif) yasağını pekiştirir. Bir malı satın alma niyeti olmadan fiyatını yükseltmek haramdır.

1583.text: A man dedi to Resûlullah (ﷺ) that he was often deceived in business. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"When you engage in any transaction, say: 'Let there be no deception.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1583.commentary: During the era of the Messenger (ﷺ), there was a man by the name of Ḥabbān ibn Munqidh who had bazı form of mental weakness. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) told him to advise bütün those he transacted with, not to deceive him in any yol because he did not have much knowledge in such matters. From this we learn that people who come to know of a person's weakness or lack of knowledge in a particular field should not deceive him by overcharging.

1584.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The person who corrupts another'in wife or his kul is not of us."(Abū Dāwūd)
1584.commentary: A Muslim who corrupts the thinking of others is not regarded to be on the yol of the Muslims because a Muslim by nature should be one who helps and assists. Corrupting another's wife can take çeşitli forms: mentioning to her the evil qualities of her husband so that she rebels against him, mentioning to her the good qualities of another man so that she regards her husband as inferior and develops nefret for him, or mentioning to her that her husband has more wealth than he shows to her so that she demands more from him.

1585.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنه)
1585.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If anyone has four qualities, he is a pure münafık, and if he has one of them, then he has a quality of hypocrisy until he gives it up. When he is placed in a position of trust, he betrays his trust. When he speaks, he lies. When he makes a promise, he breaks it. When he disputes, he becomes vulgar."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1585.commentary: Bu hadis daha önce zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 690. Müminin, alışveriş ve diğer işlemlerinde aldatanlardan uzak durması gerektiğini vurgular.

1586.text: Ibn Mas'ūd (رضي الله عنه) and Ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) narrate that Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi:"Every treacherous person will have a flag on the day of Kıyamet and it will be announced: 'This is the treachery of so-and-so.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1586.commentary: Bu hadis informs us that, on the day of Qiyāmah, a treacherous person will be made to bear a flag, that will cause his evil deceitful ameller to be known to bütün of mankind – a humiliating azap indeed!

1587.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Every treacherous person will have a flag at his rear on the day of Kıyamet. It will be raised according to the extent of his treachery. Listen, there is no treacherous person greater than a ruler of the general masses."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1587.commentary: Göre the scholars of hadis, the Arabs of old would erect a flag in the market-place for the treacherous person so that he would be disgraced and known to bütün. Bu hadis bize öğretir ki a treacherous person will be dealt with in a benzer şekil in the ahiret. The treachery of a leader is the worst form of treachery because it affects a great number of people and is totally unnecessary due to him having wealth and power at his disposal.

1588.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh dedi: 'I will personally dispute with three people on the day of Kıyamet: one who makes a covenant in My name and then breaks it, one who sells a free person and then devours the income from the sale, and one who employs a person, then extracts full work from him, but does not pay him his wage.'"(Bukhārī, Ibn Mājah)
1588.commentary: Scholars state that bütünāh will dispute with these three types of people because their crimes infringe upon the haklar of bütünāh. One who makes a covenant taking the name of bütünāh and then breaks it, commits a grave offence in bütünāh's name. One who sells a free person into slavery infringes on bütünāh's doğru because the purpose of life in dünya is to ibadet bütünāh. A slave is deprived of birçok ibadetler gibi Jumu'ah ṣalāh, Ḥaj, jihād, ṣadaqah, and birçok other optional acts which cannot be performed on account of him being in the service of his master.

1589.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There are three people that Allāh will not speak to, nor look at, nor purify on the day of Kıyamet, and they will have a painful azap."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) repeated this three times. Abū Dharr (رضي الله عنه) dedi:"They are ruined and destroyed. Who are they, O Messenger of Allāh?"He cevap verdi:"One who wears his garment below the ankles, one who boasts after doing favours for people, and one who sells his goods by taking false oaths."(Müslüman)
1589.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 794. In relation to Bu bölüm it bize öğretir ki one should not remind others of one's favours upon them. bunun sebebi is that such behaviour causes pain and inconvenience to them.

1590.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh revealed to me that you should be humble so that none transgresses against another and none is boastful over another."(Müslüman, Ibn Mājah)
1590.commentary: When the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) was told to be humble despite his lofty status, knowledge, character and physical features, then his followers need to inculcate this quality within themselves to a greater extent. The result of adopting tevazu, as the hadis explains, is that one will not oppress others. Similarly, he will not boast about his achievements because he realises them to be a gift from bütünāh, Who may snatch them away at any moment.

1591.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a person says: 'People are destroyed', then he is the one who is most destroyed of them all."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1591.commentary: This yasak is with regard to one who says it out of arrogance, belittling the people, and considering himself superior to them. This is what is Ḥarām (prohibited). As for one who says it due to observing weaknesses in people regarding their dinî practices, and he says it out of sorrow for them and for their Dīn, and considering himself superior to them, then there is no harm in it. The hadis bize öğretir ki one should asla regard himself as the only good person around and write-off everybody else. If he notices evils in others, he should thank bütünāh for saving him from those evils and supplicate for istikrar.

1592.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not sever ties with one another. Do not turn your backs on one another. Do not bear malice towards one another. Do not harbour jealousy for one another. O kullar of Allāh! Remain as brothers. It is not lawful for a Müslüman to sever ties with his brother for more than three days."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1592.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 1568. It bize öğretir ki a believer should abstain from such qualities which lead to disunity and are contrary to the concept of Islāmic brotherhood.

1593.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"It is not lawful for a Müslüman to sever ties with his brother for more than three nights so that when they meet one another, one turns away and the other also turns away. The better of the two is the one who initiates salām."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1593.commentary: Islām takes into consideration insanî feelings and emotions, bundan dolayı it recognises that it is normal after an altercation, that a person's heart will remain constricted for a period of time. For this reason, one will not feel comfortable speaking to one's adversary. bununla birlikte, one is not permitted to extend this period for more than three days because pride and the carnal self then overpower a person. The limit of three days applies to dünyevî matters only, bundan dolayı if one fears harm to one's dinî affairs or there is a geçerli Shar'ī reason, one may sever ties for a longer period.

1594.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Actions are presented (to Allāh) every Mondays and Thursdays. Allāh forgives every person who does not ascribe any partner with Allāh except for the person who harbours enmity towards his brother. He says: 'Leave the two until they reconcile.'"(Müslüman)
1594.commentary: Harbouring enmity for another Muslim without any justification deprives one of ilâhî bağışlanma. bununla birlikte, scholars agree that if a person fears that by keeping contact with a certain person, he will be spiritually harmed, then he can avoid that person, provided he does not backbite about him, search out his faults or make apparent any enmity or malice.

1595.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Shaiṭān has no ümit of being worshipped in the Arabian Peninsula by those who establish namaz, but he tries to cause enmity between them."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1595.commentary: Bu hadis is desteklenen by another narration in which the Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By bütünāh, I do not korku that you will ascribe partners to bütünāh after me, but I do korku for you that you will be rivals in dünyevî matters." (Bukhārī) Bu hadis işaret eder the believers, bununla birlikte they have been referred to as "those who establish ṣalāh," because the çoğu important quality in the life of a believer is ṣalāh. The hadis teaches us the important ders that Shaiṭān continuously tries to cause discord, disunity and infighting between Muslims, bundan dolayı her believer should make an effort to protect himself from this and also seek the assistance of bütünāh.

1596.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"It is not lawful for a Müslüman to sever ties with his brother for more than three days. One who severs ties for more than three days and passes away will enter cehennem ateşi."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1596.commentary: One who severs ties and passes away without having reconciled with his Muslim brother, will enter cehennem-fire so that he may be cleansed of this günah before being entered into cennet.

1597.text: Abū Khirāsh Ḥadrad ibn Abī Ḥadrad al-Aslamī (رضي الله عنه) – also known al-Sulamī, the Sahâbî – anlatır that he heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"One who severs ties with his brother for a year is as if he has shed his blood."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1597.commentary: Severing ties with a Muslim for a period of one year will draw ilâhî azap tıpkı... gibi killing a person draws ilâhî azap. Although the günah of killing is far greater in günah and azap, severing of ties is also haram because it is as if one has killed his brother psychologically.

1598.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"It is not lawful for a mümin to sever ties with another mümin for more than three days. Once three days have passed, he should meet him and offer salām to him. If he replies to his salām, they will share the sevap. If he does not reply, he bears the günah and the Müslüman (who offered salām) escapes (the günah of) severing ties."(Abū Dāwūd)
1598.commentary: One who offers salām after a disagreement with another person will not be included amongst those who sever ties. If the other person replies to the salām, then he will also be absolved of the günah.

1599.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When three people are together, two of them should not speak privately and exclude the third."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1599.commentary: The beautiful din of Islām covers her sphere of life. It bize öğretir ki a believer should asla harm or inconvenience others. In this regard, Bu hadis highlights an adab of insanî interactions. We are taught that if there are three people in a gathering, two of them should not speak in privacy leaving out the third.

1600.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When you are three, two should not speak privately and exclude the other until you join with more people because that might worry him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1600.commentary: İki kişinin bir toplantıda üçüncü bir kişiyi konuşmanın dışında bırakmasının yasaklanmasının sebebi, bunun üzüntüye ve ayrımcılığa yol açmasıdır.

1601.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A woman was punished because of a cat which she kept confined until it died. Due to this, she entered cehennem ateşi. She neither gave it food nor drink when she kept it confined, nor did she let it free so that it could eat the creatures of the earth."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1601.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki it is Ḥarām (haram) to harm any living creature. Instead, one should be compassionate to bütün of bütünāh's creation according to the nebevî teaching, "One who does not show rahmet, is not shown rahmet." (Bukhārī) The hadis also bize öğretir ki it is helal to keep cats and other animals as pets, bununla birlikte it is Wājib (compulsory) upon the owner of the animal to provide them with sufficient food and drink.

1602.text: Ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) passed by some Qurashī young boys who set up a kuş as a target and were shooting at it. They verdi every arrow that missed the target to the owner of the kuş. When they gördü Ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنه), they scattered. Ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) şöyle dedi:"Who did this? May Allāh curse those who did this."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) lanetledi the one who uses a living creature as a shooting target."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1602.commentary: Scholars of hadis state that because the Messenger (ﷺ) cursed one who uses a living creature as a shooting target, the amel is a major günah.

1603.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı that animals be tied as targets for shooting."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1603.commentary: Bu hadis, hayvanları hedef olarak kullanmayı yasaklayan hükmü pekiştirir. Hayvanlara eziyet etmek ve onları hedef tahtası yapmak büyük günahtır.

1604.narrator: Abū 'Alī Suwayd ibn Muqarrin (رضي الله عنه)
1604.text: I was one of seven children of Muqarrin and we had only one kul. The youngest of us once slapped her, so Resûlullah (ﷺ) ordered us to set her free."(Müslüman)
1604.commentary: The Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that she be set free to expiate the act of slapping her. The hadis teaches us the şiddet of harming or being unjust to one's servants.

1605.text: I was beating my slave with a whip when I heard a voice behind me diyerek: 'Beware, O Abū Mas'ūd!' I did not make out the voice because of my anger. When he drew near to me, I suddenly realised that it was Resûlullah (ﷺ). He dedi: 'Beware, O Abū Mas'ūd, that Allāh has more power over you than what you have over this slave.' I dedi: 'I will never beat a slave again.'"Another narration has:"The whip fell from my hand due to my awe for him."Another narration has:"I dedi: 'O Messenger of Allāh, he is free for the sake of Allāh.' He dedi: 'If you had not done so, cehennem ateşi would have burned you,' or, 'cehennem ateşi would have touched you.'"(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1605.commentary: This incident teaches us to deal compassionately with servants. One should overlook their faults, exercise sabır over their mistakes and be forbearing as bütünāh is to His servants. One should only reprimand them to the extent of their yanlış. The Messenger (ﷺ) possessed such awe that his Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) fully subjected themselves to his emir as soon as they heard it.

1606.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who beats his slave or slaps him for a crime which he did not commit, his compensation is to set him free."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1606.commentary: Âlimler, zulmettiği bir köleyi azat etmenin vacip olmadığı, ancak müstehap olduğu konusunda görüş birliği içindedir.

1607.narrator: Hishām ibn Ḥakīm ibn Ḥizām (رضي الله عنه)
1607.text: He passed by some non-Arab farmers in Syria who had been made to stand in the sun with oil poured over their heads. He sordu: 'What is this?' He was told: 'They are being punished due to (evading) the kharāj (land tax)', and in another narration, 'they are being punished for (evading) the jizyah.' Hishām dedi: 'I testify that I heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek: Allāh will punish those who punish people in this world.' He then went to the amīr (leader) and rivayet etti the hadis to him, and he ordered that they be released."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1607.commentary: The hadis contains a stern uyarı for those who unjustly punish the zayıf and poor. "bütünāh will punish those who punish people in dünya," because denigrating the honour of a insanî being is a major günah and will asla go unpunished in the ahiret.

1608.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) saw a donkey whose face had been branded and disapproved of it. Ibn 'Abbās (رضي الله عنه) dedi: 'By Allāh, I do not brand except on a spot that is furthest away from its face,' and then ordered his donkey to be branded on its hips. He was the first to brand on hips."(Müslüman)
1608.commentary: Striking an animal on the face is prohibited. Striking a insanî being on the face is prohibited to a greater extent for the following reasons: the face is the çoğu honourable portion of the insanî body, it is the point of beauty, it is delicate and retains marks of an assault, and striking it may result in permanent injury to the sight, hearing, etc.

1609.text: A donkey that had been branded on its face passed by Resûlullah (ﷺ). He dedi:"May Allāh curse the one who branded it."(Müslüman) Another narration has:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı striking the face and branding the face."
1609.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) prohibited striking and branding the face of animals. This applies even more so to insanî beings.

1610.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) gönderdi us on a military expedition diyerek: 'If you find so-and-so and so-and-so person – two men from the Quraysh whom he named – burn them with fire.' As we were about to leave, he şöyle dedi to us: 'I had emretti you to burn so-and-so and so-and-so person, however only Allāh may punish with fire. If you find them, kill them.'"(Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1610.commentary: The two men were Ḥabbār ibn al-Aswad and Nāfi' ibn 'Abd al-Qays. Ḥabbār was the one who had prodded the camel which Zaynab (رضي الله عنها), the daughter of the Messenger (ﷺ), was riding while migrating to Madīnah Munawwarah. She fell to the ground and was severely injured as a result. The Messenger (ﷺ) initially commanded that the two sinners be burnt, but then retracted because bütünāh revealed to him that only He may punish with fire.

1611.text: We were with Resûlullah (ﷺ) on a yolculuk when he gitti to relieve himself. In the interim, we noticed a red kuş with two chicks. The red kuş geldi and began flapping its wings. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) geldi and sordu: 'Who has distressed this kuş by taking its chicks? Return its chicks to it.' He also noticed an ant hill which we had set alight. He şöyle dedi: 'Who set fire to this?' We cevap verdi: 'We did.' He şöyle dedi: 'None may punish with fire except the Lord of fire.'"(Abū Dāwūd)
1611.commentary: That the Messenger (ﷺ) commanded the Ṣaḥābah to return the chicks to the mother bird bize öğretir ki it is compulsory to be merciful to her creation that has a soul. Regarding ants, it is helal to kill only such ants that cause harm to a person.

1612.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The procrastination of a wealthy person is oppression. If a wealthy person undertakes to pay your debt, accept his undertaking."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1612.commentary: In another hadis the Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Pay the labourer before his perspiration dries." (Ibn Mājah) These aḥādīth teach us that a person who delays payment for a purchase or service, or delays in settling a debt despite having the means to do so, commits a major günah. One who is wealthy but does not have access to his wealth for bazı reason is excluded from this yasak.

1613.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who takes back a gift is like a dog that returns to its own vomit."Another narration has:"The example of a person who takes back his sadaka is like that of a dog that vomits, and then returns to eat its own vomit."Another narration has:"One who takes back his gift is like one who takes back his vomit."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī)
1613.commentary: Bu hadiste, hediyesini veya sadakasını geri alan kişi, kusana geri dönen köpeğe benzetilmiştir. Verilen sadaka veya hediyeyi geri almak haramdır.

1614.text: I gave away a horse (as sadaka) in the path of Allāh, but he did not take good care of it. I wanted to buy it back and thought that he would sell it to me at a low price. I sordu Resûlullah (ﷺ) and he dedi: 'Do not buy it nor take back your sadaka even if he gives it to you for one dirham. One who takes back his sadaka is like one who takes back his own vomit.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1614.commentary: Sadaka, zekât, keffaret veya hediyeyi geri almak mekruhtur. Ancak baba, çocuğuna verdiği hediyeyi geri alabilir.

1615.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Refrain from the seven destructive günahlar."The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) sordu:"What are they, O Messenger of Allāh?"He cevap verdi:"Ascribing partners with Allāh, black magic, killing a person whom Allāh has forbidden unless for justice, consuming usury (interest), consuming the mal of an orphan, fleeing from the battlefield, and slandering chaste, innocent believing women."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1615.commentary: Bu hadis will be mentioned in a future chapter. See hadis 1793. While Bu hadis mentions seven major günahlar, scholars state that there are up to seventy such günahlar. The harms of these günahlar are not limited to the perpetrator, but extend to birçok people. With relevance to this chapter, the wealth of an orphan should asla be usurped or consumed. bunun sebebi is that an orphan is young and zayıf and bu nedenle requires assistance. To exploit this weakness for one's personal fayda is oppression.

1616.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) cursed the one who takes usury and the one who gives it."(Müslüman) Imām Tirmidhī and others add:"and the one who witnesses it and who records it."(Tirmidhī, Nasā'ī)
1616.commentary: The philosophy of interest contradicts the dictates of spirituality, sympathy, charity and humanity, bundan dolayı it is an accursed institution in birçok respects. The fact that the Messenger (ﷺ) cursed those who serve as witnesses and those who record such transactions, illustrates the gravity of the günah, and also bize öğretir ki it is Ḥarām (haram) to assist or be an accomplice in günah.

1617.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Allāh dedi: 'In comparison to other partners, I am the most independent of shirk (associating partners with Allāh). One who does an action in which he associates others besides Me with Me as partners, I abandon him and what he associates with Me.'"(Müslüman)
1617.commentary: One who does an amel to show others or to acquire wealth, status or praise, is deprived of ilâhî sevap because of his lack of ihlâs. An example of such a person is one who gives charity so that people would regard him as generous. This olarak kabul edilir kısmi shirk and such a person will be told on the day of Qiyāmah to claim his sevap from those for whom he did the amel.

1618.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"The first person who will be judged on the day of Kıyamet will be a martyr. He will be brought forward, and will be reminded of Allāh'in favours and he will acknowledge them. Allāh will then ask him: 'What did you do with them?' He will reply: 'I fought for Your sake until I was martyred.' Allāh will say: 'You are a liar. Rather, you fought so that it would be dedi: He is very brave. And so it was dedi.' The command will then be given and he will be dragged on his face until he is thrown into cehennem ateşi.""Next, a person who acquired knowledge, conveyed it to others, and recited the Kur'an will be brought forward. He will be reminded of Allāh'in favours and he will acknowledge them. Allāh will then ask him: 'What did you do with them?' He will reply: 'I acquired knowledge, conveyed it to others, and recited the Kur'an for Your sake.' Allāh will say: 'You are a liar. Rather, you studied so that it would be dedi: He is a scholar. And you recited the Kur'an so that it would be dedi: He is a reciter. And so it was dedi.' The command will then be given and he will be dragged on his face until he is thrown into cehennem ateşi.""Next, a person whom Allāh blessed with abundant mal and various types of property will be brought forward. He will be reminded of Allāh'in favours and he will acknowledge them. Allāh will then ask him: 'What did you do with them?' He will reply: 'I spent mal for Your sake in every avenue which You desired mal to be spent in.' Allāh will say: 'You are a liar. Rather, you spent it so that it would be dedi: He is very generous. And so it was dedi.' The command will then be given and he will be dragged on his face until he is thrown into cehennem ateşi."(Müslüman, Ḥākim)
1618.commentary: These three types of people will be punished because they lacked ihlâs in their ameller. Their ameller were noble, but because they were done to gain praise in dünya, they will amount to nothing on the day of Qiyāmah. The narration of Tirmidhī states that Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) fell unconscious three times when narrating this hadis. Amīr Mu'āwiyah (رضي الله عنه) cried when he heard Bu hadis and said that when the şart of these three eminent people will be such, what ümit will there be for ordinary people who were deficient in their niyetler.

1619.text: Muḥammad ibn Zayd anlatır that some people dedi to his grandfather, 'Abdullāh ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنه):"When we go to our leaders, we speak contrary to that which we say when we are not with them."He dedi:"During the era of Resûlullah (ﷺ), we considered this as hypocrisy."(Bukhārī)
1619.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 1541. It is repeated here to highlight that a person should give sincere advice to his leaders. He should not speak to them in a şekil that supports or encourages their injustices. He should, as a narration mentions, speak the truth "even if it is bitter."

1620.narrator: Jundub ibn 'Abdillāh ibn Sufyān (رضي الله عنه)
1620.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who does an action to make people know of it, Allāh will make him known because of it, and one who does an action to show off, Allāh will show him off."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1620.commentary: Göre Imām Nawawī, the hadis demektir ki "one who does an amel to make people know of it," bütünāh will disgrace him on the day of Qiyāmah, and "one who does an amel to show off," his secret will be exposed before bütün on that day. In essence, the hadis bize öğretir ki those who do ameller sincerely and secretly are loved by others and will be honoured by bütünāh in the ahiret.

1621.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who acquires knowledge by which the pleasure of Allāh is sought, in order to acquire worldly gains, will not experience the fragrance of Cennet on the day of Kıyamet."(Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah, Aḥmad)
1621.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 1391. Acquiring Islāmic knowledge is ibadet and a means of attaining closeness to bütünāh. One who destroys this noble concept by acquiring knowledge for dünyevî gains, settles for an unwise temporary gain and will not be rewarded in the ahiret for his efforts.

1622.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) was sordu:"What do you think of a person who does a good action and people praise him for it?"He cevap verdi:"That is the immediate glad tiding for a mümin."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1622.commentary: When a person is praised for a good amel without him requesting or expecting praise, it is a sign that bütünāh is pleased with him and loves him. Due to bütünāh's sevgi for him, the creation also sevgi him and he gains acceptance in their sight. Bu hadis is desteklenen by another which states that when bütünāh loves a sincere believer, He commands Jibra'īl to also sevgi him. Jibra'īl then commands bütün the angels to sevgi him and this then filters down to the earth, where bütün of the creation begin to sevgi him.

1623.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Preordained for the son of Ādam is his share of adultery which he will inevitably acquire. The adultery of the eyes is looking. The adultery of the ears is listening. The adultery of the tongue is speaking. The adultery of the hand is touching. The adultery of the foot is walking. The heart fantasises and desires. The private part either affirms it or rejects it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1623.commentary: Adultery is of two types: literal (a man having sexual relations with a woman without any Shar'ī link between them gibi marriage, etc.), and figurative (the ameller of the eyes, ears, hands, feet and heart when these are used in a prohibited şekil to stimulate the sexual desires). The latter category has been associated with adultery because of the potential of it leading to the first category of adultery. A believer is cautioned to avoid bütün avenues that lead to adultery. The Qur'ān states, "And do not even draw near to fornication. It is truly an indecent act and the worst of ways." (Sūrah Banī Isrā'īl/al-Isrā, 32)

1624.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Abstain from sitting on pathways."The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) cevap verdi:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! We have no choice because this is where we sit and have our discussions."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"If you have no alternative but to sit there, then fulfil the rights of the pathways."The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) sordu:"What are the rights of the pathways, O Messenger of Allāh?"He cevap verdi:"Lowering the gaze, removing harmful objects, replying to the salām, commanding good and forbidding evil."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1624.commentary: Bu hadis daha önceki bir bölümde zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 190. Burada bakışın, kalbin şehvete kapılmasına yol açmaması için kontrol edilmesi gerektiği vurgulanır.

1625.narrator: Abū Ṭalḥah Zayd ibn Sahl (رضي الله عنه)
1625.text: We were sitting in the area around the front courtyard of a house talking with each other when Resûlullah (ﷺ) came and stood over us. He dedi: 'Why have you gathered on the roadsides? Abstain from gathering on the roadsides.' We dedi: 'We are sitting for a reason which is not yasakladı. We are merely sitting and conversing.' He dedi: 'If you insist on doing so, then fulfil its rights: lowering the gaze, replying to the salām and speaking in the correct manner.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1625.commentary: "Speaking in the doğru şekil," means avoiding backbiting, carrying tales, speaking lies and other such futile talk. It also includes greeting others, being polite, directing people to their destinations, etc.

1626.text: I sordu Resûlullah (ﷺ) about an unintentional gaze (at a strange woman). He cevap verdi: 'Turn away your gaze.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1626.commentary: If a man's gaze unintentionally falls upon a strange woman or a young handsome boy, then it is compulsory to immediately turn away. The first unintentional gaze is forgiven, bununla birlikte if a person continues staring or begins fantasizing, then he will be guilty of günah. This is proven from the hadis in which the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said to 'Alī (رضي الله عنه), "O 'Alī! Do not cast a second gaze after the first because the first is forgiven, but not the second." (Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)

1627.text: I was with Resûlullah (ﷺ) while Maymūnah (رضي الله عنها) was with him. Ibn Umm Maktūm (رضي الله عنه) approached, and this was after we had been emretti with ḥijāb. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Veil yourselves from him.' We dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Is he not blind and therefore cannot see us and recognise us!?' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Are you two also blind? Can you not see him?'"(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1627.commentary: Scholars state that a strange woman should not gaze at a strange man. The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), on another occasion, allowed 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) to watch the Abyssinians engaged in throwing spears as she was not gazing at their bodies but their spears, and there was no korku of evil. If there is any korku of evil, then it is Ḥarām (impermissible) for a woman to look at a man. bundan dolayı, women should lower their gazes before strange men, as this is the demand of hayâ and utanç, and is in their best interests due to the immorality and permissiveness of our current times.

1628.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A man should not look at another man'in private parts, nor a woman at another woman'in private parts. A man should not lie next to another man while sharing the same sheet, nor should a woman lie next to another woman while sharing the same sheet."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Ḥākim)
1628.commentary: The private area of a male before another male and female besides one's wife, is from the navel to below the knees. For others to look at any portion of this area is prohibited. It is necessary for a male to daima keep this area covered. This rule applies when there is no korku of evil, in which case it will not be helal to look at any part of his body. The hadis also bize öğretir ki two men or two women should not lie down in the state of nakedness while sharing the same sheet because it is shameless and immoral, and can lead to the evil amel of homosexuality and lesbianism.

1629.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Avoid mixing with women."A man from the Anṣār sordu:"What about a husband'in relatives?"He cevap verdi:"The husband'in relatives are death."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1629.commentary: The hadis warns men from being in solitude with, or in the company of, strange women. Scholars have explained the phrase, "the husband's relatives are death," as follows: 1. Such harm may be caused in the family due to intermingling of these family members, that the sorrow experienced thereafter will be equivalent to a death in the household. 2. tıpkı... gibi death destroys life, unrestricted intermingling between them can cause such evils which will be the cause of destroying one's physical and dünya hayatı. 3. The korku of getting involved with them in a prohibited şekil is greater and the harm is more severe because they gain access and seclusion more easily as compared to other strange men and women.

1630.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"None of you should be in privacy with a (strange) woman unless it is in the presence of a maḥram."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1630.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 990. It bize öğretir ki it is prohibited for a man to be in seclusion with a strange woman as this can easily lead them to commit immoral ameller. This yasak will bu nedenle apply to males being in solitude with female secretaries, domestic workers, nurses, female assistants, etc. It is similarly prohibited for women to be in solitude with male workers, drivers, etc.

1631.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The sanctity of the women of the mujāhidīn upon those who remain behind is like the sanctity of their mothers. There is no man from those who remain behind who takes care of the family of a man from the mujāhidīn and then betrays him regarding them, except that he (the mujāhid) will stand for him on the day of Kıyamet and take from his good deeds whatever he wishes until he is satisfied."Then Resûlullah (ﷺ) turned to us and dedi:"What do you think (will happen)?"(Müslüman)
1631.commentary: The wives of the mujāhidīn should be treated with the same saygı as one would treat his own mother. If a person who was entrusted to look after the family of a mujāhid betrays him, then the mujāhid will be able to claim from his iyilikler on the day of Qiyāmah.

1632.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) erkeklerden kadınlara benzeyenleri ve kadınlardan erkeklere benzeyenleri lanetledi. (Buhârî)
1632.commentary: Al-Mukhannathin işaret eder men who adopt the style, ameller, söz or dressing of women and are termed effeminate. They are of two types: those who are naturally born with woman-like traits, and those who intentionally adopt such traits. The first type are excused, while the second are accursed. Similarly, women who adopt the behaviour, dressing, ameller and söz of men are accursed. bundaki hikmet yasak is that such people violate the ilâhî honour granted to her biri gender, and they destroy the natural disposition and temperament upon which they were created.

1633.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) kadın gibi giyinen erkeği ve erkek gibi giyinen kadını lanetledi. (Ebû Dâvûd)
1633.commentary: İmam Nevevî, bir cinsin diğerini taklit etmesinin, giyim, konuşma ve yürüyüşte haram olduğunu belirtmiştir.

1634.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not eat with the left hand because Shaitān eats and drinks with his left hand."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1634.commentary: Sol elle yemek yiyip içmek, şeytanın ameline benzemektedir ve şeytanın kişiye yaklaşmasına vesile olur.

1635.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"None of you should eat or drink with his left hand because Shaitān eats and drinks with his left hand."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1635.commentary: Based on this hadis, bazı scholars are of the opinion that it is Wājib to eat with the doğru hand, bununla birlikte the view of çoğu scholars is that it is Sunnah.

1636.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The Jews and Christians do not dye their hair, so act contrary to them."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1636.commentary: This işaret eder dyeing the white hairs of the beard and head with yellow or red dye. Black dye is prohibited as we will mention in the following chapter if bütünāh wills. The hadis commands us to oppose the ways of the Jews and Christians. Islām and Muslims possess a unique philosophy and system of life which is pure in nature and ilâhî in origin. her Muslim should be desirous of holding firm onto the Sunnah lifestyle of the Messenger and abstain from imitating the disbelievers in external appearance and internal attributes.

1637.text: Abū Quḥāfah, the father of Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq (رضي الله عنه), was brought on the day of the conquest of Makkah (to accept İslâm). His head and beard were completely white. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Change this, but abstain from black.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1637.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki it is Mustaḥab (advisable) to dye one's hair when it becomes white. bununla birlikte to dye it black is prohibited because it deceives people into thinking that one is young. This is bilhassa distressing for a woman who marries an old man who has dyed his hair black, thinking him to be young. Scholars have, bununla birlikte, granted izin for black dye to be utilised in jihād, in order to create awe in the hearts of the enemy by giving the impression that the Muslim fighters are young and fearless.

1638.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı shaving a portion of the head."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī)
1638.commentary: Başın bir kısmını tıraş edip bir kısmını bırakmanın yasaklanma sebebi, bunun başı şekilsiz ve çirkin göstermesidir.

1639.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) saw a child with portions of his head shaven and others not. He yasakladı them from doing so and dedi:"Shave it all off or leave it all on."(Abū Dāwūd, Nasā'ī, Aḥmad)
1639.commentary: Saçın bir kısmını tıraş etme yasağı çocuklar için de geçerlidir. Çocukları modaya uygun şekillendirmek de caiz değildir.

1640.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) allowed the aile of Ja'far (رضي الله عنه) three days to mourn over his death. He then geldi to them and şöyle dedi:"Do not cry over my kardeş (Ja'far) after today."He then şöyle dedi:"Call my kardeş'in çocuklar to me."We were brought and it was as if we were chicks. He şöyle dedi:"Call a barber for me."He then instructed him to shave our heads. (Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1640.commentary: Cafer, Ebû Tâlib'in oğlu ve Ali'nin kardeşiydi. Mute Savaşı'nda şehit edildi ve cennette iki kanatla ödüllendirildi.

1641.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı a woman from shaving her head."(Nasā'ī, Tirmidhī)
1641.commentary: The beauty and elegance of a woman lies in her long hair, and to shave it off is akin to mutilating the creation of bütünāh. tıpkı... gibi men are prohibited from shaving and trimming the beard, women are prohibited from removing and trimming their hair. Scholars state a wife may not shorten her hair even when instructed by her husband, because itaat to the creation is not acceptable by disobeying bütünāh and His Messenger (ﷺ).

1642.text: A woman sordu Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! My daughter was afflicted by a skin disease which has caused her hair to fall off. I am about to get her married, so can I join hair to her head?"He cevap verdi:"Allāh cursed the woman who joins hair and the woman whose hair is joined."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1642.commentary: Women bazen lose their hair for çeşitli reasons. bundan dolayı, to beautify themselves, they attach the hair of other women to their hair in the form of a wig or as a permanent attachment. This is prohibited, as is making such a request, providing hair for this purpose and attaching such hair to the hair of another person. The amel olarak kabul edilir changing the creation of bütünāh, and also because it is not helal to utilise any part of the insanî body for such purposes. It is bununla birlikte helal to utilise medication to lengthen the hair.

1643.text: Ḥumayd ibn 'Abd al-Raḥmān anlatır that he heard Mu'āwiyah (رضي الله عنه) on the pulpit in the year when he performed Hac. He took a handful of hair from a guard and dedi:"O people of Madīnah! Where are your scholars? I heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) prohibiting this, diyerek: 'The Banū Isrā'īl were destroyed when their women adopted this practice.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1643.commentary: Bu hadis also highlights the yasak of joining yanlış hair to one's natural hair. Muslim leaders and scholars are duty bound to prohibit wrongs in society. Silence in this regard draws the anger of bütünāh.

1644.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) cursed the woman who joins hair, the woman who requests another to join her hair, the woman who tattoos the body and the woman who requests for her body to be tattooed."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Nasā'ī)
1644.commentary: Tattooing was a yaygın uygulama during the days of ignorance and is still practised in çeşitli parts of the world today. It is prohibited and if it was done due to ignorance, it is compulsory to remove bütün traces of it, if possible. bununla birlikte, if by removing it, harm is caused to the body, the limb becomes ineffective or a major defect will be caused to the skin, then one should suffice by seeking bağışlanma from bütünāh.

1645.text: Allāh curses the women who tattoo the body, the women who request for their bodies to be tattooed, the women who pluck from their eyebrows and the women who file between their teeth for beauty, changing the creation of Allāh."A woman objected to it, so he dedi:"Why should I not curse those whom Resûlullah (ﷺ) cursed, when it is stated in the Kur'an? Allāh says: 'Hold fast to what the Messenger gives you, and refrain from what he prevents you.'"(Sûre al-Ḥashr, 7) (Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1645.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki thinning or fashioning the eyebrows is not helal. bununla birlikte, if hair grows in the area of the beard or moustache of a woman and it resembles that of a man, then it is helal to remove such hair. The hadis also bize öğretir ki women are not permitted to file their teeth in order to create gaps between them. The older ladies amongst the Arabs used to create such gaps so that people would regard them as young. bununla birlikte, if changes are done to the teeth for medical reasons, then it is helal.

1646.text: 'Amr ibn Shu'ayb anlatır from his father, from his grandfather (رضي الله عنه) that Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi:"Do not pluck out white hair because they will be a light for a Müslüman on the day of Kıyamet."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1646.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki a Muslim is prohibited from plucking out white hairs from his face, head and beard. The wisdoms of this yasak are birçok. White hairs are a sign of old age and serve as a reminder of death and the ahiret. They also indicate a person's istikrar on salih amel during old age. Another hadis has, "One who grows his white hair in Islām, then in place of her hair, bütünāh will write for him one iyilik, remove one günah and increase his stages by one." (Ibn Ḥibbān) Further, on the day of Qiyāmah, darkness will reign, bununla birlikte one of the things that will provide light and enter a Muslim into cennet will be his white hair.

1647.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who does an action which we have not emretti, it will be rejected."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1647.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 169. The phrase, "which we have not commanded," işaret eder an amel which is not proven from Islāmic sources of knowledge and which does not fall under the principles of Islāmic Sharī'ah. bütün such bid'ah (innovations) are not accepted in the court of bütünāh and one who engages in them thinking them to be part of Islām will be taken to task for it.

1648.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any of you urinates, he should not touch his private part with his right hand nor should he clean himself with his right hand. He should also not breathe into a drinking vessel."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī)
1648.commentary: From this hadis, scholars derive the principle that her good or noble amel should be done with the doğru hand, while her lowly or unclean amel should be done with the left hand. This is on account of the honour which bütünāh has granted to the doğru hand over the left. A believer who uses the doğru hand for unclean ameller will feel uncomfortable eating with the very same hand. Breathing into a drinking vessel is mekruh because impurities from the mouth or nose may enter into it causing inconvenience to oneself and others.

1649.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"None of you should walk while wearing only one sandal. He should either wear both of them or remove both of them."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1649.commentary: Tek bir terlik veya ayakkabıyla yürümek tenzîhen mekruhtur çünkü bu şeytanın işine benzer ve kişiyi riske atabilir.

1650.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"If the strap of the sandal of one of you breaks, do not walk wearing the other until it is fixed."(Müslüman, Nasā'ī, Aḥmad)
1650.commentary: Tek bir ayakkabıyla yürümek sünnete aykırı olduğu için mekruhtur. İki ayakkabıyı da giymek veya her ikisini de çıkarmak gerekir.

1651.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı a person from wearing his sandals while standing. (Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah)
1651.commentary: It is Makrūh (reprehensible) to wear one's shoes while standing when one needs to utilise his hands to wear them because one will be forced to bend down. This creates an unsightly image özellikle for those who are behind him. It is also possible that one may fall to the ground while doing so. If there is no need to utilise the hands when wearing them, then it will not be reprehensible to stand and wear them.

1652.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not leave fire burning in your houses when you sleep."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1652.commentary: It is Makrūh (reprehensible) to leave any type of fire burning whilst one is asleep since it can cause substantial damage to the house and its contents. This işaret eder live fires whether they provide light or heat. As for electrical lights which carry no such korku, these may be left on.

1653.text: A house in Madīnah together with its inhabitants burnt down one night. When Resûlullah (ﷺ) was haber verdi of this he dedi:"Fire is your enemy. When you go to sleep, you should extinguish it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1653.commentary: Bu hadis daha önce zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 161. Burada kişinin ahlâkına ve karakterine dikkat etmesi gerektiği vurgulanır.

1654.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Cover utensils, tie water-skins, lock doors and extinguish lamps because Shaitān does not untie water-skins or open doors and utensils. If any of you can find nothing except a stick to cover his utensil together with taking the name of Allāh, he should do so. A rat can burn a house together with its inhabitants."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1654.commentary: The guidelines mentioned in Bu hadis are not compulsory but Mustaḥab (advisable). Due to the merhamet of the Messenger (ﷺ) and the perfection of Islām, we have been given advice on mundane matters so that our lives may become more convenient and peaceful. The hadis bize öğretir ki utensils and containers containing food and drink should be covered so that they are not accessible to insects, reptiles, dirt and impurities. By doing so, one will also be saved from sicknesses and calamities which may descend into them. Similarly, doors should be locked so that one may enjoy a comfortable sleep and be safe from thieves, mischief makers and animals.

1655.commentary: This işaret eder formalities or exaggeration in her aspect of life dâhil söz, dressing and davranış. Scholars state that wastage of food and unnecessary expenses for marriages, functions, hosting people, etc. are included in this yasak. Instead, a believer should be simple, humble and uncomplicated in his thinking and approach.

1656.text: Masrūq anlatır:"We visited 'Abdullāh ibn Mas'ūd (رضي الله عنه) and he dedi: 'O people! One who knows something should say it. One who does not know, should say: 'Allāh knows best.' It is part of knowledge to say: 'Allāh knows best', about what you do not know. Allāh dedi to His Messenger (ﷺ): 'Say, I do not ask you people any payment for this, and I am not among those who pretend.'"(Bukhārī)
1656.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki a person should not speak on the basis of assumption. If he is not aware or he is unsure of any particular matter, he should not be shy to acknowledge his lack of knowledge. Only a person who is zayıf in iman, will give an opinion or answer questions on issues regarding which he has inadequate knowledge because he feels afraid to be degraded in the sight of others. gerçekte, a person's status in the sight of bütünāh is elevated when he proclaims his lack of knowledge. It indicates his korku of bütünāh, his purity of heart, his ihlâs, and his anlayış of Islāmic teachings.

1657.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The deceased is punished in his grave because of people wailing over him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1657.commentary: Bu hadis may seem contrary to the Qur'ānic verse, "And no soul will bear the günah of another." bu nedenle, the scholars have explained the hadis as follows: 1. It işaret eder a person who encourages his family members to wail over him after his demise. This is the yorum given by the majority of the scholars. 2. It işaret eder a person who is aware of such a âdet in his family, but does not prohibit them from it before his demise. It does not apply to a person who discourages his family from doing so. 3. azap here işaret eder pain felt by the deceased out of rahmet and merhamet when he hears their crying and wailing. 4. 'Ā'ishāh was of the opinion that Bu hadis is not genel in application, but referred to a particular Jewish lady who died. She was being punished due to her küfür and not because of wailing.

1658.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who slaps his cheeks, tears his clothing, and makes ignorant statements is not of us."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1658.commentary: It is an objection against bütünāh and a show of displeasure with the ilâhî decree when one utters statements gibi, 'One who has made my children orphans', 'One who has made his wife a widow,' 'O bütünāh, how could you have taken him away?' or 'Was he the only one You could choose?' Such statements were yaygın during the days of ignorance when people would hire women to mourn over their deceased. Islām abolished bütün such practices, and statements of this sort may even lead a person out of the fold of Islām.

1659.text: Abū Mūsā fell ill and lost consciousness. His head was in the lap of one of the women of his aile. She began screaming out in sorrow, but he was unable to say anything to her. When he regained consciousness, he şöyle dedi:"I declare myself hür of those from whom Resûlullah (ﷺ) declared himself hür. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) declared himself hür from the woman who wails, shaves off her head or tears her giysi."
1659.commentary: The fact that the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) declared himself free of those who wail and mourn in a prohibited şekil shows the şiddet of the yasak and that their behaviour is contrary to mükemmel inanç and being pleased with ilâhî decree.

1660.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"One who is wailed over, will be punished on the day of Kıyamet on account of that wailing."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1660.commentary: This işaret eder a person who encourages or does not prohibit his family from wailing over him. One who discourages them will not be punished for their ameller.

1661.text: At the time of pledging allegiance, Resûlullah (ﷺ) made us pledge not to wail over the deceased."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1661.commentary: Wailing was a yaygın uygulama amongst women in the days of ignorance, bundan dolayı the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) made them pledge that they would renounce the uygulama in future.

1662.text: 'Abdullāh ibn Rawāḥah (رضي الله عنه) fell unconscious and his kız kardeş began weeping and diyerek: 'O, the dağ among men! O, so-and-so,' enumerating his good qualities. When he regained consciousness, he şöyle dedi: 'You did not say anything except that I was sordu whether I was really like that.'"(Bukhārī)
1662.commentary: Ölen kişiyi, sahip olmadığı niteliklerle övmekten men edilmişizdir. Övgüde aşırı gitmek ve yalan söylemek yasaktır.

1663.text: Sa'd ibn 'Ubādah (رضي الله عنه) fell ill, so Resûlullah (ﷺ) went to visit him together with 'Abd al-Raḥmān ibn 'Auf (رضي الله عنه), Sa'd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ (رضي الله عنه) and 'Abdullāh ibn Mas'ūd (رضي الله عنه). When he arrived, he found him unconscious and sordu: 'Has he passed away?' They cevap verdi: 'No, Ey Allah'ın Resûlü!' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) began to weep. When the people saw Resûlullah (ﷺ) weeping, they also wept. He dedi: 'Are you listening! Allāh does not punish on account of tears of the eyes or the grief of the heart, but He punishes or shows rahmet on account of this,' and he pointed to his tongue."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1663.commentary: Weeping and being sorrowful at the time of tribulations is helal since it is a natural insanî response. bununla birlikte, one will be rewarded if he is pleased with the decision of bütünāh, and punished if he exhibits anger and dislike for the ilâhî decree.

1664.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If a woman who wails (over the deceased) does not repent before her death, she will be made to stand on the day of Kıyamet wearing a shirt of tar coal and an armour of scabies."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1664.commentary: The hadis warns against wailing over the deceased and encourages those involved in it to repent from it before death. The azap for it in the ahiret will resemble the nature of the günah.

1665.narrator: Usayd ibn Abī Usayd al-Tābi'ī (رحمه الله)
1665.text: From a woman who had pledged allegiance. She şöyle dedi:"Among the pledges which Resûlullah (ﷺ) yaptı us abide to regarding correct behaviour in respect of which he yaptı us promise that we would not disobey him were that we should not scratch our faces, ask for destruction, tear our clothes and pull out our hair."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1665.commentary: Burada zikredilen uygulamalar cahiliye döneminden kalma kalıntılardır ve bunlardan kaçınılmalıdır.

1666.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a person passes away and people cry over him by diyerek: 'O, the mountain among men! O the leader of people!' or similar statements, then two angels are appointed to prod him in his chest and ask: 'Were you really like that?'"(Tirmidhī)
1666.commentary: Bu hadis may either refer to one who has passed away or one who is about to pass away. It bize öğretir ki yanlış praises should not be conferred upon the deceased as these are a source of inconvenience for him.

1667.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There are two things people do which are actions of disbelief (kufr) in relation to them: ridiculing lineage and wailing over the dead."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1667.commentary: Bu hadis daha önce zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 1578.

1668.text: Some people sordu Resûlullah (ﷺ) about fortune tellers, so he cevap verdi: 'There is no truth to them.' They dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! They sometimes inform us of certain things which turn out to be true.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'That is a word of truth which the jinn picked up and then cast into the ear of his friend, and they pollute it with a hundred lies.'"In a narration of Bukhārī, 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) anlatır that she heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"The angels descend to the clouds and discuss a matter which has been decided in the heavens. Shaitān eavesdrops and hears it. He conveys it to the fortune tellers who then pollute it with a hundred lies from their side."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1668.commentary: Fortune telling entails providing information of future events and claiming to have knowledge of the unseen. This was very yaygın amongst the pagan Arabs before the coming of the Messenger (ﷺ). The jinns would proceed to the heavens and eavesdrop on the conversations of the angels regarding matters which had been decreed in the heavens. They would then proceed to the fortune tellers and inform them of what they had heard. These fortune tellers would then add lies to it and convey it to people. After the prophethood of the Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ), the jinn were prevented from going up to the heavens by being pelted with a blazing flame.

1669.text: Ṣafiyyah bint Abī 'Ubayd relates from one of the wives of Resûlullah (ﷺ) that he dedi:"One who goes to a diviner and asks him something, and then believes it, his namaz will not be accepted for forty days."(Müslüman)
1669.commentary: A diviner is one who interprets certain signs and then comes to know of hidden matters gibi the location of stolen goods. Learning or teaching such knowledge is prohibited. Believing in it destroys the rewards of one's righteous ameller, since it bir çeşididir shirk (polytheism) when a person equates the knowledge of people with bütünāh's knowledge of the unseen.

1670.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Predicting the future by drawing lines, taking omens from the flight of birds and casting of stones is Satanic."(Abū Dāwūd)
1670.commentary: Bu hadis explains the yasak of çeşitli acts. Al-'Iyāfah is when a fortune teller draws birçok lines on a soft piece of ground. Then he erases them, two at a time, until only one or two remain. If there are two, it is believed to be a sign of good luck, otherwise it bir işaretidir bad luck. Al-Ṭīrah işaret eder taking any evil omen or bad luck. Al-Ṭarq is taking omens from birds, as explained by Imām Nawawī. It could also refer to casting of stones and taking omens from them.

1671.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who acquires knowledge of astrology actually acquires a branch of magic. As his knowledge of astrology increases, his knowledge of magic increases."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
