1671.commentary: Astrology işaret eder reading of the stars in order to predict the future. Horoscopes are the result of astrology. The study of astrology has been likened to magic since her iki lay claim to knowledge of the unseen and hidden powers. Islām forbids it in the strongest terms. It should be noted that astronomy which is the study of the stars and other celestial bodies, is necessary and at times compulsory because of the need to determine time, qiblah direction, etc.

1672.text: I dedi: 'Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! I just recently left ignorance and Allāh brought İslâm, but there are still some among us who go to fortune tellers.' He dedi: 'Do not go to them.' I dedi: 'There are some among us who take good and evil omens from the flight of birds.' He dedi: 'That is something which they experience in their hearts, so it should not prevent them (from their objective).' I dedi: 'There are those among us who practise geomancy.' He dedi: 'One of the Messengers used to practise geomancy, so one whose geomancy conforms with his (the Messenger's) geomancy, it is correct.'"(Müslüman)
1672.commentary: The hadis prohibits fortune telling, evil omens and geomancy. The phrase, "yani something which they experience in their hearts, so it should not prevent them (from their objective)," demektir ki if such superstitious thoughts occur to a person, he will not be held responsible for it by bütünāh. He will only be held responsible if he converts such thoughts into amel. Further, such thoughts should not prevent or discourage him from what he intends doing. He should place his tevekkül upon bütünāh, be positive and not be bogged down by superstition.

1673.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı the income derived from the sale of dogs, the income from prostitution, and the earnings of a fortune teller."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1673.commentary: Göre bazı scholars, buying and selling of her type of dog is prohibited, bununla birlikte Imām Abū Ḥanīfah and other scholars say that the yasak is restricted to untrained dogs. bundan dolayı, if a dog is trained for hunting, then one can sell it due to the effort he has put into training it. The income of a prostitute and that of a fortune teller is Ḥarām (haram) according to bütün the scholars because of the sinful nature of their ameller. tıpkı... gibi earning money from these sinful occupations is Ḥarām, giving money to acquire such services is also Ḥarām.

1674.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There is no such thing as a contagious disease and there is no such thing as an evil omen, although a good omen pleases me."The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) sordu:"What is a good omen?"He cevap verdi:"A good word."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1674.commentary: bazı scholars state that there is no such thing as contagious diseases because bütün sicknesses are directly from bütünāh. bununla birlikte, birçok other scholars state the Messenger's ifade that "there is no such thing as a contagious disease" was in refutation of the yanlış inanç of the polytheists. They believed that sicknesses were contagious by their very nature and the decision of bütünāh played no part in it. They rejected bütünāh as the Creator of means and believed exclusively in the power of means. The Messenger sought to doğru this inanç and explained that these sicknesses do not spread except by the will of bütünāh. For this reason, the Messenger of bütünāh also said, "When you hear of a plague in a particular place, do not enter it," and "Run away from a leper as you run away from a lion," and "A sick person should not be brought before a healthy person."

1675.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There is no such thing as a contagious disease and there is no such thing as an evil omen. If there was bad luck in anything, it would have been in houses, women and horses."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1675.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki there is no such thing as an evil omen because everything occurs by the decree and will of bütünāh, not the flight of birds or other such superstitious phenomena. The hadis does not mean that evil omens are present in the three aforementioned things, rather that if we hypothetically assume that evil omens were a reality, then they would be in these things. The reality is that there are no such things as evil omens.

1676.commentary: Resûlullah (ﷺ) hayatın her alanında bizim rol modelimizdir. Uğursuzluk saymak gibi cahiliye inançlarına itibar etmemiştir.

1677.text: The taking of omens was mentioned in the presence of Resûlullah (ﷺ). He dedi: 'The best omen is a good omen, but it should not deter a Müslüman (from his objective). When any of you sees something that he dislikes, he should say:"Allah'ım! None but You brings good and none but You repels evil. There is no might and power except from You."' (Abū Dāwūd)
1677.commentary: If doubts creep into the heart of a person regarding evil omens or superstitious beliefs, it is Mustaḥab (advisable) to recite the du'ā' mentioned here as it reaffirms a person's īmān in bütünāh. The phrase, "it should not deter a Muslim (from his objective)" demektir ki omens should not frighten a Muslim from pursuing helal ameller and endeavours. bundan dolayı, he should not be put off from travel, trade or other aspects of life as he should know that nothing besides bütünāh can cause harm or fayda.

1678.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Those who make images will be punished on the day of Kıyamet. They will be told: 'Bring to life what you created.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1678.commentary: The yasak here işaret eder images of animate objects gibi insanî beings, animals, birds, fish, etc. as it is helal to draw or create images of inanimate objects gibi trees, buildings, rivers, etc. The hadis provides a severe uyarı for the makers of animate images whether they are hand-drawn, photographs from a camera or digital photography. Scholars state that if a person makes images of animate objects with the niyet of imitating bütünāh as the Creator, then he will become a disbeliever. If one does so without this niyet, he will be a flagrant sinner.

1679.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) returned from a journey, while I had covered the porch of my house with a curtain which had images on it. When Resûlullah (ﷺ) saw it, his face changed colour. He dedi: 'O 'Ā'ishah! Those who will receive the severest azap by Allāh on the day of Kıyamet will be those who make things like the creation of Allāh.' She dedi: 'So we cut it up and made one or two pillows from it.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1679.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 650. It bize öğretir ki images of animate objects should not be kept or used for decorative purposes. The yasak is even greater when such images are hung up or placed in a frame as a form of honour or saygı. Scholars state that the maker of an image will be punished as well the end user because such objects are produced due to the demand for them.

1680.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Every person who makes an image will be in cehennem ateşi. Life will be given to every image that he made, and it will then punish him in Hell."Ibn 'Abbās (رضي الله عنه) dedi:"If you have to do so, you may make trees and objects which are inanimate."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1680.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki the more pictures one has made in dünya, the more severely one will be punished in the ahiret. Scholars state that while forming images of inanimate objects is helal, if it is done unnecessarily, it is Makrūh Tanzīhī (mekruh) because it is an act of futility.

1681.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"One who makes an image in this world, will be compelled to breathe life into it on the day of Kıyamet, and he will not be able to breathe life into it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1681.commentary: Canlı varlıkların resimlerini yapmanın cezası, onlara ruh üflemeye zorlanmaktır ki bunu yapamayacaklardır. Bu büyük bir günahtır.

1682.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"The people who will receive the severest azap on the day of Kıyamet will be those who made images."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1682.commentary: bazı scholars are of the opinion that al-Muṣawwirūn here işaret eder those who make images of idols which could be worshipped. By doing so, one will become a disbeliever, and since his evil amel leads others to the worst günah of shirk, he will receive the severest azap. Other scholars state that the kelime al-Muṣawwirūn is genel, bundan dolayı bütün animate images, effigies and pictures are included in this yasak.

1683.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Allāh says: 'Who can be more oppressive than the one who tries to create something like My creation? Let them see if they can by creating an atom, a grain seed or a barley seed'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1683.commentary: Such an amel is oppression because the attribute of bütünāh is being assigned to the creation. bütünāh tells them to create a minute thing like an atom or a seed as a form of rebuke and to prove their inability. This was also a miraculous prophecy of the Messenger because man will asla be able to produce any such object despite his sophistication in science and progress in technology.

1684.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image (of an animate object)."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī, Aḥmad)
1684.commentary: The hadis informs us that angels of rahmet do not enter a house which has a dog or animate images. Other angels gibi those that protect a person, those that write the ameller of a person, and the angel of death are either daima present with a person or are not prevented from entering his home. One who is deprived of the company of the angels of rahmet, is deprived of their blessings, their seeking bağışlanma on his behalf, and their inspiring him to obey bütünāh.

1685.text: Jibra'īl promised Resûlullah (ﷺ) that he would come to him, but he was delayed in coming and it yaptı Resûlullah (ﷺ) quite anxious. He then geldi out (of his ev) and Jibra'īl met him. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) complained about his delay to which he cevap verdi: 'We (angels) do not enter a ev in which there is a dog or an image.'"(Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1685.commentary: Bu hadis, evde köpek ve resim bulundurma yasağını pekiştirir. Melekler, içinde köpek veya resim bulunan eve girmez.

1686.text: Jibra'īl promised Resûlullah (ﷺ) that he would come to him at a certain time. The time came, but Jibra'īl did not come. He had a staff in his hand and he threw it aside diyerek, 'Allāh and His Messengers (the angels) do not go back on their word.' He then turned around and saw a puppy dog under his bed. He sordu: 'When did this dog come in?' I cevap verdi: 'By Allāh, I did not even know it was here.' He ordered that it be taken out and Jibra'īl then came to him. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi to him: 'You promised to come at a certain time and I sat waiting for you but you did not come.' He cevap verdi: 'The dog that was in your house prevented me from coming. We (angels) do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image (of an animate object).'"(Müslüman)
1686.commentary: Dogs which are helal to keep gibi security dogs, hunting dogs, farming dogs, herding dogs, etc. do not prevent the angels from entering. bununla birlikte bazı scholars state that even though keeping these dogs is helal, precaution demands that they should be kept on the outside of the house and not inside. With regard to images, those images that are very small do not prevent angels from entering a house. bununla birlikte, here too precaution demands that one should not display any images openly.

1687.narrator: Abū al-Hayyāj Ḥayyān ibn Ḥuṣayn narrates: "'Alī ibn Abī Ṭālib (رضي الله عنه)
1687.text: To me: 'Should I not send you to do what Resûlullah (ﷺ) sent me to do? It is that you should not leave an image without obliterating it, nor an elevated grave, without levelling it.'"(Müslüman, Ḥākim)
1687.commentary: Kabri düzleme emri, aşırı yüksek olan kabirlerin tesviye edilmesi gerektiği anlamına gelir. Kabirlerin aşırı yükseltilmesi mekruhtur.

1688.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"One who keeps a dog for any reason besides hunting or herding has two qīrāṭs of his sevap decreased every day."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1688.commentary: A dog may be kept for hunting, protecting crops and animals or guarding property. Apart from these reasons, it is Makrūh Taḥrīmī to keep a dog. Scholars have given çeşitli reasons for this yasak: 1. It is extremely difficult to save oneself from their impurity and this may in turn decrease the sevap of one's ṣalāh, etc. 2. Dogs cause inconvenience to guests and others. 3. Dogs prevent angels from entering one's home. 4. Their impurity may contaminate utensils if one is negligent.

1689.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who keeps a dog has one qīrāṭ of his actions decreased every day unless it is a dog used for farming or herding."A narration of Müslüman has:"One who keeps a dog for any reason apart from hunting, herding and farming has two qīrāṭs of his rewards decreased every day."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī)
1689.commentary: A qīrāṭ is a measurement and işaret eder a fourteenth portion of something. The difference of one qīrāṭ and two qīrāṭs in the two narrations may be attributed to the degree of impurity associated with the dog. bazı âlimlere göre, it is relative to urban and rural areas because there is a greater need for dogs in rural areas. bazı scholars have stated that the narration of two qīrāṭs is for Madīnah Munawwarah and the other is for other areas.

1690.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The angels do not accompany a group in which there is a dog or bell."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Dārimī)
1690.commentary: Angels of rahmet and bağışlanma are important to a Muslim, özellikle during travel when their company draws faydalar and koruma from difficulties. bununla birlikte, dogs and bells drive away these blessed angels. bunun sebebi is that bells resemble musical instruments which Shaitān utilises to tempt and lure the believers away from good ameller. A young girl who was wearing anklets once came in the presence of 'Ā'ishah. 'Ā'ishah said to her, "Remove from me that which chases away the angels."

1691.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A bell is the flute of Shaitān."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1691.commentary: Çan kullanımı mekruhtur çünkü şeytan bu tür seslere eşlik eder. Çanlar ayrıca melekleri uzaklaştırır.

1692.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı riding a camel that eats filth."(Abū Dāwūd, Ḥākim)
1692.commentary: The kelime al-Jallālah işaret eder such an animal which is normally helal to consume, bununla birlikte it habitually consumes filth gibi dung to the extent that an obnoxious odour is perceived in its meat, milk, etc. It is mekruh to consume its meat and milk and also to ride it because its filthy perspiration will be transferred to a person's clothing. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah and Imām Shāfi'ī, such an animal needs to be kept in isolation and fed only pure fodder until the odour vanishes from its meat and milk. It can then be consumed and ridden. According to Imām Mālik, it needs to be fed with pure fodder and then washed before it can be used.

1693.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Spitting in the mescid is a günah and its expiation is to bury it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1693.commentary: The emir to bury it beneath the soil will apply if the floor of the masjid is of soil, sand, or something benzer. According to bazı, burying means to remove it from the masjid. bununla birlikte, if the masjid floor is cemented or plastered and a person rubs it with his shoe or something else, as birçok ignorant people do, then this does not entail burying it. Instead, it increases the günah and spreads the filth in the masjid. One who does so should then wipe it with his cloth, hand or something else, or he should wash it off. birçok other aḥādīth also encourage the removal of such impurities from the masjid. In one such hadis, the Messenger said: "bütünāh builds a home in cennet for one who removes filth from the masjid."

1694.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) saw some mucous, saliva or phlegm on the wall facing the Qiblah, so he scraped it off."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1694.commentary: When a person likes to keep himself and his home clean of filth, it is only appropriate that he should keep the house of bütünāh clean. bazı narrations mention that the Messenger used to personally clean the masjid with a branch of a palm tree and he would even sweep the masjid. His tevazu is worthy of emulation.

1695.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"These mescids are not suitable for urinating and any other filth. They are for the remembrance of Allāh and the recitation of the Kur'an,"or as Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi. (Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1695.commentary: The Messenger of bütünāh (ﷺ) said these sözler to a Bedouin who urinated in the masjid. The Ṣaḥābah wanted to reprimand the Bedouin, but the Messenger prevented them and kindly advised him not to do so in future because it was an inappropriate amel. Scholars state that it is compulsory to remove bütün forms of impurity gibi urine, faeces and blood from the masjid as well as substances gibi mucous, phlegm, etc.

1696.text: He heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"One who hears someone announcing the loss of an item in the mescid, should say: 'May Allāh not return it to you, as mescids were not built for this purpose.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1696.commentary: Scholars state that it is prohibited to announce in a masjid for an item that was lost outside the masjid because such an announcement utilises the gathering of people in the masjid for an incorrect purpose. bununla birlikte, an item that was lost in the masjid may be announced provided it is done with the necessary saygı and honour which the house of bütünāh deserves.

1697.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If you see someone buying or selling in the mescid, say: 'May Allāh not make your business profitable.' If you see someone announcing a lost item, say: 'May Allāh not return it to you.'"(Tirmidhī, Ḥākim)
1697.commentary: The purpose of a masjid is to perform ṣalāh, recite Qur'ān, engage in dhikr and du'ā', learn and teach Islāmic knowledge, etc. When business transactions are allowed to take place therein, then people's focus will be diverted from bütünāh towards dünyevî matters, and this is reprehensible.

1698.text: A man made an announcement in the mescid diyerek: 'Is there anyone who can tell me where my red camel is?' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'May you not find it. Mescids are built for a specific purpose.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1698.commentary: Scholars state that another reason why it is prohibited to announce for a lost item in the masjid is that it disturbs and disrupts those who are engaged in any form of ibadet. For this reason, to raise one's voice in a masjid is also prohibited. 'Abdullāh ibn Mas'ūd narrated that the Messenger said: "In the final era, there will be people who will have (dünyevî) discussions in their masjids. bütünāh will have no need for them." özetle, masjids should be kept free of bütün such activities and discussions which are purely dünyevî in nature.

1699.text: 'Amr ibn Shu'ayb anlatır from his father from his grandfather (رضي الله عنه) that Resûlullah (ﷺ) yasakladı buying and selling in the mescid, as well as announcing the loss of an item, or reciting of poetry in it. (Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)
1699.commentary: Buying and selling of goods or services in a masjid is prohibited. Scholars have bununla birlikte mentioned that a person in i'tikāf may engage in a transaction due to necessity provided that no goods are brought into the masjid. Poetry yani based on lies and futility is prohibited in a masjid. bununla birlikte, poetry yani recited in the praise of bütünāh and His Messenger or for the purpose of expounding on the beautiful teachings of Islām, is helal. This is proven from the poetry of Ḥassān ibn Thābit who recited the praises of the Messenger from the pulpit of Masjid al-Nabawī.

1700.text: I was in the mescid when a man threw a pebble at me. I looked up and it was 'Umar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb (رضي الله عنه). He şöyle dedi: 'Go and bring those two insanlar to me.' I brought them to him and he sordu them: 'Where are you from?' They cevap verdi: 'We are from Ṭā'if.' He şöyle dedi: 'If you were residents of this şehir I would have punished you. You were raising your voices in the mescid of Resûlullah (ﷺ)!'"(Bukhārī)
1700.commentary: Bu hadis shows the yasak of raising one's voice in the masjid and that such a person may be punished in an Islāmic state. bunun sebebi is that the house of bütünāh is a place for ṣalāh, dhikr, tilāwah, du'ā', learning, etc, and disturbances, noise or loud söz distracts a worshipper's attention from bütünāh. It is also inappropriate to raise one's voice in a place of sanctity and honour gibi a masjid. 'Umar threw a pebble at the Ṣaḥābī to draw his attention and did not call him by raising his voice due to the saygı demanded by the masjid of the Messenger.

1701.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who has eaten from this tree, namely garlic, should not come near our mescid."A narration of Müslüman has:"our mescids."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1701.commentary: Vücudundan veya elbisesinden rahatsız edici koku yayan kişi mescide girmemeli, temizlenene kadar beklemelidir.

1702.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who has eaten from this tree should not come near us nor perform namaz with us."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1702.commentary: Bu hadis, mescide rahatsız edici kokuyla girmenin yasağını pekiştirir. Soğan ve sarımsak yiyenler de bu kapsamdadır.

1703.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who has eaten garlic or onions should keep away from us,"or,"he should keep away from our mescid."A narration of Müslüman has:"One who has eaten onions, garlic, or leeks should not come near our mescid because the angels are inconvenienced by the things which inconvenience human beings."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1703.commentary: Angels are the pure and sinless creation of bütünāh. They frequent the gatherings of ṣalāh and ibadet in the masjid and are inconvenienced by offensive odours. Scholars state that her such odour which inconveniences people falls within this yasak gibi cigarettes.

1704.text: He delivered a sermon on Cuma in which he dedi:"O people, you eat from two plants which I consider to be foul-smelling: onions and garlic. I saw that when Resûlullah (ﷺ) got the smell of these coming from any person in the mescid, he ordered that he be taken out to al-Baqī'. One who eats them should kill their smell by cooking."(Müslüman)
1704.commentary: A Muslim is one whose body emits a pleasant fragrance özellikle when he presents himself at the masjid. He should remove any clothing which is soiled or which emits a foul odour. Scholars have stated that a person with a foul-smelling odour may be removed from the masjid. Similarly, any person who disturbs the peace of the masjid by speaking loudly, arguing and shouting may also be removed from the masjid.

1705.narrator: Mu'ādh ibn Anas al-Juhanī (رضي الله عنه)
1705.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı sitting with one'in knees against one'in chest while the Imām is delivering the sermon on the day of Cuma."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1705.commentary: Hadiste anlatılan şekilde oturmak kolayca uyku getirir ve bu da kişiyi namazdan mahrum bırakabilir.

1706.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a person has an animal to sacrifice and the new moon of Dhul Ḥijjah is seen, he should not cut his hair or his nails until he has sacrificed his animal."(Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1706.commentary: Scholars have suggested that the hikmet of this yasak is to imitate the Ḥujjāj who, during iḥrām, do not remove their hair and nails. Others have stated that by allowing the hair and nails to grow enables bütünāh's bağışlanma to encompass bütün the portions of the body. Allowing the hair and nails to grow during the first ten days of Dhul Ḥijjah is Mustaḥab.

1707.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh prohibits you from taking oaths upon your forefathers. One who wishes to take an oath, should do so in the name of Allāh, or remain silent."Another narration states:"One who wishes to take an oath, should not do so except in the name of Allāh, or remain silent."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī)
1707.commentary: bunun sebebi yasak is that by taking an oath on an item or entity implies that it enjoys greatness and grandeur, whereas bütün greatness and grandeur belongs to bütünāh alone. For this reason, bazı âlimlere göre, one who takes an oath on an entity believing it to possess the greatness of bütünāh, commits an act of kufr (küfür). While forefathers have been mentioned here, the yasak applies to everything other than bütünāh. Forefathers are used as an example because people would commonly take oaths upon them during the era of ignorance.

1708.narrator: Abd al-Raḥmān ibn Samurah (رضي الله عنه)
1708.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not take oaths upon idols or upon your forefathers."(Müslüman, An-Nasā'ī, Ibn Mājah)
1708.commentary: Cahiliye döneminde insanlar Lât ve Uzza gibi putları üzerine yemin ederlerdi. İslâm bu âdeti yasaklamış ve yalnızca Allah adına yemin etmeyi emretmiştir.

1709.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who takes an oath upon amānah (trust) is not of us."(Abū Dāwūd)
1709.commentary: Amānah (güven) işaret eder the Farāiḍ ameller gibi ṣalāh, Ḥajj, fasting, etc. which bütünāh placed as a güven upon His servants. It is not helal to take an oath on the Farāiḍ ameller because an oath may only be taken upon bütünāh or His attributes. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah, if such an oath is taken it will be binding and kaffārah will need to be given in kefaret. According to Imām Shāfi'ī the oath will not be geçerli.

1710.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If one takes an oath diyerek, 'I am free from İslâm', and if he is lying, then he is as he dedi, and if he is speaking the truth, he will not return to İslâm blameless."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1710.commentary: One who takes an oath that he is free of Islām if he does a particular amel, then if he does it intending kufr (küfür), he will indeed lose his īmān. If he does not do the amel, he will still be guilty of having committed a major yanlış by taking such an oath. For this reason, scholars have mentioned that a person should not take an oath upon matters of iman.

1711.text: He heard a man diyerek:"No, by the Ka'bah."Ibn 'Umar şöyle dedi to him:"Do not take an oath upon anything besides Allāh because I heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek: 'One who takes an oath upon anything besides Allāh, has committed an act of disbelief (kufr) or (shirk) polytheism.'"(Tirmidhī, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1711.commentary: Taking an oath on an entity besides bütünāh can take one of two forms: 1. Taking an oath upon something with the inanç that it enjoys the greatness benzer to the greatness of bütünāh. This is shirk (polytheism) and prohibited according to the consensus of the scholars. 2. Taking an oath upon something due to the sevgi or association people have with it, meselâ, 'by the oath of your son,' or 'by the oath of your life.' This is also sinful, but not as grave as the first type.

1712.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who takes an oath in order to take possession of the property of a Müslüman unjustly will meet Allāh while He will be angry with him."Ibn Mas'ūd (رضي الله عنه) dedi:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) then recited proof of this from the Book of Allāh: 'Those who sell the covenant of Allāh and their own oaths for a small price; they have no share in ahiret. Allāh shall neither speak to them, nor look at them on the day of Kıyamet, nor shall He purify them. And for them is a painful azap.'"(Sûre Āl 'Imrān, 77) (Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1712.commentary: Bu hadis explains the grave günah of usurping the property of another Muslim by means of a yanlış oath. That bütünāh will be angry with him is an expression denoting that bütünāh will punish him for his yanlış. This particular günah is özellikle evil because he wrongly utilised the greatness of bütünāh's name in an oath for the purpose of acquiring a lowly item of this fleeting world.

1713.narrator: Ebû Ümâme Iyās ibn Tha'labah al-Ḥārithī (رضي الله عنه)
1713.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who usurps the right of a Müslüman by taking an oath, Allāh makes cehennem ateşi obligatory for him and Cennet yasakladı for him."A man sordu:"O Messenger of Allāh, even if it was something insignificant?"He cevap verdi:"Even if it was only a twig of the arāk tree."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1713.commentary: Like the previous hadis, Bu hadis also explains the şiddet of the günah of usurping the doğru of another Muslim by means of a yanlış oath. Bu hadis elaborates further on the azap by explaining that such a sinner will enter the cehennem-fire. Scholars state that the mention of him not entering cennet ayrıca to him entering cehennem-fire is to express the şiddet of the crime or to show that he will forever remain in cehennem if he assumed his sinful amel to be helal. The mention of the branch of the arāk tree is to highlight that any degree of injustice is sinful, irrespective of the magnitude.

1714.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنه)
1714.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The major günahlar are associating partners with Allāh, disobedience to parents, murder and taking a false oath."Another narration has:"A Bedouin came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and sordu: 'O Messenger of Allāh, what are the major günahlar?' He cevap verdi: 'Associating partners with Allāh.' He sordu: 'Then what?' He cevap verdi: 'Taking a false oath.' I sordu: 'What is a false oath?' He cevap verdi: 'That which enables a person to usurp the property of a mümin.' In other words, by taking a false oath."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1714.commentary: The hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 337. It mentions three major günahlar. One of these is to intentionally take a yanlış oath. This is a major günah and requires tawbah to be forgiven. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah, there is no kefaret for it, but according to Imām Shāfi'ī there is. The şiddet of the günah of taking a yanlış oath can be gauged from the fact that it has been mentioned in the same breath as murder, isyan to parents and associating partners with bütünāh, bütün of which entail oppression, immorality and impinging on the haklar of others.

1715.narrator: Abd al-Raḥmān ibn Samurah (رضي الله عنه)
1715.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: to me:"When you take an oath and you then become aware of a better option, then do what is better and expiate your oath."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1715.commentary: Bir kişi bir vacibi terk etmek veya haram bir iş yapmak için yemin ederse, yeminini bozması ve keffaret vermesi gerekir. Bu durumda yemini bozmak vaciptir.

1716.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who takes an oath and then becomes aware of a better option, should expiate his oath and do what is better."(Müslüman)
1716.commentary: Bu hadis, daha iyi bir seçenek bulunduğunda yemini bozmanın caiz olduğu konusundaki önceki hadisi pekiştirir.

1717.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"By Allāh, I will never take an oath and then become aware of a better option without expiating my oath and doing what is better."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1717.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki a person should not persist upon an oath when a better option exists. He should annul his oath by adopting the better option and give kefaret. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah, one should first annul the oath and then give kefaret for it. If kefaret is given before the oath is annulled, it will not be geçerli. According to the other three Imāms, the kefaret may be given before the oath is annulled.

1718.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"For one of you to persist in his oath in respect of his family is more sinful in the sight of Allāh than him fulfilling the expiation which Allāh has prescribed upon him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1718.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki a person should not persist upon an oath when a better option exists. He should annul his oath by adopting the better option and give kefaret. kefaret of an oath is done by freeing a slave, feeding ten poor people morning and evening, or clothing ten poor people. If one does not have the ability to do any of this, then he should fast for three days.

1719.text: Bu âyet, "Allah sizi boş yere yeminlerinizden sorumlu tutmaz" bir adam hakkında indi. O, bir mesele hakkında (bir anlaşmazlıkta) yemin etmişti. (Buhârî)
1719.commentary: These apparent oaths are not generally intended as oaths, but are used as yaygın forms of söz and expression. It is bu nedenle hoped that bütünāh will forgive the use of such sözler. According to Imām Shāfi'ī, a yamīn laghw (futile oath) işaret eder an unintentional oath regarding a past or future occurrence. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah, it işaret eder an oath which a person takes regarding an occurrence thinking it to be gerçek, but it is aslında yanlış. It is hoped that bütünāh will not take one to task for such an oath.

1720.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"An oath may produce a sale of goods but it removes the nimet in the earnings."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Nasā'ī)
1720.commentary: Bu hadis warns against taking oaths when selling goods, even if the oath is gerçek, because it removes the blessing from the earnings.

1721.text: He heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"Beware of excessive oath-taking when selling, for it promotes sales but then wipes out (the nimetler)."(Müslüman)
1721.commentary: Bu hadis, satış işlemlerinde yemin etmenin mekruh olduğu konusundaki önceki hadisi pekiştirir.

1722.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Nothing but Cennet should be sordu in the name of Allāh."(Abū Dāwūd)
1722.commentary: Everything is insignificant when compared to the greatness and loftiness of bütünāh. When a person seeks to acquire something trivial by utilising the means of something honourable, then it trivialises that which is honourable. For this reason, one should not take the name of bütünāh when requesting for the trivial possessions of dünya. One may only take the name of bütünāh when requesting bütünāh for cennet or the rewards of the ahiret.

1723.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Give refuge to the one who seeks refuge in the name of Allāh. Give to the one who begs in the name of Allāh. Respond to the call of the one who calls you. Reciprocate the iyilik of the one who shows iyilik to you. If you do not have anything by which to reciprocate, then continue supplicating for him until you feel that you have repaid him."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1723.commentary: One who requests for help and assistance by taking the name of bütünāh should be granted help and assistance as a sign of honour for the Being of bütünāh. bununla birlikte, beggars should not utilise bütünāh's name to acquire dünyevî faydalar, as mentioned in the previous hadis. One who does a favour should be repaid in a benzer şekil and if this is not possible than one should supplicate for him.

1724.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The most disgraceful name in the sight of Allāh is that of a person who calls himself, 'the king of kings'."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Ḥākim)
1724.commentary: bütünāh loves tevazu and simplicity and dislikes boastfulness and arrogance. One who calls himself 'the king of kings' displays arrogance, bundan dolayı it is haram for any man to utilise this title.

1725.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not address a münafık as 'master'. Even if he is a master, you would have angered your Sustainer."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1725.commentary: The kelime 'master' is a title of honour and should not be used to address a hypocrite because he is asla worthy of honour and saygı. A hypocrite is an enemy of bütünāh and should bu nedenle not be praised. tıpkı... gibi light and darkness cannot combine, the heart of a believer cannot combine the sevgi for bütünāh and the sevgi for the enemy of bütünāh. Scholars state that a disbeliever, misguided individual, flagrant sinner and innovator should similarly not be addressed in respectful terms. It is unfortunate that nowadays, disbelieving sports players, musicians and actors are passionately praised and respected.

1726.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) went to Umm al-Sā'ib – or Umm al-Musayyab – and dedi: 'O Umm al-Sā'ib – or Umm al-Musayyab – what is wrong, why are you trembling?' She cevap verdi: 'It is because of my fever. May Allāh not bless it!' He dedi: 'Do not curse the fever because it removes the günahlar of man just as the bellows remove the filth of iron.'"(Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1726.commentary: Sickness is a blessing for a believer because it obliterates his günahlar. By cursing or speaking evil of it, one does not appreciate this bounty and further expresses displeasure for bütünāh's decision. One should rather accept it as bütünāh's decree and part of fate. It does not mean that one should not seek a cure for it because seeking a cure is Sunnah and teşvik edilen in Islām.

1727.narrator: Abū al-Mundhir Ubayy ibn Ka'b (رضي الله عنه)
1727.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not curse the wind. If you dislike anything of it, say: 'O Allāh, we ask You for the good of this wind, the good that it contains, and the good which it has been emretti to do. We seek refuge in You from the evil of this wind, the evil that it contains, and the evil which it has been emretti to do."(Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1727.commentary: The blowing of the wind is a rahmet and bounty of bütünāh because it brings clouds of rain and it enables ships to sail on the oceans. For these reasons, a believer should not curse it or speak evil of it. He should rather supplicate to bütünāh to bring goodness with it. At times, bütünāh utilises the wind to punish those who are transgressors and sinners, gibi the nation of 'Ād, bununla birlikte the scholars have mentioned that this is also a bounty because it purifies the earth of sinners without harming those who are obedient to bütünāh.

1728.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"The wind is from the rahmet of Allāh. It brings rahmet and azap. When you see it, do not curse it. Ask Allāh for the good of it and seek refuge in Him from the evil of it."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1728.commentary: One should asla curse the creations of bütünāh because they are bütün subservient to His will. A believer should focus towards bütünāh in supplication when witnessing any difficulty or calamity.

1729.text: When the wind would blow strongly, Resûlullah (ﷺ) used to say: 'O Allāh, I ask You for the good of it, the good that it contains, and the good which it has been sent with. I seek refuge in You from the evil of it, the evil that it contains, and the evil which it has been sent with.'"(Müslüman)
1729.commentary: This du'ā' should be recited when güçlü winds blow.

1730.narrator: Zeyd bin Hâlid el-Cühenî (رضي الله عنه)
1730.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not curse the rooster because it awakens the people for namaz."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1730.commentary: That the crowing of a rooster disrupts the pleasure of sleep should not cause one to speak evil of it because the ṣalāh towards which it calls is far superior. bazı scholars are of the opinion that the ṣalāh referred to here is Tahajjud as a narration states that the Messenger used to awake for Tahajjud when the rooster crowed. Other scholars state that it işaret eder Fajr ṣalāh. The fact that we have been commanded not to speak evil of an animal which faydalar mankind, bize öğretir ki a believer should be respected bütün the more because he is of greater fayda to mankind.

1731.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) led us in the Sabah namaz at Ḥudaybiyah, after some rain had fallen during the night. When he completed the namaz, he turned towards the people and dedi: 'Biliyor musunuz what your Sustainer has dedi?' The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) cevap verdi: 'Allāh and His Messenger know best.' He dedi: 'Allāh dedi: 'This morning some of My kullar are müminler and others are disbelievers. Those who dedi, 'We had rain by the grace and rahmet of Allāh', believe in Me and disbelieve in the stars. Those who dedi, 'We had rain on account of so-and-so star', disbelieve in Me, but believe in the stars.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1731.commentary: To attribute the falling of rain to any being or creation other than bütünāh is shirk (polytheism) and a denial of bütünāh as the supreme controller. bütünāh is in tam control of the rains as the Qur'ān states, "It is He who sends the rain after people have lost ümit." (Sūrah al-Shūrā, 28) bundan dolayı, we believe and accept that no entity or being besides bütünāh sends rain, causes vegetation to grow or provides sustenance.

1732.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a person says to his brother: 'O kâfir,' one of the two returns with that designation. He is either eligible for it or it returns to him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1732.commentary: The hadis demektir ki incorrectly labelling a believer as a disbeliever will cause the person who made the designation to become a disbeliever if he considered his designation as helal, because he regarded īmān as küfür. It could also mean that his sözler do not harm the believer, but will result in him committing an act of küfür.

1733.text: He heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"One who addresses another as a kâfir or says to him: 'O enemy of Allāh,' when that is not the case, it reverts to him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1733.commentary: A Muslim can only be called a disbeliever if he unambiguously and explicitly utters a ifade of küfür gibi denying a fundamental of Islām as established in the Qur'ān. Based on this hadis, one should be özellikle cautious of referring to another Muslim as a disbeliever or enemy of bütünāh because there is a possibility that if his designation is yanlış, it will be to his own detriment.

1734.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A mümin is not one who insults, curses, and utters obscene and immoral speech."(Tirmidhī)
1734.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 1555. It stresses upon the önem of guarding the tongue from immoral söz. It also bize öğretir ki a believer is one whose character is noble and not obscene and offensive.

1735.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Immodesty is not found in anything without spoiling it and modesty is not found in anything without beautifying it."(Tirmidhī, Ibn Mājah, Aḥmad)
1735.commentary: Vulgarity and unnecessary sertlik are the ingredients of an evil personality while yumuşaklık and iyilik generate honour and saygı.

1736.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Those who exaggerate are destroyed."He dedi this three times. (Müslüman)
1736.commentary: bütünāh dislikes a person who goes to great lengths in attempting to speak eloquently. Scholars state that simple and sincere sözler have an impact upon the hearts of the audience, while eloquent sözler may stir people's emotions but gerçekte fail to impact upon the heart. These aḥādīth also imply that one should not speak to an audience beyond their level of comprehension because it will cause unnecessary confusion in their minds.

1737.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنه)
1737.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh detests a person who exaggerates in speaking eloquently by rolling out his tongue like a cow."(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
1737.commentary: bütünāh dislikes a person who goes to great lengths in attempting to speak eloquently.

1738.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The most beloved of you to me and those of you who will be seated closest to me on the day of Kıyamet will be those of you who have the best character. The most detested of you to me and those of you who will be furthest away from me on the day of Kıyamet will be those who talk excessively, who brag when talking, and who adopt an arrogant manner in speech in order to display their superiority."(Tirmidhī, Aḥmad)
1738.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 631. It stresses that noble character constitutes speaking in a humble and simple şekil. One should not attempt to display one's eloquence or stamp one's authority over others when speaking because this is a reflection of pride.

1739.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"None of you should say: 'I am feeling disgusted.' He should rather say: 'I am feeling annoyed.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1739.commentary: her iki these sözler have a benzer anlam, bununla birlikte we have been instructed to utilise the one which does not denote an undesirable anlam. bazı scholars state that bunun sebebi sakındırma is that bütünāh has created man in honour and he should bu nedenle not degrade himself. 'bütünāmah Khaṭṭābī stated yanilām has gone to the extent of teaching us the şekil of giving expression to our sözler. We should utilise positive sözler and expressions instead of negative ones.

1740.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not refer to grapes as 'al-karm' because a Müslüman is 'al-karm'."Another narration has:"Al-karm is the heart of a mümin."A narration of Bukhārī and Müslüman has:"People say al-karm whereas al-karm is the heart of a mümin."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1740.commentary: During the days of ignorance, the pagan Arabs used to squeeze wine from grapes and they believed that when a person drank it he would develop qualities of generosity, iyilik and bravery. When Islām forbade alcohol, it sakındırılan naming grapes and wine as al-karm because believing that wine develops these qualities in a person is incorrect. ayrıca, a beverage which Islām has designated as haram should not be referred to with a good name so that its evil is established in the hearts of people and they do not incline towards it.

1741.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not say 'al-karm', but say: 'al-'inab' or 'al-ḥabalah'."(Müslüman, Dārimī)
1741.commentary: Al-ḥabalah işaret eder a grape tree or, according to others, the root or branch of a grape tree.

1742.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A woman should not embrace another woman and then describe her to her husband so that he can visualise her."(Bukhārī, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1742.commentary: The kelime tubāshir means to touch or view. bundan dolayı the hadis forbids a woman from touching the body of another woman with her own body or viewing it, and then describing its qualities to her husband. This is a shameful and dishonourable uygulama because when a man learns of another woman's beauty, he will be inclined to her. This may result in the ruining of marriages or at the least, it will draw impermissible thoughts in the minds of men. While Bu hadis işaret eder a woman's beauty, the law will apply equally to a man. bundan dolayı the strength and beauty of a man's body should not be described to a strange woman.

1743.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"None of you should say: 'O Allāh, bağışla me if You will. O Allāh, be merciful to me if You will.' Rather, he should ask with conviction because none can compel Him."A narration of Müslüman has:"Rather, he should ask with conviction and intense yearning because nothing is too great for Allāh to give."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah)
1743.commentary: These aḥādīth mean that a person should supplicate with conviction and certitude. He should not exhibit weakness in his request nor leave the request to bütünāh's will because this gives an impression that one is independent of bütünāh. The reality is that her person is fully dependent on bütünāh and nothing is difficult for bütünāh. According to other scholars, these aḥādīth mean that one should be hopeful of acceptance when supplicating.

1744.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When any of you supplicates, he should ask with firm conviction. He should not say, 'O Allāh, give me if You will,' because none can compel Him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1744.commentary: Bu hadis, kesin bir inançla dua etme konusundaki önceki hadisi pekiştirir. Dua ederken Allah'ın kabul edeceğine kesin olarak inanmalıdır.

1745.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not say, 'What Allāh wills and so-and-so wills.' Rather, say: 'What Allāh wills, and then what so-and-so wills.'"(Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1745.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki it is not helal to unify the creation of bütünāh with bütünāh in any amel because they cannot be equal; bütünāh is far superior.

1746.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) disliked sleeping before Yatsı and engaging in conversations after Yatsı."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
1746.commentary: Cahiliye döneminde insanlar yatsıdan sonra uzun ve faydasız tartışmalara dalarlardı. İslâm bu tür boş konuşmaları yasaklamıştır.

1747.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ), towards the end of his life, once offered the Yatsı namaz. When he completed it with salām he dedi:"Do you see this night? No one on the surface of the earth today will be alive a 100 years from now."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Ḥākim)
1747.commentary: This was a prophecy of the Messenger and it transpired as he had foretold. The Messenger explained that bütün the Ṣaḥābah who lived at that time would pass away before 100 years had passed. The last Ṣaḥābī to leave dünya was Abū Ṭufail Āmir ibn Wā'il who passed away in 110 Hijrī. This was exactly 100 years from the time the Messenger made the prophecy. Scholars state that the hadis also urges the believers towards iyilikler because life is short and death is daima imminent.

1748.text: They waited for Resûlullah (ﷺ), but he only emerged close to midnight and then led them in namaz – the Yatsı namaz. He then addressed us diyerek: 'Listen, people have performed their namaz and gone to sleep, but you were considered to be in namaz for as long as you waited for namaz.'"(Bukhārī)
1748.commentary: Bu hadis, yatsı namazından sonra ilim öğretilebileceğini vurgular. Ancak bu, dinleyicilerin yorulmaması için kısa tutulmalıdır.

1749.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a man calls his wife to his bed and she refuses, and he then spends the night angry with her, the angels curse her until the morning."Another narration has:"until she returns (to her husband)."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1749.commentary: The hadis informs us that it is a severe günah for a woman to ignore the call of her husband for conjugal relations without any geçerli reason gibi sickness, farz fasting, menstruation, etc. Such a response from her side provokes the curses of the angels and worse still, the anger of bütünāh. It also sparks enmity in the marriage and may cause the husband to satisfy his desires elsewhere. Scholars state that if a woman knows that her husband will not be angered by her refusal to satisfy his desires, the stipulated uyarı in Bu hadis will not apply. bununla birlikte, it will still be better for her to accede to his request so that sevgi and harmony may prevail between them.

1750.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"It is not permissible for a woman to fast while her husband is present except with his permission, and she may not permit anyone to enter his house without his permission."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1750.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki a woman may not engage in any Nafl ibadet without her husband's consent. In broader terms it also indicates that a husband's haklar take preference to optional ibadetler because the former are Wājib and the latter are Nafl, and fulfilling marital relations preserves hayâ and haysiyet. The second portion of the hadis informs us that a woman may not permit into her home any man whom her husband does not approve of, whether he is a family member or not. bunun sebebi is that there may be bazı enmity between the two men and this will create enmity between the couple.

1751.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Does any of you not korku that Allāh may turn his head into that of a donkey or make his form into that of a donkey if he were to raise his head before the Imām?"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1751.commentary: Ṣalāh bir çeşididir ibadet which demands itaat and conformity, bundan dolayı one should not perform it in haste or precede the Imām in any posture. bazı âlimler der ki this uyarı is not literal but figurative. başka bir deyişle, one who precedes the Imām will become zayıf in anlayış and intelligence like a donkey. Other scholars gibi Khaṭṭābī and Ibn Ḥajar state that a physical transformation of the body is also possible. Ibn Ḥajar mentioned the incident of a certain hadis scholar who daima taught from behind a veil. When one of his students insisted to see his face, it turned out to be that of a donkey. The scholar explained that he once tested the truth of Bu hadis by preceding the Imām from sajdah, and bütünāh transformed his face into that of a donkey.

1752.text: Placing the hand on the hip in namaz is yasakladı."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1752.commentary: Scholars have mentioned çeşitli reasons for this yasak: 1. On the plains of Qiyāmah, those destined for cehennem-fire will place their hands on their hips while waiting for the reckoning to commence. 2. When Shaiṭān was disgraced and expelled from cennet, he adopted this stance. 3. It is the stance of the proud and arrogant.

1753.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"namaz should not be performed when food is present, or when a person has the urge to relieve himself."(Müslüman)
1753.commentary: Performing ṣalāh when one is hard-pressed to eat or relieve oneself is mekruh because one's focus will be diverted from bütünāh. Similarly, her such amel which disturbs a person's concentration during ṣalāh should be completed before commencing ṣalāh. bununla birlikte, if the time for ṣalāh is limited and there is a korku that the ṣalāh may be missed completely, then one should perform the ṣalāh and then perform that amel.

1754.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"What is wrong with some people that they raise their gaze to the sky in their namaz?"He issued a stern warning against this to the extent that he dedi:"They should abstain from this or their eyesight will be snatched away."(Bukhārī, Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah, Aḥmad)
1754.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki a person should be focussed when performing ṣalāh and should not look around at others or at the sky above. Ṣalāh is a dialogue between the worshipper and his Creator, bundan dolayı one should not engage in any such ameller or thoughts which contradict this. If one looks around to the extent that one's chest turns away from the Qiblah, his ṣalāh will be nullified.

1755.text: I sordu Resûlullah (ﷺ) about looking around in namaz. He şöyle dedi: 'It is a means of Shaiṭān snatching away from a person'in namaz.'"(Bukhārī, Tirmidhī, Ḥākim)
1755.commentary: Namazda sağa sola bakmak, namazın gerektirdiği huşu ve kulluğa aykırıdır. Bu, şeytanın namazdan çalma yöntemidir.

1756.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: to me: 'Beware of turning around in namaz because it is a cause of destruction. If you have to do so, then let it be in Nafl namaz but not in Farḍ namaz.'"(Tirmidhī)
1756.commentary: Namazda sağa sola bakan kişi odaklanmasını kaybeder ve böylece ahiretteki sevabını azaltır.

1757.narrator: Abū Marthad Kannāz ibn al-Ḥuṣayn (رضي الله عنه)
1757.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Do not perform namaz towards graves nor sit on them."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasa'ī)
1757.commentary: Performing ṣalāh facing a grave in order to honour the occupant of that grave is kufr (küfür). Doing so without that niyet is Makrūh Taḥrīmī. It is not helal to do so even in the latter case because onlookers may consider that one is worshipping the grave. We are prohibited from sitting on graves because this is disrespectful and contradicts the honour and haysiyet which Islām demands for her person.

1758.narrator: Abū al-Juhaym 'Abdullāh ibn al-Ḥārith ibn al-Ṣimmah al-Anṣārī (رضي الله عنه)
1758.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If the person who walks across one offering namaz only knew the günah that he is committing, it would have been better for him to remain waiting for forty than to walk across him."The narrator dedi:"I do not know whether he dedi forty days, forty months or forty years."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Aḥmad)
1758.commentary: A person performing ṣalāh is focused towards the Qiblah and in dialogue with bütünāh. A person who walks across him distracts him from his purpose and has bu nedenle been warned against doing so. Scholars state that forty in Bu hadis işaret eder forty years.

1759.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When the iqāmah for the namaz is given, no namaz besides the obligatory may be performed."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
1759.commentary: The hikmet of this hüküm is that a person should attempt to tam his Sunnah and Nafl ṣalāhs before the Imām commences, so that he may join the Farḍ ṣalāh with dolu kulluk and acquire the great rewards of the first takbīr. ayrıca, an farz amel takes preference over an optional one. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah and Imām Mālik, Bu hadis excludes Fajr ṣalāh, bundan dolayı according to them it is helal to perform the Sunnah ṣalāh of Fajr after the Imām has commenced the Farḍ ṣalāh. According to Imām Shāfi'ī and Imām Aḥmad, it is Makrūh to perform any Sunnah or Nafl ṣalāhs once the Imām has commenced the Farḍ ṣalāh.

1760.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not select only the night of Cuma over other nights for performing namaz, and do not select only the day of Cuma over other days for oruç, unless it is part of the fast which you normally keep."(Müslüman, Ḥākim)
1760.commentary: çeşitli reasons have been given by the scholars for not fasting exclusively on the day of Jumu'ah: 1. One should focus on the other forms of ibadet on this day gibi a special ghusl, proceeding early to the masjid, listening attentively to the sermon, and engaging in du'ā', durūd, dhikr and Nafl ṣalāh. By not fasting, one will have additional strength to exert oneself in these forms of ibadet. 2. Jumu'ah has been called the day of 'Īd and one cannot fast on the day of 'Īd. 3. The Muslims should not exaggerate the greatness of Jumu'ah as the Jews and Christians exaggerated their days of fazilet.

1761.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"None of you should fast on the day of Cuma unless he also fasts a day before or after."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī)

1762.text: Muḥammad ibn 'Abbād anlatır:"I sordu Jābir (رضي الله عنه): 'Did Resûlullah (ﷺ) forbid oruç on the day of Cuma?' He cevap verdi: 'Yes.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)

1763.narrator: Umm al-Mu'minīn Juwayriyah bint al-Ḥārith (رضي الله عنها)
1763.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) visited her on the day of Cuma and she was oruç. He sordu:"Did you fast yesterday?"She cevap verdi:"No."He sordu:"Do you intend oruç tomorrow?"She cevap verdi:"No."He dedi:"Then break your fast."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)

1764.text: Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) and 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) narrate that Resûlullah (ﷺ) yasakladı continuous oruç. (Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1764.commentary: Fasting for two or more days without eating or drinking between them is prohibited because it induces weakness in the body and this is harmful for other ibadetler. Such fasting causes difficulty to a Muslim, whereas bütünāh desires ease.

1765.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı continuous oruç. The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) dedi to him:"But you fast continuously."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) cevap verdi:"I am not like you. I am provided with food and drink."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1765.commentary: The Messenger (ﷺ) was permitted to fast for days at a time without eating or drinking because of the following reasons: 1. The Messenger (ﷺ) was granted food and drink by bütünāh from cennet. 2. The Messenger (ﷺ) was given sabır, willpower and physical strength by bütünāh. 3. According to Ibn Qayyim, the Messenger (ﷺ) was showered with such ilâhî radiance from bütünāh while fasting that made him independent of food and drink.

1766.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"For one of you to sit on a burning coal which burns his clothes and reaches his skin is better than sitting on a grave."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1766.commentary: It is not helal to sit on a grave as this is contrary to the saygı Islām demands for fellow insanî beings.

1767.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı plastering over a grave, sitting on it, and building on it."(Müslüman)
1767.commentary: It is not helal to plaster a grave from the inside or outside, or to build a dome or structure above it because it entails unnecessary wastage of wealth. aslında, if something has been built on a grave, it is compulsory to remove it as 'Alī (رضي الله عنه) once did upon the emir of the Messenger (ﷺ).

1768.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a slave escapes from his master, he loses his İslâmic protection."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1768.commentary: A slave who escapes from Dār al-Islām to Dār al-Ḥarb and becomes a renegade, loses bütün the haklar and koruma he enjoyed under Islām and should be killed.

1769.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a slave escapes from his master, no namaz of his is accepted."Another narration has:"He has committed kufr (disbelief)."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1769.commentary: "No ṣalāh of his is accepted" demektir ki he will not be rewarded by bütünāh for performing ṣalāh. "He has committed kufr (küfür)" demektir ki he has been unappreciative of the bounties of his master, or has committed an amel yani tantamount to küfür. One who is entrusted with a particular job or responsibility should fulfil its requirements to the best of his ability.

1770.text: The Quraysh were very concerned about the Makzūmī woman who had committed theft and dedi: 'Who will speak to Resûlullah (ﷺ) about her?' They dedi: 'Who will have the courage to do so except Usāmah ibn Zayd, the beloved of Resûlullah (ﷺ)?' So Usāmah spoke to him and Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi: 'Are you interceding in one of the penal laws of Allāh?' He then stood up and addressed the people diyerek: 'The nations before you were destroyed because when a noble person among them committed theft, they left him alone, but when a weak person committed theft, they meted out the azap to him. By Allāh, if Fāṭimah the daughter of Muḥammad were to commit theft, I will cut off her hand.'"Another narration has:"The face of Resûlullah (ﷺ) changed colour and he dedi: 'Are you interceding in one of the penal laws of Allāh?' Usāmah (رضي الله عنه) dedi: 'Seek bağışlanma for me, O Messenger of Allāh.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) gave the order regarding the woman and her hand was cut off."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1770.commentary: The woman referred to here was the daughter of the brother of Abū Salamah (رضي الله عنه). The hadis bize öğretir ki Islām is a din of adalet and eşitlik. It does not differentiate between the rich and poor regarding the implementation of laws. One may intercede in a case which demands the implementation of penal law before it reaches an Islāmic court. After it reaches the court, intercession will not be geçerli. The hadis also highlights the fazilet of Usāmah ibn Zayd (رضي الله عنه) and his status in the sight of the Messenger (ﷺ).

1771.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Beware of two actions which provoke curses."The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) sordu:"What are the two actions which provoke curses?"He cevap verdi:"One who relieves himself where people walk or seek shade."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1771.commentary: Bu hadis bize öğretir ki a Muslim should not harm or inconvenience others by relieving himself in communal places.

1772.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı urinating in stagnant water."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1772.commentary: Stagnant water here işaret eder a small quantity of water gibi a pond. It is prohibited to urinate or defecate in such water because it will render the water impure. One should also not urinate close to such water because the impurity may reach the water and contaminate it. Scholars state that one should not even urinate in flowing water because if birçok people do so it will also become impure after a time.

1773.text: His father brought him to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and dedi:"I gave this son of mine a slave that I owned."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sordu:"Did you give all your children a similar gift?"He cevap verdi:"No."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi:"Then take the slave back."Another narration has:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sordu: 'Did you do this to all your children?' He cevap verdi: 'No.' He dedi: 'Fear Allāh and treat your children equally.' My father returned and took back the sadaka."Another narration has:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) sordu: 'O Bashīr, do you have other children?' He cevap verdi: 'Yes.' He sordu: 'Did you give a similar gift to all of them?' He cevap verdi: 'No.' He dedi: 'Then do not make me a şahit to this because I cannot be a şahit to an injustice.'"Another narration has:"Do not make me a şahit to an injustice."Another narration has:"Make someone else a şahit to this."He then dedi:"Would you not like all of them to be equal in their obedience to you?"He cevap verdi:"Yes, indeed."He dedi:"Then do not do that."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
1773.commentary: Favouring bazı children over others causes enmity and disunity between them, bundan dolayı it should be avoided at bütün costs. According to Imām Aḥmad (رحمه الله), such a gift in which bazı are favoured over others is Ḥarām and not geçerli. According to the other Imāms, the gift will be geçerli but it will be Makrūh. bununla birlikte, if a parent assists a particular child due to bazı need, gibi poverty, then there is no harm.

1774.narrator: Zeynep bint Ebû Seleme (رضي الله عنها)
1774.text: I went to visit Umm Ḥabībah (رضي الله عنها), the wife of the Messenger (ﷺ), when her father, Abū Sufyān ibn Ḥarb (رضي الله عنه) passed away. She sordu for some yellow-coloured perfume or something like that and applied some of it to a slave-girl. She then rubbed some of it on her own cheeks and dedi: 'By Allāh, I have no need for perfume, however, I heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek while on the pulpit: 'It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allāh and the Last Day to mourn over a deceased for more than three days besides her husband, for whom she may do so for four months and ten days.' Zaynab dedi: 'I then went to visit Zaynab bint Jaḥsh (رضي الله عنها) when her brother passed away. She sordu for some perfume and applied some of it. She then dedi: 'Listen, by Allāh, I have no need for perfume, however, I heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek while on the pulpit: 'It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allāh and the Last Day to mourn over a deceased for more than three days besides her husband, for whom she may do so for four months and ten days.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1774.commentary: In these incidents the blessed wives of the Messenger (ﷺ) applied perfume in order to display the impermissibility for a woman to mourn for more than three days for anyone besides her husband. A woman should mourn for this extended period for her husband because of his noble doğru over her as a husband, the bond of sevgi that existed between them and to establish that she is not pregnant with his child.

1775.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı an urban-dweller to sell on behalf of a rural-dweller even if he is a blood brother."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1775.commentary: Hadis, şehirlinin, köylü adına mal satmamasını emreder. Bu, köylünün kendi malını istediği fiyata satma hakkını korumak içindir.

1776.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not go out to meet goods before they reach the markets."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1776.commentary: Bu hadis commands that trade caravans should not be intercepted before reaching the market for purchase at a lower price because this prevents the sellers from ascertaining the gerçek market value of the goods. Such davranış also does harm to the genuine buyers and sellers and allows people to generate excessive profits.

1777.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not go ahead to meet caravans, and an urban-dweller should not sell on behalf of a rural-dweller."Ṭā'ūs sordu:"What does it mean that 'an urban-dweller should not sell on behalf of a rural-dweller'?"He cevap verdi:"He should not be his agent."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)

1778.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı an urban-dweller to sell on behalf of a rural-dweller, offering to purchase in order to raise the price, purchase in the midst of another brother'in purchase, sending a marriage proposal when another brother has proposed, and for a woman to ask for her sister to be divorced so that she may take her place."Another narration has:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı from going ahead to meet the trade caravans, an urban-dweller selling on behalf of a rural-dweller, a woman demanding that her sister be divorced, raising the price after the transaction has already been concluded, and he yasakladı offering to purchase in order to raise the price, and leaving milk in the udders of an animal."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasa'ī)
1778.commentary: Neceş, satın alma niyeti olmadan bir malın fiyatını yükseltmek demektir. Bu, aldatma olduğu için haramdır.

1779.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"You should not purchase in the midst of another purchase, and you should not send a marriage proposal when another brother has proposed unless he gives permission."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)

1780.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A mümin is a brother of another mümin and it is therefore not lawful for a mümin to purchase in the midst of another brother'in purchase, and he should not send a marriage proposal when another brother has proposed unless he withdraws."(Müslüman)

1781.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) likes three things for you and dislikes three things for you. He likes that you ibadet Him, that you do not ascribe any partners with Him, and that you hold to the rope of Allāh together without disuniting between yourselves. He dislikes idle chatter, excessive questions, and squandering of mal."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Mālik)
1781.commentary: Excessive questions for the purposes of disputing and sparking enmity are not helal. The Qur'ān also forbade this type of behaviour by highlighting the excessive questions posed by the Banī Isrā'īl. bütünāh (ﷻ) has created wealth for the functioning and operation of this dünya hayatı. It should be utilised in the doğru yol by giving zakāt, lillāh and purchasing items of necessity gibi food, clothing, etc. Squandering of wealth by using it in impermissible avenues, purchasing items which are useless or futile, spending exorbitant amounts on personal beautification and so forth is prohibited.

1782.text: Warrād, the scribe of al-Mughīrān ibn Shu'bah (رضي الله عنه), anlatır:"Al-Mughīrah dictated to me in a letter which he wrote to Mu'āwiyah (رضي الله عنه) that Resûlullah (ﷺ) used to say after every obligatory namaz: 'There is none worthy of ibadet besides Allāh. He is one and has no partner. His is the sovereignty and to Him belongs all praise. He has power over everything. O Allāh, none can withhold what You give and none can give what You withhold. The influence of any person who has it is of no avail against You.' He also wrote to him diyerek: 'He yasakladı idle chatter, squandering of mal and excessive questions. He yasakladı disobedience to mothers, burying of daughters alive, refusing to give what is due upon you and demanding what is not rightfully yours.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1782.commentary: Bu dua daha önce zikredilmiş ve açıklanmıştır. Bkz. hadis 1416. Hadisler bu konuda yazılıp kaydedilmiştir.

1783.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"None of you should point a weapon at his brother because it is possible that Shaiṭān may snatch it from his hand and thereby cause him to fall into a pit of cehennem ateşi."A narration of Müslüman has: Abū al-Qāsim (ﷺ) dedi:"If someone points a piece of iron at his brother, the angels curse him until he puts it down even if it is his blood brother."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Ḥākim)
1783.commentary: Bu hadis, bir mümine silah doğrultmaya karşı uyarır çünkü şeytan kişinin elini iterek bir kazaya sebep olabilir.

1784.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı the handing over of an unsheathed sword."(Abū Dāwūd, Tirmidhī, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1784.commentary: The hadis warns us against handing over an unsheathed sword because it may easily slip causing injury. ayrıca, it is Ḥarām to create korku in the heart of a believer. Scholars explain that a sword, knife or any sharp object should be handed over by placing the handle towards the person it is being given to so that no harm may result.

1785.text: Abū al-Sha'thā' anlatır:"We were sitting with Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) in the mescid and the mu'adhdhin called out the adhān. A man stood up and walked out of the mescid. Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) watched him until he left the mescid. Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) then dedi: 'This person has disobeyed Abū al-Qāsim (ﷺ).'"(Müslüman)
1785.commentary: One should not unnecessarily leave the masjid after the adhān has been called because it is possible that one may be deprived of performing the ṣalāh altogether, and it may also create evil thoughts in the minds of others. bununla birlikte, if one has a geçerli excuse, then it will be helal.

1786.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who is offered perfume should not refuse it because it is light to carry and fragrant in scent."(Müslüman)
1786.commentary: One should not refuse the gift of 'itr because it is a pleasant gift. Ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) narrated that a person should not refuse three things: a pillow, 'itr and milk. Giving 'itr as a gift and applying it özellikle before attending a gathering is Mustaḥab.

1787.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) güzel kokuyu reddetmezdi. (Buhârî, Ahmed, Tirmizî)
1787.commentary: 'bütünāmah 'Ainī (رحمه الله) stated that the Messenger (ﷺ) loved perfume because he would interact with the angels who dislike offensive odours. Scholars state that the hadis teaches the basic principle that one should not reject the gift of 'itr or any other such beneficial item which is easy to give and receive.

1788.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) heard a person praising someone excessively. He (ﷺ) dedi: 'You have destroyed him - or you have broken the man'in back.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1788.commentary: The hadis demektir ki praising a person to his face may result in him developing pride, a quality which will destroy his spirituality and rewards in the ahiret. Praise is of three types: 1. Praising an individual to his face is impermissible. 2. Praising an individual in his absence hoping that such praise will reach him is also impermissible. 3. Praising an individual without any niyet of such praise reaching him is helal. The hadis advises us that if it is necessary to praise an individual, then one should say that he thinks him to be praiseworthy. yani, he should not praise him with certainty and conviction because bütünāh (ﷻ) is the only one who knows the internal status and goodness of a person.

1789.text: A person was mentioned in the presence of Resûlullah (ﷺ) and another praised him. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'Destruction to you! You have severed your friend'in neck,' and repeated it several times. 'If you really need to praise someone, say: 'I think he is like this or like that', if you think him to be like that. Only Allāh can call him to account and none can claim purity before Allāh.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)

1790.text: Hammām ibn al-Ḥārith anlatır from al-Miqdād (رضي الله عنه) that a man began praising 'Uthmān (رضي الله عنه), so al-Miqdād (رضي الله عنه) went forward, sat up on his knees and began to throw pebbles on his face. 'Uthmān (رضي الله عنه) sordu him:"What are you doing?"He cevap verdi:"The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'When you see people praising others, then throw dust in their faces.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1790.commentary: These aḥādīth prohibit it, but there are birçok other sahih aḥādīth which permit it. Scholars state that the yöntem of reconciling between these çeşitli aḥādīth is to say that if the person who is praised has mükemmel īmān and conviction, self discipline and tam knowledge by fazilet of which he is neither tempted nor deceived by such praise, and his soul does not play around with him, then it is neither unlawful nor undesirable. But if it is feared that he will be overcome by any of these matters, it is strongly undesirable to praise him to his face.

1791.text: 'Umar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb (رضي الله عنه) set out for Syria. When he reached Sargh, the army commanders, Abū 'Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrāḥ (رضي الله عنه) and his companions met him and haber verdi him that a plague had broken out in Syria. Ibn 'Abbās (رضي الله عنه) dedi:"'Umar (رضي الله عنه) dedi to me: 'Call the first of the Muhājirīn.' I called them and 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) consulted them. He haber verdi them of the plague that had broken out in Syria. They differed in opinion. Some of them dedi: 'You set out for a particular purpose and we do not think that you should divert from it.' Others dedi: 'With you are people and the Sahâbe of Resûlullah (ﷺ). We do not think you should expose them to this plague.' He dedi: 'You may go.' He then dedi: 'Call the Anṣār.' I called them and he consulted with them. They differed among themselves as the Muhājirīn had done. He dedi: 'You may go.' He then dedi: 'Call the elders of the Quraysh who migrated before the conquest of Makkah.' I called them and they all unanimously dedi: 'We think that you should return with the people and not expose them to this plague.' 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) then announced to the people: 'I will be returning tomorrow morning, so you people should also prepare to return in the morning.' Abū 'Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrāḥ (رضي الله عنه) dedi to him: 'Are you fleeing from the decree of Allāh?' 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) dedi: 'If only someone besides you had made such a statement.' 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) disliked opposing him. 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) dedi: 'Yes. We are fleeing from the decree of Allāh and going towards the decree of Allāh. If you had camels and they descended into a valley which had two sections, one of which was fertile while the other was barren; if you were to graze them in the fertile area, will you not be grazing them by the decree of Allāh, and if you were to graze them in the barren area, will you not be grazing them by the decree of Allāh?' 'Abd al-Raḥmān ibn 'Auf (رضي الله عنه) who had been busy elsewhere then arrived and dedi: 'I have some knowledge regarding this. I heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek: 'When you hear of a plague in an area, do not go to it, and if you are in an area where a plague erupts, do not flee from it.' 'Umar (رضي الله عنه) then praised Allah (ﷻ) and returned (to Madīnah)."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1791.commentary: Bir yönetici, tebaasına danışmalı ancak onların görüşlerini kabul etmek zorunda değildir. İstişare, doğru karar vermeye yardımcı olur.

1792.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When you hear of a plague in a particular area, do not enter it, and if it erupts in an area where you are, do not leave it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
1792.commentary: Mümin, hastalık ve musibetlerden korunmak için gerekli tedbirleri almalıdır. Bu sebeple koruyucu hekimlik ve sağlık önlemleri önemlidir.

1793.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Refrain from the seven destructive günahlar."The Sahâbe (رضي الله عنهم) sordu:"What are they, O Messenger of Allāh?"He cevap verdi:"Ascribing partners with Allāh, black magic, killing a person whom Allāh has forbidden unless for justice, consuming usury (interest), consuming the mal of an orphan, fleeing from the battlefield, and slandering chaste, innocent believing women."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Abū Dāwūd)
