1793.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 1615. It is repeated here to highlight the yasak and şiddet of black magic. That it is mentioned immediately after ascribing partners with bütünāh (ﷻ) and before killing another unjustly, proves the şiddet of its günah.

1794.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı travelling with the Kur'an to enemy lands."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1794.commentary: It is prohibited to travel with a Qur'ān to enemy lands when one fears that the enemy may saygısızlık it or mock at it. If there is no such korku, this yasak does not apply.

1795.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who drinks from a silver utensil is gulping down cehennem ateşi into his stomach."Another narration of Müslüman has:"One who eats or drinks from a gold and silver utensil."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1795.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned previously. See hadis 778. It bize öğretir ki it is not helal to utilise gold and silver utensils for eating, drinking, performing wuḍū' or applying 'itr. It is haram for men to wear gold watches and rings or to write with golden pens.

1796.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı us from silk, silk brocade, and drinking from gold and silver utensils."He dedi:"They are for them in this world and for you in ahiret."Another narration has: Ḥudhayfah (رضي الله عنه) dedi: I heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"Do not wear silk or silk brocade. Do not drink from gold and silver utensils. And do not eat from such plates."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1796.commentary: Another narration states that one who wears silk in dünya will be deprived of wearing it in the ahiret. Silk garments are only haram for men and not women.

1797.text: Anas ibn Sīrīn anlatır:"I was with Anas ibn Mālik (رضي الله عنه) and a group of Magians when some fālūdhaj was brought in a silver utensil, but Anas (رضي الله عنه) did not eat from it. The person was told to change the utensil so he placed it in a wooden utensil and brought it. Anas (رضي الله عنه) then ate from it."(Bayhaqī)
1797.commentary: If food has been placed in a gold or silver utensil, it should only be eaten after being transferred to another utensil. The aḥādīth of Bu bölüm reveal yanilām encourages simplicity in food, drinks, household appliances, etc. Extravagance, wastage and imitation of the ways of the disbelievers is prohibited.

1798.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) yasakladı men from using saffron."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasa'ī)

1799.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنه)
1799.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) saw me wearing two yellow-coloured garments. He dedi: 'Did your mother order you to wear this?' I cevap verdi: 'Should I wash them?' He dedi: 'No, rather burn them.'"Another narration has:"These are the garments of the disbelievers, so do not wear them."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1799.commentary: The Messenger's (ﷺ) instruction to burn them was to inform the Ṣaḥābī of the şiddet of the günah and to prohibit others from doing so. The reason for prohibiting such clothing for men is that this colour is commonly used by women to beautify themselves, bundan dolayı men should not imitate them. While these aḥādīth prohibit the wearing of saffron-coloured garments for men, other aḥādīth permit it. Scholars have explained this contradiction as follows: 1. It was initially helal to wear such garments, but this law was later abrogated for men. 2. Those narrations that permit it refer to clothing that was coloured with saffron for fragrance purposes and after washing, very little of the colour remains.

1800.text: I memorised from Resûlullah (ﷺ): 'None can be an orphan after puberty, and none should remain silent from morning to night.'"(Abū Dāwūd) In explaining this hadis, al-Khaṭṭābī (رحمه الله) dedi:"Remaining silent was one of the customs of jāhilīyyah, hence they were yasakladı from this in İslâm and ordered to engage in the remembrance of Allāh and beneficial discussions."
1800.commentary: Bu hadisler, suskunluğun İslâm'da bir ibadet şekli olmadığını öğretir. Evet, gereksiz konuşmalardan kaçınmak iyidir, ancak susmak başlı başına bir ibadet değildir.

1801.text: Qays ibn Abī Ḥāzim anlatır:"Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq (رضي الله عنه) once went to a woman from the Aḥmas tribe called Zaynab and noticed that she was not speaking. He sordu: 'Why is she not speaking?' They cevap verdi: 'She made the intention not to speak.' He dedi to her: 'Speak, because this (silence) is not lawful. This is from the customs of jāhilīyyah.' So she began speaking."(Bukhārī)

1802.narrator: Sa'd bin Ebû Vakkās (رضي الله عنه)
1802.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who ascribes lineage to someone other than his own father while knowing that that person is not his father, then Cennet is unlawful for him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)

1803.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Do not disown your fathers. One who disowns his father commits disbelief."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1803.commentary: One who attributes his lineage to someone other than his father and assumes this as helal commits an act of kufr (küfür). bazen a high ranking person is ashamed to link himself to his father because the latter may be a poor and humble individual, but this is an unjust denial of the person through whom one came into existence. Islām regards the knowledge of lineages and relatives as important because it enables one to fulfil the necessary haklar due upon people. It also helps to protect the laws of marriage because if one cannot identify close relatives, one may easily marry a person whom Islām has haram to marry.

1804.text: Yazīd ibn Sharīk ibn Ṭāriq anlatır:"I saw 'Alī (رضي الله عنه) delivering a sermon from the pulpit and I heard him diyerek: 'By Allāh, we have no book to read besides the Book of Allāh and what is in this scroll. He unfolded it and it contained information on the ages of camels (for zakāt) and compensation for those who suffer injuries. In it Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi: 'Madīnah is a sanctuary from 'Ayr to Thaur. Therefore, one who initiates an innovation (bid'ah) in it or gives refuge to an innovator will earn the curse of Allāh, the angels and people. On the day of Kıyamet, Allāh will not accept repentance or ransom from him. The pledge of protection given by a Müslüman, even the lowest of them, is valid. One who breaks the pledge of a Müslüman earns the curse of Allāh, the angels and all people. On the day of Kıyamet, Allāh will not accept repentance or ransom from him. One who claims lineage from other than his father, or a slave who claims another as his master, earns the curse of Allāh, the angels and all people. On the day of Kıyamet, Allāh will not accept repentance or ransom from him.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1804.commentary: The region between the two mountains mentioned in Bu hadis is sacred, bundan dolayı according to Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله), Imām Aḥmad (رحمه الله) and Imām Mālik (رحمه الله) no animal can be hunted here and no tree may be cut down. According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله), no such amel should be done which contradicts the sanctity of the area, bununla birlikte one may hunt or cut down a tree. The ifade of 'Alī (رضي الله عنه) that he possessed nothing besides the Qur'ān and the scroll is a clear proof against the Shī'a who claim that the Messenger (ﷺ) had imparted to him bazı secret knowledge of Islām.

1805.text: He heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"One who knowingly claims lineage to other than his father, commits an act of disbelief. One who lays claim to what is not his is not of us. He should prepare his abode in cehennem ateşi. One who accuses another of disbelief or says: 'O enemy of Allāh!', when it is not the case, it will revert to him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1805.commentary: "Cehennem ateşinde yerini hazırlasın" ifadesi, ya bir beddua olarak ya da bir tehdit olarak yorumlanabilir.

1806.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) has a sense of discontent and His discontent manifests when a person commits an act which Allāh has made unlawful for him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1806.commentary: Bu hadis daha önce zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 64.

1807.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who takes an oath by diyerek: 'By al-Lāt and al-'Uzzā', should say, 'There is none worthy of ibadet besides Allāh.' One who says to his friend: 'Come, let us gamble', should give sadaka."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1807.commentary: One who mistakenly takes an oath on yanlış deities should recite the kalimah in kefaret, and if one did so knowingly believing it to be gerçek, then he should recite the kalimah to renew his īmān because he has committed an act of küfür. One who invites another to commit such a günah as gambling should make amends by giving bazı of his wealth in ṣadaqah.

1808.text: One morning, Resûlullah (ﷺ) spoke about Dajjāl lowering and raising his voice until we thought that he was in a nearby date-palm grove. When we went to see him later on, he realised our anxiety and sordu: 'What has happened with you?' We cevap verdi: 'O Messenger of Allāh, you spoke about Dajjāl in the morning lowering and raising your voice until we thought that he was in a nearby date-palm grove.' He dedi: 'Other things cause me to korku more for you than Dajjāl. If he appears while I am present among you, I will defeat him for your benefit. If he appears while I am not present among you, each person will have to defend himself and Allāh will be my deputy for every Müslüman. He is a youth with curly hair and his one eye will be protruding. I can compare him to 'Abd al-'Uzzā ibn Qaṭan. Anyone of you who meets him should recite the beginning verses of Sûre al-Kahf. He will appear on the road between Syria and Iraq and spread corruption to the right and left. O kullar of Allāh, remain steadfast!' We sordu: 'O Messenger of Allāh, how long will he remain on earth?' He cevap verdi: 'Forty days. One day will be equal to a year; one day will be equal to a month; one day will be like a Cuma, and the rest of his days will be the same as yours.' We sordu: 'O Messenger of Allāh, the day which will be equal to a year, will it suffice us to perform namaz for one day?' He cevap verdi: 'No, you will have to calculate.' We sordu: 'O Messenger of Allāh, how fast will he travel on earth?' He cevap verdi: 'Like rain propelled by wind. He will go to a people and invite them. They will believe him and respond to his call. He will order the heavens and it will rain, and order the earth and it will produce vegetation. Their grazing animals will return to them in the evening with the highest humps, fullest udders and broadest flanks. He will then go to a people and invite them but they will reject his message. He will depart from them and they will be struck by a drought and will be left with no mal whatsoever. He will pass by a completely deserted land and order it diyerek: 'Reveal your treasures,' and its treasures will follow him like a swarm of bees. He will then call a youth in his prime, strike him swiftly with a sword and cut him into two pieces. He will then call the youth who will walk towards him with his face beaming and laughing.' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) continued: 'While these events are unfolding, Allāh will send al-Masīḥ ibn Maryam (عليه السلام). He will descend on the white minaret to the east of Damascus, wearing two coloured garments and with his hands on the wings of two angels. When he lowers his head, drops of water will fall, and when he raises his head, drops like pearls will flow from it. Every kâfir who gets a whiff of his breath will die, and his breath will reach as far as his eyes can see. He will then search for Dajjāl until he finds him at the door of Ludd, and kill him. 'Īsā (عليه السلام) will then go to a people whom Allāh had protected from Dajjāl. He will pass his hand on their faces and inform them of their ranks in Cennet...'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1808.commentary: Bu hadis explains the evil of Dajjāl and the çeşitli tribulations that people will face when he emerges. 'bütünāmah Ṭībī (رحمه الله) stated that those who recite Sūrah Kahf will be protected from the evil of Dajjāl tıpkı... gibi the youth mentioned in this Sūrah were protected from the tyrant king of their time. The hadis mentions that 'Īsā (عليه السلام) will descend towards the east of Syria. bazı scholars interpret this as the area of Bait al-Maqdis. During his reign, adalet will prevail and there will be abundant blessings. After him, şartlar will deteriorate drastically, until such a time when no believer will remain on the face of the earth. This will herald the coming of Qiyāmah.

1809.text: Rib'ī ibn Ḥirāsh anlatır:"I accompanied Abū Mas'ūd al-Anṣārī to visit Ḥudhayfah ibn al-Yamān (رضي الله عنهم) and Abū Mas'ūd dedi to him: 'Relate to me what you heard from Resûlullah (ﷺ) about Dajjāl.' He cevap verdi: 'Dajjāl will appear with water and fire. What the people will assume to be water will actually be fire that burns, and what they assume to be fire will actually be cool, sweet water. Any of you who meet him should jump into what appears as fire because it is actually pure, sweet water.' Abū Mas'ūd dedi: 'I also heard this.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)

1810.narrator: Abdullah bin Amr bin el-Âs (رضي الله عنه)
1810.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Dajjāl will emerge among my Ummah and remain for forty – I do not know whether it will be forty days, forty months or forty years. Allāh will then send 'Īsā ibn Maryam (عليه السلام) who will search for him and destroy him. The people will then remain for seven years without any enmity between them. Allāh will then send a cool breeze from the direction of Syria and it will seize every person who has even an iota of good or īmān in his heart. If any of you were to hide in the depths of a mountain, it will reach you and seize you. The evil people will remain and they will be like swift birds and animals of prey in shedding blood. They will neither recognise good nor dislike evil. Shaiṭān will come to them in human form and say: 'Are you not going to listen?' They will ask: 'What do you command?' He will order them to ibadet idols. Despite this, they will receive abundant sustenance and will live a comfortable life. The Trumpet will then be blown and every person who hears it will lower one side of his neck and raise the other (to listen). The first to hear it will be a person repairing his camels' water trough. He will fall unconscious and so will everyone around him. Allāh will then send – or he dedi: 'Allāh will make fall' – rain that will be like dew or a shadow, and the bodies of people will grow (like plants) due to it. The trumpet will be blown again and the people will all be standing and looking around them. It will be dedi: 'O people, come to your Sustainer. Make them stand, as they are to be questioned.' It will be dedi: 'Remove those who are destined for Hell-fire.' The angels will ask: 'How many?' It will be dedi: 'Nine hundred and ninety nine from every thousand.' That will be a day which will turn children grey. That will be a day when the shins will be exposed."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1810.commentary: Bu hadis explains bazı of the events prior to Qiyāmah. It is desteklenen by another hadis which mentions that Qiyāmah will not occur until people take the name of bütünāh (ﷻ) remain on the earth.

1811.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Dajjāl will set foot upon every single land except for Makkah and Madīnah. Every entrance leading to Makkah and Madīnah is guarded by angels standing in rows. Dajjāl will halt at a swamp near Madīnah and the city will be shaken three times. Allāh will expel every kâfir and münafık from it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1811.commentary: Bu depremlerin etkisiyle, Deccal'e uyan Müslümanlar Medine-i Münevvere'de emniyette olacak, ancak şehir sarsıntılarla korunacaktır.

1812.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Seventy thousand Jews of Iṣfahān (in Iran) who will be wearing green robes will follow Dajjāl."(Müslüman)

1813.text: She heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"People will flee from Dajjāl into the mountains."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)

1814.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"There is no greater tribulation from the time of the creation of Ādam (عليه السلام) to the Final Hour than Dajjāl."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1814.commentary: This is because of his immense evil, deception and the tribulations he will create. Only a az sayıda will be safe from his plots.

1815.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When Dajjāl appears, a mümin will go towards him. The armed guards of Dajjāl will ask: 'Where are you going?' He will reply: 'I am going towards this one who has emerged.' They will ask: 'Do you not believe in our lord (Dajjāl)?' He will reply: 'Our Lord (Allāh) is not concealed.' They will say: 'Kill him.' They will then say to one another: 'Did your lord not prohibit you from killing someone without his permission?' They will then take him to Dajjāl. When the mümin sees him, he will say: 'O people, this is the Dajjāl whom Resûlullah (ﷺ) spoke about.' Dajjāl will order that he be laid on his stomach. He will then say: 'Seize him and strike him on his head and face.' The beating will expand his back and stomach. He will ask: 'Do you not believe in me?' He will reply: 'You are the false Messiah.' Dajjāl will then order him to be sawn with a saw from the centre of his head until it separates between his legs. Dajjāl will then walk between the two halves of his body and say to him: 'Stand up,' and he will stand up straight. He will then ask him: 'Do you believe in me?' He will reply: 'Now I am even more convinced (that you are the Dajjāl).' He (the mümin) will say: 'O people, he will not be able to do this to anyone else after me.' Dajjāl will seize him in order to slaughter him, but Allāh will place copper between his neck and collarbone and he will be unable to do so. He will grab him by his hands and legs and throw him. People will assume that he has thrown him into the fire, but he will have thrown him into Cennet."The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) then dedi:"This person will be the greatest martyr in the sight of Allāh."(Müslüman)
1815.commentary: This believer will be the greatest martyr because of his immense sacrifice and his proclamation of the truth to the liar, disbeliever and oppressor, Dajjāl. Scholars explain that when he is thrown into the fire, it will become cool for him tıpkı... gibi it became cool for Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام).

1816.text: No one sordu Resûlullah (ﷺ) about Dajjāl more than I did. He dedi to me: 'He will not harm you.' I dedi: 'People claim that he will have a mountain of bread and a river of water.' He dedi: 'He is not worthy of that in the sight of Allāh.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1816.commentary: "He is not worthy of that in the sight of bütünāh," demektir ki Dajjāl will not have the strength and ability to mislead the believers through these signs given to him by bütünāh. aslında, these very signs will be a testimony of his falsehood. The more he will try to mislead the believers by his deception, the stronger their īmān will become.

1817.text: Anas bildirdi that Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi,"Every Messenger warned his community about the one-eyed liar. He is one-eyed and your Sustainer is not one-eyed. Written between his eyes are the letters kāf, fā, rā."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1817.commentary: her Messenger of bütünāh (عليه السلام) warned his people about Dajjāl because of the overwhelming danger he will pose. The Messenger (ﷺ) described him to us in clear terms and stated that her gerçek believer will recognise him by the letters on his forehead. Further, he will be exposed to be a liar and imposter because he will claim to be Lord despite having physical defects. gerçek believers will not fall for his claims because they know that their Sustainer, bütünāh (ﷻ), is free of any defects and deficiencies.

1818.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Should I not tell you something about Dajjāl which no Messenger told his people? He is one-eyed. He will bring with him the likeness of Cennet and cehennem ateşi. What he refers to as Cennet is actually cehennem ateşi."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1818.commentary: Deccal, kendisini inkâr edenleri bir ateşe atacak, ancak bu ateş onlar için serin ve rahat olacaktır. Bu, Deccal'in fitnesinin büyüklüğünü gösterir.

1819.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) spoke about Dajjāl to the people and dedi:"Allāh is not one-eyed, but al-Masīḥ al-Dajjāl is blind in the right eye which is like a protruding grape."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1819.commentary: çeşitli narrations describe the eyes of Dajjāl. özetle, scholars explain that her iki his eyes will have a defect which will make his deception clear and apparent because the gerçek Sustainer of the worlds, bütünāh (ﷻ), is free of defects.

1820.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The Final Hour will not come until the Müslümans fight the Jews and the Jews will hide behind rocks and trees. The rocks and trees will say: 'O Müslüman! Here is a Jew behind me. Come and kill him!' This excludes the Gharqad tree because it is the tree of the Jews."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1820.commentary: Bu hadis describes a prophecy close to Qiyāmah when the Muslims will fight the Jews. bütün the trees and rocks will assist the Muslims except the Gharqad tree which is a thorny tree found in abundance in Palestine. Scholars state that the current settling of Jews in Palestine is part of the culmination of this prophecy because it would have been impossible for the Muslims to fight the Jews when they were dispersed throughout the world. In this final and decisive battle, the Muslims will defeat the Jews by the assistance of bütünāh (ﷻ).

1821.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"By that Being in whose control is my life, this world will not come to an end until a man passes by a grave and rolls on it, diyerek: 'If only I was in the place of this person buried here.' It will not be due to religion but because of the tribulations of the world."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1821.commentary: Kıyamete yakın, kötülük, fitneler ve musibetler o kadar artacak ki insanlar neyin doğru neyin yanlış olduğunu ayırt edemez hale gelecektir.

1822.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu: The Final Hour will not come until the Euphrates river dries up and exposes a mountain of gold that lies within it. People will fight over it and ninety nine out of every hundred will be killed. Each one of them will say, 'I ümit that I will be the one who is saved.' Another narration has:"A time will soon come when the Euphrates river will dry up and expose its treasures of gold. Whoever is present at that time should not take any of it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1822.commentary: Müslümanlara bu altının hiçbirini arzulamaları tavsiye edilmez çünkü o sadece bir fitne ve çekişme kaynağı olacaktır.

1823.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"People will leave Madīnah despite the good it contains and only wild beasts and birds will live in it. The last people to be brought for the Final Hour will be two shepherds from the Muzaynah tribe who will be heading towards Madīnah. They will herd their sheep towards it and find it deserted. When they reach Thanīyyat al-Wadā', they will fall on their faces."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1823.commentary: Bu hadis iki şekilde yorumlanmıştır. Kadı Iyâd (رحمه الله) ve İmam Kurtubî (رحمه الله) gibi âlimler, bu hadisin bir fitne alameti olduğunu belirtmişlerdir.

1824.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"At the end of time, one of your khalīfs will distribute mal without counting it."(Müslüman)
1824.commentary: Göre bazı scholars, this khalīf is Imām Mahdī (رحمه الله) who will appear close to Qiyāmah. Other scholars state that it referred to the third khalīf, 'Uthmān (رضي الله عنه). The hadis indicates that during that era there will be great prosperity and the Muslims will dominate in the world. The khalīf will not hoard wealth but spend it freely on his people. It will be a time when adalet and good ahlâk will prevail.

1825.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A time will come when a man will go around with gold to give as sadaka but he will find no one to take it from him. One man will be seen followed by forty women who will desire him because of the scarcity of men and an excess of women."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1825.commentary: Bu hadis mentions two prophecies. Firstly, due to the abundance of wealth, nobody will be prepared to accept ṣadaqah. Secondly, there will be birçok more women than men on account of wars or increased female births.

1826.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A man purchased a piece of land from another man. The one who purchased it found a jar containing gold on the land. He dedi to the seller of the land: 'Take your gold. I only purchased the land from you and not the gold.' The one who had owned the land dedi: 'I sold you the land and whatever it contained.' So they approached a person to resolve their dispute and he dedi to them: 'Do both of you have children?' One of them dedi, 'I have a son,' and the other dedi, 'I have a daughter.' He dedi: 'Marry the boy to the girl, give the gold to them, and give some in sadaka.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1826.commentary: The incident highlights that there was a time when such doğruluk and integrity prevailed amongst men that buyers and sellers were more concerned with practicing upon dinî teachings than lining their pockets. Scholars state that this incident transpired during the reign of Dāwūd (عليه السلام) who reconciled between the two parties in an amazingly wise şekil.

1827.text: He heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"There were once two women and each of them had her child with her. A wolf came and took away the child of one of them. She dedi to her companion: 'The wolf took away your child.' The other dedi: 'No, it took away your child.' They took their dispute to Dā'ūd (عليه السلام) and he ruled in favour of the elder woman. They then went to Sulaymān ibn Dā'ūd (عليه السلام) and haber verdi him. He dedi: 'Bring me a knife so that I may divide the child between the two of you.' The younger woman dedi: 'Do not do that, may Allāh be merciful to you. It is her child.' So he ruled in favour of the younger woman."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1827.commentary: Sulaymān (عليه السلام) here used a ḥīlā (hukukî stratagem) to ascertain the mother of the child because he knew that a gerçek mother would asla permit her child to be killed. This proves the permissibility of using a ḥīlā to establish the truth or to fayda Islām. Ḥīlā's for purposes that harm Islām are a grave günah and not at bütün helal.

1828.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The salih people will pass away one after another until only the scum will remain like the residue of barley or dates. They will have no value in the sight of Allāh."(Bukhārī)
1828.commentary: The hadis explains that ahlâk and spirituality will decrease to such an extent at the end of time that no righteous people will remain. At that time, open sinners and people of evil repute will dominate and assume leadership positions. tıpkı... gibi residue has no value, these sinners will have no value in bütünāh's (ﷻ) sight. One should cling to the people of knowledge and fazilet because they are beloved to bütünāh (ﷻ). One should not oppose them for korku of being deprived of bütünāh's (ﷻ) rahmet. The death of the righteous heralds the approach of Qiyāmah.

1829.narrator: Rifā'ah ibn Rāfi' al-Zuraqī (رضي الله عنه)
1829.text: Jibra'īl came to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and sordu:"What honour do those who participated in the battle of Badr have among you?"He cevap verdi:"They are among the best of Müslümans,"or words to that effect. Jibra'īl dedi:"It is the same with the angels who participated in the battle of Badr."(Bukhārī, Ibn Mājah)
1829.commentary: Muslims fought the battle of Badr against the enemy on the basis of iman and ümit in bütünāh (ﷻ). They were very az sayıda in number and possessed very little weapons. bundan dolayı, they were honoured and enjoy great status in Islām.

1830.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When Allah (ﷻ) sends azap on a nation, the azap afflicts all of them. Thereafter, they are raised according to their actions."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1830.commentary: ilâhî punishments in the form of earthquakes, floods, tornadoes, fires and so forth afflict bütün people: believers, disbelievers, righteous and sinners. bununla birlikte, on the day of Qiyāmah they will be raised and judged according to their ameller. The righteous will be in cennet and the disobedient will be in cehennem-fire. The hadis indicates that one should not befriend and associate excessively with the sinners. One should not remain silent in the face of günah, oppression and injustice.

1831.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) used to lean on a ağaç trunk while delivering his sermon. When the pulpit was put in place, we heard the ağaç trunk crying like a pregnant deve until Resûlullah (ﷺ) got down and koydu his hand on it. It then became quiet."Another narration has:"When it was the day of Cuma, Resûlullah (ﷺ) oturdu on the pulpit. The ağaç trunk from which he used to deliver the sermon cried out until it almost burst open."Another narration has:"It cried like a çocuk. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) got down and embraced it. It began to sob like a çocuk that is yaptı to keep quiet and it finally became silent. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) şöyle dedi: 'It cried because of the remembrance of Allāh which it used to hear.'"(Bukhārī)
1831.commentary: Bu hadis narrates a miracle of the Messenger (ﷺ), şöyle ki the crying of a tree trunk due to his separation. When Ḥasan Baṣrī (رحمه الله) used to narrate Bu hadis he would instinctively burst into tears and remark, 'When a dry piece of wood cried on account of his sevgi, you should cry to a greater extent in his sevgi and in expectation of meeting him.'

1832.narrator: Abū Tha'labah al-Khushanī Jurthūm ibn Nāshir (رضي الله عنه)
1832.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) made certain things obligatory, so do not neglect them. He laid down certain limits, so do not exceed them. He yasakladı certain things, so do not indulge in them. He was silent about certain things as a rahmet to you and not because of forgetfulness, so do not delve into them."(Dāraquṭnī, Ḥākim, Bayhaqī)
1832.commentary: İmam Sem'ânî (رحمه الله), bu hadisin İslâm'da çok önemli bir yere sahip olduğunu ve hadis âlimlerinin bu hadis üzerinde çok durduğunu belirtmiştir.

1833.narrator: Abdullāh ibn Abī Aufā (رضي الله عنه)
1833.text: We went with Resûlullah (ﷺ) on seven expeditions during which we ate locusts."Another narration has:"We ate locusts with him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasa'ī)
1833.commentary: Consuming locusts is helal according to bütün the four Imāms. It is not established that the Messenger (ﷺ) ever ate locusts, bununla birlikte he did not prevent the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) from doing so.

1834.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A mümin is not bitten from the same hole twice."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1834.commentary: Resûlullah (ﷺ) döneminde Ebû Gazze adında bir şair vardı. Müşrikleri şiirleriyle hicvederdi ve bu sebeple cezalandırılmıştı.

1835.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh will not speak to three people on the day of Kıyamet, nor will he look at them or purify them. For them will be a painful azap. A person who has extra water in a desert land but refuses it to a traveller; a person who sells an item to another person after İkindi and takes an oath in Allāh that he purchased it for such-and-such a price and the buyer believes him when it is not true; and a person who pledges allegiance to a leader solely for worldly gain. If the leader gives him, he remains loyal to him and if he does not give him, he opposes him."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī, Aḥmad)
1835.commentary: "bütünāh will not speak to them," means: 1. bütünāh (ﷻ) will ignore them. 2. bütünāh (ﷻ) will not address them as He will address the righteous. 3. bütünāh (ﷻ) will not speak to them in a şekil that will fayda them. The time of 'Aṣr has been mentioned because it is a blessed time when the angels gather. Taking a yanlış oath is ordinarily sinful, bununla birlikte to do so at this time and merely to make a sale is a grave günah. Pledging a deceptive oath to the khalīf of the Muslims is a grave günah because it leads to corruption and başkaldırı.

1836.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Between the two blowings of the Trumpet is forty."They sordu:"Forty days?"He dedi:"I refuse to say."They sordu:"Forty years?"He dedi:"I refuse to say."They sordu:"Forty months?"He dedi:"I refuse to say.""Everything of a person will perish except the tailbone. From it the body will be created. Allāh will then send down rain from the sky and they will grow like plants."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1836.commentary: Shortly before Qiyāmah, Isrāfīl will blow the trumpet causing her person to become unconscious. He will then blow it a second time causing bütün of humanity to rise from their graves. Bu hadis işaret eder the time interval between these two soundings of the trumpet. From other aḥādīth, we learn that the interval will be forty years. While her insanî body decomposes in its grave, the bodies of the Messengers of bütünāh (ﷺ), the martyrs and the selected friends of bütünāh (ﷻ) remain intact.

1837.text: While Resûlullah (ﷺ) was in a gathering speaking to the people, a Bedouin came and sordu: 'When is the Final Hour?' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) continued talking. Some in the gathering dedi, 'He heard what the man dedi but disliked it,' while others dedi, 'No, he did not hear it.' When Resûlullah (ﷺ) had finished speaking, he sordu: 'Where is the person who sordu about the Final Hour?' The man dedi: 'Here I am, Ey Allah'ın Resûlü!' The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'When trust is betrayed, await the Final Hour.' He sordu: 'How will it be betrayed?' He cevap verdi: 'When positions of authority are assigned to those who are undeserving of it, await the Final Hour.'"(Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1837.commentary: Bu hadis, yönetimin ehliyetsiz kişilere verilmesi durumunda kıyametin beklenmesi gerektiği anlamına gelir. Liyakat yönetimde esastır.

1838.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"They (your leaders) will lead you in namaz. If they lead you correctly, you will be rewarded. If they make a mistake, you will be rewarded and they will be responsible."(Bukhārī, Bayhaqī)
1838.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki people should not rebel against those who lead them in ṣalāh if the latter commit mistakes gibi not fulfilling the Sunnah requirements, etc. People should continue following them in ṣalāh because ṣalāh is geçerli behind even a brazen sinner. bununla birlikte, if their mistakes entail ameller which nullify ṣalāh gibi omission of a Farḍ, then one is not obligated to follow them. Similarly, if they commit or enforce any such amel which opposes the teachings of Islām, then they should not be obeyed, in accordance to the nebevî principle: "Creation cannot be obeyed by disobeying the Creator."

1839.text: Regarding the verse,"You are the best of nations appointed for people,""The people who are the most beneficial to others are those who bring others with chains around their necks until they embrace İslâm."(Bukhārī)
1839.commentary: The verse demektir ki the Ummah of Muhammed (ﷺ) is superior to other Ummahs. The yorum given here demektir ki their superiority is on account of them bringing captives from their battles and then introducing them to Islām. This is a great fazilet because, bir yandan, these brave individuals forsake their homes to spread the message of bütünāh (ﷻ) to the world, and diğer yandan, become a means of saving birçok from the azap of the cehennem-fire and entering them into cennet.

1840.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) is most pleased with a people who enter Cennet in chains."(Bukhārī) This means that they are brought as prisoners, they then embrace İslâm and gain entry into Cennet.

1841.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The most beloved of places in the sight of Allāh are the mescids and the most hated of places in the sight of Allāh are the market places."(Müslüman, Bayhaqī)
1841.commentary: The masjids are çoğu beloved to bütünāh (ﷻ) because they are places of ibadet, itaat, tilāwah and dhikr. They are the fountainheads of knowledge and guidance. A hadis states that the masjids stand out for the occupants of the heavens tıpkı... gibi the stars stand out for the occupants of the earth. For these reasons and others, those who frequent the masjids are blessed with bütünāh's (ﷻ) special rahmet. The market places are çoğu hated because they are places of deception, lies, fraud, cheating, greed, interest and broken promises. They lead people away from bütünāh's (ﷻ) remembrance and attract them towards the futilities of dünya. For these reasons, one should only go there to the extent of necessity.

1842.text: The Messenger (ﷺ) dedi:"If it is at all possible for you, do not be the first to enter the market place nor the last to leave it because it is the battle ground of Shaiṭān and the place where he hoists his flag."(Müslüman) Al-Barqānī (رحمه الله) anlatır it in his Ṣaḥīḥ from Salmān who rivayet etti that Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi:"Do not be the first to enter the market place nor the last to leave it. It is where Shaiṭān lays his eggs and where they hatch."(Müslüman)
1842.commentary: The hadis demektir ki Shaiṭān thrives in market places because of the birçok evils prevalent there. One should bu nedenle minimise one's time there.

1843.text: 'Āṣim al-Aḥwal anlatır from 'Abdullāh ibn Sarjis (رضي الله عنه) who dedi:"I dedi to Resûlullah (ﷺ): 'O Messenger of Allāh, may Allāh bağışla you.' He cevap verdi: 'And you as well.' 'Āṣim dedi: I sordu him: 'Did Resûlullah (ﷺ) seek bağışlanma for you?' He cevap verdi: 'Yes, and for you as well.' He then recited this verse: 'Seek bağışlanma for your günahlar and the günahlar of the believing men and women.'"(Müslüman)
1843.commentary: bağışlanma in relation to the Messenger (ﷺ) işaret eder bütünāh's (ﷻ) iyilik upon him and his honourable status in bütünāh's (ﷻ) sight because it is our inanç that he was free from bütün günah. That the Messenger (ﷺ) reciprocated a kind gesture with benzer iyilik was an indication of his noble character.

1844.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Part of what people learnt from the words of the earlier Messengers is: 'If you have no shame, you may do whatever you like.'"(Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1844.commentary: Bu hadis does not give izin to commit evil, rather it is a uyarı and reprimand from bütünāh (ﷻ) that the loss of utanç is a stepping stone to immorality. bunun sebebi is that utanç serves as a deterrent from günah because one who is aware that bütünāh (ﷻ) or other people are watching, will be reluctant to perpetrate günah openly. The hadis also informs us that hayâ was a teaching of bütün the Messengers of bütünāh (ﷺ), bundan dolayı it should be among the inherent good qualities of her insanî being.

1845.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The first matter that will be decided between people on the day of Kıyamet will be the shedding blood."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Nasā'ī)
1845.commentary: Among the haklar of insanî beings, murder will be dealt with first on the day of Qiyāmah because it is a grave günah. bütünāh (ﷻ) created life in man, and one who destroys such life destroys bütünāh's (ﷻ) creation, bundan dolayı He will severely punish those who commit murder. The Qur'ān mentions the seriousness of this crime in these sözler: Whoever purposely murders a believer, his azap shall be cehennem-fire where he shall live forever. bütünāh shall be angry with him, curse him and prepare for him a dreadful azap. (Sūrah al-Nisā', 93)

1846.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The angels were created from light, jinn were created from a flame of fire, and Ādam was created from what was described to you."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Bayhaqī)
1846.commentary: The hadis indicates the power of bütünāh (ﷻ) because He can create life in çeşitli forms through light, fire and sand. Man is created from a drop of sperm which is in turn formed by consuming food produced from the soil, bundan dolayı it can be said that man is created from sand.

1847.text: The character of Resûlullah (ﷺ) was the Kur'an."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1847.commentary: The hadis demektir ki the Messenger (ﷺ) lived by the Qur'ān. He was pleased with what it declared Ḥalāl, he abstained from what it declared Ḥarām, he practised upon its etiquettes, and he did not exceed its restrictions. Scholars state that tıpkı... gibi the meanings of the Qur'ān are unlimited, the qualities of the Messenger (ﷺ) portraying the üstünlük of his character were also unlimited. In her situation, his outstanding behaviour, sublime personality and supreme knowledge were matchless and indescribable. For these reasons, he served as a model and Messenger for not only insanî beings and jinn but the bütün universe.

1848.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh desires to meet one who desires to meet Him, and Allāh dislikes to meet one who dislikes to meet Him."I sordu:"O Messenger of Allāh, is it a dislike for death? All of us dislike death."He cevap verdi:"That is not what it means. Rather, when a mümin is given the glad tidings of Allāh'in rahmet, His pleasure and His Cennet, he desires to meet Allāh, and Allāh also desires to meet him. When a kâfir is given the tidings of the azap and wrath of Allāh, he dislikes to meet Allāh, and Allāh also dislikes to meet him."(Müslüman, Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)

1849.narrator: Umm al-Mu'minīn Ṣafiyyah bint Ḥuyayy (رضي الله عنها)
1849.text: I went to visit Resûlullah (ﷺ) one night while he was in I'tikāf. I spoke to him and then stood up to leave. He stood up with me to accompany me. Two men from the Anṣār passed by. When they saw Resûlullah (ﷺ), they hastened. He dedi to them: 'Take it easy. This is Ṣafiyyah bint Ḥuyayy.' They dedi: 'Glory be to Allāh, Ey Allah'ın Resûlü!' He dedi: 'Shaiṭān flows in the body of man like blood and I feared that he might implant evil thoughts – or things – into your hearts.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1849.commentary: Ibn Ḥajar (رحمه الله) stated the Messenger (ﷺ) clarified to the two Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهما) that the woman was his wife because even the slightest form of suspicion regarding his blessed being would have been detrimental to their īmān. "Shaiṭān flows in the body of man like blood," demektir ki he moves in the body of man like blood flows in the blood vessels of the body. 'bütünāmah Ṭībi (رحمه الله) stated that it demektir ki tıpkı... gibi blood flows easily throughout the body, Shaiṭān spares no effort in attempting to lead man astray. Based on this hadis, scholars state that the righteous should go the extra mile to avoid places of suspicion and doubt.

1850.narrator: Abū al-Faḍl al-'Abbās ibn 'Abd al-Muṭṭalib (رضي الله عنه)
1850.text: I was present with Resûlullah (ﷺ) during the expedition of Ḥunayn. Abū Sufyān ibn al-Ḥārith ibn 'Abd al-Muṭṭalib (رضي الله عنه) and I remained close to Resûlullah (ﷺ) and did not leave him. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) was on a white mule. When the Müslümans and polytheists faced each other in battle, the Müslümans turned around and fled. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) began prompting his donkey towards the polytheists while I was holding its reins, stopping it from hastening forward. Abū Sufyān (رضي الله عنه) was holding the saddle of Resûlullah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) dedi: 'O 'Abbās, call those who pledged allegiance under the tree (at Bay'at al-Riḍwān).'"Al-'Abbās (رضي الله عنه), who had a loud voice, dedi:"I shouted in my loudest voice: 'Where are those who pledged allegiance under the tree?' By Allāh, they turned to my call just as a cow turns to the call of its calf. They dedi: 'Here we are, here we are.' And they fought against the disbelievers. The call to the Anṣār was made, diyerek: 'O people of Anṣār! O people of Anṣār!' The call was then confined to the Banū al-Ḥārith ibn al-Khazraj. The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) remained on his mule and looked at them fighting as if he was stretching out his neck. He dedi: 'Now the oven is hot.' He then took some pebbles and threw them towards the disbelievers and dedi: 'They are defeated, by the oath of the Lord of Muḥammad.' I went to have a look and the battle was raging as it had been previously, but as soon as he threw those pebbles, I saw their strength waning and they fled."(Müslüman, Ḥākim)
1850.commentary: Ḥunayn was a valley between Makkah and Ṭā'if where the tribe of Hawazin resided. They rose against the Muslims and fought them in battle in 8 Hijrī. Scholars state that the stones thrown by the Messenger (ﷺ) in that battle miraculously penetrated the eye of her disbeliever bringing victory to the Muslims. It was the assistance of bütünāh (ﷻ) that came to the fore as the Qur'ān states: You did not throw when you threw, but it was bütünāh Who threw. (Sūrah Anfāl, 17) A Muslim leader must be a model of bravery and courage.

1851.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"O people, Allāh is pure and accepts only that which is pure. Allāh issued the same command to the müminler as He issued to the Messengers. He dedi: 'O Messengers, eat of the pure and do good,' and He dedi: 'O müminler, eat of the pure which We provided you with.' He then mentioned a person who undertakes a long journey, with dishevelled hair and dusty clothing. He stretches out his hands towards the heavens diyerek: 'Ey Rabbim! Ey Rabbim!' But his food is unlawful, his drink is unlawful, his clothing is unlawful, and his sustenance is unlawful. How can his supplication be accepted?'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1851.commentary: Bu hadis highlights the fundamental Islāmic principle that a person should choose that which is Ḥalāl over that which is Ḥarām because the former draws him closer to bütünāh (ﷻ) while the latter distances him from bütünāh (ﷻ). The description provided in the hadis convincingly önemine işaret eder earning, consuming and utilising that which is Ḥalāl.

1852.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allāh will not speak to three people on the day of Kıyamet, neither will He purify them nor look at them. For them will be a painful azap: an old adulterer, a lying king, and a poor person who is proud."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1852.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 617. Qāḍi 'Iyāḍ (رحمه الله) stated that these three individuals have been specifically mentioned because their günah was unnecessary and could have been avoided quite easily: adultery is to be expected from a young man bursting with desires, not an old man; a king has power and authority and has no need to speak lies to prove his case; and pride is expected from the wealthy, not the poor.

1853.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Saiḥān, Jaiḥān, the Euphrates and the Nile are all rivers from Cennet."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1853.commentary: Bu hadis has been interpreted in çeşitli ways. bazı scholars have stated that the source of these rivers may truly be in cennet. Others state that their waters are sweeter than that of other rivers, bundan dolayı they have been referred to as rivers of cennet. Yet other scholars state that the cities through which they flow are blessed with īmān, bundan dolayı their association with cennet. The Oxus and Jaxartes are two major rivers of Central Asia. The Euphrates runs through Iraq, and the Nile through Egypt.

1854.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) held my hand and dedi: 'Allāh created the earth on Saturday; He created the mountains on Sunday; He created the trees on Monday; He created detestable things on Tuesday; He created light on Wednesday; He spread out the animals on earth on Thursday; and He created Ādam (عليه السلام) after İkindi on Cuma as His last creation in the last hour of the day, between İkindi and the night.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1854.commentary: The hadis informs us that bütünāh's (ﷻ) final creation was Ādam (عليه السلام) who was created on Jumu'ah. From other aḥādīth we learn that the world will also terminate on the day of Jumu'ah.

1855.narrator: Abū Sulaymān Khālid ibn al-Walīd (رضي الله عنه)
1855.text: Nine swords broke in my hand in the battle of Mu'tah and only one small Yemeni kılıç remained with me."(Bukhārī)
1855.commentary: The Battle of Mu'tah took place in 8 Hijrī. The Messenger (ﷺ) had sent Ḥārith ibn Amīr (رضي الله عنه) with a letter inviting the Persian king to Islām, bununla birlikte enroute the Ṣaḥābī was killed by Sharaḥbīl. The Messenger (ﷺ) sent an army of 3000 Ṣaḥābah to avenge his murder. During the ensuing battle, Zaid ibn Ḥārithah (رضي الله عنه), Ja'far ibn Abī Ṭālib (رضي الله عنه) and 'Abdullāh ibn Rawāḥah (رضي الله عنه) her biri led the army, but were martyred in turn. Finally, Khālid ibn Walīd (رضي الله عنه) assumed leadership and the Muslims attained victory. Bu hadis highlights his bravery and it was for this reason that the Messenger (ﷺ) gave him the title, 'the sword of bütünāh.'

1856.text: He heard Resûlullah (ﷺ) diyerek:"When a judge passes judgment making every effort to be correct and then reaches the correct decision, he receives two rewards. When he passes judgment making every effort to be correct and reaches an incorrect decision, he receives one sevap."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd)
1856.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki a competent and knowledgeable scholar or judge may engage in ijtihād. Ijtihād means to exercise judgment in order to determine the truth in hukukî matters regarding which no clear hüküm exists in the Qur'ān and Sunnah. It further bize öğretir ki such ijtihād will draw a sevap whether the ultimate decision is doğru or not.

1857.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Fever is from the intense heat of Hell, so cool it down with water."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ḥākim)
1857.commentary: Scholars state that fever here does not include bütün types of fevers because in certain cases applying water to a fever will worsen it.

1858.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"If one who passes away has outstanding fasts, his next of kin should fast on his behalf."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī, Aḥmad)
1858.commentary: The preferred opinion based on Bu hadis is that it is helal to fast on behalf of a deceased person who has outstanding fasts. The 'next of kin' işaret eder a relative, whether he is an heir or not. âlimlerin çoğunluğuna göre, şöyle ki Imām Abū Ḥanīfah (رحمه الله), Imām Shāfi'ī (رحمه الله) and Imām Mālik (رحمه الله), others may only give fidyā (compensation in kind) on behalf of the deceased who omitted fasts. According to Imām Aḥmad (رحمه الله), others may fast on behalf of the deceased to compensate for his missed fasts. Imām Aḥmad (رحمه الله) utilises Bu hadis as his proof. The other scholars prove their case by stating that Bu hadis is abrogated or that fidyā is the same as fasting.

1859.text: 'Auf ibn Mālik ibn al-Ṭufayl anlatır that 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) was haber verdi that 'Abdullāh ibn al-Zubayr (رضي الله عنه) dedi with regard to a certain transaction or gift which 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) had made:"By Allāh, if 'Ā'ishah does not abstain from this, I will impose restrictions on her."She dedi:"Did he really say that?"They cevap verdi:"Yes."She dedi:"I take an oath in the name of Allāh that I will never speak to Ibn al-Zubayr again."When the separation continued for some time, Ibn al-Zubayr (رضي الله عنه) sordu someone to intercede on his behalf, but she dedi:"By Allāh, I will never accept intercession in this regard and I will never break my oath."When it had gone on too long for Ibn al-Zubayr (رضي الله عنه), he spoke to al-Miswar ibn Makhramah and 'Abd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Aswad ibn 'Abd Yagūth, and dedi:"I beg you in the name of Allāh to take me to 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) because it is not lawful for her to take an oath to sever ties with me."So Al-Miswar and 'Abd al-Raḥmān went along with him and they two sought permission to enter the home of 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها). They dedi:"Peace be upon you together with Allāh'in rahmet and nimetler. May we enter?"She dedi:"You may enter."They sordu:"All of us?"She dedi:"Yes, you may all enter,"not knowing that Ibn al-Zubayr (رضي الله عنه) was with them. When they entered, Ibn al-Zubayr (رضي الله عنه) went behind the curtain and embraced 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) weeping and beseeching her. Al-Miswar and 'Abd al-Raḥmān also began to beseech her to speak to him and accept his apology. They dedi:"You know very well that Resûlullah (ﷺ) forbade the breaking of relations and dedi that it is not lawful for a Müslüman to sever relations with his brother for more than three days."When they continued reminding and advising her, she began reminding them of her oath and began crying. She dedi:"I took an oath and an oath is a very serious matter."But they persisted until she spoke to Ibn al-Zubayr (رضي الله عنه). In expiation of her oath, she freed forty slaves. Whenever she subsequently remembered her oath, she would weep until her veil would become wet with her tears. (Bukhārī)
1859.commentary: 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) was the maternal aunt of 'Abdullāh ibn Zubayr (رضي الله عنه). He did not agree with a certain transaction she had made and tried to make her forsake it, bununla birlikte she felt offended because she had done it in good spirit. One may ask why 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) did not speak to her nephew for more than three days when the hadis forbids it. The answer to this is that one may abandon ties with another based on a geçerli Islāmic reason. The freeing of a single slave would have sufficed, bununla birlikte 'Ā'ishah (رضي الله عنها) freed forty slaves due to her takvâ.

1860.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) went out to those who were martyred at Uḥud and supplicated for them (for bağışlanma) eight years after the battle as if he was bidding farewell to the living and the dead. He then climbed onto the pulpit and dedi: 'I am your forerunner and I will be a şahit for you. You will meet me at al-Ḥauḍ (the Fountain). I can see it from where I am now. Listen, I do not korku that you will ascribe partners with Allāh after me, but I do korku this world for you and that you will compete with each other for it.' That was the last time I saw Resûlullah (ﷺ) on the pulpit."Another narration has:"I am your forerunner and I will be a şahit for you. By Allāh, I am presently looking at my Ḥauḍ. I have been given the keys to the treasures of the earth – or the keys to the earth. By Allāh, I do not korku that you will ascribe partners with Allāh after me, but I do korku that you will compete with each other for it."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Bayhaqī, Nasā'ī)
1860.commentary: The hadis teaches us to be wary of competing for dünya and its riches. The Messenger (ﷺ) was given the keys to the treasures of dünya but he refused it due to his preference for the ahiret. One should visit the graveyard and also continuously supplicate for the bağışlanma of the deceased. The Ḥauḍ is a reality and exists tıpkı... gibi cennet and cehennem exists.

1861.narrator: Abū Zayd 'Amr ibn Akhṭab al-Anṣārī (رضي الله عنه)
1861.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) led us in the Sabah namaz and then climbed the pulpit and addressed us until the Ẓuhr namaz. He descended, performed namaz, and climbed the pulpit again until the İkindi namaz. He descended the pulpit, performed namaz, and climbed the pulpit again until sunset. He haber verdi us of what had occurred and what is yet to occur. The most knowledgeable of us is the one who remembers the most."(Müslüman)
1861.commentary: The Messenger (ﷺ) informed the Ṣaḥābah (رضي الله عنهم) about the events that will unfold close to Qiyāmah. This knowledge was granted to him by bütünāh (ﷻ) as a miracle. It was not on account of his own knowledge. It was the rahmet of the Messenger (ﷺ) that he taught the Ummah whatever was necessary for their eternal success and well-being in dünya.

1862.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who takes a vow to obey Allāh should obey Him. One who takes an oath to disobey Allāh should not disobey him."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad, Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah)
1862.commentary: İslâmî öğretilere uygun yeminler yerine getirilmeli, onlara aykırı olanlar ise bozulmalıdır. Günah olan bir konuda yemin geçersizdir.

1863.text: The Messenger of Allāh (ﷺ) ordered her to kill chameleons, diyerek:"It blew on Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام) (in the fire)."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1863.commentary: That a chameleon blew into the fire in which Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام) was thrown, in order to intensify it, was evidence of its enmity to a Messenger of bütünāh (عليه السلام). The hadis bize öğretir ki bütünāh (ﷻ) dislikes even the slightest dissent or isyan to His commands.

1864.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who kills a chameleon with the first strike, will receive such-and-such good deeds. One who kills it with the second strike, will receive such-and-such good deeds, less than the first. If he kills it with the third strike, he will receive such-and-such good deeds."Another narration has:"One who kills a chameleon with the first strike, a hundred good deeds are recorded in his favour. The second strike has less than that, and the third strike has even less than that."(Müslüman)

1865.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"A man dedi: 'I will definitely give some sadaka.' He went out with his sadaka and placed it in the hand of a thief. The next morning, people began talking: 'Charity was given to a thief.' The man dedi: 'O Allāh, all praise is due to You for a thief. I will definitely give some sadaka.' He went out with his sadaka and placed it in the hand of a prostitute. The next morning, people began talking: 'Charity was given to a prostitute last night.' The man dedi: 'O Allāh, all praise is due to You for a prostitute. I will definitely give some sadaka.' He went out with his sadaka and placed it in the hand of a rich person. The next morning, people began talking: 'Charity was given to a rich person.' The man dedi: 'O Allāh, all praise is due to You for a thief, a prostitute and a rich person.' That night he saw a dream in which he was told: 'Perhaps your sadaka to the thief will cause him to abstain from stealing. Perhaps your sadaka to the prostitute will cause her to abstain from prostitution. Perhaps your sadaka to the rich person, will cause him to take a lesson and spend from that which Allāh gave him.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1865.commentary: The hadis bize öğretir ki bütünāh (ﷻ) rewards a person based on his niyet and not merely on the outcome of his amel. bundan dolayı, if charity is given with ihlâs and reaches one who is not really deserving of it, the donor should regard it as bütünāh's (ﷻ) hikmet and remain hopeful of ilâhî sevap. It also bize öğretir ki we should continue giving charity for the pleasure of bütünāh (ﷻ).

1866.text: We were with Resûlullah (ﷺ) at a feast. The foreleg of the meat was presented to him which was his favourite part. He took a bite from it and dedi: 'I am the leader of mankind on the day of Kıyamet. Biliyor musunuz why? Allāh will gather the first and the last on one plain where an observer will be able to see all of them and a caller will be able to make all hear him. The sun will draw close to them and people will experience such grief and distress that they will not be able to bear. The people will say:"Don't you see what has befallen you?"Some will say to others:"Go to your father Ādam."They will come to Ādam and say:"O Ādam, you are the father of mankind. Allāh created you with His hand, blew into you from His spirit, emretti the angels to prostrate before you and allowed you to dwell in Cennet. Will you not intercede for us before your Lord? Don't you see what we are experiencing?"He will reply:"My Lord is angry today with an anger like of which He has never been angry before and will never be angry after. He forbade me from the tree but I disobeyed. Myself, myself, myself. Go to someone else, go to Nūḥ."They will come to Nūḥ and say:"O Nūḥ, you are the first Messenger to the people of the earth and Allāh has named you a grateful kul. Will you not intercede for us before your Lord?"He will reply:"My Lord is angry today with an anger like of which He has never been angry before and will never be angry after. I made a supplication against my people. Myself, myself, myself. Go to someone else, go to Ibrāhīm."They will come to Ibrāhīm and say:"O Ibrāhīm, you are the Prophet of Allāh and His friend from among the people of the earth. Intercede for us before your Lord."He will say:"My Lord is angry today with an anger like of which He has never been angry before and will never be angry after. I had told three lies. Myself, myself, myself. Go to someone else, go to Mūsā."They will come to Mūsā and say:"O Mūsā, you are the Messenger of Allāh. Allāh favoured you with His message and conversation above all people. Intercede for us before your Lord."He will say:"My Lord is angry today with an anger like of which He has never been angry before and will never be angry after. I had killed a person whom I was not emretti to kill. Myself, myself, myself. Go to someone else, go to 'Īsā."They will come to 'Īsā and say:"O 'Īsā, you are the Messenger of Allāh and His word which He cast to Maryam, and a spirit from Him. You spoke to people in the cradle. Intercede for us before your Lord."'Īsā will say:"My Lord is angry today with an anger like of which He has never been angry before and will never be angry after."He did not mention any günah."Myself, myself, myself. Go to someone else, go to Muḥammad."' In another narration: 'They will come and say:"O Muḥammad, you are the Messenger of Allāh and the seal of the Prophets. Allāh has forgiven your past and future günahlar. Intercede for us before your Lord. Don't you see what we are experiencing?"I will proceed until I reach below the Throne and fall prostrate before my Lord. Then Allāh will open to me such praises and glorification which He did not open to anyone before me. It will then be dedi:"O Muḥammad, raise your head. Ask and you will be given, intercede and your intercession will be accepted."I will raise my head...'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1866.commentary: Bu hadis describes the agonising scenario on the day of Qiyāmah when bütün of humanity will anxiously await the commencement of the reckoning. They will approach çeşitli Messengers (عليهم السلام) but her biri of them will excuse himself. They will finally approach the only person worthy of this honour, the Messenger (ﷺ). bütünāh (ﷻ) has kept this sequence in order to reveal the Messenger's (ﷺ) superiority over bütün the Messengers (عليهم السلام). He will then praise bütünāh (ﷻ) in sözler beyond description and bütünāh (ﷻ) will allow him to intercede for his Ummah. This is his lofty and prestigious position referred to in the Qur'ān: Soon Your Lord will accord to you the Maqām Maḥmūd. (Sūrah al-Isrā', 79)

1867.text: Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام) brought the anne of Ismā'īl and her oğul, Ismā'īl, whom she was suckling, and ayrıldı her by the ev near a large ağaç above Zamzam at the highest point of the mescid. At the time, no one resided in Makkah and there was no su. He ayrıldı them there with a bag of dates and a su-skin. Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام) then turned and began to leave on the path he had come. The anne of Ismā'īl (عليه السلام) followed him and sordu: 'O Ibrāhīm! Where are you going, leaving us in a valley where there is no companionship or anything else?' She repeated the question several times but he paid no attention to her. She sordu: 'Has Allāh emretti you to do this?' He cevap verdi: 'Yes.' She şöyle dedi: 'In that case, He will not allow harm to come to us,' and gitti back. Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام) continued until he reached al-Thanīyyah, where they could not see him. He turned towards the ev and supplicated, raising his hands: 'O our Sustainer! I have settled some of my offspring in a valley that is barren, near Your Sacred ev. O our Sustainer! So that they may establish namaz. Therefore, make the hearts of some insanlar to incline towards them and provide them with fruits, perhaps they may be şükreden.' (Sûre Ibrāhīm, 37)"He then rivayet etti the hadis in full. (Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1867.commentary: Hājirā was a Coptic woman who was given to Sārah, the wife of Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام), as a gift by the king of Egypt. Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام) then married Hājirā. Hājirā's contentment with bütünāh's (ﷻ) order to her husband was astonishing. The sağlamlık of her īmān led her to easily accept that by accepting bütünāh's (ﷻ) emir, He would asla allow harm to come to her or her son. Her sacrifice and effort was so beloved to bütünāh (ﷻ) that He enshrined her search for water as an incumbent ritual of Ḥaj and 'Umrah.

1868.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"The mushroom is a type of manna and its water is a cure for the eyes."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1868.commentary: Manna was a type of food which bütünāh (ﷻ) provided as sustenance to the Banū Isrā'īl. According to the scholars, mushrooms have been compared to manna because her iki these foods are acquired without effort or cultivation.

1869.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Cloudiness comes over my heart and I seek bağışlanma from Allāh a hundred times a day."(Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1869.commentary: The "cloudiness" referred to here is not a solid barrier. It is merely a kısmi covering benzer to a light cloud in the sky which does not block out the rays of the sun. Scholars have provided çeşitli explanations: 1. The Messenger (ﷺ) would occasionally be occupied in something which prevented him from his routine state of remembering bütünāh (ﷻ) gibi eating, engagement with family, etc. This was by no means a shortcoming, bununla birlikte he considered it to be a shortcoming because of his takvâ. 2. The Messenger (ﷺ) would bazen choose rukhṣah (concessionary law) instead of 'azīmah (absolute law) or he would choose the less preferable of two helal options. When he would later come to realise that he could have chosen better, he would be greatly distressed.

1870.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"By Allāh, I seek bağışlanma from Allāh and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day."(Bukhārī)

1871.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"By the oath of that Being in whose control is my life, if you do not commit günahlar, Allāh will remove you and replace you with a people who will commit günahlar and seek bağışlanma from Allāh, and He will bağışla them."(Müslüman)
1871.commentary: The hadis does not mean that günah is teşvik edilen, rather it highlights bütünāh's (ﷻ) rahmet and bağışlanma and that, at times, günah is a means towards safety from pride. başka bir deyişle, it encourages us to engage in abundant tövbe for the günahlar we are bound to commit as bütünāh (ﷻ) asla fails to accept those who turn to Him. bütünāh (ﷻ) loves a repentant sinner more than one who is content with his good ameller because the former turns to bütünāh (ﷻ) and expresses his weakness while the latter exhibits pride.

1872.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'in meclisinde otururduk ve onu yüz kere: "Rabbim! Beni bağışla, tövbemi kabul et. Şüphesiz Sen tövbeyi çok kabul eden ve çok bağışlayansın" derken sayardık. (Buhârî, Müslim)
1872.commentary: Aḥādīth which mention the abundant tövbe of the Messenger (ﷺ) do not imply that he committed günah, but serve as teşvik for his Ummah to do likewise. It is also possible that because of his continuous advancement in spirituality, he regarded his past state as one worthy of tövbe.

1873.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When a person regularly seeks bağışlanma, Allāh provides for him a way out of every difficulty, relieves him from every anxiety, and provides him with sustenance from avenues he never expected."(Abū Dāwūd)

1874.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"One who says, 'I seek bağışlanma from Allāh apart from whom there is none worthy of ibadet, the Living, the All-Sustaining, and I turn to Him in repentance,' will have his günahlar forgiven even if he fled from the battlefield."(Abū Dāwūd, Ḥākim)
1874.commentary: Göre Abū Nu'aym al-Iṣbahānī (رحمه الله), Bu hadis proves that bazı major günahlar are forgiven by fazilet of tövbe. These major günahlar exclude günahlar related to the haklar of insanî beings.

1875.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The best way of seeking bağışlanma is for a kul to say: 'Allah'ım! You are my Sustainer. There is none worthy of ibadet besides You. You created me and I am Your kul. I will abide by Your covenant and Your promise to the best of my ability. I seek refuge in You from the evil which I have committed. I acknowledge Your bounties on me, and I acknowledge my günahlar, so bağışla me. None forgives günahlar except You.' One who says these words during the day with total conviction in them and passes away before the evening, will be from the people of Cennet. One who says them at night and passes away before the next morning, will be from the people of Cennet."(Bukhārī, Aḥmad)
1875.commentary: This du'ā' is said to be the best yol of seeking bağışlanma because, according to Ibn Abī Jamrah (رحمه الله), it incorporates çeşitli profound meanings and beautiful sözler of expression. In it a person acknowledges bütünāh's (ﷻ) Oneness and that He is the Creator, and he admits to the covenant made to bütünāh and expresses ümit of bütünāh's (ﷻ) promises. One acknowledges his evil and the bounties of His Sustainer, and attributes günah to himself. He displays his desire for attaining bağışlanma and confesses that none but bütünāh (ﷻ) can forgive him.

1876.text: When Resûlullah (ﷺ) used to complete his namaz, he would seek bağışlanma three times and say: 'O Allāh, You are peace and all peace is from You. You are most blessed, O possessor of might and honour!'"Al-Auzā'ī, one of the narrators of this hadis, was sordu:"How should one seek bağışlanma?"He cevap verdi:"Say, 'I seek bağışlanma from Allāh. I seek bağışlanma from Allāh.'"(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1876.commentary: Bu hadis daha önceki bir bölümde zikredilmiştir. Bkz. hadis 1415.

1877.text: Before Resûlullah (ﷺ) passed away he used to excessively say: 'Glory be to Allāh and praise be to Him. I seek bağışlanma from Allāh and I turn to Him in repentance.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Nasā'ī)
1877.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 114. It teaches that one should increase in iyilikler towards the end of one's life in emulation of the uygulama of the Messenger (ﷺ). It also bize öğretir ki īmān in bütünāh (ﷻ) is a prerequisite for bağışlanma because it is the foundation for the acceptance of iyilikler. Without īmān, one cannot be forgiven, nor will one receive any sevap in the ahiret for any of his iyilikler.

1878.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ)'i şöyle derken işittim:"Allah (ﷻ) says: 'Ey Âdemoğlu! I will bağışla you as long as you continue supplicating to Me and having ümit in Me and I will not mind. Ey Âdemoğlu! I will bağışla you even if your günahlar reach the height of the skies and you then seek bağışlanma from Me and I will not mind. Ey Âdemoğlu! If you come to Me with günahlar equivalent to the size of the earth and you then meet Me without having ascribed any partners with Me, I will come to you with the equivalent amount of bağışlanma.'"(Tirmidhī)
1878.commentary: Bu hadis was mentioned in a previous chapter. See hadis 442. It is repeated here to emphasise the overwhelming rahmet of bütünāh (ﷻ) and that one should asla regard one's günahlar as too great for bütünāh (ﷻ) to forgive.

1879.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"O assembly of women! Give sadaka and seek bağışlanma in abundance because I have seen that you are the majority of the inmates of cehennem ateşi."One of the women sordu:"Why are we the majority of the inmates of cehennem ateşi?"He cevap verdi:"You curse a lot and you are ungrateful to your husbands. Despite the fact that I see you deficient in intellect and religion, you can overpower a man of intelligence."She sordu:"What is the deficiency in our intellect and religion?"He dedi:"The şehadet of two women is equal to that of one man, and there are some days when you do not perform namaz (due to menstruation)."(Müslüman, Aḥmad, Ibn Mājah)
1879.commentary: "Kocalarınıza karşı nankörlük ediyorsunuz" ifadesi, kadınların genellikle kocalarının iyiliklerini ve ihsanlarını inkâr ettiği anlamına gelir.

1880.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The inhabitants of Cennet will eat and drink. They will have no need to defecate, blow their noses or urinate, rather, their food will produce a burp with the fragrance of musk. Glorifying Allāh (tasbīḥ) and expressing His greatness (taḥmīd) will be as natural to them as breathing."(Müslüman)
1880.commentary: cennet is a place of pristine purity. It is free of bütün forms of impurity, filth or dirt. A Muslim scholar was once asked how it was possible for Muslims to believe that they would not defecate or urinate in cennet despite eating food. He replied that the concept was not farfetched because a foetus in the mother's womb is nourished with food but does not defecate or urinate. Imām Qurṭubī (رحمه الله) stated that the dhikr of the people of cennet has been compared to breathing because her iki are performed without any effort. They will instinctively praise and glorify bütünāh (ﷻ) because their hearts will be radiant and overflowing with bütünāh's (ﷻ) recognition and sevgi.

1881.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) dedi: 'I have prepared for My salih kullar that which no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no heart has imagined.' Read if you wish: 'No soul knows what pleasures are hidden for him as a sevap for the deeds he carries out.'"(Sûre al-Sajdah, 17) (Bukhārī, Müslüman)

1882.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The first group to enter Cennet will be like the full moon. The next group will be like the brightest star in the sky. They will have no need to urinate, defecate, spit or blow their noses. Their combs will be of gold and their perspiration of musk. Their burners will burn fragrant aloes-wood. Their wives will be the wide-eyed damsels. All the men will be in appearance like their father, Ādam, sixty cubits in length."Another narration has:"Their utensils will be of gold and their perspiration of musk. Each of them will have two wives whose shin bones will be seen through the flesh because of their beauty. There will be no differences between them nor any hatred. Their hearts will be united, glorifying Allāh morning and evening."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad)
1882.commentary: bazı may ask why they will have fragrant burners when their bodily fragrance will be one of musk. The answer is that the fragrances of cennet will be merely for pleasure and enjoyment and not due to necessity. Men in cennet will bütün be handsome in form and features. None will be excessively tall, short, fat or thin. They will be around 30 meters in length because cennet will similarly be huge in size. her biri man will have a minimum of two wives excluding the damsels. The reference to their shin bones being seen through the flesh is to indicate their exceptional purity and beauty. Their hearts will be united and free from nefret because they will be purified of her distasteful quality before entering cennet.

1883.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Mūsā (عليه السلام) sordu his Sustainer: 'Who will have the lowest rank in Cennet?' He cevap verdi: 'It will be a person who will come after all the inhabitants of Cennet have entered Cennet and he will be told:"Enter Cennet."He will ask:"Ey Rabbim! How can I when the people have already settled down in their places and taken what has been prepared for them?"He will be told:"Would you be pleased if you have a kingdom like that of one of the kings of the world?"He will reply:"I will be pleased, Ey Rabbim!"Allāh will say to him:"You have that, and the like thereof, and the like thereof, and the like thereof, and the like thereof."When it is dedi to him the fifth time, he will say:"I am pleased."Allāh will say:"You will have that and ten times the like thereof. You will have whatever your heart desires and whatever pleases your eye."He will say:"I am pleased, Ey Rabbim!"(Mūsā عليه السلام) sordu:"Ey Rabbim! Who will be the highest in rank?"Allāh cevap verdi:"For those whom I choose, I have prepared their honour with My hands and I have sealed it. It is what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no heart has imagined."' (Müslüman)
1883.commentary: That the one lowest in rank will enjoy such a cennet, speaks volumes of bütünāh's (ﷻ) iyilik and grace upon His servants.

1884.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"I know who will be the last to leave cehennem ateşi and the last to enter Cennet. He will come out from cehennem ateşi dragging himself on the ground. Allah (ﷻ) will say to him: 'Go and enter Cennet.' He will go to Cennet and it will appear full to him. He will therefore turn back and say: 'Ey Rabbim! I found it full.' Allah (ﷻ) will say: 'Go and enter Cennet.' He will go to Cennet and it will appear full to him. He will therefore turn back and say: 'Ey Rabbim! I found it full.' Allah (ﷻ) will say: 'Go and enter Cennet. You will have a place the size of this world and ten times more – or you will have a place ten times this world.' He will say: 'Are You making fun of me – or are You joking with me – when You are the King?'"Ibn Mas'ūd (رضي الله عنه) dedi:"I saw Resûlullah (ﷺ) laughing until his molars were visible. He was diyerek: 'That will be the lowest of people in rank in Cennet.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Ibn Mājah)
1884.commentary: The Messenger (ﷺ) laughed because of the şekil in which the servant of bütünāh (ﷻ) will question his Sustainer.

1885.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"In Cennet, the mümin will have a tent made of a single hollow pearl. It will be sixty miles high. The mümin shall have family there and he will go around visiting them, but they will not see each other."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1885.commentary: Cennetteki evlerin büyüklüğü, onun genişliğinin bir göstergesidir. Müminin cennetteki evi, dünyadaki evinden katbekat büyük olacaktır.

1886.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"In Cennet there is a tree beneath which a strong, healthy, swift rider will not be able to ride across in a hundred years."Another narration from Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) has:"A rider will not be able to cross its shade in a hundred years."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1886.commentary: The extended shade of the trees of cennet should serve to encourage people to live such lives in dünya which will make them eligible to be from its inhabitants.

1887.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The people of Cennet will look up at the people in apartments above them just as you look at a glittering star moving on the horizon from the east or the west because of the difference in rank between them."The Sahâbe dedi:"Ey Allah'ın Resûlü! Will those be the ranks of the Messengers which only they will attain?"He dedi:"No, by the oath of that Being in whose control is my life, they are people who believed in Allāh and accepted the Messengers."(Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1887.commentary: Bu hadis, cennetteki herhangi bir grup ile kendilerinden üstün olanlar arasındaki mesafenin, doğu ile batı arası kadar olduğunu açıklar.

1888.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The length of a bow in Cennet is better than everything upon which the sun rises or sets."(Bukhārī)
1888.commentary: The smallest space or object in cennet is far superior to the bütün world because the former is eternal and everlasting while the latter is transient.

1889.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"There is a market-place in Cennet to which the people will go every Cuma. The northerly wind will blow, brushing over their faces and clothes causing their beauty and handsomeness to increase. They will return to their families with increased beauty and handsomeness. Their families will say to them: 'By Allāh, you have become more beautiful and handsome.' They will reply: 'By Allāh, you have also become more beautiful and handsome since we left.'"(Müslüman)
