1889.commentary: Bu hadis describes the fragrant breeze that will aromatise the inhabitants of cennet. It also indicates to the mutual sevgi and joy that will exist between families in cennet. The northerly wind has been mentioned because it generally brings rain to the Arab lands. Scholars state that tıpkı... gibi the women of cennet will not go to the market places of cennet, they should also not go to the shopping malls, bazaars and markets in dünya, except due to necessity.

1890.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"The people of Cennet will look at the upper apartments of Cennet just as you look at the stars in the sky."(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī)

1891.text: I was present in a gathering of Resûlullah (ﷺ) in which he described Cennet. Towards the end of his discussion, he dedi: 'In it is what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no heart of man has imagined.' He then recited: 'Their sides remain away from their sleeping places, calling on their Sustainer with korku and longing. And they spend out of what We provided for them. No soul knows what pleasures are hidden for him as a sevap for the deed he carried out.'"(Sûre al-Sajdah, 16-17) (Bukhārī, Müslüman)
1891.commentary: Bu hadis explains that one of the birçok rewards of performing Tahajjud Ṣalāh is that one will be greatly rewarded in cennet. Scholars state that Bu hadis proves that aḥādīth are a commentary of the Qur'ān. başka bir deyişle, the Qur'ān can only be correctly understood by a sahih anlayış of the aḥādīth.

1892.narrator: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and Abu Hurayrah (ra)
1892.text: Abū Sa'īd al-Khudrī (رضي الله عنه) and Abū Hurayrah (رضي الله عنه) narrate that Resûlullah (ﷺ) dedi:"When the people of Cennet enter Cennet, an announcer will proclaim: 'You will live and never die. You will be healthy and never fall ill. You will be young and never grow old. You will have bounties and never experience misery.'"(Müslüman)
1892.commentary: Unlike this dünya hayatı, the bounties and pleasures of cennet will be perpetual and everlasting. There will be no suffering or hardship of any sort, in accordance with the Qur'ānic verse: No difficulty shall afflict them there, neither will they be removed from there. (Sūrah al-Ḥijr, 48)

1893.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) will say to the one with the lowest rank in Cennet: 'Make a wish.' He will wish and wish. He will then ask him: 'Have you wished?' He will reply: 'Yes.' He will say to him: 'You have whatever you wished for and the like thereof.'"(Müslüman)

1894.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"Allah (ﷻ) will say to the inhabitants of Cennet: 'O inhabitants of Cennet!' They will reply: 'We are at your service, O our Sustainer, and we are pleased to be here. All good is in Your control.' Allāh will ask: 'Are you pleased?' They will reply: 'O our Sustainer! Why should we not be pleased when You have given us what You have not given any of Your creation?!' Allāh will ask: 'Should I not give you something better than that?' They will ask: 'What could be better than that?' Allāh will say: 'I bestow My pleasure upon you after which I will never be angry with you.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Tirmidhī)

1895.text: We were once with Resûlullah (ﷺ) as he looked at the full moon. He dedi: 'You will see your Sustainer in person just as you are seeing this moon. Your view of Him will not be impeded.'"(Bukhārī, Müslüman, Aḥmad, Tirmidhī)
1895.commentary: The sight of bütünāh (ﷻ) has been compared to the dolu moon because of the absolute certainty of the sighting as well as the ease with which it will happen.

1896.text: Resûlullah (ﷺ) şöyle buyurdu:"When the people of Cennet enter Cennet, Allāh will ask them: 'Do you desire that I give you anything more?' They will reply: 'Have You not illuminated our faces? Have You not admitted us into Cennet and saved us from cehennem ateşi?' The veil will then be lifted and they will not have been given anything that was more beloved to them than seeing their Sustainer."(Müslüman, Ḥākim)
1896.commentary: Bu hadis is desteklenen by the Qur'ānic verse: birçok faces on that day will be resplendent looking at their Sustainer. (Sūrah Qiyāmah, 22-23) O bütünāh, grant us the good fortune of viewing Your blessed countenance, O çoğu Merciful of those who show rahmet!
